building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_c.value_translated: Mountain Colony placeholder rom_building_flavour_texts.loc

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_c.value_original: A communal expanse set aside for public use, unfolding as a bustling tapestry of activity.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_c.value_translated: Un extenso espacio comunal reservado para uso público, desplegándose como un bullicioso tapiz de actividad.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_c.value_original: "I warned you not to go near those scrolls with that pipe!"
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_c.value_translated: «¡Te advertí que no te acercaras a esos pergaminos con esa pipa!»

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_c.value_original: This library is so vast that it holds a section dedicated to the art of Songs.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_c.value_translated: Esta biblioteca es tan vasta que cuenta con una sección dedicada al arte de las canciones.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_c.value_original: Young scions and dusty professors from all over Gondor wander these halls.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_c.value_translated: Jóvenes herederos y polvorientos profesores de todo Gondor deambulan por estos pasillos.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_c.value_original: A Gondorian will always know the taste of their own cities' bread.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_c.value_translated: Un gondoriano siempre conocerá el sabor del pan de su propia ciudad.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_c.value_original: Local farmers sell their harvest here, stocking the populace with essential provisions.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_c.value_translated: Los agricultores locales venden su cosecha aquí, abasteciendo a la población con provisiones esenciales.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_c.value_original: Droughts, plagues or, worse, orcs. Food must be stored to ensure the survival of Gondor.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_c.value_translated: Sequías, plagas o, peor aún, orcos. La comida debe ser almacenada para garantizar la supervivencia de Gondor.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_c.value_original: A square surrounded by stonepillars, featuring local sculptors' works and providing a space to discuss current events.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_c.value_translated: Una plaza rodeada de pilares de piedra, con obras de escultores locales y proporcionando un espacio para discutir eventos actuales.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_c.value_original: Gondorians assemble here to partake in the city's events, from spectacles to arts.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_c.value_translated: Los gondorianos se reúnen aquí para participar en los eventos de la ciudad, desde espectáculos hasta artes.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_c.value_original: Local merchants, artisans and nobles gather here in grand feasts to celebrate their Kingdom.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_c.value_translated: Los comerciantes locales, artesanos y nobles se reúnen aquí en grandes festines para celebrar su Reino.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_c.value_original: This civic edifice serves as a hub for governance and communal affairs.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_c.value_translated: Este edificio cívico sirve como centro de gobierno y asuntos comunitarios.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_c.value_original: Here discussions unfold guided by the wisdom that has shaped the realm through the ages.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_c.value_translated: Aquí las discusiones se desarrollan guiadas por la sabiduría que ha moldeado el reino a través de los siglos.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_c.value_original: An august chamber of justice, adorned with stone pillars and rich tapestries depicting tales of honor.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_c.value_translated: Una augusta cámara de justicia, adornada con pilares de piedra y ricos tapices que representan historias de honor.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_c.value_original: The Citadel harbors the governing heart of Gondor: austere halls echoing with the footsteps of Stewards and Kings of old.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_c.value_translated: La Ciudadela alberga el corazón gobernante de Gondor: austeros salones que resuenan con los pasos de los Senescales y Reyes de antaño.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_c.value_original: A mug of ale and a large enough hay bed is enough for a weary traveler.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_c.value_translated: Una jarra de cerveza y una cama de heno lo suficientemente grande es suficiente para un viajero cansado.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_c.value_original: Local farmers, merchants and artisans board here, boasting about their work .
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_c.value_translated: Los agricultores, comerciantes y artesanos locales se alojan aquí, presumiendo de su trabajo.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_c.value_original: A renown stop for people of all trades, from Gondor and beyond.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_c.value_translated: Un lugar renombrado para personas de todos los oficios, desde Gondor y más allá.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_c.value_original: Artisans and farmers from all over the countryside gather here to sell their goods.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_c.value_translated: Artesanos y agricultores de todas partes se reúnen aquí para vender sus productos.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_c.value_original: A place of laughter and quarrels, where merchants can hawk their wares.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_c.value_translated: Un lugar de risas y peleas, donde los comerciantes pueden vender sus mercancías.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_c.value_original: With the right amount of castars, anything can be bought in here.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_c.value_translated: Con la cantidad adecuada de castars, cualquier cosa puede ser comprada aquí.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_f.value_original: Fair and fertile townlands, tended by the commoners for the good of the Realm.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_f.value_translated: Tierras justas y fértiles, cuidadas por los plebeyos por el bien del Reino.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_f.value_original: Herding cattle is vastly preferable to herding cats.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_f.value_translated: Cuidar ganado es preferible a cuidar gatos.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_f.value_original: The cattle roams the fields with an envious carelessness.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_f.value_translated: El ganado pasea por los campos con una despreocupación envidiable.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_f.value_original: The cow is a versatile, profitable animal.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_f.value_translated: La vaca es un animal versátil y provechoso.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_f.value_original: An apple plucked from a tree is ten times tastier than one bought at the market.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_f.value_translated: Una manzana arrancada de un árbol es diez veces más sabrosa que una comprada en el mercado.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_f.value_original: A dedicated group of farmers tends to carefully nurtured trees, ensuring each one bears quality produce.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_f.value_translated: Un grupo dedicado de agricultores cuida con esmero los árboles cultivados, asegurándose de que cada uno produzca frutos de calidad.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_f.value_original: Robust trees filled with fruits populate the countryside, creating a vast expanse of agricultural richness.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_f.value_translated: Árboles robustos llenos de frutas pueblan el campo, creando una vasta extensión de riqueza agrícola.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_f.value_original: A rustic manor, surrounded by verdant fields of wheat and barley.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_f.value_translated: Una mansión rústica, rodeada de campos verdes de trigo y cebada.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_f.value_original: A sturdy stone structure nestled beside a wheat field, humming with the rhythmic sound of turning wheels.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_f.value_translated: Una sólida estructura de piedra junto a un campo de trigo, zumbando con el sonido rítmico de las ruedas giratorias.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_f.value_original: Enormous fields of grain encircle hamlets inhabited by local farmers.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_f.value_translated: Enormes campos de grano rodean aldeas habitadas por granjeros locales.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_f.value_original: The vast and fertile lands of Gondor will serve well for the Realm's shepherds.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_f.value_translated: Las vastas y fértiles tierras de Gondor servirán bien para los pastores del Reino.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_f.value_original: Sheep pens keep their predators, both man and beast, at bay.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_f.value_translated: Los corrales de ovejas mantienen a raya a sus depredadores, tanto humanos como bestias.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_f.value_original: A labirinth of pens and fences, to confuse the sheep before they are sheared by their masters!
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_f.value_translated: Un laberinto de corrales y cercas, ¡para confundir a las ovejas antes de ser esquiladas por sus amos!

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_i.value_original: An investment in the economy is a good investment for both the local Lords and the city-folk.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_i.value_translated: Una inversión en la economía es una buena inversión tanto para los señores locales como para los habitantes de la ciudad.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_i.value_original: "Careful planning, not whips and lashes, will make our cities grow."
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_i.value_translated: «Una planificación cuidadosa, sin látigos ni azotes, hará crecer nuestras ciudades.»

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_i.value_original: A local warehouse for stones, timber and mortar.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_i.value_translated: Un almacén local para piedras, madera y mortero.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_i.value_original: Producing building supplies in our cities will make their expansion faster, stronger, better.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_i.value_translated: Producir suministros de construcción en nuestras ciudades hará que su expansión sea más rápida, más fuerte, mejor.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_i.value_original: A student of engineering has recently opened up shop here. Do not expect too much.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_i.value_translated: Un estudiante de ingeniería ha abierto recientemente una tienda aquí. No esperes demasiado.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_i.value_original: Ropes, timber and hard-working folks are all that is needed to make a great machine of war.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_i.value_translated: Cuerdas, madera y gente trabajadora son todo lo que se necesita para hacer una gran máquina de guerra.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_i.value_original: The Kingdom's most experienced engineers have made this settlement a marvel of their craft.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_i.value_translated: Los ingenieros más experimentados del Reino han convertido este asentamiento en una maravilla de su oficio.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_i.value_original: However little this community produces, it must be stored and exported in vessels.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_i.value_translated: Por poca que sea la producción de esta comunidad, debe ser almacenada y exportada en recipientes.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_i.value_original: "You are a potter, Húrin! You cannot expect me to deliver all of this wine in a box!"
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_i.value_translated: «¡Eres un alfarero, Húrin! ¡No puedes esperar que entregue todo este vino en una caja!»

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_i.value_original: Heat, sweat and clay stand as the foundations of a commercial empire.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_i.value_translated: Calor, sudor y arcilla son los cimientos de un imperio comercial.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_i.value_original: Tradition and need drive Gondor's crafts-people to take up the carving skills of their forefathers.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_i.value_translated: La tradición y la necesidad impulsan a los artesanos de Gondor a adquirir las habilidades de tallado de sus antepasados.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_i.value_original: "We must remember our glorious past by committing it to the stone."
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_i.value_translated: «Debemos recordar nuestro glorioso pasado al grabarlo en la piedra.»

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_i.value_original: "Behold, the Heroes of Numenór and the Kingdoms-in-Exile! It is as if they have come to life!"
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_i.value_translated: «¡He aquí, los héroes de Numenor y los Reinos en el Exilio! ¡Es como si hubieran cobrado vida!»

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_i.value_original: Diligent artisans preparing clothes for Gondor's citizens and fabric for their trades.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_i.value_translated: Diligentes artesanos preparando ropa para los ciudadanos de Gondor y tela para sus oficios.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_i.value_original: The Gondorians will always need the strongest sails, as well as the most fashionable outfits.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_i.value_translated: Los gondorianos siempre necesitarán las velas más fuertes, así como los atuendos más elegantes.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_i.value_original: Proud stand the banners of Gondor! The black and white wool finely worked by expert hands.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_i.value_translated: ¡Orgullosas se alzan los estandartes de Gondor! La lana negra y blanca finamente trabajada por manos expertas.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_m.value_original: Swords and shields for paesants alike!
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_m.value_translated: ¡Espadas y escudos para campesinos por igual!

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_m.value_original: Trained and disciplined, knights and their mounts ride from the stables to the frontlines.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_m.value_translated: Entrenados y disciplinados, los caballeros y sus monturas cabalgan desde los establos hacia las líneas del frente.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_m.value_original: Boasting the banner of the White Swan, these buildings echo with the resounding hooves of noble steeds and the clatter of armor.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_m.value_translated: Portando el estandarte del Cisne Blanco, estos edificios resuenan con el estruendo de los nobles corceles y el tintineo de la armadura.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_m.value_original: Clad in steel plate, the stalwart defenders of Gondor train, dine and sleep in these halls.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_m.value_translated: Ataviados en placas de acero, los valientes defensores de Gondor entrenan, cenan y duermen en estos salones.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_m.value_original: The Royal Barracks serve as the forge where the wardensof Gondor are tempered, their steel resolve matched only by the gleam of their spears.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_m.value_translated: Los barracones reales sirven como la forja donde los custodios de Gondor son templados, su firme determinación de acero igualada solo por el brillo de sus lanzas.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_p.value_original: Fishermen and merchants argue every day to grab the last remaining dock.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_p.value_translated: Pescadores y comerciantes discuten todos los días para agenciarse el último muelle disponible.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_p.value_original: In this place, wood, ropes, and sails converge to shape the future of Gondor's maritime strength.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_p.value_translated: En este lugar, la madera, las cuerdas y las velas convergen para dar forma al futuro de la fuerza marítima de Gondor.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_p.value_original: A crucial maritime hub, this wharf readies warships for deployment, ensuring a vigilant naval defense along the Kingdom's shorelines.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_p.value_translated: Un puerto marítimo crucial, este muelle prepara buques de guerra para su despliegue, asegurando una defensa naval vigilante a lo largo de las costas del Reino.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_p.value_original: Look! The fleets of Númenor come alive again!
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_p.value_translated: ¡Mira! ¡Las flotas de Númenor vuelven a cobrar vida!

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_p.value_original: This port buzzes with trade and traffic, accommodating vessels of various sizes.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_p.value_translated: Este puerto rezuma con el comercio y el tráfico, acomodando embarcaciones de diferentes tamaños.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_p.value_original: A versatile harbor is crucial for welcoming ships from all trade routes.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_p.value_translated: Un puerto versátil es crucial para dar la bienvenida a los barcos de todas las rutas comerciales.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_p.value_original: A vibrant hub lining the waterfront with warehouses and markets, serving as the epicenter of maritime commerce and industry.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_p.value_translated: Un vibrante centro que bordea la costa con almacenes y mercados, sirviendo como epicentro del comercio marítimo e industria.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_r.value_original: A symbol of Gondorian pride, gracing the main square with its elegance and tales of the past.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_r.value_translated: Un símbolo del orgullo gondoriano, adornando la plaza principal con su elegancia y relatos del pasado.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_r.value_original: This graveyard serves as a dignified resting place for the departed souls of the local nobility.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_r.value_translated: Este cementerio sirve como un lugar de descanso digno para las almas fallecidas de la nobleza local.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_r.value_original: A collection of ornate burial mounds, with tombs fit for the heroes of old.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_r.value_translated: Una colección de suntuosos túmulos funerarios, con tumbas dignas de los héroes de antaño.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_r.value_original: A marvel of architectural artistry, these complex house illustrious figures and preserve the legacy of their lineage.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_r.value_translated: Una maravilla de la artesanía arquitectónica, estas casas complejas ilustran figuras y preservan el legado de su linaje.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_r.value_original: The youth of Gondor delight in play before refreshing themselves with a splash from this fountain.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_r.value_translated: Los jóvenes de Gondor se deleitan en jugar antes de refrescarse con un chapuzón de esta fuente.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_r.value_original: Rising in dignified splendor, this statue commands the attention of the locals, serving as a reminder of the history of Gondor.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_r.value_translated: Elevándose en esplendor dignificado, esta estatua demanda la atención de los lugareños, sirviendo como un recordatorio de la historia de Gondor.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_r.value_original: This elegant courtyard serves as the distinguished venue where local nobles meet with the townspeople, merchants and other esteemed guests.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_r.value_translated: Este elegante patio sirve como el distinguido lugar donde los nobles locales se reúnen con los habitantes del pueblo, comerciantes y otros invitados de renombre.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_r.value_original: "...and in that space stood the houses and domed tombs of bygone kings and lords, for ever silent between the mountain and the tower."
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_r.value_translated: «...y en ese espacio se alzaban las casas y tumbas abovedadas de antiguos reyes y señores, para siempre en silencio entre la montaña y la torre.»

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_s.value_original: A modest structure that efficiently caters to the immediate needs of local outposts and patrols.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_s.value_translated: Una estructura modesta que atiende eficientemente a las necesidades inmediatas de puestos y patrullas locales.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_s.value_original: A bustling workshop, crafting essential arms and armor for the local defenders.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_s.value_translated: Un taller bullicioso, creando armas y armaduras esenciales para los defensores locales.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_s.value_original: From dusk til' dawn, smoke rises from this forge to equip the armies of Gondor.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_s.value_translated: Desde el atardecer hasta el amanecer, el humo se eleva de esta fragua para equipar a los ejércitos de Gondor.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_s.value_original: This foundry is a sprawling complex where master artisans forge weapons and armors of the highest quality.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_s.value_translated: Esta fundición es un complejo extenso donde maestros artesanos forjan armas y armaduras de la más alta calidad.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_s.value_original: As an intermediary hub, the distributor extends its reach to multiple outposts, carefully managing the distribution of supplies.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_s.value_translated: Como centro intermediario, el distribuidor amplía su alcance a múltiples puestos, gestionando cuidadosamente la distribución de suministros.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_s.value_original: Reinforced walls safeguard a substantial reserves of strategically-positioned supplies.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_s.value_translated: Las paredes reforzadas protegen una reserva sustancial de suministros estratégicamente posicionados.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_s.value_original: A sprawling complex caters to the supply chain of the frontline for the armies of Gondor.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_s.value_translated: Un complejo extenso atiende a la cadena de suministro del frente para los ejércitos de Gondor.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_w.value_original: All along the watchtower sentinels keep the view.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_w.value_translated: A lo largo de la torre de vigilancia, centinelas mantened la vista.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_w.value_original: The defense of Gondor must reach far and wide to protect its people
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_w.value_translated: La defensa de Gondor debe extenderse lejos y ampliamente para proteger a su pueblo.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_w.value_original: Scouts on horseback and silent rangers roam these lands. Nothing gets past their eyes.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_w.value_translated: Exploradores a caballo y montaraces silenciosos recorren estas tierras. Nada escapa a su mirada.

building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_w.value_original: Experienced envoys stand vigilant here; to warn, advise and rouse their people.
building_flavour_texts_flavour_rom_gon_w.value_translated: Experimentados enviados permanecen vigilantes aquí; para advertir, aconsejar y incitar a su pueblo.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Once a lively abode of many families, ghosts now haunt this group of huts.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una vez el animado hogar de muchas familias, ahora fantasmas acechan este grupo de chozas.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Once a proud center of culture and power, now reduced to rubble and ash, its streets silent beneath the weight of forgotten glories.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una vez fue un orgulloso centro de cultura y poder. Ahora ha sido reducido a escombros y cenizas, con sus calles silenciosas bajo el peso de glorias olvidadas.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Once a proud center of culture and power, now reduced to rubble and ash, its streets silent beneath the weight of forgotten glories.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una vez fue un orgulloso centro de cultura y poder. Ahora ha sido reducido a escombros y cenizas, con sus calles silenciosas bajo el peso de glorias olvidadas.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Once a bustling harbor of trade and life, now its piers lie broken, its warehouses burned, and the sea reclaims what remains.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una vez fue un puerto bullicioso de comercio y vida. Ahora sus muelles yacen destrozados, sus almacenes quemados y el mar reclama lo que queda.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Once a bustling harbor of trade and life, now its piers lie broken, its warehouses burned, and the sea reclaims what remains.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una vez fue un puerto bullicioso de comercio y vida. Ahora sus muelles yacen destrozados, sus almacenes quemados y el mar reclama lo que queda.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Prized since the Aulendur learned their craft, copper was valued above gold by Mahtan, father of the wife of Fëanor; he earned the epithet Urundil because of the copper circlet he wore.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The northern Edain of the First Age crafted the new and greedy swords, as Tom Bombadil calls them, from this red metal, and placed copper items amoung the burial hoards of the Barrow-downs.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Even if it lacked the sheen of other priceless metals, the dwarves worked with copper all the same.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Copper is used in a variety of everyday objects such as pots or pans, so it is no surprise to see it in such demand.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Open fields and wooded hills teaming with game, ripe for those that would claim their piece.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: There's no open wall-space left, for these lodges are filled with trophies of the hunt.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Where the hunters brag over their trophies and a rankings board is kept, fostering some fun competition.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Hunters and trappers share routes, traps, and market contacts so fresh pelts move from hunter to buyer more quickly.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The heat and pressure within Middle-earth crystallize ordinary minerals into the stunning gems coveted by many.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: No gem unearthed here is like the Arkenstone, much less a Silmaril, but they are beautiful nonetheless.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Even the Rings of Power needed gemstones for their settings.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The deeper the delving, the greater reward.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Gold is highly prized by all manner of artisan and thief, and used for many things from jewelry to currency.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Though this mine is small in size, never underestimate the evil that the lure of gold may stir.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: It is said gold was the chosen metal of Morgoth; perhaps that is why so many succumb to it.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Greed and avarice are but words when compared to the amount of gold pouring out of these mines.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Common herbs that many would feed to pigs in fact have unique healing properties.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A local herbalist can treat most ailments, for the great healers are seldom found outside the capitals of Middle-earth.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "Now where did I leave my mortar and pestle?"
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Tales of the skill of the great healers circulate far and wide. Getting gravely injured or catching a debilitating ailment allows one to witness the skill up close.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Without this ore, there would be no war... an interesting thought.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The uses for iron are innumberable, but in this Third Age, often equally deplorable.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The Iron Hills of the dwarves are rich in its namesake, which is probably why they're dotted with mines like these.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The secret of iron has always carried with it a mystery. You must learn its riddle and you must learn its discipline. In iron you can trust.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The jungles of far-east Harad are home to the mightiest beasts in Middle-earth. Southrons call them Mûmakil. Sam doubted anyone back home would believe he and Frodo saw an Oliphaunt in Ithilien.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Brief shelter before the next hunt. The demand for ivory almost matches the demand for gold.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Hunting the mighty Mûmakil is not for the faint of heart; every Southron here is ready to die trying.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The Black Serpent of Harad may now have outlawed the poaching of the majestic Mûmakil for their ivory tusks, but the ivory industry must not have gotten word.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The wealth of Moria came not from gold or jewels, but Mithril.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: All folk desired it. It could be beaten like copper, and polished like glass; and the dwarves could make of it a metal, light and yet harder than tempered steel
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The Ñoldor and Númenóreans used Mithril in many of their ancient crafts, for its metal and sheen never grew dull even to the ends of the ages.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Deeper and deeper the mines now lead, endless Mithril, endless greed.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A simple one tends the insects here. They are more his friends than any real folk.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: When the first silk garment was presented to an Easterling chieftain, he immediately decreed the silkworm indespesnsable to Rhûn's economy.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Who would have thought that the finest fibres to be woven into the finest clothing would come from sticky proteins secreted from insects?
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Fewer ruined cocoons, cleaner reels, and faster turnover means the silk sold here brings better profit.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "This forest is old. Very old."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Beech, oak, chestnut, ash. You'll find these here and many more.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: At least the Ents were not the friends and caretakers of these trees or there would be a real problem.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: As efficient in clearing woodlands for their timber as the Númenóreans in felling the vast forest once covering much of Eriador.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: No self-respecting hobbit, man, or dwarf travels anywhere without his pipe. Here they can purchase a few tobacco leaves.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Tobacco leaves must be dried once harvested. Suspended from rafters over smouldering coals, the workers pass by the barn hoping to catch a whiff.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: An operation so well-planned that one of the Hornblower family's most experienced plantation foremen defected.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Attempting to replace Old Toby and Longbottom Leaf as the premier pipe-weed in Middle-earth.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "Dash-it-all keep that shadow back in Mordor, my grapes need eight hours of direct sunlight every day!"
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The profit margin isn't too shabby. Everyone enjoys some wine now and again.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Nothing pairs better with a roast than a goblet of fine red wine.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Casks of wine fill the storehouses, aging for at least five years. That's what makes the wine so good, and why orders are placed so far in advance.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A humble beginning, where hope is built brick by brick, under the vigilance of the Lonely Mountain.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un humilde comienzo, donde la esperanza se construye ladrillo a ladrillo, bajo la vigilancia de la montaña.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Rising from ruin, driven by the trade of dwarves and worksmanship of men.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Alzándose de entre las ruinas, impulsado por el comercio de enanos y la habilidad de los hombres.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Bustling streets, where deals are struck and mead flows freely.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Calles bulliciosas, donde se hacen tratos y la hidromiel fluye libremente.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: One of the jewels of Dale, where markets overflow and prosperity reigns.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una de las joyas de Valle, donde los mercados rebosan y la prosperidad reina.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A shadow of glory, long fell into ruin waiting for the return of the King under the Mountain.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una sombra de gloria, hace mucho cayó en ruinas esperando el regreso del Rey bajo la Montaña.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A simple start, where tales of old shall foster hopes for the new.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un comienzo sencillo, donde las historias antiguas fomentarán esperanzas para lo nuevo.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A stone refuge for the vigilant, watchful of distant mountains.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un refugio de piedra para los vigilantes, atentos a las montañas distantes.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: With the Smaug gone, people now once again seek strength in unity.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Con el dragón desaparecido, la gente ahora vuelve a buscar fuerza en la unidad.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Defended by proud men, recalling the strength of days before the dragon.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Defendido por hombres orgullosos, recordando la fuerza de los días antes del dragón.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "One Esgaroth has burned, yes- but we can build another!"
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «Esgaroth ha ardido, sí, ¡pero podemos construir otra!».

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: High walls arrayed with scorpions and keen archers- no dragon can pass our leaguer this time!
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: ¡Altos muros adornados con escorpiones y arqueros expertos - ningún dragón podrá pasar nuestro campamento esta vez!

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The beating heart of Dale's cities, where all roads and errands meet.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: El corazón palpitante de las ciudades de Valle, donde confluyen todos los caminos y viajeros.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: As if scorched by Smaug, only black, burnt mounds now remain here.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Como si hubieran sido quemados por Smaug, solo quedan aquí montículos negros y quemados.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The scent of bread and loaf is ever present around this place.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: El aroma de pan y hogaza está siempre presente en este lugar.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Shelves stacked high with the bounty of the land and lake.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Estantes repletos de los frutos de la tierra y el lago.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Storing the harvests of summer, preparing for both feast and famine, or winter.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Almacenando las cosechas del verano, preparándose tanto para la abundancia como para la escasez..., o para el invierno.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The seat of governance, where Bard’s lineage ensures the city thrives.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: La sede del gobierno, donde el linaje de Bardo garantiza la prosperidad de la ciudad.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Where men of proud lineage and deep wisdom debate the future of Dale.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Donde hombres de linaje orgulloso y profunda sabiduría debaten el futuro de Valle.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A place of opulence and grandeur, where the line of Bard holds court.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un lugar de opulencia y grandeza, desde donde el linaje de Bardo ejerce su dominio.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Resting places for travellers from distant lands.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Lugares de descanso para viajeros de tierras lejanas.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A warm fire, a mug of ale, and stories of adventure.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Lugares de descanso para viajeros de tierras lejanas.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Dwarves, men, and even the wood-elves buy and sell their wares here.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un fuego cálido, una jarra de cerveza y relatos de aventuras.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Where gossip flows as freely as the ale.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Donde los rumores fluyen tan libremente como la cerveza.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A marketplace filled with the odour of ale and the sound of haggling.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los enanos, los hombres e incluso los elfos del bosque compran y venden sus mercancías aquí.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A place of merriment and trade, where the people gather for festivals and fairs.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un mercado lleno del aroma de la cerveza y el sonido de los regateos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Where the wealthy of Dale’s merchants are housed and guarded.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un lugar de alegría y comercio, donde la gente se reúne para festivales y ferias.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The nucleus of commerce, where fortunes are made and lost.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Donde residen y son protegidos los ricos mercaderes de Dale.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A powerful coalition of the most powerful tradesmen of Dale, whose whims shape the market and its prosperity.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: El núcleo del comercio, donde se hacen y se pierden fortunas.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A nexus of commerce, connecting Dale with the wider world.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una poderosa coalición de los más poderosos comerciantes de Dale, cuyos caprichos moldean el mercado y su prosperidad.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The starting point for those who seek to bring trade to the far reaches of Middle-earth.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un nexo de comercio, conectando Dale con el resto del mundo.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Fine wines and spirits from the best vineyards of Dorwinion and beyond.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: El punto de partida para aquellos que buscan explorar las lejanas tierras de la Tierra Media.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Facilitating the exchange of goods within the lands of men and dwarves.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Facilitando el intercambio de bienes dentro de las tierras de los hombres y los enanos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Purveyors of the finest vintages, ensuring the cellars of Dale never run dry.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Vinos y licores finos de los mejores viñedos de Rhovanion y más allá.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A place where merchants and connoisseurs gather to discuss the best of the vine.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Proveedores de los mejores vinos, asegurando que las bodegas de Dale nunca se queden sin existencias.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The sweeping golden fields that sustain Dale, tended by the hands of many.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un lugar donde los mercaderes y conocedores se reúnen para discutir lo mejor de la vid.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Watching over the herds that provide meat and leather for Dale.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: El verde ondulante que sostiene Dale, cuidado por las manos de muchos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Where livestock is kept, prepared for market, feast, or the tanner.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Vigilando a los rebaños que proveen carne y cuero para Dale.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Rows of fruit-bearing trees, promising a sweet bounty.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Donde se cuidan a los animales, listos para el mercado o el festín- o el curtidor.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Producing the best cuts of meat for the tables of Dale.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Produciendo los mejores cortes de carne para las mesas de Dale.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The skilled hands that ensure a good harvest from the orchards.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Filas de árboles frutales, prometiendo una dulce recompensa.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A modest farm, providing for the table and the market.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Las manos habilidosas que aseguran una buena cosecha de los huertos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Where the fruits of labor are grown and gathered.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Donde se cultivan y se recolectan los frutos del trabajo.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Turning the harvest into sustenance, fueling the city’s growth.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una modesta granja, proveyendo para la mesa y el mercado.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The guardians of the flocks that dot the fields of Rhovanion.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Convirtiendo la cosecha en sustento, alimentando el crecimiento de la ciudad.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Expansive lands worked by many, feeding the realm's ever-growing population.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Tierras expansivas trabajadas por muchos, alimentando la creciente población del reino.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Enclosures for the flocks, ensuring a steady supply of wool and meat.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los guardianes de los rebaños que salpican los campos de Rhovanion.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Hammers ring out, crafting both beauty and blade.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Recintos para los rebaños, asegurando un suministro constante de lana y carne.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Where wool is spun, and mutton is prepared for our people's tables.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Donde se hilan las lanas y se prepara el cordero para las mesas de nuestro pueblo.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The artistry of Dale, turning the ordinary wood into something extraordinary.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los martillos resuenan, forjando tanto la belleza como la hoja.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Crafting homes and halls with the timber of Mirkwood
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: La maestría de Dale, convirtiendo la madera ordinaria en algo extraordinario.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Masters of their craft, ensuring every beam stands true.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Construyendo hogares y salones con la madera del Bosque Negro.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "The dwarves have taught us their ways with metal, now it is time we put the knowledge to good work!"
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Maestros de su oficio, asegurando que cada viga se mantenga firme.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "With our gold free from the clutches of the Dragon, it can be made into works of art by our smiths."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los enanos nos han enseñado sus formas de trabajar el metal, ¡ahora es hora de poner ese conocimiento en buen uso!

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Dale's jewellers are always striving to out-do the gems of the dragon-hoard.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Con nuestro oro liberado de las garras del dragón, puede ser convertido en obras de arte por nuestros herreros.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Stone and timber, building the future of Dale.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Nuestros joyeros siempre están esforzándose por superar las gemas del tesoro del dragón.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Essential goods for building, from iron nails to oak beams.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Piedra y madera, construyendo el futuro de Dale.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Where raw resources become the tools of trade and war.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Bienes esenciales para la construcción, desde clavos de hierro hasta vigas de roble.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "Skilled hands create vessels to hold the mead of our dwarven friends!"
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Donde los recursos en bruto se convierten en herramientas de comercio y guerra.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Kilns of Dale burn bright, turning clay to works of delight.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: ¡Manos habilidosas crean vasijas para proteger la hidromiel de nuestros amigos enanos!

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Looms toil day and night, garbing the proud men of Dale in ever prouder fabric.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Las hornos de Dale arden brillantes, convirtiendo la arcilla en obras de deleite.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Blending fire with earth produces the finest bricks for our sturdy homes.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Mezclar fuego con tierra produce los mejores ladrillos para nuestros robustos hogares.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Wool is spun into the finest cloth in all of Rhovanion.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los telares trabajan día y noche, vistiendo a los orgullosos hombres de Dale con telas aún más orgullosas.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Training the men of Dale to defend their home, hearth, and kin.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: La lana es hilada en la tela más fina de todo Rhovanion.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Mass-producing the garments that warm the men of Dale in winter’s chill.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Produciendo en masa las prendas que calientan a los hombres de Dale en el frío del invierno.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "When creatures of shadow or those golden lordlings bump us in the night, here we learn to bump back."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Entrenando a los hombres de Dale para defender su hogar, su tierra y su familia.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "No men in Middle-earth can surpass our riders, save for our cousins in Rohan."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «Ningún hombre de la Tierra Media puede superar a nuestros jinetes, salvo nuestros primos de Rohan».

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The finest and proudest steeds, reserved for the nobles of Dale.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los mejores y más orgullosos corceles, reservados para los nobles de Valle.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Where soldiers train, ready to issue forth at a moment’s notice.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Donde los soldados se entrenan, listos para salir en cualquier momento.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The elite infantry, sworn to protect Dale’s royal family and its treasures.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: La fuerza de élite, jurada a proteger a la familia real de Dale y sus tesoros.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "If swords are no more use here, how about a thousand arrows?"
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: PLACEHOLDER

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Shooting further and more accurate, elite archers are trained here.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: PLACEHOLDER

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Where the river meets the city, a hub of trade and travel.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Donde el río se encuentra con la ciudad, un centro de comercio y viaje.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Ships come and go, carrying goods to and from distant lands.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Las naves vienen y van, llevando bienes hacia y desde tierras lejanas.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Building and repairing the vessels that keep Dale’s trade routes open.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Construyendo y reparando las embarcaciones que mantienen abiertas las rutas comerciales de Valle.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Bustling with activity, labour, and the creaking of hulls, ships of war are produced here by the dozens.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Lleno de actividad, trabajo y el crujido de los cascos, aquí se producen docenas de naves de guerra.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A testament to Dale's valour, pride, and trials it has overcome.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un testamento a nuestro valor, nuestro orgullo y las pruebas que hemos superado.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Resting place for those that have passed beyond the confines of this world.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Lugar de descanso para aquellos que han pasado más allá de los confines de este mundo.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Ancient tombs that echo with the legacy of those who have passed on.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Tumbas antiguas que resuenan con el legado de aquellos que han partido.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The resting place of Dale's mightiest and doughtiest, laid to sleep amid the eternal stone.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: El lugar de descanso de nuestros más poderosos y valientes, los cuales yacen dormidos entre la piedra eterna.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Forging weapons and tools, vital to both war and industry.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: La forja de armas y herramientas, fundamental tanto para la guerra como para la industria.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Long chains of supplies to ensure our forces are always well-fed and well provisioned.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Largas cadenas de suministros para asegurar que nuestras fuerzas siempre estén bien alimentadas y bien provistas.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "Our blacksmits can link rings and forge swords that can rival those of the Lonely Mountain."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «Nuestros herreros pueden unir anillos y forjar espadas que pueden rivalizar con las de la Montaña Solitaria».

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Here metal is wrought into mail, buckler, corslets, axes, and swords on an impressive scale.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Nuestros herreros negros pueden enlazar anillos y forjar espadas que pueden rivalizar con las de la Montaña Solitaria.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Long chains of supplies to ensure Dale's forces are always well-fed and well provisioned.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Largas cadenas de suministro para garantizar que las fuerzas de Dale estén siempre bien alimentadas y bien abastecidas.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Here metal is wrought like fishes mail, as well as buckler and corslets and axes and swords.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Aquí el metal es forjado en mallas de escamas, así como escudos y corseletes y hachas y espadas.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Managing the flow of arms and wares throughout the lands for the hosts of Dale.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Gestionando el flujo de armas y mercancías por todo el territorio para nuestros anfitriones.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "Everyone knows that supplies are the blood and veins of any army, so we must protect ours at any cost."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Todos saben que los suministros son la sangre y las venas de cualquier ejército, por lo que debemos proteger los nuestros a cualquier precio.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The heart of the Kingdom's supply network, ensuring efficiency and order.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: El corazón de la red de suministro del Reino, asegurando eficiencia y orden.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "Never again will any orc, or dragon, pass our vigilance."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: El corazón de la red de suministro del Reino, asegurando eficiencia y orden.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A distant sentinel, standing guard over the farthest frontiers of the realm.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un centinela distante, en pie de guardia sobre las fronteras más lejanas de nuestro reino.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Where the swiftest riders of Dale are dispatched to carry messages and scout the lands.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Donde los jinetes más veloces de Valle son enviados para llevar mensajes y explorar las tierras.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The diplomatic heart of Dale, where alliances are forged, and envoys are received.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: El corazón diplomático de Valle, donde se forjan alianzas y se reciben enviados.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The diplomatic heart of Dale, where alliances are forged, and envoys are received.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: El corazón diplomático de Valle, donde se forjan alianzas y se reciben enviados.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A humble beginning, where hope is built brick by brick, under the vigilance of the Mountain.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un humilde comienzo, donde la esperanza se construye ladrillo a ladrillo, bajo la vigilancia de la montaña.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Rising from ruin, driven by the trade of dwarves and worksmanship of men.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Alzándose de entre las ruinas, impulsado por el comercio de enanos y la habilidad de los hombres.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Bustling streets, where deals are struck and mead flows freely.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Calles bulliciosas, donde se hacen tratos y la hidromiel fluye libremente.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: One of the jewels of Dale, where markets overflow and prosperity reigns.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una de las joyas de Valle, donde los mercados rebosan y la prosperidad reina.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A shadow of glory, long fell into ruin waiting for the return of the King under the Mountain.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una sombra de gloria, hace mucho cayó en ruinas esperando el regreso del Rey bajo la Montaña.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A simple start, where tales of old shall foster hopes for the new.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un comienzo sencillo, donde las historias antiguas fomentarán esperanzas para lo nuevo.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A stone refuge for the vigilant, watchful of distant mountains.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un refugio de piedra para los vigilantes, atentos a las montañas distantes.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: With the Dragon gone, people now once again seek strength in unity.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Con el dragón desaparecido, la gente ahora vuelve a buscar fuerza en la unidad.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Defended by proud men, recalling the strength of days before the dragon.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Defendido por hombres orgullosos, recordando la fuerza de los días antes del dragón.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "One Esgaroth has burned, yes- but we can build another!"
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «Esgaroth ha ardido, sí, ¡pero podemos construir otra!».

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: High walls arrayed with scorpions and keen archers- no dragon can pass our leaguer this time!
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: ¡Altos muros adornados con escorpiones y arqueros expertos - ningún dragón podrá pasar nuestro campamento esta vez!

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The beating heart of Dale's cities, where all roads and errands meet.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: El corazón palpitante de las ciudades de Valle, donde confluyen todos los caminos y viajeros.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: As if scorched by Smaug, only black, burnt mounds now remain here.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Como si hubieran sido quemados por Smaug, solo quedan aquí montículos negros y quemados.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The scent of bread and loaf is ever present around this place.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: El aroma de pan y hogaza está siempre presente en este lugar.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Shelves stacked high with the bounty of the land and lake.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Estantes repletos de los frutos de la tierra y el lago.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Storing the harvests of summer, preparing for both feast and famine- or winter.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Almacenando las cosechas del verano, preparándose tanto para la abundancia como para la escasez..., o para el invierno.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The seat of governance, where Bard’s lineage ensures the city thrives.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: La sede del gobierno, donde el linaje de Bardo garantiza la prosperidad de la ciudad.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Where men of proud lineage and deep wisdom debate the future of Dale.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Donde hombres de linaje orgulloso y profunda sabiduría debaten el futuro de Valle.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A place of opulence and grandeur, where the line of Bard holds court.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un lugar de opulencia y grandeza, desde donde el linaje de Bardo ejerce su dominio.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Resting places for travellers from distant lands.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Lugares de descanso para viajeros de tierras lejanas.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A warm fire, a mug of ale, and stories of adventure.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Lugares de descanso para viajeros de tierras lejanas.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Dwarves, Men, and even the wood-elves buy and sell their wares here.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un fuego cálido, una jarra de cerveza y relatos de aventuras.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Where gossip flows as freely as the ale.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Donde los rumores fluyen tan libremente como la cerveza.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A marketplace filled with the odour of ale and the sound of haggling.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los enanos, los hombres e incluso los elfos del bosque compran y venden sus mercancías aquí.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A place of merriment and trade, where the people gather for festivals and fairs.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un mercado lleno del aroma de la cerveza y el sonido de los regateos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Where the wealthy of Dale’s merchants are housed and guarded.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un lugar de alegría y comercio, donde la gente se reúne para festivales y ferias.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The nucleus of commerce, where fortunes are made and lost.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Donde residen y son protegidos los ricos mercaderes de Dale.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A powerful coalition of the most powerful tradesmen of Dale, whose whims shape the market and its prosperity.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: El núcleo del comercio, donde se hacen y se pierden fortunas.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A nexus of commerce, connecting Dale with the wider world.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una poderosa coalición de los más poderosos comerciantes de Dale, cuyos caprichos moldean el mercado y su prosperidad.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The starting point for those who seek to explore the far reaches of Middle Earth.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un nexo de comercio, conectando Dale con el resto del mundo.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Fine wines and spirits from the best vineyards of Dorwinion and beyond.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: El punto de partida para aquellos que buscan explorar las lejanas tierras de la Tierra Media.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Facilitating the exchange of goods within the lands of men and dwarves.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Facilitando el intercambio de bienes dentro de las tierras de los hombres y los enanos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Purveyors of the finest vintages, ensuring the cellars of Dale never run dry.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Vinos y licores finos de los mejores viñedos de Rhovanion y más allá.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A place where merchants and connoisseurs gather to discuss the best of the vine.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Proveedores de los mejores vinos, asegurando que las bodegas de Dale nunca se queden sin existencias.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The rolling green that sustains Dale, tended by the hands of many.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un lugar donde los mercaderes y conocedores se reúnen para discutir lo mejor de la vid.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Watching over the herds that provide meat and leather for Dale.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: El verde ondulante que sostiene Dale, cuidado por las manos de muchos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Where livestock is kept, ready for market or feast- or the tanner.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Vigilando a los rebaños que proveen carne y cuero para Dale.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Rows of fruit-bearing trees, promising a sweet bounty.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Donde se cuidan a los animales, listos para el mercado o el festín- o el curtidor.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Producing the best cuts of meat for the tables of Dale.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Produciendo los mejores cortes de carne para las mesas de Dale.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The skilled hands that ensure a good harvest from the orchards.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Filas de árboles frutales, prometiendo una dulce recompensa.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A modest farm, providing for the table and the market.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Las manos habilidosas que aseguran una buena cosecha de los huertos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Where the fruits of labor are grown and gathered.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Donde se cultivan y se recolectan los frutos del trabajo.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Turning the harvest into sustenance, fueling the city’s growth.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una modesta granja, proveyendo para la mesa y el mercado.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The guardians of the flocks that dot the fields of Rhovanion.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Convirtiendo la cosecha en sustento, alimentando el crecimiento de la ciudad.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Expansive lands worked by many, feeding the realm's ever-growing population.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Tierras expansivas trabajadas por muchos, alimentando la creciente población del reino.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Enclosures for the flocks, ensuring a steady supply of wool and meat.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los guardianes de los rebaños que salpican los campos de Rhovanion.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Hammers ring out, crafting both beauty and blade.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Recintos para los rebaños, asegurando un suministro constante de lana y carne.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Where wool is spun, and mutton is prepared for our people's tables.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Donde se hilan las lanas y se prepara el cordero para las mesas de nuestro pueblo.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The artistry of Dale, turning the ordinary wood into something extraordinary.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los martillos resuenan, forjando tanto la belleza como la hoja.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Crafting homes and halls with the timber of Mirkwood
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: La maestría de Dale, convirtiendo la madera ordinaria en algo extraordinario.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Masters of their craft, ensuring every beam stands true.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Construyendo hogares y salones con la madera del Bosque Negro.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "The dwarves have taught us their ways with metal, now it is time we put the knowledge to good work!"
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Maestros de su oficio, asegurando que cada viga se mantenga firme.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "With our gold free from the clutches of the Dragon, it can be made into works of art by our smiths."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los enanos nos han enseñado sus formas de trabajar el metal, ¡ahora es hora de poner ese conocimiento en buen uso!

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Dale's jewellers are always striving to out-do the gems of the dragon-hoard.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Con nuestro oro liberado de las garras del dragón, puede ser convertido en obras de arte por nuestros herreros.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Stone and timber, building the future of Dale.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Nuestros joyeros siempre están esforzándose por superar las gemas del tesoro del dragón.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Essential goods for building, from iron nails to oak beams.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Piedra y madera, construyendo el futuro de Dale.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Where raw resources become the tools of trade and war.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Bienes esenciales para la construcción, desde clavos de hierro hasta vigas de roble.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "Skilled hands create vessels to hold the mead of our dwarven friends!"
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Donde los recursos en bruto se convierten en herramientas de comercio y guerra.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Kilns of Dale burn bright, turning clay to works of delight.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: ¡Manos habilidosas crean vasijas para proteger la hidromiel de nuestros amigos enanos!

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Looms toil day and night, garbing the proud men of Dale in ever prouder fabric.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Las hornos de Dale arden brillantes, convirtiendo la arcilla en obras de deleite.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Blending fire with earth produces the finest bricks for our sturdy homes.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Mezclar fuego con tierra produce los mejores ladrillos para nuestros robustos hogares.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Wool is spun into the finest cloth in all of Rhovanion.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los telares trabajan día y noche, vistiendo a los orgullosos hombres de Dale con telas aún más orgullosas.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Training the men of Dale to defend their home, hearth, and kin.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: La lana es hilada en la tela más fina de todo Rhovanion.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Mass-producing the garments that warm the men of Dale in winter’s chill.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Produciendo en masa las prendas que calientan a los hombres de Dale en el frío del invierno.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "When creatures of shadow or those golden sychophants bump us in the night, here we learn to bump back."
