building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Entrenando a los hombres de Dale para defender su hogar, su tierra y su familia.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "No men in Middle Earth can surpass our riders, save for our cousins in Rohan."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Nadie en la Tierra Media puede igualar a nuestros jinetes, excepto nuestros primos en Rohan.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The finest and proudest steeds, reserved for the nobles of Dale.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los mejores y más orgullosos corceles, reservados para los nobles de Valle.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Where soldiers train, ready to issue forth at a moment’s notice.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Donde los soldados se entrenan, listos para salir en cualquier momento.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The elite infantry, sworn to protect Dale’s royal family and its treasures.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: La fuerza de élite, jurada a proteger a la familia real de Dale y sus tesoros.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "If swords are no more use here, how about a thousand arrows?"
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: PLACEHOLDER

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Shooting further and more accurate, elite archers are trained here.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: PLACEHOLDER

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Where the river meets the city, a hub of trade and travel.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Donde el río se encuentra con la ciudad, un centro de comercio y viaje.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Ships come and go, carrying goods to and from distant lands.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Las naves vienen y van, llevando bienes hacia y desde tierras lejanas.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Building and repairing the vessels that keep Dale’s trade routes open.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Construyendo y reparando las embarcaciones que mantienen abiertas las rutas comerciales de Valle.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Bustling with activity, labour, and the creaking of hulls, ships of war are produced here by the dozens.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Lleno de actividad, trabajo y el crujido de los cascos, aquí se producen docenas de naves de guerra.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A testament to Dale's valour, pride, and trials it has overcome.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un testamento a nuestro valor, nuestro orgullo y las pruebas que hemos superado.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Resting place for those that have passed beyond the confines of this world.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Lugar de descanso para aquellos que han pasado más allá de los confines de este mundo.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Ancient tombs that echo with the legacy of those who have passed on.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Tumbas antiguas que resuenan con el legado de aquellos que han partido.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The resting place of Dale's mightiest and doughtiest, laid to sleep amid the eternal stone.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: El lugar de descanso de nuestros más poderosos y valientes, los cuales yacen dormidos entre la piedra eterna.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Long chains of supplies to ensure our forces are always well-fed and well provisioned.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Largas cadenas de suministros para asegurar que nuestras fuerzas siempre estén bien alimentadas y bien provistas.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Forging weapons and tools, vital to both war and industry.
"Our blacksmits can link rings and forge swords that can rival those of the Lonely Mountain."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Forjando armas y herramientas, vitales tanto para la guerra como para la industria.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Here metal is wrought into mail, buckler, corslets, axes, and swords on an impressive scale.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Nuestros herreros negros pueden enlazar anillos y forjar espadas que pueden rivalizar con las de la Montaña Solitaria.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Here metal is wrought like fishes mail, as well as buckler and corslets and axes and swords.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Aquí el metal es forjado en mallas de escamas, así como escudos y corseletes y hachas y espadas.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Long chains of supplies to ensure Dale's forces are always well-fed and well provisioned.
Managing the flow of arms and wares throughout the lands for the hosts of Dale.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Gestionando el flujo de armas y mercancías por todo el territorio para nuestros anfitriones.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "Everyone knows that supplies are the blood and veins of any army, so we must protect ours at any cost."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Todos saben que los suministros son la sangre y las venas de cualquier ejército, por lo que debemos proteger los nuestros a cualquier precio.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The heart of the Kingdom's supply network, ensuring efficiency and order.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: El corazón de la red de suministro del Reino, asegurando eficiencia y orden.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "Never again will any orc- or dragon- pass our vigilance."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Nunca más ningún orco o dragón evadirá nuestra vigilancia.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A distant sentinel, standing guard over the farthest frontiers of the realm.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un centinela distante, en pie de guardia sobre las fronteras más lejanas de nuestro reino.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Where the swiftest riders of Dale are dispatched to carry messages and scout the lands.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Donde los jinetes más veloces de Valle son enviados para llevar mensajes y explorar las tierras.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The diplomatic heart of Dale, where alliances are forged, and envoys are received.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: El corazón diplomático de Valle, donde se forjan alianzas y se reciben enviados.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Young Erebor was dug with just a pickaxe and a dream.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un humilde comienzo, pero incluso Erebor comenzó con solo un pico y un sueño.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: As the halls grow so too do the coffers of the dwarves within.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Escondido en lo profundo de la montaña, un refugio seguro para los hermanos enanos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "With every strike of the pickaxe, the halls of our ancestors are reborn from the stone."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «Con cada golpe del pico, los salones de nuestros antepasados renacen de la piedra».

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Halls of stone so deep and grand they rival Erebor itself.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Salones de piedra tan profundos y majestuosos que rivalizan con la misma Erebor.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The carved rock speaks of the pain that the Dwarves endured when their life was taken.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: La roca tallada cuenta el dolor que los Enanos soportaron cuando su vida les fue arrebatada.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Every great mansion must start from simple origins.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Cada gran mansión debe comenzar desde orígenes simples.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: As dwarven families grow, so too does the hope for Erebor and Durin's folk.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Escondido en piedra, un hogar sencillo para la raza de los Enanos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Each home in this sprawling town offers a unique opportunity to make coin. Opportunity only a dwarf could dig up.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: A medida que crecen las conexiones de las estructuras subterráneas, comienza a formarse un salón enano.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: So tall and deep are the halls of the Dwarves that they take up entire mountains!
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: ¡Tan altos y profundos son los salones de los enanos que ocupan montañas enteras!

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Abandoned pits and empty caves now mark this place as a ruin.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Salones abandonados y cuevas vacías ahora marcan este lugar como una ruina.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Down beneath the ground, this is the heart of every community.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Enterrado bajo tierra, este es el corazón de cada comunidad.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A dwarf would gladly use any magic, as long as it meant an increase in the quality of their work, and therefore, an increase in profit.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un enano usaría con gusto cualquier magia, siempre y cuando signifique un aumento en la calidad de su trabajo, y por lo tanto, un aumento en sus ganancias.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Constant smoke rises from this building. Sometimes green, sometimes blue, sometimes white.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: De este edificio sale humo constantemente. A veces verde, a veces azul, a veces blanco.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Where most see only a rock or a mineral, skilled dwarven chemists see yet another way to improve the quality of their craft.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Donde la mayoría solo ve una roca o un mineral, los hábiles químicos enanos ven otra forma de mejorar la calidad de su oficio.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Good gwarves drink good ale.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Entre el pub y la mina, un enano tiene que estar en uno u otro sitio.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Halls that smell better than any mortal could possibly imagine.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Todos los enanos sienten un sano amor por la comida, la bebida y la diversión, por lo que un lugar donde se pueden encontrar las tres cosas es aún más apreciado.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "If more of us valued food and cheer and song above hoarded gold, it would be a merrier world."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «Si más de nosotros valoráramos la comida, la alegría y la canción por encima del oro, este sería un mundo más alegre.»

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: As dwarves dwell largely beneath the earth, they are often found trading with other races for that which cannot be obtained belowground.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Como los enanos habitan principalmente debajo de la tierra, a menudo se les encuentra comerciando con otras razas por aquello que no se puede obtener bajo tierra.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Would a dwarf rather a grumbly stomach or a light coin pouch? Traders here need not answer.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Bajo tierra, sin luz solar, cualquier intento de cultivar granos sería fútil, por lo que debe ser obtenido a través del comercio.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Various foodstuffs of all manner flow through this market, both in and out.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Varios alimentos de todo tipo fluyen a través de este mercado, tanto hacia adentro como hacia afuera.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A centre of dwarven life, ensuring the law is well kept.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un centro del día a día de los enanos, asegurando que la ley sea bien cumplida.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Within these halls councils are formed and important affairs are debated.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Dentro de estos salones se forman consejos y se debaten asuntos importantes.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Justice is a great way to settle a grudge, most of the time.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: El sentido de camaradería y la lealtad inquebrantable entre los enanos hacen que las audiencias judiciales solo se celebren para tratar los asuntos más importantes.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A new start for those who seek to join the thriving dwarven community.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un nuevo comienzo para aquellos que buscan unirse a la próspera comunidad enana.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Once again the Blue Mountains welcome the dwarves and their halls.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Incluso Nogrod y Belegost comenzaron como humildes moradas aquí.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: It may be new stone, yet the carving of mansions is tradition as old as time.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: ¡Los hijos de los Barbas de Fuego y los Nalgudos han comenzado a reclamar lo que una vez fue suyo!

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "Aye, the Iron Hills have strong dwarves. Stronger metals too."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Sería sabio mantener una presencia en las minas de las Colinas de Hierro.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: From within these halls one could hear laughter, coins clinking, drinking, and the smelting of iron.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una presencia más fuerte en las Colinas de Hierro garantizaría nuestro suministro de este metal.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The beginnings of a new dwarven mansion.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los comienzos de una nueva mansión enana.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Mansions in the east, where the Red Mountains rise.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Mansiones en el Este, donde se alzan las Montañas Rojas.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "You have food, we have gold. Let us bargain."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «Tú tienes comida, nosotros tenemos oro. Hagamos un trueque.»

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Dwarven traffic is what keeps the economies of their allies running.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: El tráfico enano es lo que mantiene en marcha las economías de sus aliados.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: From Lindon to Rhûn, from Forodwaith to Far Harad, all goods of any worth have passed through here.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Desde Lindon hasta Rhûn, desde Forodwaith hasta Harad Lejano, todos los bienes de valor han pasado por aquí.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Dwarves must treat the earth, as the rocky ground beneath their feet is not suitable for any sort of work.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los enanos deben tratar la tierra, ya que el suelo rocoso debajo de sus pies no es adecuado para ningún tipo de trabajo.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A whole boar might be considered enough for a single dwarf’s lunch.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un jabalí entero podría ser considerado suficiente para el almuerzo de un solo enano.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Durin’s folk delight in boars, making sausages, bacon, and hams from their meats.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los descendientes de Dúrin se deleitan en los jabalíes, elaborando salchichas, tocino y jamones con su carne.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: “Dwarves devour so much flesh, they might as well be orcs!”
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «¡Los enanos devoran tanta carne, que bien podrían ser orcos!»

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: It’s amazing what a couple of mugs of an intensely flavoured ale can do to raise the spirits of a dwarf!
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: ¡Es increíble lo que un par de jarras de cerveza pueden hacer para levantar el ánimo de un enano!

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Here the brewmaster oversees large-scale production of the most stout dwarven beers.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Botellas de CEI, Cerveza Enana Intensa, pueblan las estanterías.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Here the finest alcoholic beverages are produced en masse, yet there are somehow always shortages.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Aquí se producen en masa las mejores bebidas alcohólicas, pero de alguna manera siempre hay escasez.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: What's better than roasted goat for a dwarven launcheon?
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: ¿Qué hay mejor que cabrito asado para un almuerzo enano?

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "Our mountain-neighbours make for an excellent source of fresh meat."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «Nuestros vecinos de las montañas son una excelente fuente de carne fresca».

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Goats give Dwarves a constant supply of war horns, clothes, and meat.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Las cabras proveen a los enanos un suministro constante de cuernos de guerra, ropa y carne.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Mushrooms grow in dark and moist places. Like dwarves!
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los hongos crecen en lugares oscuros y húmedos. ¡Como los enanos!

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "Miner's meat! That's what they call mushrooms! Only... we also eat real meat."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «¡Carne de minero! ¡Así llaman a los hongos! Aunque... también comemos carne real.»

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Here mushrooms grow in abundance, contributing to a considerable part of our food supply.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Aquí crecen hongos en abundancia, contribuyendo a una parte considerable de nuestro suministro de alimentos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: With the hammer's stroke we arm our dwarves for every blow.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Con el golpe del martillo armamos a nuestros enanos para cada golpe.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Only the hands of a dwarf can make the roughest metal shine as bright as the Sun.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Solo las manos de un enano pueden hacer que el metal más áspero brille tan brillante como el Sol.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Greed grows at the smith.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Oro, plata, mithril... Los herreros enanos hacen maravillas con los tesoros de la tierra.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "Seven for the dwarf-lords in their halls of stone."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Alguien que convierte gemas en bruto en maravillas artesanales.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "Mithril! All folk desired it. It could be beaten like copper, and polished like glass; and the dwarves could make of it a metal, light and yet harder than tempered steel."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: El valor del mithril era diez veces superior al del oro, al igual que la habilidad necesaria para trabajarlo.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The finest pots to store the mead!
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: ¡Las mejores vasijas para guardar el hidromiel!

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: For people that hoard many things, there must be many things to put them in.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Las complejidades de la sociedad enana pueden apreciarse en las sutiles pinturas que adornan sus jarrones.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A strong Dwarven Kingdom will require countless vases to spread its goods around Middle Earth.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un fuerte reino enano requerirá innumerables jarrones para difundir sus bienes por la Tierra Media.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Dwarves don't go about garbless like the wildmen of the woods!
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: ¡Los enanos no andan por ahí sin vestimenta como los hombres salvajes del bosque!

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "I'd wager even one of them pointy-eared ones would wear one of our works!"
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «¡Apuesto a que incluso uno de esos de orejas puntiagudas llevaría una de nuestras creaciones!».

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Dwarven cloaks and tunics of the finest quality are created here.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Aquí se crean capas y túnicas enanas de la más alta calidad.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A dwarf with a hammer can tame any mountain.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Uno se sorprendería de la cantidad de herramientas que siempre se guardan en los bolsillos de un enano.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Minecarts filled with chisels and pans for the next expedition.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los armamentos cotidianos del arsenal de un enano son producidos aquí.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The works of dwarven armourers are a wonder to behold!
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: ¡Los productos de los armeros enanos son una maravilla para contemplar!

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Small reminders of home can carry a dwarf's resolve to the edge of Middle-Earth.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: ¿Qué mejor para llenar los rincones de las casas enanas que pequeñas piezas de metalistería?

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Memories of playing with a new toy among grand halls is something only a dwarf could cherish.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «¡Nuestros innovadores herreros siempre se esfuerzan por superar los juguetes de Valle!».

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: One after another toys fall into minecarts. All on their way to be distributed across Middle-earth.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: En vano, los hombres se esfuerzan por superar a los artesanos enanos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "Baruk Khazâd! Khazâd ai-mênu!"
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «¡Baruk Khazâd! ¡Khazâd ai-mênu!»

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Long hours of mining, sprinting, and fighting have forged these dwarves into quite a formidable fighting force.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Largas horas de minería, carrera y lucha han convertido a estos enanos en una fuerza de combate bastante formidable.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "This is my axe. There are many like it, but this one's mine. Without me, my axe is useless. Without it, I am still a dwarf."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «Este es mi hacha. Hay muchas como esta, pero esta es mía. Sin mí, mi hacha no sirve para nada. Sin ella, yo no sirvo para nada».

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The loyalty of these dwarves is as unbreakable as mithril.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: La lealtad de estos enanos es tan inquebrantable como el mithril.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: “Loyalty, honour, a willing heart; I can ask no more than that.”
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «Lealtad, honor, un corazón dispuesto; no puedo pedir más que eso.»

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: It's not just a wisp of cloud, it's the rain of dwarven arrows moving fast against the wind.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: No es solo una nube, es una lluvia de flechas enanas que se mueven rápidamente contra el viento.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Even a dwarf can see the profit in ships and sails.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Esta estructura primitiva sirve como un modesto puerto de anclaje para los comerciantes enanos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: This harbor, like a dwarf, is small and smells, but serves its purpose with the same steadfast dedication.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Este puerto, como un enano, es pequeño y apesta, pero cumple su propósito con la misma dedicación firme.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Mountains of gold pile upon the banks.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Este puerto marítimo da la bienvenida a muchos comerciantes extranjeros procedentes de tierras lejanas, cuyos tesoros hacen las delicias de muchos enanos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A bustling heart of maritime commerce, exotic goods of all manner flow through this dwarven haven.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un bullicioso corazón de comercio marítimo, bienes exóticos de todo tipo fluyen a través de este puerto de los enanos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A towering testimony to the indomitable might of the dwarves.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una imponente prueba del poder indomable de los enanos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A final resting place suitable for the might of the dwarves' departed kin.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un lugar de descanso final adecuado para el poderío de los difuntos parientes de los enanos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: “Faithless is he that says farewell when the road darkens."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «Sin fé es aquel que se despide cuando el camino se oscurece.»

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Death for a dwarf begins their legacy.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Aquí yacen los más destacados entre los antepasados de los enanos. Su valor inquebrantable y esplendor no se reducen ni siquiera en la muerte.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Seemingly endless halls of gold and precious stones, a monument to dwarven diligence.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Salones aparentemente interminables de oro y piedras preciosas, un monumento a la diligencia de los enanos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A basic chain of storage outposts manage to distribute their meagre stock of supplies throughout this region.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una sencilla cadena de almacenes logra distribuir sus escasas existencias por toda esta región.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Everything required for a campaign outside of the mountains can be found here.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: ¡Cada golpe de martillo arma a otro enano!

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The dwarves inside the forges work tirelessly to ensure the army is equipped with no less than the highest quality of armaments.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los enanos que trabajan en las forjas laboran sin descanso para garantizar que el ejército cuente con armamento de la más alta calidad.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The unparalleled mastery of the dwarven craftsmen is clearly seen in the gleam of their blades and the shining of their armour.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: La incomparable maestría de los artesanos enanos se aprecia claramente en el brillo de sus espadas y el resplandor de sus armaduras.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: While the Heart of the Mountain may be lost, dwarves can certainly build a new one.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «¡Fuelles gigantes! ¡Aire tan caliente como el sol! En las profundidades de Erebor, hemos dominado las enseñanzas de Aulê».

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Giant bellows! Air as hot as the Sun! In the depth of Erebor, we have mastered Aulê's teachings.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: ¡Grandes fuelles! ¡Aire tan caliente como el Sol! En las profundidades de Erebor, hemos dominado las enseñanzas de Aulê.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: No greater sound exists than hammer on anvil.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Después de partir en dos a hordas de trasgos y orcos, las hachas enanas rotas necesitarán ser reemplazadas.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: This establishment serves as a more complex centre of administration, ensuring dwarven armies are well supplied.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Este establecimiento funciona como un centro administrativo más complejo, que garantiza el buen abastecimiento de los ejércitos enanos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "Here our shining arms are laid in hoard, safe behind lock, rock, and key."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «Aquí nuestras relucientes armas están guardadas en un tesoro, a salvo tras cerrojos, rocas y llaves».

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: No dwarf will go without his rations as long as this centre and its colossal network of supply posts are in place.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Ningún enano se quedará sin sus raciones mientras este centro y su colosal red de puestos de suministro sigan en funcionamiento.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: All along the watchtower sentinels keep the view.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: A lo largo de la torre de vigilancia, centinelas mantened la vista.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The scouts set up base here, ready to map out uncharted realms, like Durin of old.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los exploradores establecieron aquí su base, listos para cartografiar territorios inexplorados, como Dúrin en tiempos antiguos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Dwarven expeditions are launched from here, seeking treasure and trade.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Las expediciones enanas son lanzadas desde aquí, en busca de tesoros y comercio.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: From here, the dwarves organise missions to reclaim what was lost.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Desde aquí, los enanos organizan misiones para recuperar lo que se perdió.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "The world is still full of the scions of the likes of Smaug, and who better to hunt them than us?"
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «El mundo sigue lleno de descendientes de seres como Smaug, y ¿quién mejor que nosotros para cazarlos?».

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A place for the scouts to share the secrets they uncovered.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un lugar para que los exploradores compartan los secretos que han descubierto.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Those Balchoth ruffians need a place to gather before they raid.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Esos rufianes balchoth necesitan un lugar donde reunirse antes de lanzar sus incursiones.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "You can't sit with us. Raiders only."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «No puedes sentarte con nosotros. Solo incursores».

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Perfecting the art of raiding is the sole focus of the men here.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Perfeccionar el arte de las incursiones es el único objetivo de los hombres que están aquí.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Traditions formed in the humble homes of Rhûn will stand strong long after wooden walls become stone palaces.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: La gente del Este se establece aquí.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The promise of gold and fertile land call Easterlings from all across the steppes, and with them comes prosperity.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: No es Mistrand, pero servirá.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Stronghold - Short Description Placeholder
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Stronghold - Short Description Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Marvelous stone statues, breathtaking temples, and bright nighttime streets are staples of many of Rhûn's cities.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los habitantes de Rhûn saben un par de cosas sobre el desarrollo de ciudades.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Fortress - Short Description Placeholder
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Fortress - Short Description Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A jewel of the steppes, this metropolis could rival any city in Gondor.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: La joya de las estepas, una metrópolis que rivaliza con cualquier ciudad de Gondor.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Large Fortress - Short Description Placeholder
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Large Fortress - Short Description Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Ruined City - Short Description Placeholder
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Ruined City - Short Description Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Quaint and humble, a new beginning for the people of Rhûn.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Pintoresco y humilde, un nuevo comienzo para el pueblo de Rhûn.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Keep - Short Description Placeholder
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Keep - Short Description Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "I've been to Caras Menegrim before. The stone streets are nice, but there's no better feeling than a dirt road under your boots."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Ha nacido y se ha mudado aquí tanta gente que el lugar necesita más espacio.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Castle - Short Description Placeholder
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Castle - Short Description Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A lively centre of everyday life in the east.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un animado centro de la vida cotidiana en el Este.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Large Castle - Short Description Placeholder
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Large Castle - Short Description Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Large Town - Short Description Placeholder
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Large Town - Short Description Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Ruined Village - Short Description Placeholder
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Ruined Village - Short Description Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Where the people go about the important business of their day.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Donde la gente se ocupa de los asuntos importantes de su día a día.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Long walks through the garden under the moonlight are a favoured tradition in Rhûn.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Largos paseos por el jardín bajo la luz de la luna.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The kind of dancing done here is not exactly the kind Nessa would be fond of.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: El tipo de baile que se practica aquí no es precisamente el que le gustaría a Nessa.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: What occurs in the court of pleasures remains within the court of pleasures.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Lo que ocurre en la corte de los placeres se queda en la corte de los placeres.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Clan Settlement - Short Description Placeholder
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Clan Settlement - Short Description Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Variag Settlement - Short Description Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Khand Migrant Establishment - Short Description Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Khand Colony - Short Description Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Rachrohir Settlement - Short Description Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Wainrider Migrant Establishment - Short Description Placeholder
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Wainrider Migrant Establishment - Short Description Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Wainrider Colony - Short Description Placeholder
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Wainrider Colony - Short Description Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: As it is written, so shall it be done. Don't ask who wrote it.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Como está escrito, así se hará. No preguntes quién lo escribió.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Here the eldest and wisest of the clan provide counsel to their chieftain. Whether he listens is another matter.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Aquí, los más ancianos y sabios del clan aconsejan a su jefe. Que él les escuche es otra cuestión.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: His word is law!
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: ¡Su palabra es ley!

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "Ah, the hunt. Turns boys to men."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «Ah, la caza. Convierte a los niños en hombres».

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A proper hunting expedition begins with a hearty meal and good company.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: La etiqueta adecuada para la caza comienza con una comida abundante y buena compañía.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Hunting Commune - Short Description Placeholder
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Hunting Commune - Short Description Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "We certainly won't be selling the loot. For the trinkets we raid are ours to keep!"
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «Por supuesto que no venderemos el botín. ¡Las baratijas que saqueamos son nuestras y nos las quedamos!».

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Here is found hustle and bustle only rivalled by the footbeats of Rhûn's mighty armies.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Aquí se encuentra un bullicio y un ajetreo solo rivalizados por los pasos de los poderosos ejércitos de Rhûn.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Fineries from all over the east are haggled over at stands and booths, and even more sought after are those from far-away realms.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: En este lugar se regatean las finuras de todo el Este, y aún más codiciadas son las procedentes de reinos lejanos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A common stop for wary travellers looking to rest and refresh themselves.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Viajeros cautelosos descansando y refrescándose.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Scouts ride across the vast steppe; they could use a camp to rest and reorganise.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los exploradores cabalgan por la vasta estepa; les vendría bien un campamento para descansar y reorganizarse.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Travel Network - Short Description Placeholder
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Travel Network - Short Description Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The clan controlling this city will fiercely defend it, for there is no greater honour than defending one's home.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: El clan que controla esta ciudad la defenderá ferozmente.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A gathering place for the greatest warriors of the clan to boast to one another and to attempt to one-up each-others' deeds.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «No soy uno de esos guerreros que intentan superar las hazañas de los demás. Conocí a un guerrero mucho peor que yo en eso».

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Loyalty to the clan above all else.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Lealtad al clan por encima de todo.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "Best we not raid our own fields if we want to eat..."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «Será mejor que no saqueemos nuestros propios campos si queremos comer...».

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Soured milk and good meat are what every true Easterling soldier needs
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Criar, engordar, sacrificar. Carne para los ejércitos de Rhûn.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The endless grasslands could be considered paradise for the Aurochs of the east.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Ordeñaremos nuestras vacas hasta sacarle todo el provecho posible.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Cattle Farm - Short Description Placeholder
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Cattle Farm - Short Description Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "Wheat, grain, barley, malt. I've got them all."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «Trigo, cereales, cebada, malta. Los tengo todos».

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The mighty steppe winds easily power grinding millstones, and so are beloved by the people of Rhûn.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un molino que aprovecha los fuertes vientos de la estepa para hacer girar la muela y producir muchas variedades de harina.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Farming Estates - Short Description Placeholder
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Farming Estates - Short Description Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: From the meat to the shearings, no part of an animal goes to waste.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Tanto la carne como las esquilas tienen un buen valor.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "Keeping the flock safe and sound. Until we want to eat them, of course."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «Mantener al rebaño sano y salvo. Hasta que queramos comérnoslos, claro».

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Sheep Farm - Short Description Placeholder
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Sheep Farm - Short Description Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Long traditions of handmade crafts drive the heartbeat of the east.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Impulsando el latido del Este con su arte.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "It's art, you uncultured swine! Don't ask me how, or why, but it's art."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «¡Es arte, cerdo inculto! No me preguntes cómo ni por qué, pero es arte».

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Fashion is an important part of Easterling culture, even in the army. After all, you need something to compliment your black eye-liner.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Algunos accesorios elegantes para complementar todo ese delineador de ojos, incluso para el ejército.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Banners inspire hope for a future that stretches past Rhûn.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Las pancartas inspiran esperanza en un futuro que va más allá de Rhûn.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Conquering requires rebuilding.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Conquistar requiere reconstruir.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Turns out the Easterlings enjoy building cities as much as destroying them.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Resulta que a los orientales les gusta tanto construir ciudades como destruirlas.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: In the dawn of a new age the cities of the east shall no longer remain a mystery.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: En los albores de una nueva era, las ciudades del Este dejarán de ser un misterio.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The birthplace for the wagons of war.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: El lugar de origen de los carros de guerra.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "Our carpenters are the bones upon which clans are built upon."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «Nuestros carpinteros son los cimientos sobre los que se construyen los clanes».

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Select craftsmen are given the honour of carving chariots for their chieftans.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: A determinados artesanos se les concede el honor de tallar carros para sus jefes tribales.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "A vase is much more than a container. It begins and ends our way of life."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «Un jarrón es mucho más que un recipiente. Es el principio y el final de nuestra forma de vida».

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Kilns, bright as dragonfire.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Hornos, brillantes como el fuego de dragón.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Adobe Kiln - Short Description Placeholder
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Adobe Kiln - Short Description Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Hand-crafted textiles, woven on a much larger scale than a simple group of elderly women could accomplish.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Textiles hechos a mano a una escala mayor que la de un pasatiempo de mujeres mayores.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "Clothes on our backs the way a dragon wears its scales."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «La ropa que llevamos puesta es como las escamas que luce un dragón».

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Textile Producer - Short Description Placeholder
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Textile Producer - Short Description Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The famous golden armour of the Lókë-Rim drawns many young men into the ranks.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: La esperanza de poder llevar algún día esa armadura dorada es un gran aliciente para el reclutamiento.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "Dress right, dress, one two. Ready, front, one two."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «Vístete bien, vístete, uno, dos. Listos, adelante, uno, dos».

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "Rule one on page one of the book of war: Do not march on Rhûn. You will be run down."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Muchos hombres caminan con las piernas arqueadas después de pasar largas horas montando a caballo.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The hordes of Lókë-Rim cavalry are sometimes known as the "Terror of the Steppes" in the West, and for good reason.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Establos de la caballería Lôke-Rim, los mejores guerreros a caballo del Este.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "Your hand is hurt. I once fought two days with an arrow through my testicle. Your enemy won't care. Up."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «Te duele la mano. Una vez luché dos días con una flecha clavada en el testículo. A tu enemigo no le importará. Levántate».

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Barracks of the proud Lókë-Rim infantry, clad in their golden armour.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Barracones de la infantería Lôke-Rim, vestidos con sus armaduras doradas.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Where an archer learns to hit the target, absent of any battlefield conditions that would make it difficult.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Donde un arquero aprende a dar en el blanco, aunque sin las condiciones del campo de batalla que lo harían difícil.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Surrounding the enemy on horseback with a storm of arrows is the specialty of the gilded archers of the east.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Dominio de los arqueros Lôke-Rim, los mejores arqueros de los Hombres.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Small vessesls that keep close to the shore anchor here.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Las pequeñas embarcaciones que se mantienen cerca de la costa fondean aquí.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "Two kinds of sailors inhabit these ports, those that have run aground, and those that lie about it."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «Hay dos tipos de marineros que habitan estos puertos: los que han encallado y los que mienten al respecto».

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "I hear the Sea of Rhûn is particularly nice this time of year."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «He oído que el mar de Rhûn es especialmente bonito en esta época del año».

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: They called Alcarondas the castle of the seas; Easterlings would rather build a citadel of the seas.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Llamaban a Alcarondas el castillo de los mares; los orientales preferían construir una ciudadela de los mares.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Perhaps it is safer to submit to than to defy darkness.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Quizás sea más seguro someterse a la oscuridad que desafiarla.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: As much a symbol of the failure of the Blue Wizards as for devotion to the true Dark Lord.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Tanto un símbolo del fracaso de los Magos Azules como de la devoción al verdadero Señor Oscuro.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Inspiring and demanding devotion to the first and mightiest of the Valar.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Inspirando y exigiendo devoción al primero y más poderoso de los Valar.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The centre of worship for all dark things: Melkor, dragons, and the Eye.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Adoración de todo lo relacionado con la oscuridad: Melkor, Sauron, dragones.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Supply Station - Short Description Placeholder
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Supply Station - Short Description Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: All that shiny armour has to come from somewhere.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Toda esa armadura tiene que venir de algún sitio.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Blacksmith - Short Description Placeholder
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Blacksmith - Short Description Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The strike of hammer upon anvil is music to the ears of those who prepare Rhûn for war.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: El golpe del martillo sobre el yunque es música para los oídos de quienes preparan Rhûn para la guerra.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Forge - Short Description Placeholder
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Forge - Short Description Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: If swords are named for their great deeds, every one produced here will earn a name.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Si las espadas reciben nombres por sus grandes hazañas, todas las que se fabrican aquí se ganarán un nombre.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Foundry - Short Description Placeholder
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Foundry - Short Description Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: It's not as organised as it could be, but everyone gets what they need.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Asegurando que los ejércitos orientales siempre tengan lo suficiente para sobrevivir.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Supply Distributor - Short Description Placeholder
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Supply Distributor - Short Description Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "This one is for Borthand, do we have a Borthand here? A glaive for you sir. Next!"
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Garantizando que los suministros necesarios para la guerra lleguen a su destino.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Fortified Warehouse - Short Description Placeholder
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Fortified Warehouse - Short Description Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Easterling armies must be well-supplied on their long marches to the West, and those supplies must be well kept.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «La primera regla de la primera página del libro de la guerra es no marchar sobre Rhûn».

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Logistics Centre - Short Description Placeholder
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Logistics Centre - Short Description Placeholder

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The secret of Easterling warfare is the ability to supply an army from vast distances, using the power of their mighty supply chains.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los ejércitos orientales deben estar bien abastecidos en sus largas marchas hacia el oeste.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Carts and stone-masons have come from all over Gondor to settle these lands.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Carros y canteros han venido de todas partes de Gondor para establecerse en estas tierras.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A growing hub for the stone-folk of Gondor to live and settle in.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un creciente centro para que las gentes de las canteras de Gondor vivan y se establezcan.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: This fief has thrived, defying the threats of diseases, misrule, and conflict that often befell lesser colonies.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Este feudo ha prosperado, desafiando las amenazas de enfermedades, mal gobierno y conflictos que a menudo afectaban a colonias inferiores.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Through considerable growth, this colony has seamlessly integrated into the Kingdom.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: A través de un crecimiento considerable, esta colonia se ha integrado perfectamente en el Reino.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Once a great Gondorian city, now only its ruins stand as a testament to its greatness.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una vez una gran ciudad Gondoriana, ahora solo sus ruinas se mantienen como testamento de su grandeza.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A small and hard-working community inhabits these lands.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una pequeña y trabajadora comunidad habita estas tierras.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A meeting place for Gondorian people from all over the countryside.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un lugar de encuentro para el pueblo gondoriano de los campos y zonas rurales.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Bustling and ever-growing, this settlement attracts men of all trades.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Bullicioso y en constante crecimiento, este asentamiento atrae a hombres de todos los oficios.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Tall and proud Gondorians sell ther wares in the crowded streets of this town.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Altos y orgullosos gondorianos venden sus mercancías en las concurridas calles de esta ciudad.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The will of evil has swept these lands, leaving behind nothing but ruins and dust.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: La voluntad del mal ha barrido estas tierras, dejando atrás solo ruinas y polvo.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A communal expanse set aside for public use, unfolding as a bustling tapestry of activity.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un extenso espacio comunal reservado para uso público, desplegándose como un bullicioso tapiz de actividad.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "I warned you not to go near those scrolls with that pipe!"
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «¡Te advertí que no te acercaras a esos pergaminos con esa pipa!»

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: This library is so vast that it holds a section dedicated to the art of song.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Esta biblioteca es tan vasta que cuenta con una sección dedicada al arte de las canciones.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Young scions and dusty professors from all over Gondor wander these halls.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Jóvenes herederos y polvorientos profesores de todo Gondor deambulan por estos pasillos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A Gondorian will always know the taste of their own city's bread.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un gondoriano siempre reconocerá el sabor del pan de su propia ciudad.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Local farmers sell their harvest here, stocking the populace with essential provisions.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los agricultores locales venden su cosecha aquí, abasteciendo a la población con provisiones esenciales.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: To ensure the survival of Gondor, food stores must be able to withstand droughts, plagues or, worse, orcs.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Sequías, plagas o, peor aún, orcos. La comida debe ser almacenada para garantizar la supervivencia de Gondor.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A square surrounded by stone pillars, featuring local sculptors' works and providing a space to discuss current events.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una plaza rodeada de pilares de piedra, con obras de escultores locales y proporcionando un espacio para discutir eventos actuales.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Gondorians assemble here to partake in the city's goings-on, from spectacles to arts.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los gondorianos se reúnen aquí para participar en los eventos de la ciudad, desde espectáculos hasta artes.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Local merchants, artisans, and nobles gather here in grand feasts to celebrate their Kingdom.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los comerciantes, artesanos y nobles locales se reúnen aquí en grandes fiestas para celebrar su reino.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: This civic edifice serves as a hub for governance and communal affairs.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Este edificio cívico sirve como centro de gobierno y asuntos comunitarios.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Discussions guided by the wisdom that has shaped the realm through the ages unfold here.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Aquí se desarrollan debates guiados por la sabiduría que ha dado forma al reino a lo largo de los siglos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: An august chamber of justice, adorned with stone pillars and rich tapestries depicting tales of honour.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una augusta cámara de justicia, adornada con pilares de piedra y ricos tapices que representan historias de honor.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The Citadel of Minas Tirith harbours the governing heart of Gondor: austere halls echoing with the footsteps of Stewards and Kings of old.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: La Ciudadela de Minas Tirith alberga el corazón gobernante de Gondor: austeros salones en los que resuenan los pasos de los Senescales y Reyes de antaño.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A mug of ale and a large enough hay bed is enough for a weary traveler.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una jarra de cerveza y una cama de heno lo suficientemente grande es suficiente para un viajero cansado.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Local farmers, merchants, and artisans board here, boasting about their work .
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los agricultores, comerciantes y artesanos locales se alojan aquí y presumen de su trabajo.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A renown stop for people of all trades, from Gondor and beyond.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un lugar renombrado para personas de todos los oficios, desde Gondor y más allá.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Artisans and farmers from all over the countryside gather here to sell their goods.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Artesanos y agricultores de todas partes se reúnen aquí para vender sus productos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A place of laughter and quarrels, where merchants can hawk their wares.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un lugar de risas y peleas, donde los comerciantes pueden vender sus mercancías.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: With the right amount of castar, anything can be bought in here.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Con la cantidad adecuada de castar, aquí se puede comprar cualquier cosa.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Fair and fertile townlands, tended by the commoners for the good of the realm.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Tierras justas y fértiles, cuidadas por los plebeyos por el bien del Reino.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Herding cattle is vastly preferable to herding cats.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Cuidar ganado es preferible a cuidar gatos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The cattle roam the fields with an envious carelessness.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: El ganado vaga por los campos con una despreocupación envidiable.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The cow is a versatile, profitable animal.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: La vaca es un animal versátil y provechoso.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: An apple plucked from a tree is ten times tastier than one bought at the market.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una manzana arrancada de un árbol es diez veces más sabrosa que una comprada en el mercado.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A dedicated group of farmers tends to carefully nurtured trees, ensuring each one bears quality produce.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un grupo dedicado de agricultores cuida con esmero los árboles cultivados, asegurándose de que cada uno produzca frutos de calidad.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Robust trees filled with fruits populate the countryside, creating a vast expanse of agricultural richness.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Árboles robustos llenos de frutas pueblan el campo, creando una vasta extensión de riqueza agrícola.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A rustic manor, surrounded by verdant fields of wheat and barley.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una mansión rústica, rodeada de campos verdes de trigo y cebada.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A sturdy stone structure nestled beside a wheat field, humming with the rhythmic sound of turning wheels.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una sólida estructura de piedra junto a un campo de trigo, zumbando con el sonido rítmico de las ruedas giratorias.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Enormous fields of grain encircle hamlets inhabited by local farmers.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Enormes campos de grano rodean aldeas habitadas por granjeros locales.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The vast and fertile lands of Gondor will serve well for the realm's shepherds.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Las vastas y fértiles tierras de Gondor serán muy útiles para los pastores del reino.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Sheep pens keep their predators, both man and beast, at bay.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los corrales de ovejas mantienen a raya a sus depredadores, tanto humanos como bestias.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A labirinth of pens and fences, to confuse the sheep before they are sheared by their masters!
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un laberinto de corrales y cercas, ¡para confundir a las ovejas antes de ser esquiladas por sus amos!

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: An investment in the economy is a good investment for both the local lords and the city-folk.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una inversión en la economía es una buena inversión tanto para los señores locales como para los habitantes de la ciudad.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Careful planning, not whips and lashes, will make Gondor's cities grow.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una planificación cuidadosa, y no los látigos y los azotes, hará crecer las ciudades de Gondor.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A local warehouse for stones, timber, and mortar.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un almacén local para piedras, madera y mortero.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "Producing building supplies in our cities will make their expansion faster, stronger, better."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «La producción de materiales de construcción en nuestras ciudades hará que su expansión sea más rápida, más sólida y mejor».

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A student of engineering has recently opened up shop here. Do not expect too much.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un estudiante de ingeniería ha abierto recientemente una tienda aquí. No esperes demasiado.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Ropes, timber, and hard-working folk are all that is needed to make a great machine of war.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Cuerdas, madera y gente trabajadora es todo lo que se necesita para fabricar una gran máquina de guerra.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The Kingdom's most experienced engineers have made this settlement a marvel of their craft.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los ingenieros más experimentados del Reino han convertido este asentamiento en una maravilla de su oficio.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: However little this community produces, it must be stored and exported in vessels.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Por poca que sea la producción de esta comunidad, debe ser almacenada y exportada en recipientes.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "You are a potter, Húrin! You cannot expect me to deliver all of this wine in a box!"
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «¡Eres un alfarero, Húrin! ¡No puedes esperar que entregue todo este vino en una caja!»

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Heat, sweat and clay stand as the foundations of a commercial empire.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Calor, sudor y arcilla son los cimientos de un imperio comercial.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Tradition and need drive Gondor's crafts-people to take up the carving skills of their forefathers.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: La tradición y la necesidad impulsan a los artesanos de Gondor a adquirir las habilidades de tallado de sus antepasados.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Gondor remembers its glorious past by committing it to the stone.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Gondor recuerda su glorioso pasado grabándolo en piedra.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Behold, the Heroes of Numenór and the Kingdoms-in-Exile! It is as if they have come to life!
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: ¡Contemplad a los héroes de Númenor y los reinos en el exilio! ¡Es como si hubieran cobrado vida!

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Diligent artisans prepare clothes for Gondor's citizens and fabric for their trades.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Artesanos diligentes preparan ropa para los ciudadanos de Gondor y telas para sus oficios.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The Gondorians will always need the strongest sails, as well as the most fashionable outfits.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los gondorianos siempre necesitarán las velas más fuertes, así como los atuendos más elegantes.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Proud stand the banners of Gondor! The black and white wool finely worked by expert hands.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: ¡Orgullosas se alzan los estandartes de Gondor! La lana negra y blanca finamente trabajada por manos expertas.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Swords and shields to make peasants into soldiers!
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: ¡Espadas y escudos para campesinos por igual!

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "Gondorians! What is your profession!?"
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «¡Gondorianos! ¿Cuál es vuestra profesión?».

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Trained and disciplined, knights and their mounts ride from the stables to the front lines.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Entrenados y disciplinados, los caballeros y sus monturas cabalgan desde los establos hasta el frente.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Boasting the banner of the White Swan, these buildings echo with the resounding hooves of noble steeds and the clatter of armour.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Portando el estandarte del Cisne Blanco, estos edificios resuenan con el estruendo de los nobles corceles y el tintineo de la armadura.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Clad in steel plate, the stalwart defenders of Gondor train, dine, and sleep in these halls.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Revestidos con placas de acero, los valientes defensores de Gondor entrenan, comen y duermen en estas salas.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The Royal Barracks serve as the forge where the wardens of Gondor are tempered, their steel resolve matched only by the gleam of their spears.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los Barracopnes Reales sirven como la forja donde se templan los custodios de Gondor, cuya determinación de acero solo es comparable al brillo de sus lanzas.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The ceaseless sound of ashen arrows piercing through the air and finding their marks on hay-bale targets is heard here.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Aquí se oye el incesante sonido de flechas cenicientas que atraviesan el aire y dan en el blanco en los objetivos de pacas de heno.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Home to the most skilled marksmen of Gondor's armies, and the only place to perfect the art of splitting an arrow with another arrow
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Hogar de los tiradores más hábiles de los ejércitos de Gondor, y el único lugar donde se puede perfeccionar el arte de partir una flecha con otra flecha.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Fishermen and merchants argue every day to grab the last remaining dock.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Pescadores y comerciantes discuten todos los días para agenciarse el último muelle disponible.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: In this place, wood, ropes, and sails converge to shape the future of Gondor's maritime strength.
