building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: En este lugar, la madera, las cuerdas y las velas convergen para dar forma al futuro de la fuerza marítima de Gondor.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A crucial maritime hub, this wharf readies warships for deployment, ensuring a vigilant naval defense along the Kingdom's shorelines.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un puerto marítimo crucial, este muelle prepara buques de guerra para su despliegue, asegurando una defensa naval vigilante a lo largo de las costas del Reino.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Look! The fleets of Númenor come alive again!
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: ¡Mira! ¡Las flotas de Númenor vuelven a cobrar vida!

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: This port buzzes with trade and traffic, accommodating vessels of various sizes.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Este puerto rezuma con el comercio y el tráfico, acomodando embarcaciones de diferentes tamaños.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A versatile harbour is crucial for welcoming ships from all trade routes.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un puerto versátil es crucial para dar la bienvenida a los barcos de todas las rutas comerciales.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A vibrant hub lining the waterfront with warehouses and markets, serving as the epicentre of maritime commerce and industry.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un vibrante centro que bordea la costa con almacenes y mercados, sirviendo como epicentro del comercio marítimo e industria.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A symbol of Gondorian pride, gracing the main square with its elegance and tales of the past.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un símbolo del orgullo gondoriano, adornando la plaza principal con su elegancia y relatos del pasado.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: This graveyard serves as a dignified resting place for the departed souls of the local nobility.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Este cementerio sirve como un lugar de descanso digno para las almas fallecidas de la nobleza local.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A collection of ornate burial mounds, with tombs fit for the heroes of old.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una colección de suntuosos túmulos funerarios, con tumbas dignas de los héroes de antaño.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A marvel of architectural artistry, this complex houses the illustrious departed and preserves the legacy of their lineage.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una maravilla de la artesanía arquitectónica, estas casas complejas ilustran figuras y preservan el legado de su linaje.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Few things exemplify the ingenuity and beauty that Gondorian hands are capable of than flowing water housed in white stone.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los jóvenes de Gondor se deleitan en jugar antes de refrescarse con un chapuzón de esta fuente.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Rising in dignified splendor, this statue commands the attention of the locals, serving as a reminder of the history of Gondor.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Elevándose en esplendor dignificado, esta estatua demanda la atención de los lugareños, sirviendo como un recordatorio de la historia de Gondor.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: This elegant courtyard serves as the distinguished venue where local nobles meet with the townspeople, merchants, and other esteemed guests.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Este elegante patio sirve como lugar distinguido donde los nobles locales se reúnen con los ciudadanos, los comerciantes y otros invitados ilustres.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: ...and in that space stood the houses and domed tombs of bygone kings and lords, forever silent between the mountain and the tower.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: ...y en ese espacio se alzaban las casas y las tumbas abovedadas de reyes y señores de antaño, eternamente silenciosas entre la montaña y la torre.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A modest structure that efficiently caters to the immediate needs of local outposts and patrols.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una estructura modesta que atiende eficientemente a las necesidades inmediatas de puestos y patrullas locales.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The heave of the bellows, the strike of hammer upon anvil, and the quench of steel into the water barrel create a pleasing melody here.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: El movimiento del fuelle, el golpe del martillo sobre el yunque y el enfriamiento del acero en el barril de agua crean aquí una agradable melodía.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A bustling workshop, crafting essential arms and armour for the local defenders.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un taller bullicioso, donde se fabrican armas y armaduras esenciales para los defensores locales.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: From dusk til' dawn, smoke rises from this forge to equip the armies of Gondor.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Desde el atardecer hasta el amanecer, el humo se eleva de esta fragua para equipar a los ejércitos de Gondor.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: This foundry is a sprawling complex where master artisans forge weapons and armors of the highest quality.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Esta fundición es un complejo extenso donde maestros artesanos forjan armas y armaduras de la más alta calidad.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Here the quartermaster and his logistics team ensure that the troops are well-prepared for war.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Aquí, el intendente y su equipo de logística se aseguran de que las tropas estén bien preparadas para la guerra.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: An intermediary hub, the distributor extends its reach to multiple cities, carefully managing the distribution of supplies.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Como centro intermediario, el distribuidor amplía su alcance a múltiples puestos, gestionando cuidadosamente la distribución de suministros.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Reinforced walls safeguard a substantial reserves of strategically-positioned supplies.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Las paredes reforzadas protegen una reserva sustancial de suministros estratégicamente posicionados.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A sprawling complex caters to the supply chain of the frontline for the armies of Gondor.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un complejo extenso atiende a la cadena de suministro del frente para los ejércitos de Gondor.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The eyes of the White Tower are open here, too.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los ojos de la Torre Blanca también están abiertos aquí.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The defense of Gondor must reach far and wide to protect its people
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: La defensa de Gondor debe extenderse lejos y ampliamente para proteger a su pueblo.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Scouts on horseback and silent rangers roam these lands. Nothing gets past their eyes.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Exploradores a caballo y montaraces silenciosos recorren estas tierras. Nada escapa a su mirada.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Experienced envoys stand vigilant here; to warn, advise, and rouse their people.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Embajadores experimentados permanecen vigilantes aquí; para advertir, aconsejar y animar a su pueblo.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Hope is kindled!
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: ¡La esperanza se enciende!

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Desert scouts and trackers stationed here guard the approach to the Great Desert's riches.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Exploradores y rastreadores del desierto estacionados aquí para vigilar el acceso a los asentamientos haradrim.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Those with keen sight to spot the slightest movement in the sands below provide overwatch.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Aquellos con una vista aguda para detectar el más mínimo movimiento en las arenas de abajo proporcionan vigilancia.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: From here the guards and lookouts of the Haradrim army secure the region.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Desde aquí, los guardias y vigías del ejército haradrim protegen la región.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Its great sandstone bricks seem to touch the very sky, and not a single piece of sand blowing in the wind goes unnoticed.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Sus enormes ladrillos de arenisca parecen tocar el cielo, y ni una sola partícula de arena arrastrada por el viento pasa desapercibida.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A small but valiant people have settled these lands.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un pueblo pequeño pero valiente ha establecido su hogar en estas tierras.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: People from distant sands come here to congregate and trade.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: La gente de arenas lejanas viene aquí a congregarse y comerciar.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A considerable force stands vigil behind these walls, safeguarding the sands as far as eyes can see.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una fuerza considerable se mantiene en vigilia detrás de estas murallas, protegiendo las arenas hasta donde alcanza la vista.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Bustling and ever-growing, this settlement attracts men of all trades.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Bullicioso y en constante crecimiento, este asentamiento atrae a hombres de todos los oficios.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Our stone-masons try their utmost to make fortifications that rival those of Gondor!
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: ¡Nuestros canteros hacen todo lo posible para construir fortificaciones que rivalicen con las de Gondor!

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: One can sparsely walk the streets of this city without meeting exotic travelers and merchants from all over Middle-earth.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Es difícil pasear por las calles de esta ciudad sin encontrarse con viajeros y comerciantes exóticos procedentes de toda la Tierra Media.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Any enemy would smash themselves to smithereens if they were to assault these walls.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Cualquier enemigo se haría pedazos si intentara asaltar estas murallas.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The desert wells here are sufficient to support a few families.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los pozos del desierto de este lugar son suficientes para mantener a unas pocas familias.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Good fortifications ensure our people are safe from both man and beast.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Buenas fortificaciones aseguran que nuestro pueblo esté a salvo tanto de los hombres como de las bestias.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "There is strength in numbers amid the sands of our fathers."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «Hay fuerza en los números entre las arenas de nuestros padres».

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Capable of withstanding assaults from any enemy- and mounting assaults if needs be.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Capaz de resistir los ataques de cualquier enemigo, y lanzar ataques si es necesario.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: With so many of our people flocking to the safety of walls, it would not be long before this place becomes a vital lifeline.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Con tantos de nuestro pueblo acudiendo a la seguridad de las murallas, no pasará mucho tiempo antes de que este lugar se convierta en una encrucijada vital.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A bulwark rising amidst the sands, standing tall and guarding the lands as far as eyes can see.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un baluarte que se eleva en mitad de las arenas, erguido y custodiando las tierras hasta donde alcanza la vista.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Men of all trades and crafts gather in this thriving center of culture and commerce.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Hombres de todas las profesiones y oficios se reúnen en este próspero centro de cultura y comercio.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Where the voices of various peoples are heard and addressed.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Donde se escuchan y se abordan las voces de diversos pueblos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: An oasis of beauty and relaxation amidst the harshness of the sands.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un oasis de belleza y relajación en mitad de la dureza de las arenas.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: More than just gardens, this place offers every luxury known to Harad.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Más que solo jardines, este lugar ofrece todos los lujos conocidos en Harad.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Where the most powerful come to indulge in the finest things life has to offer.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Donde los más poderosos vienen a deleitarse con las mejores cosas que la vida tiene para ofrecer.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The seat of power for the leaders of the sands, where decisions are made over a cup of hot spiced tea.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: La sede de poder de los líderes de las arenas, donde se toman decisiones con una taza de té caliente y especiado.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "The wisdom of our forefathers echoes in these walls, guiding our paths."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «La sabiduría de nuestros antepasados resuena en estas paredes, guiando nuestros pasos».

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Where battle plans are forged, and blood oaths are sworn.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Donde se forjan planes de batalla y se juran juramentos de sangre.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Where the hunters rest, their walls adorned with trophies of the wild.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Donde descansan los cazadores, sus paredes adornadas con trofeos de la naturaleza.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The hunters return to share their tales of daring and cunning.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los cazadores regresan para compartir sus relatos de valentía y astucia.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A collective of hunters, ensuring no beast in the desert goes unchecked.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un colectivo de cazadores, asegurando que ninguna bestia en el desierto quede descontrolada.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A vital rest for traders journeying across the endless sands.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un descanso vital para los comerciantes que viajan a través de las interminables arenas.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Home to those who wander, never settling for long.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Hogar de aquellos que vagan, nunca quedándose en el mismo lugar por mucho tiempo.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Temporary homes for those who seek shelter from the storms of the desert.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Casas temporales para aquellos que buscan refugio de las tormentas del desierto.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Men and women toiling under the harsh sun, shaping the future of Harad.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Hombres y mujeres trabajando bajo el sol implacable, moldeando el futuro de Harad.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Where men are turned into soldiers, ready to serve the cause.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Donde los hombres son convertidos en soldados, listos para servir a la causa.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The backbone of the workforce, labouring without rest for the glory of Harad.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: La columna vertebral de la fuerza laboral, trabajando sin descanso por la gloria de Harad.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Men of trade can see opportunity where others see only sand.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los hombres de comercio pueden ver oportunidad donde otros solo ven arena.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A marketplace filled with the scent of spices and the sound of haggling.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un mercado lleno del aroma de las especias y el sonido del regateo.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A vast marketplace where all the riches of the south can be found.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un vasto mercado donde se pueden encontrar todas las riquezas del sur.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The breadbasket of the desert, where the land is coaxed into life.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: La despensa del desierto, donde se persuade a la tierra para que de vida.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A good camel is worth more than all the riches of the world to a tradesman of the Great Desert.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un hombre que conoce el valor de un buen camello en el desierto.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Like ships of the desert, the camels make port until they set off to far away lands once more.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Criando y cuidando camellos, los barcos del desierto.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Sustaining both man and beast in the harsh desert.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Sustentando tanto a hombre como a bestia en el árido desierto.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The goat herder knows every rock and blade of grass in the desert.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: El cabrero conoce cada roca y hoja de hierba en el desierto.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Where the goats are kept safe from predators and the harsh desert nights.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Donde las cabras son protegidas de los depredadores y las duras noches del desierto.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A thriving farm where the milk and meat of goats sustain many.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una granja próspera donde la leche y la carne de cabras sustentan a muchos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A small but productive farm, providing for those who live upon it.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una pequeña pero productiva granja, que provee para aquellos que viven en ella.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The old fashioned way of grinding grain by hand is not fast enough for the ever-growing desert cities.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Convirtiendo la cosecha en sustento para el pueblo.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Expansive lands that feed our armies and fill our granaries.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Tierras sin fin que alimentan a nuestros ejércitos y llenan nuestros graneros.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The guardian of the flock, ever watchful of the threats lurking in the dunes.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: El guardián del rebaño, siempre vigilante ante las amenazas acechando en las dunas.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Secure enclosures where the sheep are gathered at night.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Recintos seguros donde las ovejas son reunidas por la noche.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Providing wool and meat, these farms are the lifeblood of many communities.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Proporcionando lana y carne, estas granjas son el sustento de muchas comunidades.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Food storing facility.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Edificio para almacenar alimentos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Food storing facility.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Edificio para almacenar alimentos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Food storing facility.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Edificio para almacenar alimentos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: What may seem like strange tools and stranger wargear are just part of the trade for busy Southron hands.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Aquí se producen herramientas de guerra.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Even a broken piece of pottery can become a treasure in the hands of a skilled artisan.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Incluso un pedazo roto de cerámica puede convertirse en un tesoro en las manos de un hábil artesano.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: For those who desire to wear the beauty of the desert around their necks.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Para aquellos que desean llevar la belleza del desierto alrededor de sus cuellos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Banners and symbols that rally our people, the Serpent instilling courage and devotion into their hearts.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Estandartes y símbolos que reúnen a nuestro pueblo. La Serpiente infunde coraje y devoción en sus corazones.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Skilled artisans to make desert cities shine in splendour.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Artesanos expertos para hacer que las ciudades del desierto brillen con esplendor.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "If raw ore could kill a man, the dwarves of the mountains would rule us all. But we've got our own ore, too."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «¡No podemos ir a la guerra con mineral en bruto! Primero hay que fundirlo y procesarlo».

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Every war machine has to be fed with copious quantities of raw materials.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Cada máquina de guerra debe ser alimentada con abundantes cantidades de materiales en bruto.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: What precious little wood the Haradrim have is often used to create works of art.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: La escasa madera que poseen los Haradrim se utiliza a menudo para crear obras de arte.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A master craftsman who dedicated his life to provide the city with woodwork of surpassing quality.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un maestro artesano que dedicó su  vida a proporcionar a la ciudad trabajos en madera de una calidad insuperable.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A skilled congregation of carpenters and artisans who can turn any log into a wonder to behold.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una congregación de hábiles carpinteros y artesanos que pueden convertir cualquier tronco en una maravilla digna de contemplar.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Crafting the most enduring bricks, perfect for withstanding the harsh desert winds.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Forjando los ladrillos más duraderos, perfectos para resistir los duros vientos del desierto.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "Only the best pots are fit enough to adorn our halls."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «Solo las mejores vasijas son lo suficientemente dignas para adornar nuestros salones».

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The burning sun scorches the burning kilns. The output will deliver plenty of goods to our people.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: El sol ardiente quema los hornos ardientes. La producción entregará abundantes bienes a nuestro pueblo.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Threads of gold and silk weave tales of the Black Serpent's glory.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Hilos de oro y seda tejen historias de la gloria de la Serpiente.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The raw materials of our lands, spun into fine threads ready for the loom.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los materiales en bruto de nuestras tierras, hilados en finos hilos listos para el telar.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The finest fabrics, sought after even beyond the Desert's borders.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los mejores tejidos, buscados incluso más allá de las fronteras del desierto.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "Why would we build a new marketplace instead? Have we conquered the desert by selling trinkets?"
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «¿Por qué necesitaríamos un nuevo mercado? ¿Acaso hemos conquistado el desierto vendiendo baratijas?».

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The men of desert tribes display their colours here for all Haradrim to see, and under them they shall march to war.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los colores de las tribus del desierto se exhiben aquí, para que todos sus hombres y súbditos los vean.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: To house the mighty Mûmakil, certain accomodations must be made.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Para albergar al poderoso Mûmakil, es necesario realizar ciertos cambios.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "The finest of our cavalrymen and the most terrible of the Mahûd shall ride into battle together."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «Los mejores de nuestros jinetes y los más temibles de nuestros Mahûd cabalgarán juntos hacia la batalla».

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Veterans and seasoned warriors drill the art of war into Haradrim foot soldiers until it is their very nature.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Veteranos y guerreros experimentados por igual se reúnen alrededor de los fosos, donde el oro y el acero del Oeste se muestran al descubierto para que todo Harad lo vea.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Separate wings for the men who wield glaive, sword, or spear, so their rivalry doesn't become riot.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Separa en alas distintas a los hombres que empuñan gujas, espadas o lanzas, para que su rivalidad no se convierta en disturbios.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: One shot can signify life or death in the desert.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un disparo puede ser la diferencia entre vida o muerte en el desierto.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "Only the best marksmen among our people can come and show their shooting skills to the Black Serpent."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «Solo los mejores tiradores de nuestro pueblo pueden venir y demostrar sus habilidades de tiro ante la Serpiente Negra».

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Simple docks where fishermen and traders moor their vessels.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Muelles simples donde los pescadores y comerciantes amarran sus embarcaciones.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Where the most fearsome sailors of Harad plan their raids.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Donde los marineros más temibles de Harad planean sus incursiones.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The launching point for many a daring raid upon the seas.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: El punto de partida para muchas audaces incursiones en los mares.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Where the black ships of the Corsairs are built and repaired, ready for their next voyage.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Donde se construyen y reparan los barcos de los corsarios, listos para su próximo viaje.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A bustling port, a gateway to the riches of sands far away.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un puerto bullicioso, una puerta de entrada a las riquezas de arenas lejanas.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A major hub of trade, connecting Harad with the wider world.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un importante centro de comercio, conectando Harad con el resto del mundo.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A sprawling network of docks and warehouses, teeming with activity day and night.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una extensa red de muelles y almacenes, rebosante de actividad día y noche.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A grim reminder of the Power of the Shadow, standing ominously in the desert.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un sombrío recordatorio del poder de la Sombra, que se alza amenazador en el desierto.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A place of worship for those who follow the Dark Lord's teachings.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un lugar de culto para aquellos que siguen las enseñanzas del Señor Oscuro.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Here, men gather to honour the memory of Melkor and his great works.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Aquí, los hombres se reúnen para honrar la memoria de Melkor y sus grandes obras.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A secretive place where the most devoted followers of Melkor meet in the shadows.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un lugar secreto donde se reúnen en las sombras los seguidores más devotos de Melkor.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The lifeblood of any army, ensuring our forces are well-provisioned.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: El alma de cualquier ejército, asegurando que nuestras fuerzas estén bien abastecidas.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A blacksmith crafts for both the home and the battlefield, but in Harad, mostly the battlefield.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un herrero fabrica objetos tanto para el hogar como para el campo de batalla, pero en Harad, principalmente para el campo de batalla.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Forging weapons and armour, the blacksmith is indispensable to the Haradrim cause.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: El herrero, que forja armas y armaduras, es indispensable para la causa de los Haradrim.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A place of heat and fire, where the finest weapons are made.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un lugar de calor y fuego, donde se forjan las mejores armas.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A vast industrial complex where iron and steel are transformed into tools of war.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un vasto complejo industrial donde el hierro y el acero son transformados en herramientas de guerra.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A logistics station gathering necessary supplies for the army.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una estación logística que reúne los suministros necesarios para el ejército.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Coordinating the flow of supplies across the desert, ensuring nothing is left to chance.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Coordinando el flujo de suministros a través del desierto, asegurándose de que nada se deje al azar.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A secure storehouse for the vital resources needed by our armies.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un almacén seguro para los recursos vitales necesarios por nuestros ejércitos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The nerve centre of Harad's supply network, ensuring everything runs smoothly.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: El centro neurálgico de la red de suministro de Harad, que garantiza que todo funcione a la perfección.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: An industrial powerhouse always starts small. Given time, even this small camp will be worthy of the White Wizard.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un campamento temporal rudimentario de los hombres salvajes de las Tierras Brunas.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The pesky strawheads will find difficulty crashing through sturdy wooden walls!
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Las rudimentarias fortificaciones proporcionan cierta protección a este campamento temporal.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Day and night, Saruman's workforce treads these busy streets, preparing for the call to action.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un puesto avanzado cuyo objetivo es difundir la influencia de Isengard.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A burgeoning settlement, the industrial marvels made within would inspire awe, were they not so terrible in their use...
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una floreciente colonia, repleta de uruk negros.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Once a city, now a graveyard, home to bats and wolves.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Lo que una vez fue una ciudad, ahora es un cementerio, hogar de murciélagos y lobos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The difference between an orc camp and a camp of Uruks is that the crude tents are somewhat aligned.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un campamento temporal rudimentario de los hombres salvajes de las Tierras Brunas.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Pointed wood beams surround the tents where wildmen and Uruks gather, all bearing the White Hand.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Las rudimentarias fortificaciones proporcionan cierta protección a este campamento temporal.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Spies, wicked men, Uruks, and orcs all live in the same squalor, the only similarity being their hatred of the Free Peoples.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un puesto avanzado cuyo objetivo es difundir la influencia de Isengard.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A burgeoning settlement, swelling with black uruks.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una floreciente colonia, repleta de uruk negros.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The remnants of a once-thriving village,
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los restos de lo que una vez fue una próspera aldea.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A mustering ground where Isengard's orcs gather before being sent to war.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un lugar de reunión donde los orcos de Isengard se reúnen antes de ser enviados a la guerra.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Orcs hone their brutality in these blood-soaked pits.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los orcos perfeccionan su brutalidad en estos fosos empapados de sangre.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A place where Uruk-hai sharpen their skills and prepare for battle.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un lugar donde los uruk-hai refinan sus habilidades y se preparan para la batalla.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Here, only the strongest survive — perfect training for Saruman's elite.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Aquí, solo los más fuertes sobreviven. El entrenamiento perfecto para la élite de Saruman.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The humble abode of a Dunland chieftain, loyal to Isengard.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: La humilde morada de un jefe dunledino, leal a Isengard.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A more elaborate residence for a chieftain, overseeing his wildmen.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una residencia más elaborada para un jefe, con vistas perfectas para supervisas a sus hombres salvajes.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The quarters of an Uruk-hai commander, close to the heart of battle.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Las cuarteles de un comandante uruk-hai, cerca del corazón de la batalla.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Fresh meat, though the source is often questionable.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Carne fresca, aunque de origen cuestionable.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Supplies the forces of Isengard with a steady, if unsavory, diet.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Suministra a las fuerzas de Isengard una dieta constante, aunque poco apetecible.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A factory dedicated to processing and preserving meat for the armies, for meat must always be kept on the menu.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una fábrica dedicada al procesamiento y la conservación de carne para los ejércitos, ya que la carne siempre debe estar presente en el menú.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Dark and damp, prisoners of war are kept here until their fate is decided.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Oscuro y húmedo, aquí se mantienen a los prisioneros de guerra hasta que su destino sea decidido.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "Do you know how the orcs first came into being?"
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «¿Sabes cómo surgieron los orcos en este mundo?»

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A larger facility for holding and tormenting those who oppose Sharky.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una instalación más grande para retener y atormentar a aquellos que se oponen a Sharky.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Forced labour camps where the weak are driven to fuel Sharky's ambitions.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Campos de trabajo forzado donde los débiles son forzados a alimentar las ambiciones de Sharky.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Slaves are bought and sold here, traded like cattle to serve the White Hand.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Aquí se compran y venden esclavos, intercambiados como ganado para servir a la Mano Blanca.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: From here, slaves are dispatched to toil in the pits and forges.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Desde aquí, los esclavos son enviados a trabajar en los fosos y forjas.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The land is tainted and twisted to serve the needs of Isengard.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: La tierra ha sido corrompida y retorcida para servir a las necesidades de Isengard.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Even the earth itself is enslaved, producing crops under duress.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Incluso la misma tierra está esclavizada, produciendo cosechas bajo coacción.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A more extensive agricultural operation, feeding the war machine.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una extensa operación agrícola, alimentando la máquina de guerra.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Vast fields managed by slaves, churning out provisions for Isengard.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Vastos campos trabajados por esclavos, produciendo provisiones para Isengard.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The potions brewed here fuel the strength of Saruman's forces.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Las pociones elaboradas en este lugar alimentan la fuerza de las fuerzas de Saruman.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Mass production of the infamous orcish draughts, increasing their ferocity.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Producción en masa del infame brebaje orco, con ferocidad aumentanda.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Where vile potions are concocted to bolster the might of the White Hand.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Donde se elaboran pociones viles para fortalecer el poder de la Mano Blanca.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The heart of Isengard's industry, where labour fuels the war machine.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: El corazón de la industria de Isengard, donde el trabajo alimenta la máquina de guerra.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Like orcs, no one truly knows how Uruk-hai were created, only that they come from foul, dark places.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los uruk-hai sí salen de la tierra después de todo.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A more extensive network of breeding caves, churning out foot soldiers.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una red más extensa de cabvernas de cría, produciendo soldados rasos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A massive operation dedicated to producing endless waves of orcs.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una enorme operación dedicada a producir oleadas  interminables de orcos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: These craftsmen erect the towering structures that mark Isengard's dominion.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Estos artesanos erigen las imponentes estructuras que demarcan el dominio de Isengard.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Provides the raw materials needed to keep our forges burning.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Proporciona los materiales necesarios para mantener encendidas nuestras forjas.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Here, raw materials are refined into the tools of war.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Aquí, las material prima es refinada y convertida en herramientass de guerra.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Orcs gather whatever scraps they can find to fuel the war effort.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los orcos recogen cualquier pedazo de chatarra que puedan encontrar para alimentar el esfuerzo de guerra.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Even the Uruks need clothing; this mill produces the rags they wear.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Incluso los uruks necesitan ropa; esta hilandería produce los trapos que usan.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Churns out uniforms for the battalions and platoons of Isengard, crude but functional.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Fabrica uniformes para los batallones y pelotones de Isengard, toscos pero funcionales.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Crude, but effective weapons are forged here for the orc hordes.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Burdas, pero efectivas armas son forjadas aquí para las hordas orcas.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Gear crafted from scrap, ready to be used by the Uruk-hai.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Equipo hecho de chatarra, listo para ser utilizado por los uruk-hai.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Where tools and weapons are mass-produced for armies that bear the White Hand.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Donde se fabrican en masa herramientas y armas para los ejércitos que llevan la Mano Blanca.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The methodical mind of Saruman ensures that even at the lowest level, army recruitment is well managed.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Donde los hombres salvajes se reúnen y son entrenados para luchar bajo el estandarte de Saruman.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "There is no such force? Have a look at this."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «¿No existe tal fuerza? Echa un vistazo a esto».

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The elite of Saruman, the Uruk-hai prepare here for war.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: La élite de Saruman, los uruk-hai se preparan aquí para la guerra.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The barracks housing Saruman’s finest, the fearsome Uruk-hai.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los barracones que albergaban a los mejores soldados de Saruman, los temibles uruk-hai.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The crossbow is yet another battlefield edge for the Uruk-hai, and here they learn to wield them.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: La ballesta es otra ventaja más en el campo de batalla para los uruk-hai, y aquí aprenden a manejarla.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Live targets. Not the worst way to go for slaves of Isengard.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Blanco vivo. No es la peor forma de morir para los esclavos de Isengard.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A simple dock for Isengard’s limited naval operations.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un muelle sencillo para las limitadas operaciones navales de Isengard.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Ferries transport goods and troops across the rivers of Middle-earth.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los transbordadores transportan bienes y tropas a través de los ríos de la Tierra Media.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A modest port where Isengard’s ships can dock and unload.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un modesto puerto donde los barcos de Isengard pueden atracar y descargar.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A bustling hub for the transport of goods and soldiers by water.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un bullicioso centro para el transporte de mercancías y soldados por agua.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Where Saruman’s twisted experiments push the boundaries of nature and magic.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Donde los retorcidos experimentos de Saruman empujan los límites de la naturaleza y la magia.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The gathering place for those who betray their kin for Saruman’s favor.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Aquí se reunen aquellos que traicionan a sus parientes a cambio del favor de Saruman .

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Where the dark arts are practiced, under the watchful eye of Saruman.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Donde se practican las artes oscuras, bajo la atenta mirada de Saruman.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A place of learning, where the White Wizard's apprentices delve into forbidden knowledge.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un lugar de aprendizaje, donde los aprendices del Mago Blanco se adentran en conocimientos prohibidos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Basic supplies are stored here, ensuring the army’s needs are met.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Las provisiones básicas se almacenan aquí, asegurando que se satisfagan las necesidades del ejército.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Burning the old world in the fires of industry.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Quemando el viejo mundo en las llamas de la industria.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The clang of hammers echoes as weapons are forged for war.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: El sonido metálico de los martillos resuena mientras se forjan armas para la guerra.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Weapons and armour are crafted here with relentless efficiency.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Las armas y armaduras son elaboradas aquí con una eficiencia implacable.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Molten metal and fire combine to create the tools of industry.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: El metal fundido y el fuego se combinan para crear las herramientas de la industria.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Basic attempts to ensure the Uruk-hai are always prepared for battle.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Intentos básicos para asegurarse de que los uruk-hai estén siempre preparados para la batalla.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A more organised effort to manage and distribute supplies across Saruman's domain.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un esfuerzo más organizado para gestionar y distribuir suministros en todo el dominio de Saruman.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Stronghold for storing and protecting crucial supplies from the enemy.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Fuerte para almacenar y proteger suministros cruciales del enemigo.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The nerve centre for Isengard’s supply lines, ensuring nothing is left to chance.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: El centro neurálgico de las líneas de suministro de Isengard, asegurando que nada se deja al azar.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Sentinels keep a close eye on the surrounding lands from these high towers.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los centinelas mantienen una estrecha vigilancia sobre las tierras circundantes desde estas altas torres.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A place for scouts to regroup and report on enemy movements.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un lugar para que los exploradores se reagrupen y reporten sobre los movimientos enemigos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Orc raiders assemble here before setting out on their pillaging runs.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los saqueadores orcos se reúnen aquí antes de salir en sus incursiones de pillaje.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Saruman's eyes are everywhere, even amoung birds and beasts.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los ojos de Saruman están en todas partes, incluso entre los pájaros y las bestias.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Orcs settle, but their rest is always temporary, for war ever calls to them.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los orcos se establecen, pero su descanso siempre es temporal, pues la guerra siempre los llama.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Even the foulest rabble knows to build defenses to keep enemies at bay.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Incluso la chusma más repugnante sabe construir defensas para mantener a raya a los enemigos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Without the command of an overlord, orc settlements are doomed to remain as a sprawl of tents.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Nuevas tierras caen bajo el puño de hierro de Sauron.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The sheer size and population of an orc city inspires a morbid, horrified awe. That an orc could create at such scale is a wonder on its own.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un dominio cada vez mayor sobre las tierras libres.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Once prosperous, now a haunting reminder of Sauron’s reach.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Lo que una vez fue próspero es ahora un recordatorio inquietante del alcance de Sauron.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Quickly nailed together, an orc camp would look like a ruin to any other race. Indeed, many orc camps are simply old ruins with tarps.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los orcos se establecen, pero su descanso siempre es temporal, pues la guerra siempre los llama.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Orc fortifications are rough and ugly, but they can at least deter a direct assault.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Incluso la chusma más repugnante sabe construir defensas para mantener a raya a los enemigos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Walking through an orc town may almost make one believe that orcs are capable of such things as 'society' and 'productivity.'
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Nuevas tierras caen bajo el puño de hierro de Sauron.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: An ever-expanding grip on the free lands.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un dominio cada vez mayor sobre las tierras libres.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The shadow of Mordor leaves only desolation in its wake.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: La sombra de Mordor solo deja desolación a su paso.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A place where orcs muster before they march.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un lugar donde los orcos se reúnen antes de marchar.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: You don't exactly need a place to start a fight, but it does feel more important that way.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los mejores orcos demuestran aquí su valía.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Here, the strong survive, and the weak... do not.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Aquí, los fuertes sobreviven, y los débiles... no.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: It's a common misconception that orcs love fighting. In reality, they just can't help themselves.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Entrenar a través del dolor es lo que se hace en  Mordor.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: One of the highest marks of orc culture is living somewhere that has both a door and floorboards.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: No sería adecuado para los capitanes vivir bajo el cielo.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: From the squabbling and scraping, a tactical plan eventually emerges, usually at the cost of a few lesser orc captains.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Muchas mentes reunidas pueden idear planes de batalla más intrincados que los anteriores, siempre y cuando no se maten entre sí primero.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The dwelling of a warlord, stained with blood and hate.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: La morada de un señor de la guerra, manchada de sangre y odio.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Orcs need meat, and they are not picky about the source.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los orcos necesitan carne, y no son exigentes con su origen.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Fresh or rancid, it is all the same in Mordor.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Fresco o rancio, en Mordor no hay diferencia.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "Meat is meat, now move along."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «La carne es carne, ahora sigue adelante».

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A holding place for the disobedient, or those stupid enough to get on the chief's bad side.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un lugar de detención para los desafortunados... o desobedientes.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "The screams of pain are music to our ears."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «Los gritos de dolor son música para nuestros oídos».

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The fortunate are merely imprisoned; the unfortunate are forgotten.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los afortunados simplemente están encarcelados. Los desafortunados han sido ya olvidados.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Hard work or death - the only choices in Mordor.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Trabajo duro o muerte: las únicas opciones en Mordor.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: No greater honour can defeated scum have than to serve the Master with their mind and flesh.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: La vida es barata; las almas lo son aún más.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Nowhere in Middle-earth can be seen such a great, constant flow of slaves and slavers.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: No hay mayor honor para la escoria derrotada que servir al Amo con su mente y su carne.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The soil here could support a crop or two.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: La tierra de aquí podría soportar uno o dos cultivos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Slaves labour here day and night to feed Mordor's hosts.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los esclavos trabajan aquí día y noche para alimentar a las huestes de Mordor.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: It is only the all-encompassing ash that keeps the soil fertile in the Black Land, if indeed it is fertile at all.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Incluso el Señor Oscuro no puede proveer alimento para las incontables almas en Mordor.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Fields as far as the eyes can see- the only greenery for leagues about.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Campos hasta donde alcanza la vista. La única vegetación en leguas a la redonda.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Potions and poisons brewed for nefarious purposes.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Pociones y venenos elaborados con fines nefastos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A dark concoction for every need.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una mezcla oscura para cada necesidad.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Crafting vile elixirs to aid in the dark arts.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Creando viles elixires para ayudar en las artes oscuras.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: On your feet, scum!
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: ¡De pie, escoria!

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Orcs spawn from the deep, ready to serve the Eye.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los orcos surgen de las profundidades, listos para servir al Ojo.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: An endless stream of fresh muscle for the front lines.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un flujo interminable de sangre nueva para el frente.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Orcs are bred like flies, destined for the front lines, to die at the Master's whim.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los orcos se crían como moscas, destinados al frente, para morir a capricho del Amo.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Even the Dark Lord needs his architects.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Incluso el Señor Oscuro necesita arquitectos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The very bones of the earth are ripped out for Mordor’s needs.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los mismos huesos de la tierra son arrancados para satisfacer las necesidades de Mordor.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Forged from darkness and blood, materials of war are churned out relentlessly.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Forjados a partir de la oscuridad y la sangre, los materiales de guerra se producen sin descanso.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: No material is too worthless in the service of Sauron.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Ningún material es demasiado insignificante al servicio de Sauron.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "Even in the heat and darkness of Mordor we have need for cloaks."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «Incluso en el calor y la oscuridad de Mordor necesitamos capas».

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Sable garments fit for the Dark Lord's dark armies.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Prendas de marta cibelina aptas para los oscuros ejércitos del Señor Oscuro.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Crude, effective, and always ready for battle.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Burdo, eficaz y siempre listo para la batalla.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Armaments of the lowest order, but they do the job.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Armamento de baja calidad, pero cumple su función.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Weapons and tools forged in the fires of hate.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Armas y herramientas forjadas en las llamas del odio.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The ranks swell with soldiers who only know the crack of whips.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Las filas se llenan de soldados que solo conocen el chasquido de los látigos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "Form ranks you maggots!"
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «¡Formad filas, gusanos!».

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: They have a cave troll. What about a second cave troll? Or a hundred?
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Tienen un troll de las cavernas. ¿Y qué hay de un segundo troll de las cavernas? ¿O cien?

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Iron whips and scalding hot irons. Brutality is the only training they need.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Látigos de hierro, porras al rojo vivo, la brutalidad es el único entrenamiento que necesitan.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Hard beds and harder lives. That's Mordor’s way.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Camas duras y vidas aún más duras. Así es Mordor.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A select number of orcs have enough skill to be properly trained, and are as deadly as any soldier in the west.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un flujo interminable de sangre nueva para el frente.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: "Now you're getting the hang of orc archery. Fire enough arrows and hope to hit the target."
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: «Sí, muy típico de los orcos. Disparar suficientes flechas y esperar dar en el blanco».

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Fear of getting ripped in half by a troll will usually keep Mordor's archers accurate.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: El miedo a ser destrozados por un troll suele hacer que los arqueros de Mordor sean precisos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Mordor's ships dock here, bringing goods and slaves.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Las naves de Mordor atracan aquí, trayendo bienes y esclavos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Transporting the dark forces across waters, unseen and deadly.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Transportando las fuerzas oscuras a través de las aguas, invisibles y mortales.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Where the river meets the dark land.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Donde el río se encuentra con la tierra oscura.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Ships unload, and the spoils of war flow in.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Las naves descargan, y los botines de guerra fluyen.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Apprentices of the Master gather here to share their knowledge.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los aprendices del Maestro se reúnen aquí para compartir sus conocimientos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A breeding ground for treachery and deceit.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un caldo de cultivo para la traición y el engaño.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: All know and bow to the one true Lord of the World - Sauron the Great.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Todos conocen y se inclinan ante el único y verdadero Señor del Mundo: Melkor.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: One tower to watch them all.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una torre para vigilarlos a todos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: No shortage of jagged iron hooks to disembowel and dismember!
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los Nazgûl se reúnen aquí, esperando la llamada de su maestro.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The armies of Mordor must be fed... somehow.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los ejércitos de Mordor deben ser alimentados... de alguna manera.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Blades are forged in darkness and sharpened in hate.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: ¡No faltan ganchos de hierro dentados para destripar y descuartizar!

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: It was the forging of the Great Ring that started it all, after all.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Las espadas se forjan en la oscuridad y se afilan con odio.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A warrior is only as good as his equipment...that's not saying much in Mordor.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Fue la forja del Gran Anillo lo que lo dió comienzo a todo, después de todo.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Weapons and armour sets are churned out here faster than you can curse Gondor.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Aquí se fabrican armas y armaduras a un ritmo más rápido de lo que tardas en maldecir a Gondor.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Moving rations, weapons, and foul intentions across the land.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Un guerrero es tan bueno como su equipo... lo cual no es decir mucho en Mordor.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Stores of war, guarded and sealed tight.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Moviendo raciones, armas, y malas intenciones a donde hagan falta.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Where the plans of conquest are supplied and organised.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Almacenes de guerra, vigilados y sellados herméticamente.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The Eye is watching you...
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Donde se elaboran y organizan los planes de conquista.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: No unusually short orcs will be sneaking away now.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: El Ojo te está observando...

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Plunderers assemble, ready to wreak havoc.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: No hay orcos inusualmente bajos que se escapen de la formación, los exploradores los detectarían.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Knowledge is power, and power is what the Master craves.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Los saqueadores se reúnen, listos para sembrar el caos.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Here the lords of evil men swear their fealty to the Dark Lord.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: El saber es poder.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Here the lords of evil Men swear their fealty to the Dark Lord.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Aquí, los señores de los hombres malvados juran lealtad al Señor Oscuro.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Nestled amongst the rolling hills, it has the potenial to one day rival Edoras.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Enclavado entre colinas onduladas, tiene el potencial de rivalizar algún día con Edoras.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Grown up from its modest beginnings thanks to the hard work of the people, its inhabitants live a good life.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Gracias al esfuerzo de su gente, ha crecido desde sus modestos comienzos y sus habitantes disfrutan de una buena vida.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Rohan's cities may be built from timber instead of stone, but they are the same cosmopolitan hubs as those over the White Mountains.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Las ciudades de Rohan pueden estar construidas con madera en lugar de piedra, pero son los mismos centros cosmopolitas que los que se encuentran más allá de las Montañas Blancas.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Thriving and prosperous cities like this help ensure the dominion of men.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Ciudades prósperas y florecientes como esta contribuyen a garantizar el dominio de los hombres.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Placeholder short description
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder short description

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Like the Éothéod's first camp in Calenardhon, the people of Rohan begin anew here.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Al igual que el primer campamento de los Éothéod en Calenardhon, el pueblo de Rohan comienza de nuevo aquí.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Thatched roofs, humble abodes, a simple community, but no less cherished by its people.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Techos de paja, viviendas humildes, una comunidad sencilla, pero no por ello menos apreciada por sus habitantes.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Where the men and women of Rohan build their lives and legacies.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Donde los hombres y mujeres de Rohan construyen sus vidas y legados.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Placeholder short description
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder short description

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Placeholder short description
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder short description

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: A loud, bustling street with market stalls in the shadows of houses: from a bargain to trouble anything can be found here.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Una calle ruidosa y bulliciosa con puestos de mercado a la sombra de las casas: desde gangas hasta problemas, aquí se puede encontrar de todo.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Set away from the rest of the settlement, bakeries are surrounded by warm air and the delicious scent of their trade.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Alejadas del resto del asentamiento, las panaderías están rodeadas de aire cálido y del delicioso aroma de su oficio.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: In a cool cellar, crates of root vegetables line the walls and smoked meats hang from wooden beams, in preparation of the coming winter.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: En una fresca bodega, cajas de tubérculos se alinean contra las paredes y carnes ahumadas cuelgan de vigas de madera, en preparación para el invierno que se avecina.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The golden bounty of harvests is stored in sacks or large barrels, protected from the elements and ready to be used.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: La abundante cosecha dorada se almacena en sacos o grandes barriles, protegida de los elementos y lista para ser utilizada.

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Placeholder short description
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder short description

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Placeholder short description
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder short description

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: Placeholder short description
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: Placeholder short description

building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_original: The heart of the Rohan's administration, officials convene here to direct public affairs through frightfully well carried out proclamations.
building_short_description_texts_short_d.value_translated: El corazón de la administración rohirrica, los funcionarios se reúnen aquí para dirigir los asuntos públicos mediante proclamaciones terriblemente bien ejecutadas.
