character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: At least he wanted to give his army glory in battle, but he did not consider the odds.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por derrotas decisivas como atacante[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSe le dificulta coordinar ofensivas efectivas.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: This one would send a horse against a Mûmakil. Clearly he does understand the balance of power in batle.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por derrotas decisivas como atacante[[/rgba]]\\n\\nComete costosos errores cuando se lanza al ataque.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: They say insanity is repeating the same action and expecting a different result.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por derrotas decisivas como atacante[[/rgba]]\\n\\nInepto en planificar y ejecutar asaltos.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: In the habit of claiming victory on the battlefield.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por victorias decisivas o heroicas como atacante[[/rgba]]\\n\\nLidera asaltos con precisión y confianza.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: “Victorious warriors win first and then attack, while defeated warriors attack first and then seek to win.”\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por victorias decisivas o heroicas como atacante[[/rgba]]\\n\\nInfunde terror en los enemigos cuando está a la ofensiva.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: High King Fingolfin would be impressed at this one's relentless offensives.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por victorias decisivas o heroicas como atacante[[/rgba]]\\n\\nConocido por ataques devastadores e implacables.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Should not go into battle again until his bodyguard is replenished.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por luchar cuerpo a cuerpo como comandante[[/rgba]]\\n\\nLleva las marcas de muchas batallas.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Turning the tide of battle was their hope as his protectors threw themselves into the fray.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por luchar cuerpo a cuerpo como comandante[[/rgba]]\\n\\nForjado en el crisol de la guerra.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: He will not fall while his guards defend him. They still defend him! They have died defending him!\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por luchar cuerpo a cuerpo como comandante[[/rgba]]\\n\\nUn guerrero experimentado, moldeado por el conflicto interminable.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Acknowledges that casualties are simply part of war.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por una gran cantidad de bajas en batalla[[/rgba]]\\n\\nEl comandante ha probado el sabor de la guerra y se ha acostumbrado a sus brutales exigencias.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Winning is worth the cost, right?\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por una gran cantidad de bajas en batalla[[/rgba]]\\n\\nPocos pueden resistir los implacables ataques de este comandante; allá donde va, el enemigo cae en masa.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: The more blood and mutilated corpses left on the field after battle, the greater a battle it was.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por una gran cantidad de bajas en batalla[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSu nombre se susurra en el viento; su paso deja tras de sí campos en ruinas y un legado escrito con sangre.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Would ask no more of his soldiers than he would of himself.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por victorias decisivas donde el comandante luchó cuerpo a cuerpo[[/rgba]]\\n\\nEnfrenta el peligro sin titubear.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: You've go two already? Ha! I'm on seventeen!""\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]"
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por victorias decisivas donde el comandante luchó cuerpo a cuerpo[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSe mantiene firme ante adversidades abrumadoras.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: A true inspiration to his army, his warriors fight harder knowing he fights amoung them.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por victorias decisivas donde el comandante luchó cuerpo a cuerpo[[/rgba]]\\n\\nInspira valor mediante hazañas legendarias.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: He who defends his home from behind the door will not stop it from being burned.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por pasar muchos turnos en regiones enemigas[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSe ha aventurado lejos de casa, llevado por curiosidad o ambición.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: More at home in the lands of his enemies than in his own.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por pasar muchos turnos en regiones enemigas[[/rgba]]\\n\\nObtiene conocimiento y experiencia desde tierras lejanas.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Crossed the whole of Middle-earth to make war on his enemies.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por pasar muchos turnos en regiones enemigas[[/rgba]]\\n\\nLidera audazmente hacia lo desconocido, sin temor.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Has found a few new places for his people to reside.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por colonizar enclaves desolados[[/rgba]]\\n\\nEste comandante ha colocado las primeras piedras sobre la tierra arrasada, donde solo ruinas yacian antes.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: We can build a city anywhere.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por colonizar enclaves desolados[[/rgba]]\\n\\nHa creado puntos de apoyo en medio de la desolación más de una vez, llevando estructura donde no habia ninguna.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Concerned with the settlement of unclaimed lands in Middle-earth.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por colonizar enclaves desolados[[/rgba]]\\n\\nPocos pueden convertir ruina en fuerza. Comanda el filo de la civilización, cambiando el descampado en fortalezas listas para la guerra.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: From the distant peaks come cries of vengeance; from the roots of the mountains, a tremor of rage. The dwarves will never forget.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por múltiples victorias contra los enanos[[/rgba]]\\n\\nHa demostrado habilidad combatiendo enanos.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Dwarven mothers tell tales of this one, to ensure that their children behave.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por múltiples victorias contra los enanos[[/rgba]]\\n\\nUn temido enemigo para los enanos.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Even among the bards and singers of the elves, the tale of slaughter and pain that this one caused leaves them without song or word.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por múltiples victorias contra los elfos[[/rgba]]\\n\\nHa matado elfos y se jacta de ello.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: The Halls of Mandos are filled with awaiting-elves who lost their lives against this one: his feats a display of cruelty, worthy of the worst of tapestries.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por múltiples victorias contra los elfos[[/rgba]]\\n\\nReconocido por sus victorias contra los elfos.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Men are predictable. They seek to avoid death, yet it is often their desires that lead them to it. To defeat them, one need only apply this same logic to the battlefield.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por múltiples victorias contra los hombres[[/rgba]]\\n\\nExperimentado en batallas contra hombres.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: “The Age of Men is over. Our time has come.”\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por múltiples victorias contra los hombres[[/rgba]]\\n\\nUn terror para los reinos de los hombres.\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Gross creatures they are. Terrifying, even. And yet they die all the same.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por múltiples victorias contra orcos[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSabe como rastrear y derrotar orcos.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Never since the days of the Ñoldor has anyone slain so much filth.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por múltiples victorias contra orcos[[/rgba]]\\n\\nTemido por los orcos, por muchas matanzas.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: It's their fault too...being on our land before we got here.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por ocupar asentamientos[[/rgba]]\\n\\nConocido por tomar tierras enemigas.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: The settlement was taken before the defenders even realized it was lost.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por ocupar asentamientos[[/rgba]]\\n\\nAplasta la resistencia bajo su voluntad.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Whether or not he puts the people to the sword, he has already slaughtered the entire defending force.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por ocupar asentamientos[[/rgba]]\\n\\nHa aniquilado por completo reinos enemigos.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Constant worry clouds his mind, his nerves frayed and fragile.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido al perder una batalla donde el comandante no peleó cuerpo a cuerpo[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSuele mostrarse indeciso frente al peligro.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: This one's courage seems to fail at every step.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido al perder una batalla donde el comandante no peleó cuerpo a cuerpo[[/rgba]]\\n\\nReacio a comprometerse en batalla.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: His resolve is easily shattered by the reality of conflict.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido al perder una batalla donde el comandante no peleó cuerpo a cuerpo[[/rgba]]\\n\\nEvita el conflicto en cada oportunidad.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: The attack, always the attack. He does not know how to defend.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por derrota decisiva cuando defiende[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSe le dificulta conservar territorio.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: His soldiers would throw down their arms as soon as they see the enemy on the field.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por derrota decisiva cuando defiende[[/rgba]]\\n\\nMuy frecuentemente se retira cuando más se le necesita.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Even if his enemy had to traverse a bay, a mountain, and the Black Gate before reaching the field, he would still lose the battle.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por derrota decisiva cuando defiende[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSus ciudades caen como piezas de dominó.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Knows how to turn defense into a deadly weapon.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por victoria decisiva o heroica cuando defiende[[/rgba]]\\n\\nMatiene la linea cuando otros vacilan.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: The dwarves likely got the idea of their shield walls from this one.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por victoria decisiva o heroica cuando defiende[[/rgba]]\\n\\nConvierte fortalezas en bastiones.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: More unyielding and resolute than the Númenórean stone used to construct Orthanc.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por victoria decisiva o heroica cuando defiende[[/rgba]]\\n\\nLos asedios solo fortalecen su determinación.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Removes all trace that a people ever lived in that place.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por arrasar asentamientos[[/rgba]]\\n\\nDeja destrucción a su paso.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Erasing all memory of a people from the histories is his hobby.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por arrasar asentamientos[[/rgba]]\\n\\nQuema y arrasa sin piedad.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: For Middle-earth to be remade, it must first be unmade.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por arrasar asentamientos[[/rgba]]\\n\\nNinguna ciudad queda en pie cuando ha terminado.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: He is gathering all soldiers to him.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por pasar muchos turnos en actitud de reclutamiento[[/rgba]]\\n\\nMantiene sus tropas bien entrenadas.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: I'm outnumbered. I need more warriors.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por pasar muchos turnos en actitud de reclutamiento[[/rgba]]\\n\\nDirige ejércitos con precisión.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Soon he will be ready to make his war.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por pasar muchos turnos en actitud de reclutamiento[[/rgba]]\\n\\nEntrena soldados de élite de implacable eficiencia.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Witnesing too many dwarven shield walls makes him wary of the sons of Durin.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido al perder batallas contra enanos[[/rgba]]\\n\\nTiene dificultades contra la armadura pesada y obstinada furia de los enanos.\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: All those beards give me a terrible fright!\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido al perder batallas contra enanos[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSe estremece al sonido de botas de hierro y martilos de guerra. Los enanos rompen mucho más que escudos.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Too many battles over before he even knew where the arrows came from.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido al perder batallas contra elfos[[/rgba]]\\n\\nDuda contra los elfos - rápidos, silenciosos y letales.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Well they are immortal, so perhaps challenging them isn't the best idea.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido al perder batallas contra elfos[[/rgba]]\\n\\nAtormentado por tormentas de flechas y espadas fantasmas. Los elfos atacan antes que él los vea.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: They are unruly and will not be ruled. To challenge them is to court death.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido al perder batallas contra hombres[[/rgba]]\\n\\nCansado de la guerra tras enfrentarse a la fuerza y el orden de los hombres.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: What is it that gives mens' hearts so much fortitude against us?\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido al perder batallas contra hombres[[/rgba]]\\n\\nLa confianza le falla cuando los hombres forman filas. Su valor corta más profundo que las espadas.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Retreating from the spawn of Melkor too often is cause for pause.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido al perder batallas contra orcos[[/rgba]]\\n\\nPerturbado por la ira y el enjambre de las hordas de orcos.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: There are too many. What can men do against such reckless hate?\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido al perder batallas contra orcos[[/rgba]]\\n\\nPreso del terror cuando enfrenta los tambores, aullidos y la inmundicia de las partidas de guerra orcas.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Garden salad? You mean those weeds?\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por pasar muchos turnos en territorio enemigo o entrar en áreas con desgaste[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSabe como sobrevivir en tierras hostiles, viviendo de lo que se pueda conseguir.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: In harmony with nature.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por pasar muchos turnos en territorio enemigo o entrar en áreas con desgaste[[/rgba]]\\n\\nMantiene su fuerza alimentada mediante astuto saqueo y pillaje.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Middle-earth provides.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por pasar muchos turnos en territorio enemigo o entrar en áreas con desgaste[[/rgba]]\\n\\nHace la guerra sin la necesidad de tren de suministros. La tierra provee - de una manera u otra.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Winning such victories thanks to his grasp of battlefield tactics.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por victoria heroica contra una fuerza enemiga superior[[/rgba]]\\n\\nJuglares y guerreros por igual hablan de su coraje - un nombre que se escuha tanto en hogueras como en las cortes.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Famous amoung the famous. \\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por victoria heroica contra una fuerza enemiga superior[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSus victorias inspiran temor y esperanza en igual medida. Historias de sus hazañas cruzan fronteras e idiomas.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: His company will follow him to whatever end.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por victoria heroica contra una fuerza enemiga superior[[/rgba]]\\n\\nMás que meramente un comandante - Es un nombre a recordar, un símbolo de triunfo que perdurará más allá de la guerra.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Surely he would not let his army rest when there is glory soon at hand.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por pasar múltiples turnos en actitud de marcha forzada[[/rgba]]\\n\\nAcostumbrado a largos caminos y poco descanso, a este comandante no le son desconocidas las penas de la marcha.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: His army moves faster than any other in Middle-earth, forewards or backwards. His men get out of trouble quicker then they got into it.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por pasar múltiples turnos en actitud de marcha forzada[[/rgba]]\\n\\nEntrenado para llevar tanto al ejército como asi mismo a través de grandes distancias, este genenral no pierde tiempo entre batallas.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: When he learned the Orocarni Mountains are as far as or greater from the Misty Mountains than the Misty Mountains are from the Blue Mountains, he decided to test the theory.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por pasar múltiples turnos en actitud de marcha forzada[[/rgba]]\\n\\nImpulsa a los hombres hacia adelante con voluntad incansable, cubriendo leguas en el tiempo que a otros les toma reunirse. Su llegada es rápida y a menudo inesperada.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: His quality is known amoung his enemies.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por perdonar a los cautivos después de la batalla[[/rgba]]\\n\\nPerdona a los derrotados frecuentemente. La piedad es rara en la guerra.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Would never keep a slave, nor suffer one to be kept.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por perdonar a los cautivos después de la batalla[[/rgba]]\\n\\nConocido por ofrecer cuartel y mantener el orden después de la victoria.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Your life is yours. Depart this place freely.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (Militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por perdonar a los cautivos después de la batalla[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSe apega a la justicia en la guerra - un alma excepcional que templa la espada.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Leave none alive.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por ejecutar a los prisioneros después de la batalla[[/rgba]]\\n\\nNo se da cuartel. La espada termina lo que la batalla comienza.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: He did not come to destroy homes or crops, he came to destroy people...down to the last child.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por ejecutar a los prisioneros después de la batalla[[/rgba]]\\n\\nConocido por sus castigos despiadados y su venganza implacable.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Has done great things. Terrible!...things. But great.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por ejecutar a los prisioneros después de la batalla[[/rgba]]\\n\\nUn terror tanto para los enemigos como para los prisioneros. Donde él marcha, la piedad muere.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: You merely adopted the dark. I was born in it, moulded by it.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido al ganar batallas nocturnas como atacante[[/rgba]]\\n\\nLucha bien en la oscuridad, donde sus movimientos audaces desestabilizan a los desprevenidos.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Striking from the shadow is the best way to catch the enemy off guard.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido al ganar batallas nocturnas como atacante[[/rgba]]\\n\\nUtiliza la noche como tapadera para incursiones y ataques sorpresa.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Only the moon and the stars bore witness to the battle laid before them.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido al ganar batallas nocturnas como atacante[[/rgba]]\\n\\nUn maestro del crepúsculo y las sombras. Las batallas comienzan cuando los demás duermen.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: This will teach them. \\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido al saquear o arrasar asentamientos[[/rgba]]\\n\\nHa participado en las primeras devastaciones de tierras enemigas, golpeando ligeramente pero dejando huella.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: The blood washes off the gold, not to worry.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido al saquear o arrasar asentamientos[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSabe cómo quebrantar el espíritu de una tierra: graneros vaciados, hogares fríos y caminos inseguros.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Making an example of those that would defy him. \\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido al saquear o arrasar asentamientos[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSu llegada se susurra con temor: las ciudades se vacían, los campos son pisoteados y la ruina sigue como un manto.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: This must be like what the dwarves felt after Azanulbizar.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido tras una victoria pírrica en la que el comandante luchó en combate cuerpo a cuerpo[[/rgba]]\\n\\nAudaz, quizás demasiado. Se lanza a la carga antes de sopesar todas las opciones.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: You think you're alive because you can fight? You are alive because of what I did to save you!\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido tras una victoria pírrica en la que el comandante luchó en combate cuerpo a cuerpo[[/rgba]]\\n\\nA menudo exige demasiado a sus hombres, aunque a veces funciona.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Victory is his. Barely. And likely only because he entered the fray.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido tras una victoria pírrica en la que el comandante luchó en combate cuerpo a cuerpo[[/rgba]]\\n\\nConocido por sus riesgos temerarios y sus ataques repentinos. Gloria o ruina. No hay término medio.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Maybe he thought the numbers were on his side. He fooled around and found out.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido al perder una batalla como atacante contra una fuerza enemiga superior[[/rgba]]\\n\\nArriesgó y perdió más de lo que valía la apuesta.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: If I can at least weaken them, it's worth the sacrifice.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido al perder una batalla como atacante contra una fuerza enemiga superior[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSus apuestas suelen salir mal. Demasiado impaciente, poco prudente.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: He tries, he fails. He tries, he fails. Perhaps he should stop trying.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido al perder una batalla como atacante contra una fuerza enemiga superior[[/rgba]]\\n\\nFamoso por sus errores disfrazados de valentía. Su suerte se ha agotado.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Fortune favours the bold.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido al ganar una batalla como atacante contra una fuerza enemiga superior[[/rgba]]\\n\\nApostó y ganó. A veces la fortuna favorece a los audaces.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: An unexpected victory, to be sure, but a welcome one.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido al ganar una batalla como atacante contra una fuerza enemiga superior[[/rgba]]\\n\\nHace que las jugadas arriesgadas salgan bien la mayoría de las veces. Mirada aguda, nervios de acero.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Puts no stock in odds or probabilities. He knows the strength of the heart, and sword arm, of every warrior under his command.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido al ganar una batalla como atacante contra una fuerza enemiga superior[[/rgba]]\\n\\nAtrevido, peligroso y, por lo general, acertado. Un general de instinto y golpes audaces.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: My army is never late, nor is it early. It arrives precisely when I mean it to.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por ganar batallas defensivas reforzando a otro ejército[[/rgba]]\\n\\nEste comandante es conocido por llegar en el momento en que los aliados más necesitan acero y fuerza.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Two armies are better than one.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por ganar batallas defensivas reforzando a otro ejército[[/rgba]]\\n\\nYa sea por lealtad, deber o beneficio, la oportuna llegada de este general ha cambiado el rumbo de la batalla más de una vez.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: The victory does, in fact, belong to me. It was I that lead our people to victory.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido por ganar batallas defensivas reforzando a otro ejército[[/rgba]]\\n\\nPocos llegan a tiempo. Menos aún llegan a menudo. Su nombre se invoca en momentos de desesperación.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: At least he sails the ship toward the enemy, but that's about all the skill he's got.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido tras perder batallas navales como atacante[[/rgba]]\\n\\nInexperto en asaltos navales; mueren más hombres ahogados que en tierra.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Sailors weigh their chances jumping overboard.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido tras perder batallas navales como atacante[[/rgba]]\\n\\nLe resulta dificil coordinar abordajes y asaltos marítimos.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: The fleet is lost before it even sets sail.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido tras perder batallas navales como atacante[[/rgba]]\\n\\nUn desastre marítimo conocido. Sus barcos naufragan y sus asaltos fracasan.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Leads his sailors to victory with confidence and valour when attacking.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido tras ganar batallas navales como atacante[[/rgba]]\\n\\nMuestra cierto potencial para liderar ataques desde el mar.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: All captains know his flagship.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido tras ganar batallas navales como atacante[[/rgba]]\\n\\nDirige a las tripulaciones de abordaje con precisión y sincronización letal.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Even the Great Armament would be sunk if he attacked first.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido tras ganar batallas navales como atacante[[/rgba]]\\n\\nUn despiadado incursor marítimo. Las costas arden allá donde su flota pone pie en tierra.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Victory at sea becomes him.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido tras ganar batallas navales[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSujeta el timón con mano firme, aunque aún le falte destreza.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: No captain can do very wrong if he places his ship alongside that of the enemy.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido tras ganar batallas navales[[/rgba]]\\n\\nExperto en maniobras, señalización y guerra bajo el viento marino.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: As skilled as Eärendil in his command of the seas.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido tras ganar batallas navales[[/rgba]]\\n\\nUn veterano comandante de flota. Ni las tormentas ni los enemigos lo detienen.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Asks for his brown pants when he sees enemy ships on the horizon.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido tras perder batallas navales como defensor[[/rgba]]\\n\\nMal preparado para defender barcos o puertos bajo ataque.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Knows the further he is from the harbour, the higher the chance of defeat.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido tras perder batallas navales como defensor[[/rgba]]\\n\\nCalcula mal las mareas, las tácticas enemigas y el momento oportuno.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: His ships leak enough water that they begin to sink before battle even begins.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido tras perder batallas navales como defensor[[/rgba]]\\n\\nUn lastre en el mar. Los defensores caen donde él los comanda.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: The enemy captain won't realize he's fallen into a trap until it's sprung.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido al ganar batallas navales como defensor[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSabe cómo mantener una línea en el mar y cuándo contraatacar.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: He wins because his ships out-maneuver the enemy.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido al ganar batallas navales como defensor[[/rgba]]\\n\\n Combina su defensa con la marea y el acero. Sus barcos se mantienen firmes.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Uses wind and wave for his defense, often making his enemy sail against the wind for battle.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido al ganar batallas navales como defensor[[/rgba]]\\n\\nUna fortaleza flotante. Sus barcos no huyen, aplastan.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Found his sea legs right quick.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido tras pasar varios turnos en el mar[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSe ha acostumbrado a la vida a bordo de un barco.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Seems he prefers to travel by water. Quick. Smart.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido tras pasar varios turnos en el mar[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSe siente cómodo con el viento, las olas y los viajes largos.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Channeling his inner Númenórean.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido tras pasar varios turnos en el mar[[/rgba]]\\n\\nUn auténtico marinero de los mares que ha contemplado horizontes lejanos.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: From atop their battlements his enemies laugh as his troops flounder outside the walls.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido tras perder batallas de asedio como atacante[[/rgba]]\\n\\nHa fracasado en sus asaltos y ha perdido hombres innecesariamente ante las murallas.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Might not be the best idea to send the enritre army through a single breach in the wall.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido tras perder batallas de asedio como atacante[[/rgba]]\\n\\nCarece de sincronización, concentración y astucia: las puertas enemigas se mantienen firmes.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: His siege equipment is usually destroyed before it even gets into position.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido tras perder batallas de asedio como atacante[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSus repetidos errores le han hecho famoso por no quebrar nada más que su propio ejército.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: An army can never have enough siege equipment.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido tras ganar batallas de asedio como atacante[[/rgba]]\\n\\nDemuestra aptitudes para derribar murallas y liderar asaltos.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Uncanny how this one always seems to know the right spots of his enemies' walls to attack.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido tras ganar batallas de asedio como atacante[[/rgba]]\\n\\nRompe puertas, derriba muros: una mano eficaz en el arte del asedio.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: He will smash all walls to the ground in glorious siege.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido tras ganar batallas de asedio como atacante[[/rgba]]\\n\\nUn veterano maestro del asedio. Las ciudades caen, las torres arden y el camino siempre queda despejado.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: You are soldiers! No matter what comes through the gates you will stand your ground!\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido tras ganar batallas de asedio como defensor[[/rgba]]\\n\\nDefendió las murallas contra un enemigo una vez y aprendió el valor de los cuellos de botella.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: They will break upon our walls like water on rock. Crops can be resown, homes rebuilt. Within these walls, we will outlast them.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido tras ganar batallas de asedio como defensor[[/rgba]]\\n\\nGestiona murallas, reservas y contraataques con gran perspicacia.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: You!...shall not!...pass!!!!!\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido tras ganar batallas de asedio como defensor[[/rgba]]\\n\\nUn comandante de fortalezas con mucha experiencia. Pocos logran atravesar sus puertas, y menos aún sobreviven al intento.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Knows that for victory in the desert the army must move from water to water.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido al ganar batallas en terreno desiertos[[/rgba]]\\n\\nHa aprendido a moverse y atacar bajo el sol abrasador y las arenas movedizas.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: To win is imperative. To win easily is a blessing. He found that blessing in the desert.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido al ganar batallas en terreno desiertos[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSabe dónde marchar, dónde atacar y cómo desangrar al enemigo en el desierto.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Commands the very sands to swallow his enemies.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido al ganar batallas en desiertos[[/rgba]]\\n\\nUn experimentado comandante del desierto. Las dunas y el viento seco son sus aliados.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: His soldiers feel at home in the woods.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido al ganar batallas en bosques[[/rgba]]\\n\\nHa aprendido el peligro y el valor de luchar bajo los árboles.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Makes good use of the forest's tactical advantages.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido al ganar batallas en bosques[[/rgba]]\\n\\nMueve tropas con sigilo y astucia bajo el dosel del bosque.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Would have made a fine Marchwarden for the Girdle of Doriath.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido al ganar batallas en bosques[[/rgba]]\\n\\nUn maestro de la guerra en el bosque: sus ataques son silenciosos y rápidos.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Keeping the high ground while on the side of a mountain should be rather easy.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido al ganar batallas en montañas[[/rgba]]\\n\\nHa experimentado la tensión de la guerra en grandes altitudes y pasos estrechos.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: The rock shakes and trembles as his army approaches; it knows a mighty battle is at hand.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido al ganar batallas en montañas[[/rgba]]\\n\\nLidera bien en terrenos irregulares y pendientes escarpadas, donde los necios caen y los guerreros escalan.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: His charge down or up the mountain is more glorious than a thunderstorm battle between stone giants.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido al ganar batallas en montañas[[/rgba]]\\n\\nDomina las alturas como un señor de las montañas nato. Pocos pueden derrotarlo en ellas.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: He prefers battle in the wastes. No unexpected variables.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido al ganar batallas en yermos[[/rgba]]\\n\\nEndurecido por la batalla en tierras muertas donde la esperanza se desvanece y el terreno es traicionero.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Fighting in the wasteland makes his army tougher.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido al ganar batallas en yermos[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSabe cómo marchar y matar donde otros pierden el ánimo: entre polvo, ruinas y huesos.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Puts the Dead Marshes to shame with all the enmies he's killed in the wastes.\\n\\n[[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Military Experience[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:204:255:1]]Experiencia (militar)[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Adquirido al ganar batallas en yermos[[/rgba]]\\n\\nUn veterano de campos de batalla abandonados. Gobierna las ruinas y las convierte en su campo de batalla.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: A Capain with the courage to do his lord's will, he is loyal to his father, not some Wizard's pupil.\\n\\n[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]] [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Gained by events, cannot be lost.[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Obtenido por eventos, no se puede perder.[[/rgba]]\\n\\nEl orgullo de su padre, a quien prefiere por encima de su hermano.

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: [[rgba:204:229:255:1]]Generic[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Survived an assassination attempt[[/rgba]]\\n\\nA poor organiser of much-needed security that would keep ill-doers at a distance.
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:229:255:1]]Genérico[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Ha sobrevivído a un intento de asesinato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nUn pésimo organizador de seguridad, la cual tanta falta hace para mantener a los malhechores a distancia.

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: [[rgba:204:229:255:1]]Generic[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Survived an assassination attempt[[/rgba]]\\n\\nCareless by nature as far as his own security is concerned.
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:204:229:255:1]]Genérico[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Ha sobrevivído a un intento de asesinato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nDescuidado por naturaleza en lo que respecta a su propia seguridad.

Sus tropas sufren la misma suerte bajo el sol abrasador.

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Of the most noble house of all the corsairs that sail from Umbar, none other would dispute his lordship over the Black Haven.\\n\\n[[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendary Trait[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendario[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]No se puede mejorar[[/rgba]]\\n\\nUn corsario despiadado cuyo nombre es temido desde la bahía de Belfalas hasta las costas de Harad Lejano. Ar-Belzagar inspira terror y lealtad a partes iguales, y sueña con un nuevo dominio númenóreano que surja del mar.

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Once a proud man of Númenórean lineage, but since swayed by Sauron's promises.\\n\\n[[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendary Trait[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendario[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]No se puede mejorar[[/rgba]]\\n\\nAntiguos hechiceros y tiranos, corrompidos por la Oscuridad.

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: He strikes without warning, and disappears into the desert night. He is the Black Serpent, patriarch of the Lostladen Tribe, and the one man destined to unite the Haradrim.\\n\\n[[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendary Trait[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendario[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]No se puede mejorar[[/rgba]]\\n\\nAzote de los desiertos y rey esclavista del sur.

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Faramir, youngest son of Steward Denethor II of Gondor, leads the Rangers of Ithilien in patrolling the forested lands on the east bank of the Anduin and harrying any orcs entering those lands from the Morgul Vale.\\n\\n[[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendary Trait[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendario[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]No se puede mejorar[[/rgba]]\\n\\nHumilde y sabio montaraz, protector de las fronteras de Gondor.

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Boromir, eldest and favourite son of the Steward, is the chief commander of Gondor's military. His leadership and ability to inspire his troops lead the city of Osgiliath to be reclaimed, for Gondor! For Gondor! For GONDOR!\\n\\n[[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendary Trait[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendario[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]No se puede mejorar[[/rgba]]\\n\\nAmado guerrero de Gondor. Valiente hombre que carga con el peso de su tierra.

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: The Dark Lord cannot yet take physical form, but his spirit has lost none of its potency. He exists now as the Great Eye, lidless, wreathed in flame.\\n\\n[[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendary Trait[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendario[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]No se puede mejorar[[/rgba]]\\n\\nEncarnación de la sombra y el fuego que ha regresado para dominar el mundo.

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Elrond Half-elven founded the elven refuge of Imladris after the Fall of Eregion. He is bearer of Vilya, member of the White Coucil, foster of Aragorn, and had led Isildur into the Sammath Naur, where the One Ring was forged, the one place it could be destroyed.\\n\\n[[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendary Trait[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendario[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]No se puede mejorar[[/rgba]]\\n\\nElrond el Medio Elfo, sabio más allá del entendimiento de los hombres, es el guardián del conocimiento antiguo y la previsión. Su presencia fortalece la determinación, y sus consejos dan forma al curso de los reinos.

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: The Chieftain of the Rhúrim clan, annointed by the Dark Lord as ruler of the steppes, he will subdue the Easterling clans through sheer power of will. All of Rhûn shall answer to him.\\n\\n[[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendary Trait[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendario[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]No se puede mejorar[[/rgba]]\\n\\nTras forjar la unidad con sangre y fuego, Khahar ahora gobierna como emperador de Rhûn, temido, venerado y sin rival entre los orientales.

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Erkenbrand is the Lord of the Deeping-coomb, the green valley that begins five leagues from the Fords of Isen and ends where the Hornburg stands. He is the chief lord of the West-fold, second in command there to Prince Théodred. \\n\\n[[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendary Trait[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendario[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]No se puede mejorar[[/rgba]]\\n\\nErkenbrand, un defensor incondicional de las tierras de Rohan, reúne a sus hombres en los momentos más oscuros. Su cuerno ha resonado en el Abismo de Helm y más allá, llevando la fuerza de la Marca a la batalla.

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: As a Marchwarden of Lothlórien, Haldir guarded the forest’s northern borders and acted as guide and sentry for visitors to Caras Galadhon. He met the Fellowship on 15 January, T.A. 3019 near the streams of Nimrodel and Silverlode.\\n\\n[[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendary Trait[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendario[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]No se puede mejorar[[/rgba]]\\n \\nHaldir, centinela del Bosque Dorado, protege las fronteras del reino de Galadriel. Sus guerreros se mueven con silenciosa precisión, y sus flechas son tan rápidas y certeras como la luz de la luna entre los árboles.

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Son of Khahár, the Chieftain of the Rhúrim clan, he is one of the brightest tactical minds of the steppe, and a gifted swordsmen to boot. One day all the East will be his.\\n\\n[[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendary Trait[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendario[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]No se puede mejorar[[/rgba]]\\n\\nUn señor de la guerra cuyo poder va en aumento, destinado a unir bajo su dominio a las dispersas huestes del Este.

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Aragorn carried the Shards of Narsil everywhere with him as a Ranger and wore the Ring of Barahir, heirlooms of his direct descent from the lineage of Isildur.\\n\\n[[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendary Trait[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendario[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]No se puede mejorar[[/rgba]]\\n\\nEl rey oculto, un líder predestinado, ha regresado.

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: A veteran of Azanulbizar, Glóin was one of Thorin Oakenshield's company on the Quest for Erebor, and fought in the Battle of the Five Armies. He accompanied his son Gimli to the Council of Elrond as representatives of the dwarves.\\n\\n[[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendary Trait[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendario[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]No se puede mejorar[[/rgba]]\\n\\nVeterano curtido y firme enano de Erebor.

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Descended from the line of Girion, he is the King of the City and the surrounding realm of Dale.\\n\\n[[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendary Trait[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendario[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]No se puede mejorar[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSábio gobernante y heredero del Matadragones, reconstructor de Valle.

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Twisted by some ill spell, Théoden King is a man so bent with age that he seems almost a dwarf. Even his mind is weighed down with sorrows, his dreams darkened. And yet, his eyes still burn with a bright light.\\n\\n[[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendary Trait[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendario[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Nivel 1[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSu corona aún descansa sobre su frente, pero el fuego de sus ojos se ha apagado. character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Thanks to Greyhame, the shadows that darkened Théoden King's mind are gone! He now stands against the treachery of Orthanc, worthy of his new title: "Ednew", the Renewed.\\n\\n[[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendary Trait[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendario[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Nivel 2[[/rgba]]\\n\\nAntaño cautivo, ahora renacido para llevar a los Rohirrim a la gloria.

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: In his throne is set the Arkenstone, for he is the King of Erebor, greatest and grandest surviving dwarven mansion.\\n\\n[[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendary Trait[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendario[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]No se puede mejorar[[/rgba]]\\n\\nRey y guerrero inquebrantable, escudo de la Montaña Solitaria.

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Thranduil, son of Oropher, is the ruler of the Woodland Realm, an isolated and secure kingdom of Silvan elves hidden beneath the boughs of Mirkwood.\\n\\n[[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendary Trait[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendario[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]No se puede mejorar[[/rgba]]\\n\\nOrgulloso y reservado rey elfo, guardián del Bosque Negro.

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Khamûl the Easterling, one of the Nine, second in authority only to the Witch-king, is named the Lieutenant of Dol Guldur by Sauron about T.A. 2951. character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendario[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]No se puede mejorar[[/rgba]]\\n\\nEl segundo de los Nueve, envuelto en hechicería y sombras.

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Lord and Castellan of Minas Morgul when his master the Witch-king is not in residence. A ruthless and sadistic Black Númenórean, Morgul orcs fear Gothmog almost as much as the Witch-king.\\n\\n[[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendary Trait[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendario[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]No se puede mejorar[[/rgba]]\\n\\nBrutal comandante de campo, criado para la guerra y la conquista.

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Imrahil the Fair was the Prince and ruler of the port-city of Dol Amroth and fiefdom of Belfalas during the War of the Ring. character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendario[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]No se puede mejorar[[/rgba]]\\n\\nNoble príncipe de las costas de Gondor, valiente y leal.

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Celeborn of the Sindar, husband of Galadriel, is the Lord of Lothlórien and principal captain of the Galadhrim.
