character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendario[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]No se puede mejorar[[/rgba]]\\n\\nAntiguo y noble señor de los elfos, protector del Bosque Dorado.

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: The Witch-king of Angmar is the Lord of the Nazgûl and the most formidable servant of the Dark Lord. He orchestrated the downfall of the kingdom of Arnor and was responsible for breaking the line of the kings of Gondor.\\n\\n[[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendary Trait[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendario[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]No se puede mejorar[[/rgba]]\\n\\nEl primero de los Nueve, temible comandante de las huestes de Mordor.

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: The first and largest uruk-hai to be born in the pits of Orthanc, Lurtz personally led the patrol to track the Fellowship, catching up with them at Amon Hen.\\n\\n[[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendary Trait[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendario[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]No se puede mejorar[[/rgba]]\\n\\nLurtz, el primero de los Uruk-hai de Saruman criados para la guerra, es un comandante brutal forjado en las fosas bajo Orthanc. Lidera con fuerza bruta, lealtad inquebrantable y sed de conquista.

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Commanding Rohan's cavalry, Éomer is the Third Marshal of the Riddermark, nephew of King Théoden, and cousin to Prince Théodred.\\n\\n[[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendary Trait[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendario[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]No se puede mejorar[[/rgba]]\\n\\nAudaz capitán de los Rohirrim, destinado a llevar la corona.

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Saruman the White was given the Key of Orthanc in T.A. 2759 to manage the western defenses and there discovered the Orthanc-stone, using it to secretly commune with Sauron. He took Isengard for his own with the death of Steward Turgon in T.A. 2953.\\n\\n[[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendary Trait[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendario[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]No se puede mejorar[[/rgba]]\\n\\nEl mago caído, cuya ambición lo lleva a manipular a todos para que le sirvan.

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: The orders for this general of the uruk-hai are simple: March to Helm's Deep. Leave none alive. \\n\\n[[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendary Trait[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendario[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]No se puede mejorar[[/rgba]]\\n\\nMog, un jefe temido incluso entre los suyos, se gana la obediencia a través de la carnicería. Su furia es un arma, su camino está marcado por la ruina y su ambición solo está limitada por la fuerza de sus enemigos.

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Prince and Second Marshal of the Riddermark, Théodred is the only son and heir of King Théoden of Rohan. He commands the realm's western forces.\\n\\n[[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendary Trait[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendario[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Nivel 1[[/rgba]]\\n\\nHijo devoto y príncipe.

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Théodred fights with valour and distinction as he repels the uruk-hai and Dunlending armies from the Riddermark. The people of Rohan are confident that he will not let the Westfold fall again.\\n\\n[[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendary Trait[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendario[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Nivel 2[[/rgba]]\\n\\nHijo devoto y príncipe, probado en la batalla.

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Legolas of the Woodland Realm is the son of King Thranduil. He represented the Woodland Realm at the Council of Elrond and was chosen to represent the elves in the Fellowship.\\n\\n[[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendary Trait[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendario[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]No se puede mejorar[[/rgba]]\\n\\nArquero letal y ágil hijo del bosque.

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Once a powerful lord of men, long since corrupted by one of Sauron's nine Rings of Power; now a mighty instrument in the Dark Lord's terrifying arsenal.\\n\\n[[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendary Trait[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendario[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]No se puede mejorar[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSombras inmortales que siembran el miedo y la ruina.

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Gimli, son of Glóin was born in T.A. 2879. Gimli attended the Council of Elrond and was chosen to represent the dwarves in the Fellowship. He is the only dwarf ever to be allowed to travel to Valinor because of his bond with Legolas.\\n\\n[[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendary Trait[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendario[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]No se puede mejorar[[/rgba]]\\n\\nGuerrero leal e intrépido, atado a un juramento y a su hacha.

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: The Steward Denethor looked indeed much more like a great Wizard than Gandalf did, more kingly, beautiful, and powerful; and older.\\n\\n[[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendary Trait[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendario[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]No se puede mejorar[[/rgba]]\\n\\nLleva sobre sus hombros el peso de la Ciudad Blanca, gobernando en lugar de los reyes ausentes. Orgulloso, de mente aguda y agobiado por su clarividencia, su vigilia protege Gondor, pero su voluntad se desgasta bajo la sombra.

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Son of Dáin II Ironfoot, Thorin III was born T.A. 2866 and became Lord of the Iron Hills when his father became King. He fought in the Batle of Dale in T.A. 3019 against the Easterlings, becoming King after Dáin is killed in the battle.\\n\\n[[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendary Trait[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendario[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]No se puede mejorar[[/rgba]]\\n\\nHijo de Dáin Pie de Hierro y heredero del legado de Erebor, Thorin Escudo de Roble es un rey guerrero de determinación inquebrantable. Endurecido por la guerra y agobiado por el deber, se erige como un escudo entre la Montaña y la Sombra.

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Commanding the uruk-hai patrol after Lurtz's death, Uglúk quarreled with Grishnákh over what route and in what condition to take Merry and Pippin to Isengard. On the border of Fangorn he announced that meat was back on the menu.\\n\\n[[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendary Trait[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendario[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]No se puede mejorar[[/rgba]]\\n\\nEntre los uruk-hai, Uglúk destaca por su astucia y crueldad. Leal a Saruman, pero feroz por derecho propio, impulsa a sus guerreros hacia adelante con amenazas gruñidas y espadas ensangrentadas.

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: In memoriam DeAustriae. Seldom do the knights of Rohan turn their minds to books or the lore of ages past. Such matters they leave to the elders, while they themselves rise at dawn to train with spear and shield, and spend their days riding across the wide plains of Calenardhon. In this, Winfried is unlike his kin. Born to a noble household of the east of Rohan, just beneath the shadows of the White Mountains, he would often ride not to join the Éored, but to be at peace as he read the books and words of old. Alone and for years, he travelled far and wide, to seek the wisdom of the elves, to learn the secrets of the dwarves, and to read of the ancient times from whichever scroll laid in the darkest archives of Minas Tirith. Nowadays, his valour as a wise man, a learned scholar, and a just governor is recognised from the Westfold to the halls of Anórien.\\n\\n[[rgba:153:51:153:1]]Legendary Trait[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: In memoriam DeAustriae.\\n\\nLos caballeros de Rohan rara vez se interesan por los libros o las tradiciones de épocas pasadas. Dejan esos asuntos a los ancianos, mientras ellos se levantan al amanecer para entrenarse con la lanza y el escudo, y pasan los días cabalgando por las amplias llanuras de Calenardhon. En esto, Winfried es diferente a los suyos. Nacido en una familia noble del este de Rohan, justo al pie de las Montañas Blancas, a menudo montaba a caballo no para unirse a los Éored, sino para encontrar la paz leyendo libros y palabras antiguas. Solo y durante años, viajó por todas partes en busca de la sabiduría de los Elfos, para aprender los secretos de los Enanos y leer sobre los tiempos antiguos en cualquier pergamino que se encontrara en los archivos más oscuros de Minas Tirith.\\n\\nHoy en día, su valor como hombre sabio, erudito y gobernador justo es reconocido desde el Folde Oeste hasta los salones de Anórien.

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: [[rgba:255:128:0:1]]Special trait[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Can never be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nThe most formidable servant of the Dark Lord.
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nHas a talent for leading his people into great accomplishments.\\n\\n

[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nKnows how to govern lands despite being short of many things - funds, food, or able-bodied fighters.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nWastes no hour in search of efficiency over the lands he is tasked to safeguard.\\n\\n
Doesn't mind climbing over others, or knocking them down a few rungs, on the ladder of success.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nAspira a llegar más alto, sin importar el coste.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Knows his station and does not waste any time to let others know it, too.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nHabla y actúa con confianza y claridad.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Stern, disciplined, simple. Not much of a personality.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nEspartano en sus hábitos, severo en su estilo de vida.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: An example to others in situations many would flee from.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nEnfrenta el peligro sin dudar.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Or prudent? One might wager they are the same.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nMide todos los riesgos antes de actuar.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: A cult of personality follows this one.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nAtrae naturalmente a los demás para que le sigan y crean en él.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: The very idea of battle makes him ill.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nRápido huyendo cuando cambia la marea.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Perhaps war has changed him for the worse.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nDisfruta con el dolor y la dominación.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Manipulating and deceiving his enemies while often hiding his true intent.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nPrefiere el engaño y las trampas a la fuerza bruta.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Actively works against his superiors and his realm.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nDispuesto a traicionar si la recompensa es lo suficientemente grande.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Whatever his beliefs are, he ardently defends them.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nArde con devoción por una causa o un credo.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Does not want the weight of grudges on his conscience.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nNo guarda rencor y cree en las segundas oportunidades.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Has an appreciative love of food and drink.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nAma la buena comida más que las marchas difíciles.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Material possessions give this one excessive gratification.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSiempre buscando más, sin importar el coste.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Quick to anger, even the most trivial and inconsequential things set him off.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSe enfada con facilidad y es difícil controlarlo.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Though he does not bear the ring Narya, his soldiers are inspired to fight as if he does.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nLidera con el ejemplo y levanta el ánimo de los soldados.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: It will be done my way.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nFirme en sus propósitos, incluso bajo presión.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Has to act tough outwardly to keep appearances, but is a real softy at heart.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nDe naturaleza amable y lento para castigar.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Why do today what I can put off until tomorrow?\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nEncuentra comodidad en la ociosidad y evita el esfuerzo.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Serves his master with loyalty to a fault.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nServidor devoto, sin importar las dificultades.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: When opportunity knocks, he answers. \\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nAprovecha el momento, sin importar a quién perjudique.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: With such sneaky schemes and plots, he could give Gríma a run for it.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSiempre tramando planes a puerta cerrada.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Known for his calm demeanour, thinking before acting.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nInmune a las adversidades, inquebrantable en el cumplimiento del deber.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Wary of the plots hatched in hushed voices, dark alleys, and behind secret doors. \\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nVe traición acechando en cada sombra.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Since he believes his underlings to be loyal, he is okay with sharing information they'd otherwise not be privy to.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nCree en la bondad de los demás, a veces de forma ciega.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: If this one says he'll do something, he'll do it. Others trust him for that.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nFiable en sus palabras, acciones y lealtad.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Melkor should think about replacing Sauron with this one as his lieutenant.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nGobierna mediante el miedo y una disciplina férrea.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Woe upon those who have wronged him. He is coming.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nRecuerda cada ofensa y ajusta todas las cuentas.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Sees Middle-earth not for what it is, but for what it could be.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nVe el futuro con claridad e inspira el progreso.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: It's not out of malice that he doesn't care about the goings-on of Middle-earth, he just doesn't have any desire to.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nPrefiere la soledad y evita los asuntos públicos.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: [[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nKnows his station and does not waste any time to let others know it, too.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nConsidered demanding by many of his kin.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nThe thrill of battle and bloodshed is enough to put him into a frenzy.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSeldom known to rush into action before weighing his options.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nPrefers to know his enemies' whereabouts before taking decisive action.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nKnows how to give an inspiring speech to motivate his troops.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nCan rally his men to action even in the most disheartening situations.\\n\\n

[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nCan be trusted to motivate his troops to fulfill their oaths, even if it means riding into certain death.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nCan be entrusted to put his men in a favourable position on the field of battle.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nHas a natural talent for warfare, even the more arcane aspects of it.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nNavigates around most battlefields with brazen impunity.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSwift and resolute in every mission, trusting his own capabilities.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSpeaks his mind directly, whether it causes him trouble in the end.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nHas a habit of taking into possession things that are not strictly his own.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nPrefers the safety and comfort of a bed over a saddle.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSeldom seen leading his army from the front.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nMakes use of an artful mindset to find his own solutions.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nHas a certain disregard for any life that is not his own.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nWill stop at nothing to further his own ambition.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nFamiliar with many things of the vast world beyond.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nValues his own interests highly, sometimes above the greater cause.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nDisregards the greater good for his own self-interest.\\n\\n
Resigned himself that the Dúnedain do not have the strength left to stop the shadow from covering Middle-earth.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nAgobiado por la larga lucha de Gondor, este personaje espera lo peor y se prepara para perder.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Few men ever receive the gift of foresight.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nDotado de una profunda perspicacia, este personaje anticipa las amenazas antes de que surjan.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: There is no reason to not follow ancient tradition. It worked then, it will work now.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nDedicado al estudio del derecho, la historia y la sabiduría, este personaje encuentra su fuerza en el conocimiento.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: It is true the Dúnedain are a blessed race of men, but it has gone to his head.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nOrgulloso de su antiguo linaje, este personaje mira con desdén a los hombres inferiores.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: The Men of the Mountains were too weak to fulfill their oathes, but no such weakness is found in the hearts of Gondor.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nAtado por promesas sagradas, este personaje nunca renegará de un voto.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Gondor is the greatest realm that ever was or will be!\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nFerozmente leal al legado de Gondor, este personaje antepone el honor del reino a todo lo demás.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Resisting the shadow for as long as they have existed, the descendants of the Dúnedain grow wary.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nDesconfiado de todos los que sirven al Enemigo, este personaje ve la mano de la Sombra en todas partes.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Whether gripping sword, shield, bow, or spear, Dúnedain hands and hearts do not falter.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSereno y disciplinado, este personaje no se tambalea en momentos de presión.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: We act under the law of the men of Gondor; anything else is mere brigandage."\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nFiel creyente en la ley y la justicia, este personaje defiende el orden de Gondor con claridad y precisión.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Bring the casks! A sober army fights like a smith with cold tongs!\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nJovial y cordial, aunque a veces le gusta demasiado la bebida.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Makes loyalty to the dwarven clan he belongs to the primary lense for his decisions.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nLa lealtad hacia los familiares supera todos los demás lazos.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Gold and gems are not only found near the surface, but in the deep places.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSiempre curioso por saber qué hay debajo de cada piedra.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: His love of gold teters on the edge of dragon-sickness.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nValora profundamente la riqueza, tanto para el clan como para el salón y para sí mismo.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: I'll always prefer a good ol' fashioned hammering. Why rely on anything but blunt force?\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nFuerte de brazos, rápido para resolver problemas con el acero.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: A dwarf whose honour is bound to clan, craft, and lineage.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSe enorgullece de su habilidad y herencia, a veces hasta el punto del desprecio.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Conveys his plans in Khuzdul and only to his inner circle.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nComparte poco más allá de lo que debe decirse.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: With nerves as unyielding as the rock of his halls.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nResistente e imperturbable, como las propias montañas.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: The stubborness of the dwarves is legend. Gandalf stormed off from Thorin's company once exclaiming that he was the only one around with any sense.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nNo se desviará, incluso cuando la sabiduría lo aconseje.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: He speaks little and listens deeply, measuring words like rare ore.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nHabla poco, actúa con cuidado, lo observa todo.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: [[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nPrefers to seize the initiative in battle.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nKnown to forge his own luck rather than waiting for an opportunity to present itself.\\n\\n
A bond sealed in blood that shapes his fate, with dangerous and dire cost should he foresake it.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nProfunda lealtad hacia la familia y los parientes.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Unwaveringly determined to reach his goals by any means necessary.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nBrutal ejecutor de la disciplina y la obediencia.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Devoid of mercy in victory and vengeance; to him, it is the greatest of all weakness.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nImplacable y despiadado con sus enemigos y rivales.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Pitty the poor soul who believed this one had enough honour to fulfill an oath.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nConocido por traicionar pactos y alianzas.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: A proud member of the Balchoth clan, this one's heart flutters when a new raiding and pillaging target is agreed upon.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nEncuentra placer en el saqueo y las incursiones.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Family, home, and clan are his greatest sources of pride. And he's not ashamed to show it.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSentido exagerado de grandeza y superioridad personal.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Seethes with contempt for everyone outside of his immediate circle.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nDesprecia a los extranjeros.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Had a waking dream of a unified Rhûn; now works to make it so.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nBusca unir a las tribus divididas bajo un solo gobierno.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: He will not yield a single inch of Rhûn to his enemies, and once his attack is begun he will not yield until his enemy's destruction. He is both immovable and unstoppable.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nNunca se echa atrás ante un conflicto.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: An insatiable hunger for war drives him to terrifying ferocity. Even the Valar breathe a sigh of relief that he is mortal.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nVive para el caos de la batalla.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Fanatic would be an understatement. He would convert the whole of Middle-earth, or put them all to the sword if they resisted.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nFerviente creyente en las antiguas costumbres y el fervor religioso.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Awoke so very long ago at Cuiviénen.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nHa vivido durante largos siglos; cargado con recuerdos y sabiduría.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Fëanor's implacable wrath at the theft of the Silmarils and the murder of his father Finwë is matched by this one's burning anger.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nPropenso a la ira apasionada y a los actos precipitados; orgulloso y peligroso.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: His movement, speech, and presence carry a quiet, effortless harmony.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSe mueve con naturalidad y elegancia; inspira respeto.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: The elves are the Firstborn after all. Surely that means they are superior.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nMira con desprecio a los mortales y a los seres inferiores.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Speaks, reads, and writes Quenya, Telerin, and Sindarin, and all of their linguistic branches.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nDotado para la oratoria y los idiomas; tiende puentes entre culturas con facilidad.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: With his kin making their exodus from Middle-earth, what light could possibly hold back the darkness?\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSufre el peso de los siglos y la gloria que se desvanece.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Yearns for the Blessed Realm of Valinor.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nAnhela las Tierras Imperecederas; desapegado del mundo.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: The elves have their own labours and their own sorrows. Mine is to keep unending watch on the shadow.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSiempre cauteloso ante el regreso del mal; desconfiado y siempre alerta.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: The courage of his heart shines like Eärendil, most beloved star. May it be a light in dark places, when all other lights go out.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nElegido o predestinado por un propósito divino; misterioso y etéreo.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Will know no peace until Sauron is at last cast from Arda. \\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nConstantemente vigilante; rara vez descansa o cede al cansancio.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Sworn to a single, relentless purpose in the same way Fëanor's Oath bound him and his sons singularly to the recovery of the Silmarils.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nPosee una determinación indomable; nunca se deja influir.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: A true champion of Yavanna.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nProtector de los bosques y los lugares naturales.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Whether gifted from Aman or earned throughout the ages of Middle-earth, the compassion within this one's heart is the pinnacle of the Firstborn. \\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nCompasivo y comprensivo; una voz firme en el consejo.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: [[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nArduous or demanding tasks seldom prevent this man from seeing them through to completion.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSeldom seen commanding from the rear of his army.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nDoes not lose his composure even when faced with foes beyond his strength.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nKeen on proliferating his beliefs far and wide.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nNever known to back down from a fight, even one in which he may not prevail.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nPrefers benevolence over selfishness when the well-being of others are at stake.\\n\\n

[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nKnown for his refined palate, with a love for foods ranging from mashed potatoes to crispy bacon.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nMaterial possessions grants this man excessive gratification.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nPlaces emphasis on that which to many is long lost or long forgotten.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nKnown to rush into action, often before thinking through his options.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nExceptionally clever and able to make good use of his quick wits.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nUses authority indiscriminately to bend servants to his will.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nMore accepting of other races, beliefs and ways of life than many around him.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nWields the power of penmanship and uses it to great efficiency.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nPlaces significant trust in his superiors at all times.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nMuch would have to go wrong in the world for him to abandon his cause.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSeldom heard or seen doing anything out of place.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nKnown to harbour no love for anyone but his own kin.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nThrives in the dark and will use the night to his advantage.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nFears the dark and the creatures of terror that call it 'home'.\\n\\n
Treats all those he meets with a humble respect.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nDiscreto y respetuoso, se gana la confianza con palabras cuidadas y un espíritu generoso.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Full of deceit and possessing a most untrustworthy account. \\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nDice una cosa y quiere decir otra; un maestro de las mentiras sutiles y las manipulaciones.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: A courage made man, with a fire like those found in the Edain burning brightly in his core. \\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nValiente y enérgico, conocido por lanzarse sin dudar al peligro.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Wants his name to last into the next age of Middle-earth.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nImpulsado por el deseo de alcanzar la fama; ansioso por ganarse canciones y renombre a través de la batalla.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Whether from decadence or simple overestimation, he believes himself vastly superior to others.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSiente un gran orgullo por su familia y su país; a menudo se resiste a los consejos o a las influencias externas.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: The pleasantries are useless. Get to the point.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nFranco y brusco en el habla y el comportamiento; carece de refinamiento, pero inspira respeto por su fuerza de voluntad.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Never one to pass up a drinking game or friendly brawl.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nRuidoso, alegre y a menudo disruptivo en las reuniones; prospera en los salones pero no en el consejo.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: His foes grudginly respect this mountain of a man, for he plants his boots and will not be moved.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nEndurecido por largos inviernos, años oscuros y fuego de dragón. Firme y tranquilo bajo presión.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: It was an eerie feeling of unease and dread that surrounded him when he was exploring some old ruins as a youth. He has acknowledged the power of the unseen world ever since.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nVe presagios en sueños y señales; impulsado por el destino y receloso de los malos augurios.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: The stories of his noble lineage taught this one by his parents and grandparents resulted in his arrogant vanity.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nObsesionado con la reputación personal y la apariencia; se siente fácilmente menospreciado y tarda en olvidar los insultos.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: [[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSees most things as transactions, where he himself intends to end up on top.\\n\\n
Got to get ahead somehow.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nNadie está a salvo cuando él está cerca.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Makes some interesting jewelry from the bones of enemies.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nLleva los huesos de sus víctimas como trofeos: cada uno cuenta una historia.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Scars are the only proof of worth for those who survive his trials. Discipline is his weapon. \\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nGobierna a sus subordinados con látigo y acero; la obediencia se espera, no se gana.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Whether out of necessity or twisted curiousity, he developed a fondness for the meat of orcs.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSe alimenta tanto de amigos como de enemigos; pocos se atreven a desafiarlo.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: As if carving the symbol of the Eye across his chest wasn't enough, he then ripped out one of his eyes in reverence to the Great Eye.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nAdora al Señor Oscuro con un fervor aterrador; obedece sin cuestionar.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: A biscuit made of tables. Go ahead, have a seat. I can smell the sun. In the kettle, in the kettle. The tree says oink! Oink. Oink!\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSusurra para sí mismo y grita a las sombras, pero lucha como un demonio.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Spits words full of daggers to those beneath him but quick to bend the knee when faced with someone greater. \\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nRápido para arrodillarse y lento para morir. Los maestros tienden a mantenerlo cerca.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: A thousand-thousand pulsing maggots crawled over and into me. Now they are with me, always. A churning, writhing horde of torment.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nDébil y enfermo, pero inquietantemente resistente.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: If anyone sees him skulking alone in a dark corner, someone is about to die.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nNunca olvida una ofensa. Un día, te despertarás con un cuchillo clavado en la espalda.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Even by uruk standards the unbridled savagry this one displays is unsettling. \\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSolo vive para derramar sangre; el pensamiento civilizado es una pérdida de tiempo con él.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: The lies roll off his tongue with ease, making him impossible to trust, yet dangerously effective.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nMiente incluso cuando la verdad le beneficiaría más. Nadie confía en él.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: A rather slobbery chap, whether it fills one with horror or disgust depends on the foe.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nMitad animal, todo furia. Apenas controlable, totalmente destructivo.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Few orcs yearn for the tunnels such as this one, for they find the callous sun particularly blinding.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nTeme al sol, prospera bajo tierra.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: This one repeats words of the Master. This servant of Sauron has reached his pinnacle.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nHabla con aterradora autoridad, como si fuera el propio Sauron quien diera las órdenes.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: I'll whip you to the bone you slugs!\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nDisfruta con el castigo; su séquito marcha para evitar su ira.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Grotesquely disfigured and deformed, his life has been one of constant humiliation and torture.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nRechazado por los suyos, pero más difícil de matar de lo que cabría esperar.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: [[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nA traveler of many places, this man knows his way around the world out there.\\n\\n

[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nFew details are lost on this man. To be taken by surprise in any matter would be a blow to his pride.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nHas a particular way with words to bind others to his will.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nKnown to find a solution to most problems facing him.\\n\\n
Some are quick to forgive. This one is not among them. \\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nLo ignoran, se burlan de él, y no se fían de él, y él lo sabe. El resentimiento hierve a fuego lento bajo la superficie.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: [[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nOften fears interaction with other people.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nPresence of mind is key to control any situation; all too important to this man.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nGood-natured and enticing to be around.\\n\\n

[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nSees value in every life and will go to great lengths to ease the hardships of those under his command.\\n\\n
He wears dignity like armour, but his courtesy often masks his disdain. Definitely judges the other Southron generals by the seams of their tunics.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nConsidera a otras personas por debajo de su nivel.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: The shifting sands and the bright sun show no mercy, so neither shall I.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nNo muestra piedad ni compasión hacia los enemigos o traidores.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: In the desert he can see things, sense things.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nPosee una profunda reverencia por los ritos antiguos, los presagios y los poderes oscuros.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: An oath is a bond he just would never even think of breaking.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nValora la lealtad y los juramentos por encima de todo.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: Life in the desert of Harad is tough. This one is proud of it.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nIrradia superioridad cultural y desdén por los forasteros.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: In the habit of using desert proverbs to communicate more than his words alone.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nHabla con sutileza, metáforas y amenazas veladas.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: The only gift he ever gives is a scimitar.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nBusca la batalla, la conquista y el botín de guerra.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: A fervent worshipper of the Dark Lord, he would see all of Harad turn to Sauron or be put to the sword.\\n\\n[[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]
character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_translated: [[rgba:255:204:102:1]]Personalidad[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innato[[/rgba]]\\n\\nCegado por la devoción a poderes oscuros o cultos antiguos.\\n\\n

character_trait_levels_colour_text_rom_t.value_original: [[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nKnown for his calm demeanours, thinking before acting.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nOftentimes apt at tasks he's not initially familiar with.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nMakes good use of his own ability in whatever situation he's put into.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nWill often strive to do the right thing, even at his own detriment.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nDependable when tasked with something that requires personal integrity.\\n\\n
[[rgba:154:205:50:1]]Personality[[/rgba]]. [[rgba:192:192:192:0]]Innate trait, cannot be lost[[/rgba]]\\n\\nCan be counted on to preserve good relations with other peoples.\\n\\n
