diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_can.value_translated: El Amo posee una riqueza que haría llorar al más grande de los señores enanos. Esto solo supone un obstáculo para tus arcas.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_can.value_original: I had already assumed that wealth no longer flows between our lands, such is the sorry state of thy markets. Thy art of no worth to us, creature.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_can.value_translated: Ya había dado por hecho que la riqueza ya no circula entre nuestras tierras, tal es el lamentable estado de tus mercados. Tu arte no tiene ningún valor para nosotros, criatura.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_can.value_original: This is no hindrance, I assure thee. What the Lord of the Tower wants, He shall recieve.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_can.value_translated: No supone ningún obstáculo, te lo aseguro. Lo que el Señor de la Torre quiera, lo recibirá.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_can.value_original: Fine. Keep your gold and your grain. But you won't keep your throats in the middle of the night.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_can.value_translated: Vale. Quédate con tu oro y tu trigo. Pero no te quedarás con tus gargantas en plena noche.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_can.value_original: You get fat on our blades, then pull your deals like teeth from a wolf’s mouth? We should’ve eaten you instead.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_can.value_translated: ¿Te haces rico gracias a nuestras cuchillas y luego nos quitas tus negocios como si fueran los dientes de la boca de un lobo? Más nos hubiera valido comerte a ti.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_can.value_original: What is trade to the Orcs? You think you've got the upper hand? We do not trade, we take!
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_can.value_translated: ¿Qué es el comercio para los orcos? ¿Crees que tienes la sartén por el mango? ¡Nosotros no comerciamos, tomamos!

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_can.value_original: Rohan has always ridden alone if need be, and so we shall again. Though this severing weakens us both, we will not falter.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_can.value_translated: Rohan siempre ha cabalgado solo cuando ha sido necesario, y así lo haremos de nuevo. Aunque esta separación nos debilita a ambos, no nos desanimaremos.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_can.value_original: Your choice is made. May your stores prove sufficient against the hardship you have chosen.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_can.value_translated: Ya has tomado una decisión. Ojalá tus reservas resulten suficientes para hacer frente a las dificultades que has elegido.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_can.value_original: The agreement is broken, then. While regretful of its end, Rohan will not beg. Mayhap one day, trust can be rebuilt, but the road is long.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_can.value_translated: Entonces, el acuerdo se ha roto. Aunque lamenta que haya llegado a su fin, Rohan no suplicará. Quizá algún día se pueda recuperar la confianza, pero el camino es largo.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_can.value_original: We shall tell our bazaars to rid their pits of dung. I mean, their shelves of your wares.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_can.value_translated: Les diremos a nuestros mercadillos que se deshagan de sus montones de estiércol. Quiero decir, de sus estanterías llenas de vuestras mercancías.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_can.value_original: Your trinkets are as valuable as the sands. We have enough dunes as it stands.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_can.value_translated: Tus baratijas valen tanto como la arena. Ya tenemos suficientes dunas tal y como están las cosas.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_can.value_original: We regret your loss of our caravans.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_can.value_translated: Lamentamos que hayas perdido nuestras caravanas.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_can.value_original: You break bread with us no longer. Take your soft goods and leave our sight.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_can.value_translated: Ya no compartes el pan con nosotros. Coge tus pertenencias y desaparece de nuestra vista.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_can.value_original: Keep your wares, hoard your gold. The wildmen have survived without your scraps before, and we will again.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_can.value_translated: Quédate con tus mercancías, atesora tu oro. Los hombres salvajes ya hemos sobrevivido antes sin tus sobras, y lo volveremos a hacer.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_can.value_original: Then the hills will provide, as they always have.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_can.value_translated: Entonces las colinas nos darán lo que necesitamos, como siempre han hecho.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: Your bearing is lowly in my presence, yet it is long now since you have turned from your own way at my counsel. Would it were not so!
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Tu actitud es humilde en mi presencia, pero hace mucho que te apartaste de tu camino por mi consejo. ¡Ojalá no fuera así!

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: Then there shall be no accord. Let it be known who refused wisdom when it was offered.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Entonces no habrá acuerdo. Que se sepa quién rechazó la sabiduría cuando se le ofreció.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: Then it must be so. When darkness comes creeping to your doorstep, perhaps you shall remember this refusal.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Entonces debe ser así. Cuando la oscuridad se acerque sigilosamente a tu puerta, tal vez recuerdes este rechazo.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: Stubborn as the Dwarves! May your pride not prove your undoing.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: ¡Ta terco como los enanos! Que tu orgullo no sea tu perdición.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: Must it ever be so, that good counsel falls on deaf ears until doom is at the very door? Depart then, and bear the weight of your own short-sightedness.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: ¿Debe ser siempre así, que los buenos consejos caen en oídos sordos hasta que la perdición llama tus puertas? Entonces vete y carga con el peso de tu propia ceguera.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: So be it, though I deem it folly. For the road ahead is perilous, and those who refuse guidance may falter and fall.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Que así sea, aunque lo considere una locura. Porque el camino que te espera es peligroso, y aquellos que rechazan la guía suelen vacilar y caer.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: Blast it all. I had hoped for more sense from ye.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: ¡Maldita sea! Esperaba que tuvierais un poco más de sentido común.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: Bah, stubborn as a mountain goat, you are.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Vaya, eres tan terco como una cabra de montaña.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: Damn and blast! I poured over them plans for weeks. Should've known better than to expect sense from surface folk.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: ¡Maldita sea! Llevaba semanas estudiando a fondo esos planos. Debería haber sabido que no se puede esperar que la gente de la superficie tenga sentido común.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: Fine. Waste yer chance, then.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Vale. Pues desperdicia tu oportunidad, entonces.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: Don't come cryin' back. I'll say I told ya so.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: No vuelvas a venir a lloriquear. Te diré que ya te lo había dicho.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: Durin's beard! A right pity, it is.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: ¡Por la barba de Durin! Es una verdadera lástima.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: So, you are a fool, then. It is no matter. If you are as witless as I think, you may never even come to realise your mistake.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Pues, entonces eres un tonto. No importa. Si eres tan despistado como creo, puede que ni siquiera llegues a darte cuenta de tu error.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: You have chosen...poorly.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Has elegido... mal.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: It is no matter. You simply lack the fortitude to do what is necessary when presented the opportunity.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: No pasa nada. Simplemente te falta la entereza necesaria para hacer lo que hay que hacer cuando se te presenta la oportunidad.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: I regret your decision. All of Rhûn regrets your decision. Pray you the golden hordes do not take offense.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Lamento tu decisión. Todo Rhûn lamenta tu decisión. Reza para que las hordas doradas no se ofendan.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: Our failure to convince you is not of great import. It is but our courage to continue that counts.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: El hecho de que no hayamos logrado convenceros no tiene gran importancia. Lo que cuenta es nuestro valor para seguir adelante.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: The clansmen are disappointed you have chosen a path of folly this day.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Los miembros del clan están decepcionados porque hoy has elegido un camino de locura.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: Fare free, for that is your wish. To say "well" would be in vain, if you go in this way. A shadow is over you; when we meet again, may it be no darker.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Que seas libre, pues ese es tu deseo. Decir «que te vaya bien» sería en vano, si sigues por este camino. Una sombra te cubre; cuando nos volvamos a encontrar, que no sea más oscura.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: Perhaps reason has not prevailed today, but so be it: it is written now in the history of Arda, and neither Melkor nor Manwë can unwrite it.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Quizá hoy no haya prevalecido la razón, pero que así sea: ya está escrito en la historia de Arda, y ni Melkor ni Manwë pueden borrarlo.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: You, it seems, will take counsel with your own wisdom, or with your sword only, and you speak haughtily. And I say to you that if you do so, other might be your doom than you look for.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Parece que vas a guiarte por tu propia sabiduría, o solo por tu espada, y hablas con altivez. Y yo te digo que, si lo haces, tu destino podría ser muy distinto al que esperas.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: I wish it were not so, yet I do not cast all hope away. Tomorrow is unknown. Rede oft is found at the rising of the Sun.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Ojalá no fuera así, pero no pierdo del todo la esperanza. El mañana es una incógnita. A menudo se encuentra la solución al salir el sol.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: I had hoped that the wisdom of ages might find purchase in your heart. Farewell, then.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Tenía la esperanza de que la sabiduría de los siglos encontrara eco en tu corazón. Adiós, pues.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: Alas, some eyes are blind to the light that graces the path of wisdom.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Por desgracia, hay quienes no ven la luz que ilumina el camino de la sabiduría.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: I have made a fair offer, so that those whom you mislead may clearly see the choice of roads. I need you not!
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: He hecho una oferta justa, para que aquellos a quienes engañas puedan ver claramente las distintas opciones que tienen. ¡No te necesito!

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: You are proud and do not love advice, having indeed a store of your own wisdom. But on this occasion you erred.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Eres orgulloso y no te gustan los consejos, ya que, de hecho, tienes tu propia sabiduría. Pero en esta ocasión te has equivocado.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: Your love of the Halflings' leaf has clearly slowed your mind!
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: ¡Tu pasión por la hoja de los medianos te ha nublado claramente la mente!

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: I gave you the chance of aiding me willingly.  But you have elected the way of pain!
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Te di la oportunidad de ayudarme por voluntad propia. ¡Pero has elegido el camino del sufrimiento!

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: Well, I see that this wise course does not commend itself to you. Not yet? Not if some better way can be contrived?
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Bueno, veo que esta sabia decisión no te convence. ¿Aún no? ¿A menos que se pueda idear alguna forma mejor?

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: You have chosen the path of obsolescence. Do not expect sympathy when your forests fall to fuel the furnaces of a new age.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Has elegido el camino de la obsolescencia. No esperes compasión cuando tus bosques sean talados para alimentar los hornos de una nueva era.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: I remind you that a choice made in anger cannot be undone, nor will we forget it.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Os recuerdo que una decisión tomada en un momento de enfado no se puede deshacer, ni la olvidaremos.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: Common sense, it seems, is not so common.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Al parecer, el sentido común no es tan común.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: We are decepted then. Our terms were fair, yet you lay the matter to rest.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Entonces nos han engañado. Nuestras condiciones eran justas, y sin embargo tú das el asunto por zanjado.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: So your will is made plain. Defiance.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Así que tu voluntad ha quedado clara. Desafío.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: You will not unmake what you have wrought. Reap the firstfruits of your folly.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: No podrás deshacer lo que has hecho. Cosecha los primeros frutos de tu insensatez.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: You refuse, and that is your right, though the wind turns cold.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Te niegas, y estás en tu derecho, aunque el viento se vuelva frío.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: A poor choice. Know that there will be consequences for denying the Master His will.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Una mala decisión. Ten en cuenta que habrá consecuencias por negarte a cumplir la voluntad del Maestro.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: Kah! Niceties are not enough for thee? I will not understand thy kind, not ever.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: ¡Bah! ¿No te bastan las sutilezas? No llegaré a entender a los de tu calaña, nunca jamás.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: It is no matter. Sauron the Great and most Powerful can only be denied for so long.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: No importa. A Sauron, el Grande y el Más Poderoso, solo se le puede resistir durante un tiempo.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: A bold choice. I would commend thy will, if it were not so mindless.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Una decisión audaz. Elogiaría tu determinación, si no fuera tan irreflexiva.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: Very well, thy mind is made. Do not grovel when my Master's will is done in force.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Muy bien, ya has tomado una decisión. No te humilles cuando se cumpla con firmeza la voluntad de mi Señor.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: Did I mishear thee? Or art thou truly more of a fool than I thought?
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: ¿Te he oído mal? ¿O es que realmente eres más tonto de lo que pensaba?

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: Guess it's time for a raiding party.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Supongo que es hora de organizar una incursión.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: We like the sound of iron better than words anyway.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: De todos modos, nos gusta más el sonido del hierro que el de las palabras.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: Now we can take what we asked for. More fun that way.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Ahora podemos quedarnos con lo que pedimos. Así es más divertido.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: Suit yourself. Then hear this: we’re coming, and not to talk.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Como quieras. Pues escucha esto: vamos para allá, y no es para hablar.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: Hope your blood’s worth the insult.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Espero que tu sangre valga la pena el insulto.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: What a shame. At least we know to not bother talking next time.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Qué pena. Al menos ya sabemos que la próxima vez no vale la pena ni molestarnos en hablar.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: This rash decision is a sign of dark times indeed. Let us hope ill does not befall you on your journey home.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Esta decisión precipitada es, sin duda, un indicio de que corren tiempos oscuros. Esperemos que no te ocurra nada malo durante el viaje de vuelta a casa.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: Pray you swiftly ride forth, for your welcome here is now cut short.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Reza por que te marches pronto, pues tu estancia aquí ha llegado a su fin.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: So be it. Though you turn aside our offer, may your course be wise, and may the wind not turn against you.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Que así sea. Aunque rechacéis nuestra oferta, que vuestra decisión sea acertada y que el viento no se vuelva en vuestra contra.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: A sorrow, perhaps, that we do not find common ground. Yet Rohan endures, as it always has.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Quizá sea una pena que no encontremos puntos en común. Sin embargo, Rohan perdura, como siempre lo ha hecho.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: It is a bitter thing to extend good-will only for it to be cast aside. Take your leave of my halls.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Es muy doloroso ofrecer buena voluntad para que luego la rechacen. Abandona mis aposentos.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: I find no surprise in your answer. You were ever thus, bound to your nature as the horse is to the plains.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Tu respuesta no me sorprende en absoluto. Siempre has sido así, tan ligado a tu naturaleza como lo está el caballo a las llanuras.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: I know a forked tongue when I see one.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Reconozco una lengua viperina cuando la veo.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: Your reasoning is as foreign to me as my lands are to you.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Tu razonamiento me resulta tan ajeno como mis tierras te lo son a ti.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: Mulkhêrasal...your desires are a maze to my mind. Guide me now, so I can escape.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Mulkhêrasal... tus deseos son un laberinto para mi mente. Guíame ahora, para que pueda escapar.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: Bah. You are the reason we never venture from our lands.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Bah. Tú eres la razón por la que nunca nos aventuramos fuera de nuestras tierras.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: Don't check your pockets when I leave.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: No revises tus bolsillos cuando me vaya.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: Help me understand your ways. Is it the snow clogging your mind?
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Ayúdame a entender cómo piensas. ¿Es la nieve lo que te nubla la mente?

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: You may not live to regret this.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Puede que ni siquiera llegues a arrepentirte de esto.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: Stupid choice. The dark will take you soon.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Qué elección más estúpida. La oscuridad te atrapará pronto.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: You protest too much, I think.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Creo que te quejas demasiado.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: Do I need to ask a second time? I hate asking a second time.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: ¿Tengo que volver a preguntarlo? Odio tener que volver a preguntar.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: You are disappointing. But the Elders have expected this.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Me estás decepcionando. Pero los Ancianos ya se lo esperaban.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_original: So, there is no honour in you, then. I knew it.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_rej.value_translated: Así que no tienes ningún sentido del honor, pues. Ya me lo imaginaba.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_original: This gift of gold is received with gratitude. May the stars ever light your path.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_translated: Este regalo de oro se recibe con gratitud. Que las estrellas iluminen siempre tu camino.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_original: A token well-received and worthy of our noble people. Let this strengthen our bond with your kind.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_translated: Un gesto muy bien recibido y digno de nuestro noble pueblo. Que esto fortalezca nuestro vínculo con los tuyos.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_original: This gift shall be received as token of friendship, like Felagund gave to Barahir of yore.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_translated: Este regalo se recibirá como muestra de amistad, tal y como Felagund hizo con Barahir en tiempos pasados.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_original: Another generous gift such as this and Smaug may return!
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_translated: ¡Si hay otro regalo tan generoso como este, puede que Smaug vuelva!

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_original: By my beard! A welcome sight, indeed.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_translated: ¡Por mi barba! Menuda alegría, la verdad.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_original: Now yer speakin' my tongue.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_translated: Ahora sí que me entiendes.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_original: You show your quality in this gift. It shall be repaid in kind.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_translated: Con este regalo demuestras tu valía. Se te recompensará con la misma moneda.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_original: The palace treasury can hold no more, yet you present a kingly gift. Honour be unto you, noble one.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_translated: El tesoro del palacio no puede albergar nada más, y, sin embargo, me ofreces un regalo digno de un rey. Que el honor te acompañe, noble.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_original: It is said that the Sea of Rhûn is the water of life for the body and the soul. I shall send you some for this gift.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_translated: Se dice que el Mar de Rhûn es el agua de la vida para el cuerpo y el alma. Te enviaré un poco como regalo.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_original: Your generosity shines like sunlight through the leaves, and is gratefully received. May it prove a bright ember against the coming night.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_translated: Tu generosidad brilla como la luz del sol a través de las hojas, y la recibimos con gratitud. Que sea una brilla brasa que ilumine la noche que se avecina.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_original: Hannon allen. This gift is fair as the gleaming starlight caught within the waters of our falls. I thank you for your aid.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_translated: Hannon Allen. Este regalo es tan hermoso como la luz resplandeciente de las estrellas reflejada en las aguas de nuestras cascadas. Te agradezco tu ayuda.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_original: Many things that are fair dwell still beneath these trees, yet the brightness of your boon outshines them. May the stars ever light your path.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_translated: Bajo estos árboles aún habitan muchas cosas hermosas, pero el resplandor de tu regalo las eclipsa. Que las estrellas iluminen siempre tu camino.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_original: You offer this gift to the greatest of the Istari. What gift might the White Wizard bestow upon you?
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_translated: Le ofreces este regalo al más grande de los Istari. ¿Qué regalo podría concederte el Mago Blanco?

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_original: A most generous token. Those who look upon Isengard with favour shall not find themselves forgotten when the hour darkens.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_translated: Un gesto de gran generosidad. Aquellos que miren con buenos ojos a Isengard no se verán olvidados cuando llegue la hora oscura.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_original: This gift is noted and appreciated. In times to come, remembrance of such gestures may carry weight beyond their worth.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_translated: Tomamos nota de este regalo y lo agradecemos. En el futuro, el recuerdo de gestos como este puede tener un valor que vaya más allá de su valor material.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_original: A rare kindness, and not forgotten. May your generosity meet with justice in the turning of seasons.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_translated: Un gesto de bondad poco común, que no se olvida. Que tu generosidad encuentre su merecida recompensa con el paso de las estaciones.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_original: Our halls are brightened by your gift, and our hearth warmer toward your folk because of it.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_translated: Tu regalo ilumina nuestros salones y, gracias a él, nuestro hogar se llena de más calidez hacia los tuyos.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_original: Your generosity finds welcome here, and your name is carved into more than stone...it rests in memory.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_translated: Tu generosidad es bienvenida aquí, y tu nombre no solo está grabado en piedra... sino que perdura en la memoria.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_original: Thou art generous, lord. The Black Council surely favours thee.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_translated: Eres generoso, señor. Sin duda, el Consejo Negro te favorece.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_original: The coffers of Lugbúrz are not filled without effort. My gratitude.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_translated: Las arcas de Lugbúrz no se llenan sin esfuerzo. Mi agradecimiento.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_original: A gift? I will deliver this to my master. I must document this, so that He knows thee. Scribe thy name here, and here, and here. Not there.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_translated: ¿Un regalo? Se lo entregaré a mi señor. Debo dejarlo por escrito para que Él te conozca. Escribe tu nombre aquí, aquí y aquí. Ahí no.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_original: Well, what a nice gift you have there. The snagas won't have to eat maggoty bread this week, ha!
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_translated: Vaya, qué bonito regalo tienes ahí. Los snagas no tendrán que comer pan lleno de gusanos esta semana, ¡ja!

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_original: Looks like you're trying to pay us off now! I'll take it, but keep it coming, or we keep taking!
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_translated: ¡Parece que ahora intentas sobornarnos! Lo aceptaré, pero sigue así, ¡o seguiremos cogiendo!

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_original: Saves us the trouble of having to pillage and plunder. For today.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_translated: Nos ahorra la molestia de tener que saquear y robar. Al menos por hoy.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_original: Your generosity warms my heart like a hearth-fire in winter. This gold shall be well-used, strengthening the sinews of Rohan against the coming darkness.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_translated: Tu generosidad me llena el corazón de calor, como el fuego de la chimenea en invierno. Este oro se empleará bien, fortaleciendo los lazos de Rohan frente a la oscuridad que se avecina.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_original: This is a kingly offering, worthy of song. Rohan thanks you for your unwavering support; we shall remember this when the horns of war sound.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_translated: Esta es una ofrenda digna de un rey, digna de ser cantada. Rohan te agradece tu apoyo inquebrantable; lo recordaremos cuando suenen los cuernos de guerra.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_original: Such bounty is a great aid to our people. Know that your kindness will be repaid, be it in deed or in honour, as the fates allow.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_translated: Tal generosidad supone una gran ayuda para nuestro pueblo. Ten por seguro que tu bondad será recompensada, ya sea con hechos o con honores, según lo permitan los destinos.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_original: A man who gives without debt is rare in our lands. My thanks to you, kisala.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_translated: Es raro encontrar en nuestras tierras a un hombre que dé sin pedir nada a cambio. Muchas gracias, kisala.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_original: As valuable as a cold waterskin. Our gratitude is eternal.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_translated: Tan valioso como una cantimplora de agua fría. Nuestra gratitud es eterna.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_original: Men of near and far will know of your generosity.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_translated: Hombres de cerca y de lejos se enterarán de tu generosidad.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_original: This is a good gift. You are a man of honour.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_translated: Es un buen regalo. Eres un hombre de honor.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_original: What’s given may bear root… or rot. But it lies with us now.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_translated: Lo que se nos ha dado puede echar raíces… o pudrirse. Pero ahora depende de nosotros.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_original: A gift passed without chain, without spear. Our hearths will speak of it.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_sta.value_translated: Un regalo entregado sin cadenas, sin lanzas. Nuestros hogares lo contarán.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_original: I will not forget your oath, nor fail to reward what is given: fealty with love, valour with honour, oath-breaking with vengeance.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_translated: No olvidaré tu juramento, ni dejaré de recompensar lo que se me ha dado: la lealtad con amor, el valor con honor, la rotura de un  juramento con venganza.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_original: Swear now this oath: "Here do I swear fealty and service to the Lord and Steward of the realm, from this hour henceforth, until my lord release me, or death take me, or the world end."
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_translated: Presta ahora este juramento: «Juro lealtad y servicio al Señor y Senescal del Reino, desde este momento y en adelante, hasta que mi señor me libere, o la muerte me lleve, o el mundo se acabe».

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_original: This shall you swear: fealty and service to the Lord of the realm, to speak and to be silent, to do and to let be, to come and to go, in need or plenty, in peace or war, in living or dying, from this hour henceforth.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_translated: Jurarás lo siguiente: lealtad y servicio al Señor del reino, hablar y callar, hacer y dejar hacer, venir e ir, en la necesidad y en la abundancia, en la paz y en la guerra, en la vida y en la muerte, desde este momento en adelante.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_original: Now, have ye sent yer fair share of gold to the King?
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_translated: Bueno, ¿ya habéis enviado al rey la parte de oro que os corresponde?

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_original: Now show me ye've got the spine to stand tall beside us when the axes clash and the mountain trembles.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_translated: Ahora demostradme que tenéis la entereza necesaria para permanecer erguidos a nuestro lado cuando las hachas choquen y la montaña tiemble.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_original: Aye, I accept yer fealty. Prove yerself a strong arm and a sturdy pick.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_translated: Sí, acepto tu lealtad. Demuestra que eres un hombre fuerte y un minero resistente.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_original: It shall be thus: that you are under our protection, and shall render aid and assistance when called upon.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_translated: Quedará así establecido: que estáis bajo nuestra protección y que prestaréis ayuda y asistencia cuando se os solicite.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_original: Rhûn is a confederacy of clans. We welcome you, and gladly share in the rich spoils of our wars.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_translated: Rhûn es una confederación de clanes. Te damos la bienvenida y compartimos con mucho gusto el abundante botín de nuestras guerras.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_original: Take comfort you are under the protection of the golden dragon. All shall be well.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_translated: Tén la tranquilidad de saber que estás bajo la protección del dragón dorado. Todo irá bien.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_original: We hear your oath, sworn beneath the trees and stars. Let your loyalty be a bright flame against the gathering gloom, and a shield against the enemies of the light.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_translated: Oímos tu juramento, pronunciado bajo los árboles y las estrellas. Que tu lealtad sea una llama brillante frente a la oscuridad que se cierne sobre nosotros, y un escudo contra los enemigos de la luz.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_original: So it is written, so it shall be. You are more worthy to wear the armor of elf-princes than many that have looked more comely in it.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_translated: Así está escrito, así será. Eres más digno de llevar la armadura de los príncipes elfos que muchos de los que han lucido mejor con ella.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_original: Your fealty is accepted, and your fate now intertwined with ours. May this union blossom with strength, and never wither, like deep roots of old growth.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_translated: Tu lealtad ha sido aceptada, y tu destino queda ahora entrelazado con el nuestro. Que esta unión florezca con fuerza y nunca se marchite, como las raíces profundas de un bosque centenario.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_original: From the pinnacle of Orthanc I observe my dominion, and now by your fealty my sight grows ever further.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_translated: Desde lo alto de Orthanc contemplo mi reino, y ahora, gracias a vuestra lealtad, mi visión se extiende cada vez más.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_original: Your banners now fly beneath the shadow of Orthanc, not in shame, but in foresight. For Isengard does not demand fealty. It inspires it.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_translated: Vuestros estandartes ondean ahora a la sombra de Orthanc, no por vergüenza, sino por visión de futuro. Porque Isengard no exige lealtad. La inspira.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_original: In times such as these, lesser powers must anchor themselves to certainty. And the dominion of Isengard is the only certainty that remains.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_translated: En tiempos como estos, las potencias menores deben aferrarse a la certeza. Y el dominio de Isengard es la única certeza que queda.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_original: By your oath and our seal, the bond is struck. Let our flame guard your hearth, and let your strength now be counted among ours.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_translated: Por tu juramento y nuestro sello, el pacto queda sellado. Que nuestra llama proteja tu hogar, y que tu fuerza se sume ahora a la nuestra.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_original: The river runs fuller now, for another stream has joined. May we find strength in the flow, and peace in its depths.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_translated: El río lleva ahora más agua, pues se le ha unido otro arroyo. Ojalá encontremos fuerza en su corriente y paz en sus profundidades.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_original: Let it be recorded in the halls and remembered in song. On this day we stand united in oath, unbroken in purpose.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_translated: Que quede constancia de ello en los salones y se recuerde en las canciones. En este día nos mantenemos unidos en nuestro juramento, con un propósito inquebrantable.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_original: Bow thy head and bend thy knee, for thou art in service of the Dark Lord. When He calls upon thee, thou must always answer. Now go, and know that the Tower guards thy lands.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_translated: Inclina la cabeza y dobla la rodilla, pues estás al servicio del Señor Oscuro. Cuando Él te llame, debes responder siempre. Ahora vete, y ten presente que la Torre protege tus tierras.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_original: And so, thy land is spared of misery. Rejoice and know that Lord Sauron, the most Benevolent and Wise, rules over thee.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_translated: Y así, tu tierra se libra de la miseria. Alégrate y ten presente que el Señor Sauron, el más benévolo y sabio, reina sobre ti.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_original: It is well that thou hath joined Sauron. These lands will never fall, and its might will outlast all of the West.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_translated: Has hecho bien en unirte a Sauron. Estas tierras nunca caerán, y su poder perdurará más que todo el Oeste.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_original: You crawl before us at last, but do not expect submission frees you of servitude. You are snaga now.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_translated: Por fin te arrastras ante nosotros, pero no esperes que la sumisión te libere de la servidumbre. Ahora eres un snaga.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_original: We have your lands. Keep your heads. But fail to obey us, and we'll take them too.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_translated: Tenemos vuestras tierras. Mantened la cabeza fría. Pero si no nos obedecéis, también os las quitaremos.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_original: It's about time you bent the knee. I thought we'd have to pry the submission from your bones.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_translated: Ya era hora de que te arrodillaras. Pensaba que tendríamos que arrancarte la rendición a la fuerza.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_original: The bond between us is now sworn. May your loyalty prove as strong as the war-steeds of the Mark.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_translated: El vínculo que nos une ya está sellado. Que tu lealtad sea tan fuerte como los corceles de guerra de la Marca.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_original: Your oath is taken, and we accept it. Ride now with the Rohirrim, until death or darkness take us.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_translated: Tu juramento ha sido prestado y lo aceptamos. Cabalga ahora junto a los rohirrim, hasta que la muerte o la oscuridad nos separen.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_original: I hear your pledge. Now, ride with us, fight with us, and let your deeds speak louder than any vow.
diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_translated: He escuchado tu promesa. Ahora, cabalga con nosotros, lucha con nosotros y deja que tus actos hablen más alto que cualquier juramento.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_vas.value_original: To be under the shadow of our oasis is to shade yourself from danger.
Now hail the Black Serpent. Your rightful liege and protector.
Join now with the chiefs of Harad. They will accustom you to our ways.
Good, more hunting grounds.
My men will still kill you if you look at them wrong. But I will punish it.
You kneel. Serve well, and the wilds will not rise against you.

diplomacy_strings_string_acknowledge_war.value_original: Let the fires of war be kindled, then. You will find the blood of Númenor still running strong in our men.
War it must be, then, but I do not love the bright sword for its sharpness, nor the arrow for its swiftness, nor the warrior for his glory.
So be it! The White Tree has weathered worse. Waves of assault will break upon our white walls, and each man slain will be repaid tenfold!
Come on, then! Bring your pretty face to my axe!
If you choose to stand between me and my kin, I'll split your pretty head open. See if you're still smirking then.
Ya hear that, lads? We're on! Let's give these bastards a good hammering!
Fool! You doom more than your selfish life! A Chieftain of Rhûn conquers until he is sated, and you will be long scorched when his last enemy falls in this war.
Tell your master he shall burn in golden fire. Rhûn does not back down once a battle begins.
Your head shall soon adorn a spike on my palace walls!
Amarth faeg! So, the Eldar must go to war, though we wish it not.
You shall learn that the wrath of the Eldar has not yet diminished wholly. A red sun will rise, and your blood will be spilled.
So, the green moss and the fair pools of our forest must be tainted red, as swift arrow and valiant blade bring death to the intruders. I philinn wîn gwathrar Anor!
If you go to war, needlessly, for I did not desire it, then men will be slain!
Too long have you escaped the gibbet yourself. But the noose comes, slow in the drawing, tight and hard in the end. Hang if you will!
You do not seriously think that your ragged band of peaseants and drunkards could contend with the might of Isengard?
So be it. Your steel speaks louder than your counsel ever did. We shall not yield. The winds hence ever echo with your folly.
I've thought of several dark and unpleasant endings for you.
You will destroy your army here and never raise another. By my oath, this will be the end of you.
Thy flesh shall be devoured, and thy shrivelled mind be left naked to the Lidless Eye.
There is no life in the void, only death. Thy whole people shall soon fall into its darkness.
Ha, old fool. It would be better, if thou wouldst cut thy own head off here and now, before my Master breaks thee in battle.
Looks like meat is back on the menu, boys!
There's knifework to be had here! We have plenty of blood to spill.
War, is it? Good. We’ve been sharpening steel and starving for man-flesh.
Arise now, Riders of Rohan! Dire deeds awake, dark it is eastward. Let horse be bridled, horn be sounded. We make ready for war!
Very well. Muster the Rohirrim! We will ride out at dawn!
Fell deeds awake: fire and slaughter! Spear shall be shaken, shield be splintered, a sword-day, a red day, ere the sun rises!
Sands of time bury the wise. Times of war bury the weak.
Death, here, is nothing more than common currency. I shall spend some on you, if you like.
Our blades, our minds, our resilience, sharpened for enemies more threatening than you. To arms!
And so you poke the bear.
We will make you dead. And your wives. And also the children.
Your burning houses will warm us. Your slain horses will feed us. Ha, and your wives will keep us company!

diplomacy_strings_string_approach_duneda.value_original: Hail, lord! I am come with counsel and tidings in this dark hour.
The hour demands parley. Will you hear the voice of the Dúnedain?
I am sent from Minas Tirith to parley with you. There are affairs afoot that touch upon your borders as well as our own, and we have a course to suggest.
My lord, the tides of the world are turning, and not for the better. I bring word which would be prudent for you to hear.
By your leave, I would speak with you on behalf of the Men of the West. We have a matter to put forth that could shape the fortunes of this age.
Even between those not bound by amity, necessity may compel speech. I am here to deliver a proposal. Hear it, and weigh your response carefully.
Let us speak openly and take counsel as friends in these darkening days.
Greetings, friend of the West! I come seeking your ear on a matter of great import, where the wisdom of true hearts like yours is most needed.
The shadow lengthens, and it is to those whose friendship we value most that we turn. Let us take counsel together, for the road ahead is dark for all free folk.
It is good to speak with one who understands the perils we face. I have a proposition that I believe will serve us both well in the struggles to come.
I bring an offer that I trust will find favour, born of mutual respect and common need.
The world is changing, but the friendship of the Dúnedain is ever steadfast. I seek your agreement in this matter, that we may continue to count you amongst our friends.
The courtesy of your halls is somewhat lessened as of late. Let us parley swiftly, that I may withdraw to fairer lands.
I shall not waste breath on pleasantries you ill deserve. I make this proposal, perhaps the last you shall receive from us in peace. Attend to it.
I had expected to find no courteous welcome, yet I bring words you would be wise to heed, however unwelcome their bearer.
Let the lord of your land come forth! Swift counsel we have to take, for I would not linger in his foul presence more than necessity demands.
Let us dispense with the feigned civilities. I bring these terms to you. Your alternatives, I assure you, are considerably less appealing.
Circumstance, not desire, brings me to you, for I have an offer. Listen well, for our patience wears thin, as does the courtesy we extend.

diplomacy_strings_string_approach_dwarve.value_original: Good morning. How are we all? I have a wee proposition, if you don't mind giving me a few moments of your time.
I have a plan brewing, and your skills might just be the hammer we need to forge it true.
Greetings. I've been considering a venture, and it seems you lot might be of use.
Right then, let's not waste daylight. I have a proposition, a way for us both to profit mightily.
I have a grand idea, a proposition, if you will, that could bring glory and gold to us both. Let's talk!
I've been wanderin' far over them Misty Mountains cold to find ye, so at least listen to me.
It's nice to see an old friend in these dark times.
Good to see a friendly face. I've got a proposition that could benefit us both.
Greetings! By the beard of Durin, it's good to see you!
Right then, good day to you. Let's cut straight to the chase, there's gold that needs minin'.
Don't just stand there shivering. I need your ear, and I think I have something you need as well. Let's talk profit!
I've a matter I'd like to discuss with you over a mug of ale, friend.
I don't want to be 'ere anymore than you do. Times force my axe, and my tongue.
Bah! Yer face is even more disgustin' than they told me about! Let's get the talkin' done quickly.
A goblin's den is a mansion compared to yer pitiful halls! Listen up, just agree and I'll be gone!
So, you daft folk, I'll need ye to sign here... and here... and here. Hurry up!
Ye don't look like one for long talk, cause ye wouldn't understand more than ten words!
Looks like ye ain't even got any good ale around. Damn, I'll have to do this sober!

diplomacy_strings_string_approach_easter.value_original: We have decided to open up talks with the foreigners. I should think we have much to discuss.
These are strange lands compared to Rhûn, but I have come to offer and seek counsel.
The golden dragon flies to you. We would have you hear our words with the dignity they are given.
You have never seen a wain of the East, have you? It carried me swiftly, for my purpose here is diplomacy.
The men at my back hail from the Balchoth clan. Listen to what I have to say, and they need not bloody this place.
I come to this place with counsel. Our dragon priests have glimpsed the webs of fate, and I would share their wisdom to the wise.
A Chieftain of Rhûn comes now to treat with you under the banner of friendship.
I would seek wisdom from you who is of noble bearing.
I humble myself before you and speak these words. You have been judged worthy by the Chieftains to hear them.
Hark! A warrior, nay, a friend. Let us share honour and wisdom before we prosper our people.
Your courage has never gone unnoticed, friend. That is why we approach.
It is a long journey from my palace in Rhûn, even by wain, to reach you, friend. I bring news and would speak with you.
I have learned your horrid tongue, now, have you the stomach to respond to my words?
You will listen to my words, then I will depart this accursed place.
I will not utter one word of your infernal tongue. You will listen to the words of Rhûn. It is demanded.
You hold your court in this pitiful squalor? There is more grandeur in a goblin-hole. I will speak. You will listen.
Do not mistake my purpose here. It is but necessity borne of dark times.
It is not the way of Rhûn to treat with the enemy. Be grateful that I bring words rather than swords.

diplomacy_strings_string_approach_elves_.value_original: Le suilon. I come with news and counsel from the Wood-elves, if you would hear me.
Aníron peded. I much desire to speak with you, for I have brought terms from the Wood-elves, and an agreement would be wise.
Lasto nin. Hear me, lord, for I bring tidings from the woods.
The world is changing, and l weep for the fair things that may perish. Hear my word, for I seek to preserve what is not yet lost.
At the waning of this age, hope may be found in unlikely places. Let us shape that hope together.
The West is ever calling for the Elves, but we still hold sway in Middle-earth. It would be wise to heed our counsel.
Mae govannen! Your noble wisdom shines bright even as the Star of Eärendil, and I fain would take counsel with you.
The light of the Eldar has guided me to you, lord. Though the Havens bid me hence, the Elves have business with you this day.
Fair is the hour of our meeting, mellon. I have seen much that has not yet come to pass, and would take counsel with you.
The shadows lengthen, and a darkness falls upon our wood. In this hour, I turn to true friends, that we may together find the light.
Even as Gil-galad of yore took counsel with those who defied the Enemy, so I would now take counsel with you, mellon.
N’uir i thiad lîn ‘ell. Ever your presence is a delight, even in hours of darkness. Let us parley together, that more mirth may yet come to be.
Hearken ye! I grace your lowly halls with the light and wisdom of the Eldar.
Be grateful, for I have perceived your lack of wisdom, and grant you the boon of Elven counsel.
The presence of baseborn thralls in your halls sullies my very essence. Hearken my words swiftly, that I may be gone the sooner.
I desire to speak with the lord of these lands, not some lowborn men in ragged robes!
Perhaps I have grown over-accustomed to the fair fragrances of Elves, for your stench assails my nose. Take my counsel swiftly, I wish not to tarry any further.
Behold! I grace these halls of darkness with the light of the Eldar. Hear my counsel, even if it may transcend your limited understanding.

diplomacy_strings_string_approach_isenga.value_original: I lead the Order of Istari. Would you not think it prudent to take counsel from one so wise?
Hail, lord of these domains. I trust you will be attentive enough to comprehend the compelling logic of my proposition.
Truly, your domains are as grand as I have been told. Tell me now, is their lord of grand mind also, to heed the wisdom of Isengard?
My journey hither was unduly hampered by wild growth and vast forests. Would you not see them felled to make way for the order of metal and industry?
I bestow my greetings upon you, o esteemed one, and my gratitude for hearing my voice. For it is one of reason, and I trust you will find it rewarding.
I trust you perceive the significance of this meeting. For seldom one of the Istari, least one so high as I, stoops so low as to offer guidance to lesser folks.
You have a noble mind and eyes that look both deep and far. Will you listen to my counsel?
The hour is later than you think. Sauron's forces are already moving. It would be wise to heed my counsel, friend.
The age is coming to an end, and much is changing. Let us take counsel together, friend, to forge the path ahead.
Ah, it is pleasant to see you, my friend, for you are a clear voice amidst the cacophony of lesser squabbles. I hope you thus also clearly see the path ahead.
The hour has grown dark, my old friend. Allow me to illuminate it with counsel and wisdom, and shine light upon the path of order that we shall tread together.
My friend, let us speak: The old ways are fading, and the great and wise must take counsel together if a path is to be found through the coming storm.
I have come but to tell you of your doom, for I have seen it in the Palantir.
I do not expect you to show wisdom; but I give you the chance of aiding me willingly, and so saving yourself much trouble and pain.
If you do not prove yourself useful to Isengard, do not expect me to show mercy.
Let us dispel the feigned civilities. I stoop to offer you a glimpse of my wisdom, so I demand you take heed.
I had not expected much, yet the lack of courtesy in this decrepit barn you call palace is astounding. Let us speed business so I may remove myself.
It amuses me to behold your lesser civilisation with its quaint rituals and profound inefficiency. Now, make way for the rule of progress and order.

diplomacy_strings_string_approach_middle.value_original: I have come to treat with you. Will you not speak with me?
I would have your ear attentive to the sound of my instructive tongue.
A hunted man sometimes wearies of distrust and longs for friendship. I would speak with you and forge such bonds.
We come with respect and reason, seeking not favor but understanding. Let our talks be guided by wisdom, and our aims by the good of both our peoples.
The roads between us are quiet, yet not cold. I would speak with you that they may warm.
I would sit and speak with the man with whom such meeting might a step toward something greater than either of us alone.
I come with clear purpose. Together, we might shape the course of what’s to come.
Let the words of my mouth be acceptable to you, friend. For you are my rock in this sea of shadows.
I bring no banner here, only goodwill. Let’s sit and speak of what might be done between friends.
We come to you to find common ground and shared purpose. Will you hear my words?
There is much we might accomplish together, friend, if you but lend me your ear.
The world shifts around us, and the shadow spreads, but I am here that that we do not face such times alone.
Our past is marked by grievance, but the future need not be. We are willing to talk if you are willing to listen.
I am not here to forgive, nor to forget, but to speak. That is more than most would offer.
You can listen, or you can be destroyed. Such choice is not often presented.
I venture here not as friend, but neither is my blade drawn. I would speak with you, if only to avoid worse.
Even bitter soil may yield crop. There may be advantage yet in words, if not in arms. Listen to mine.
You’ve given us every reason to turn away. And yet, here we are. That should tell you something.

diplomacy_strings_string_approach_mordor.value_original: Hear me and rejoice. I grace thee with counsel from Sauron, the most Wise and Generous.
My name is of little import: what matters now is that I deliver the decree of Sauron the Great.
The Black Council has decided that thou art worthy of my presence. This may well decide thy fate, so speak wisely...
Seldom does the Master send out His diplomats to foreign lands. Be pleased to know that He has selected thee.
Be grateful that thou should be able to treat with me, and not some half-minded orc scribe.
Thou hath enough quality for my time. Let us speak now, while my image of thee remains untainted.
Thou art fortunate that Sauron's gaze falls upon thee today. Thy answer will be noted and not forgotten.
Sauron the Great trusts thee to carry out His will. I will be His judge and voice this hour.
Greetings, lord. Thy services are requested in the Tower. We must speak at once.
The Master has need of thee. I come now as His emissary, and through me His will shall be made real.
Hail, lord. As a token of friendship, the Master wishes to discuss terms with thee, before making demands.
Thou hath some worth it would seem: I am a diplomat of Sauron the Great, and I am sent only to those He deems dignified.
This land shall be broken and remade by He who is the Lord of the Earth. I come as but a messenger to speak words to those who soon will be no more.
There are things of worth in thy kingdom that the Eye desires. Hear my demands now, lest the orc masses take what we need and more.
Save thy greetings, I have little desire for idle words. The sooner thou scribeth thy name upon this parchment, the sooner I shall leave.
I find thee detestable, but it would seem that my Master believes that there is worth in thy words. Let us find out.
Hail, trifling. I come bearing the word of the Eye. Let us be done swiftly so that I might leave thy hideous table.
Know this: thy land is marked already for subjugation. I come now only to bandy words in hopes that thou hath some use before thy downfall.

diplomacy_strings_string_approach_orcs_0.value_original: An Orc coming to parley is a rare thing, but no less real. Tell me now if I waste my time.
We sit, we speak. You listen. Then maybe, we make a deal.
Noise makes war. Silence makes deals. I bring the second. If you do too, we talk.
Every tooth behind me waits for one word to bite. So let’s speak sharp, and make it worth the silence.
I bring terms. Hear 'em well before spit turns to steel.
Maybe it's smarter to deal than burn. We've the sense to know that. Do you?

diplomacy_strings_string_approach_orcs_f.value_original: Word carried that your lot ain't all squeamish 'bout dealing with us, so here I am.
You’ve dealt fair before. That’s why I’m here. Let’s talk like warriors...plain, quick, honest.
Does an Orc need an excuse to see his blood-brother? We've not spoken for a time.
Look at us playin’ nice. Didn’t see that comin’, did you? But I'm here, so listen up.
Man-filth think us beasts without minds, but we know the worth of words. I come to test if yours hold weight.
Don't think I've gone soft. I'll say my piece but my tongue is as sharp as my blade!

diplomacy_strings_string_approach_orcs_h.value_original: Yes, I brought this troll with me in case you're too stupid to listen. Splatter your brains right quick.
You ain’t dead yet...means I came to talk.
If you knife me before I speak, all the Orcs go to war. Stupid of you, lucky for us.
Could’ve stormed your gates. Chose not to. That’s your first gift. The second? This chance to speak.
You know what we are. You know what we’ve done. Still, I come to speak.
This is your hall? There's more opulence in my shrakh-pit. I will say this once, so listen up, wretch.

diplomacy_strings_string_approach_rohirr.value_original: We ride the paths of our ancestors the Éothéod and have come to you seeking to give and receive counsel.
You are not daunted by words; and you have courteous speech. And we shall have need of all folk of courtesy, be they great or small, in the days to come.
I bring greetings from the wide plains of Rohan. Long have your halls stood as a refuge for those who seek wisdom.
We come with words rather than spears, that there may be understanding rather than wrath. If wisdom guides these halls, let it answer in kind.
I come as the voice of Rohan. Let us speak and see where fate takes us.
The banners of the Mark seldom fly in these lands far from our plain. I would have counsel with you, that it may reveal what future lies ahead.
Would you prepare for us a feast? For we have ridden to you seeking your ear as a friend of the Mark.
The King of Rohan desires an audience with you, lord. He would seek your wisdom, for dark days fall upon the Mark, but your friendship is as a rock steadfast against the sea.
Hail, noble friend. In the name of Rohan, I extend my hand in fellowship and goodwill. May our words be fruitful, and our friendship bloom like spring upon the Riddermark.
I come seeking counsel, for your voice carries the weight of years and the wisdom of rulers before you. May our words be spoken in good faith and our hearts remain steadfast in friendship.
Long have our realms stood in friendship, and I am glad to once more speak with you, if you would welcome it.
I come not merely as King but as a sworn friend to your house. Let us speak together, that our friendship may remain steadfast and our people prosper.
I would cut off your head if it stood but a few more inches from the ground, but I have come with a message for your foul ears to hear.
I will not enter the accursed halls of fiend and foe. I shout these words therefore, that you would bring them to your craven master.
If there remains any reason in the black blood of you Orc-friends, let it be tested here in words before it spills upon the field.
We offer words before war, but if treachery is your answer, then upon the field of battle shall justice be done.
The Marshals disfavour my coming here, for you are naught but the servant of darkness. I give you this one chance to use word before sword.
It is likely that my words are wasted on you, foul one, but if some chance the whispers of the wind bring reason upon you, I would have you hear them.

diplomacy_strings_string_approach_southr.value_original: Counsel I could give, and words I could speak to you. Will you hear them?
We, the men of Harad, approach among unchartered lands. Will we be welcomed, or turned away?
We follow the wind. It has lead us here.
We hail from Harad. Land of jungle and desert, of coast and grassland. Will you have us on this day?
You only know of us now because we make it so. Here we are. The business is quick and important.
It is customary to Haradrim that negotiations begin with a cold cup of water. Once you set one before me, we may begin.
I have come far to speak with you, my friend. Let us speak of my journey, then we will speak of my purpose.
You are an oasis in a sea of sand. Let us speak of the times and our people.
I hope the caravans have treated your people well. We have many tales to share.
Far and wide are our lands. As are the smiles when we see the faces of friends.
Peace be with you, along calm seas and shady jungle. There is much to discuss.
Word of your honourable people has swept like a sandstorm through our bazaars. We are eager to talk to you.
Your lands are far from mine, this we both know. I will learn now whether my journey was worth the time.
I have words to speak with you. If you waste my time, you will have wasted the many weeks I spent on my travels as well.
It is rare that the destination be more difficult than the journey. Lend me your ear, so I can return to my home.
We are here on formality and formality alone.
The desert-snake strikes at those that handle it with disrespect. We have learned much from its ways, if you understand.
The next Haradrim you see will be the Serpent's headsman unless you bend to our will.

diplomacy_strings_string_approach_wildme.value_original: I come from the hills. The Elders have devised an offer.
We come with no quarrel, but no trust either. Will you hear me?
We have words to share. What comes of them is yours to shape.
The hills have words for you if you would hear them.
Hear us, and we’ll hear you.
I have words. If you'll hear them, I'll speak them. If not, I return to the hills.
You are a friend. Perhaps you will listen.
We've come far from the hills. Your fires have warmed us before. May they do so again, while we speak as friends.
The winds between us have been kind. We come from the wilds with words to share.
I am here with open breath and steady feet.
Though we are wild, when we speak with you, friend, the calm of wisdom covers the hills.
The hills sent us. We come to talk if your fire still welcomes us.
Give us your word already. So I don't have to keep coming.
Give me your ear. So I don't take your head.
Sit down and shut your mouth.
A wolf comes among you sheep. Listen well.
The hills did not stop us, and neither did your name. We’re here, and we have words.
I've held my tongue long enough. You'll hear my words, or you'll feel the sting of my steel.

diplomacy_strings_string_cancel_defensiv.value_original: As the winds shift and grow chill, the Dúnedain can aid you no longer. You must look to your own defence.
The spirit of our accord has waned, or perhaps was never as strong as we had hoped. Henceforth, we shall walk our path without your counsel or blade.
The currents of this age flow swifter than the Seven Rivers, and old allegiances may not hold against them. We must now look to our own shores; our mutual compact is at an end.
Take your leave, and trouble us no further. We'll carve our own path from here.
Our halls darken. We can not spare aid any longer.
We choose to keep to ourselves. Like we've always done.
Why should our golden warriors be spent in your defence when you prove unable to defend yourself?
Your pitiful forces dishonour the golden hordes. I shall find another worthy ally.
Enough. Stand and fight on your own, without the crutch that has been my army.
Boe annin mened. The light of kinship has dimmed, leaving only a cold twilight between us. We deem it wise to part while some memory of amity remains.
The world is changing, and the threads of our bond are unravelled by the passing of time. The forest stands alone, as we have in ages past.
We have reached the cross-roads, and the way that you tread is one we cannot follow. Alas for our parting.
The Tower of Orthanc was constructed of Numenorean stone, nigh imperveous. The forces of Isengard look to its own defence.
Isengard shall no longer shoulder the burden of those unwilling to act with strength. Seek shelter elsewhere, if such shelter remains.
Isengard does not squander its vigilance defending the weak. This is not abandonment, rather liberation. From illusion. From dependence.
We owe our safety to no one. From this day, we stand unbound, and we answer only for our own.
The bridge we built between our shields now crumbles. Let each guard their own gates.
We’ve guarded one another through more than most recall. But the land calls us inward now. We’ll tend our own walls and your folk must do the same.
Lugbúrz has decided that we have misdjudged thy kingdom. Expect no more aid from us, and be relieved of thy duties to our borders.
Sauron the Great no longer requires thee. Our agreement? Thy lands are worthless to us. Good day, be gone.
It would seem that thy lands are no longer defended by His legions. Very sad, is it not? Oh, truly. Do not weep in my presence.
We will look after ourselves. We don't need you. Leave now, and never come back!
No more wasted steel and blood. Fend for yourselves. We fight only for our own.
Enough of this pact. We will not be the shield of weaklings. Go and rot in your own misery!
The Mark withdraws its hand from yours. Misunderstandings have grown too deep, and alliance offers no advantage.
Rohan will stand alone. We release you from all oaths, and expect the same in return.
Our kinship ends here, for our needs diverge; let each stand on their own strength henceforth.
We are strong, we are one, and we no longer need your feeble protection.
Isolation is the promise of the desert. A promise we will uphold.
Gone is the expectation that our troops must endure the journey to each others lands in times of need.
You are not what we thought. This alliance weakens us. So, we sever it.
Find your own way. We will not share the burden of your failures.
Our hills defend us. Not you.

diplomacy_strings_string_cancel_soft_mil.value_original: No longer do we trust your soldiers to cross our borders. This courtesy is henceforth withdrawn.
To march soldiers in our lands is not a right but a privilege. Consider yours revoked.
Prudence dictates a more cautious watch. The freedom of your soldiery within our realm is a risk we are no longer prepared to entertain.
You heard me right. Yer passage through our lands is finished.
Right, that's it. Your armies will cross our lands no more.
Well, seems like ya overextended our Dwarven generosity. Find another road, or find yourselves unwelcome guests.
The Chieftains no longer welcome your soldiers in their lands. Be gone at once.
Rhûn shall once again be purged of outsiders. All those that do not wear the armor of the golden dragon are to henceforth depart our lands
I gave you passage. I did not expect your forces to abuse my lands and rob my people.
Edledhio uin dôr nîn. I banish you from my land; no longer shall your men tread the ground of our forest, or defile its fair pools under the stars.
Meno uin râd. No longer may you walk our secret paths, for the forest is closed to any save those that dwell within.
The whispers of the trees carry unease. Your soldiers' passage through our forest breeds only discord; that passage is now forbidden. Boe anden mened.
Your soldiers will walk Isengard’s soil no more. Not for enmity… not yet. But the wind changes, and the wise seal their gates before the storm.
The tower of Orthanc sees further than you know. Your path lies elsewhere. Take this as clarity, not insult, though our roads are closed to you now.
The gates of Isengard close to you. Our aims now differ. Severing this arrangement spares you the burden of our ascent.
Our roads must again be kept for our own. You’ll find no open gates ahead.
The presence of your forces within our lands invites tensions we can no longer afford.
Your steel on our roads breeds whispers in the dark. Your forces must withdraw beyond our borders.
We have decided that thou art unwise, and thy actions will lead us to premature war. Stay clear of our lands, for we will bear no responsibility.
Crossing into thy borders has been an unwelcome experience, even for the lowliest snaga. We will do so no longer.
The delicate, stable society of the orcs has been disrupted by thy crossings into our lands. Bother us no more.
Squeal and scamper back to your halls. The next step you take into our lands will be your last.
Find your own roads. These lands crawl with blades, not bargains.
Our borders are sealed. Your boots have stomped here too long.
The roads of the Riddermark are no longer open to your riders. Our land will not suffer further trespass.
The right of passage is forfeit. Withdraw your forces and seek another path, or face the strength of the Rohirrim.
The welcome is withdrawn. The fields of Rohan are not for your armies to tread. Find your own way, lest steel greet your advance.
You are no longer permitted to charter our lands.
Harad is not a land for wanderers. We no longer offer purpose for travel.
No longer will we endure the weight of your soldiers passing through our dunes.
You will not wander our land any longer.
Your men were given passage. They repaid kindness with theft and disrespect. Get out.
We suffer your presence no longer. Your armies must return from whence they came. Now.

diplomacy_strings_string_cancel_trade_du.value_original: Our lands are closed to your merchants. The Men of the West will look to their own, as they have before.
Our markets are already over-full, and have no need for inferior products. Withdraw your merchants from our lands.
It has come to pass that this agreement is no longer favourable for us, as it serves only to enrichen your merchants, whose purses already overflow with coin.

diplomacy_strings_string_cancel_trade_dw.value_original: Aye, we're closin' the books on this sorry deal. Best find yerselves another partner.
Let's be blunt. Your goods are shoddy, your word's no good. Get your people and your trinkets off our land afore sundown.
This trade ain't workin' for us, and that's the bottom line. We're cuttin' ties.

diplomacy_strings_string_cancel_trade_ea.value_original: Worthless wares and stones of impure quality you offered us. No longer.
I have no need of your coin. My palace brims with gold, and Rhûn shall want for no more of your petty treasures.
Our Chieftain decrees trade with you is at an end. Go now and do what you will, without our coin.

diplomacy_strings_string_cancel_trade_el.value_original: The wood is blighted, the fruit spoiled. This venture has grown sour, and must now be abandoned.
The scales are uneven; shadow outweighs that which is fair. Regretfully, this agreement must end.
The threads of our commerce have frayed, and no longer bind us as they once did. Let the agreement, like autumn leaves, be released to the wind.

diplomacy_strings_string_cancel_trade_is.value_original: Isengard no longer traffics in the petty needs of lesser realms. Let your merchants find other gates to beg at.
We have moved beyond the commerce of crumbling kingdoms. Our trade is finished.
There will be no further exchange. Our priorities have changed, and trade is no longer among them.

diplomacy_strings_string_cancel_trade_mi.value_original: The flow of goods between us must cease for a time. This is no slight, but a measure of restraint in darker days.
Too many eyes now watch the crossing of goods and coin. Until the clouds part, our ledgers shall close.
It grieves us to sever what once brought mutual gain, but our harvest wanes. When plenty returns, so may our trade.

diplomacy_strings_string_cancel_trade_mo.value_original: As per agreement, thy trade rights have come to an end. Here, on this parchment, this is thy name scrawled in agreement. No, this is no orc ink-forgery, thou simply hath inbred hands.
The quality and quantity of goods has been lacking of late. We will not deal with thee any longer. Good day.
We understand that the orc-scraps are dear to thee, but we can no longer spare them.

diplomacy_strings_string_cancel_trade_or.value_original: Crawl back to your hole and stay there. You've got your share. Trade is over.
No more goods. No more coin. Deal's done, get out!
Trade is for the weak, a fool's game. You thought to profit from the Orcs? Ha!

diplomacy_strings_string_cancel_trade_ro.value_original: The wind has changed, and with it our fortunes. Rohan will not continue under these terms.
The trade is at an end. We deem it no longer serves the good of the Mark.
Our needs have shifted, and our merchants shall find other means. This pact is dissolved; let it be done.

diplomacy_strings_string_cancel_trade_so.value_original: Even if you could cross the desert into our lands, the bazaars will remember you, and turn away.
No jewel you offered us gleamed brightly as the desert sands.
Our bazaar required your wasted space for a recent caravan of valuable goods.

diplomacy_strings_string_cancel_trade_wi.value_original: Your trinkets are not worth our respect. This bargain ends now.
Your last shipment carried a crow. That is the end of our trade.
We don't want your things anymore.

diplomacy_strings_string_counter_accept_.value_original: Very well. You have proven yourself a wise bargainer, and your terms are accepted.
You have argued your case with some skill, and a measure of reason. Very well, your revised terms find acceptance.
