diplomacy_strings_string_war_orcs_03.value_translated: La era de los hombres ha terminado. Ha llegado la hora de los orcos...

diplomacy_strings_string_war_rohirrim_01.value_original: Fell deeds awake! Now for wrath, now for ruin and the red dawn!
diplomacy_strings_string_war_rohirrim_01.value_translated: ¡Un momento cruel se avecina! ¡Ahora es el momento de la ira, ahora es el momento de la ruina y del amanecer rojo!

diplomacy_strings_string_war_rohirrim_02.value_original: The hour has come. We ride now, for ruin and glory, to the world's ending! Death is upon you!
diplomacy_strings_string_war_rohirrim_02.value_translated: Ha llegado la hora. ¡Cabalgamos ahora, hacia la ruina y la gloria, hacia el fin del mundo! ¡La muerte os acecha!

diplomacy_strings_string_war_rohirrim_03.value_original: The horn of the Éored will be blown, and the trampling of hooves shall come upon you as a blast of thunder, that your foul deceit be cleansed with fire and sword!
diplomacy_strings_string_war_rohirrim_03.value_translated: ¡Se tocará el cuerno de los Éored, y el estruendo de los cascos os golpeará como un trueno, para que vuestro vil engaño sea purificado con fuego y espada!

diplomacy_strings_string_war_southrons_0.value_original: Your heads will be rolled down the dunes for sport, and your blood will paint the sand!
diplomacy_strings_string_war_southrons_0.value_translated: ¡Vuestras cabezas rodarán por las dunas por diversión, y vuestra sangre pintará la arena!

diplomacy_strings_string_war_southrons_0.value_original: The mighty Mûmakil shall crush you into dust. Your lands, your people, your legacy, all forgotten.
diplomacy_strings_string_war_southrons_0.value_translated: El poderoso Mûmakil te reducirá a polvo. Tus tierras, tu pueblo, tu legado, todo quedará en el olvido.

diplomacy_strings_string_war_southrons_0.value_original: The black serpent strikes without warning, lethal, against the foes of Harad.
diplomacy_strings_string_war_southrons_0.value_translated: La serpiente negra ataca sin previo aviso, letal, contra los enemigos de Harad.

diplomacy_strings_string_war_wildmen_01.value_original: Enough talk! The time for blood has come.
diplomacy_strings_string_war_wildmen_01.value_translated: ¡Basta de charla! Ha llegado la hora de derramar sangre.

diplomacy_strings_string_war_wildmen_02.value_original: We will take back the lands you stole! Every village will be burned!
diplomacy_strings_string_war_wildmen_02.value_translated: ¡Recuperaremos las tierras que nos robasteis! ¡Quemaremos todos los pueblos!

diplomacy_strings_string_war_wildmen_03.value_original: Cry havoc, and let slip the dogs of war!
diplomacy_strings_string_war_wildmen_03.value_translated: ¡Grita «caos» y suelta a los perros de la guerra!

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: This garrison's provisions have been poisoned.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Las provisiones de esta guarnición han sido envenenadas.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: An enemy unit has been ravaged by this agent's arrows.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Una unidad enemiga ha sido devastada por las flechas de este agente.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: A unit has been ravaged by an agent's attack.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Una unidad ha sido devastada por el ataque de un agente.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: An enemy unit has been afflicted by this agent's arrows.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Una unidad enemiga ha sido alcanzada por las flechas de este agente.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: A unit has been afflicted by an enemy agent's attack.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Una unidad ha sido afectada por el ataque de un agente enemigo.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The King's control collapsed and the folk are in open defiance.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: El control del rey se ha derrumbado y el pueblo se ha rebelado abiertamente.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: A widening divide grows between the King and his folk.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: La brecha entre el rey y su pueblo se hace cada vez más grande.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Sons of Durin displeased that their hold is not yet as great as Khazad-dûm.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Los Hijos de Durin están descontentos porque su dominio aún no es tan grande como el de Khazad-dûm.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Residents neither troubled nor thriving. Precarious as a hastily dug mine-shaft.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Los residentes no están preocupados ni prosperan. Precarios como un pozo minero excavado apresuradamente.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: A dependable discipline keeping the folk orderly and reliable.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Una disciplina fiable que mantiene al pueblo ordenado y responsable.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Loyalty and duty to the King as strong as forged iron.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Lealtad y deber hacia el rey tan fuertes como el hierro forjado.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: With unity absolute, the region stands in flawless order, solid as stone.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Con una unidad absoluta, la región se mantiene en un orden impecable, sólida como una roca.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Harmony has failed and discontent spreads through the hold like a withering blight.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: La armonía ha fracasado y el descontento se extiende por el dominio como una plaga devastadora.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The hearts of elves stir to unrest as the light of the Eldar fades.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Los corazones de los elfos se agitan con inquietud a medida que la luz de los Eldar se desvanece.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Calm unsettled, quiet troubles taking root.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: La calma inquieta, en la que los problemas silenciosos echan raíces.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: No shift towards shadow or light; peace lies yet unshaken.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Sin cambios hacia la sombra o la luz; la paz permanece inquebrantable.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Elves move in gentle accord as peace returns.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Los elfos se mueven en armonía a medida que vuelve la paz.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: With restored clarity and calm, the Firstborn place their faith and trust in leadership.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Con la claridad y la calma recuperadas, los Primogénitos depositan su fe y confianza en el liderazgo.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The region stands in full grace, its peace deep and unbroken.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: La región se encuentra en plena gracia, su paz es profunda e inquebrantable.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The denizens would sooner see the hold burn than submit to authority.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Los habitantes preferirían ver arder todo el dominio antes que someterse a la autoridad.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Rage and ruin in the absence of order, your subjects' hatred targets your rule.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: La ira y la ruina en ausencia de orden, el odio de tus súbditos se dirige contra tu gobierno.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Obedience is feigned and trouble is brewing despite the lash.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: La obediencia es fingida y se avecinan problemas a pesar del látigo.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: A grim balance of dread, fervour neither rises nor falls against you.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Un sombrío equilibrio entre el temor y el fervor no aumenta ni disminuye en tu contra.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Their will bent, order now is maintained through fear and habit.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Su voluntad se ha doblegado, y ahora el orden se mantiene mediante el miedo y la costumbre.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: All exist to serve according to your designs.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Todos existen para servir según tus designios.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: One will to rule them all, and in the darkness guide them.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Una voluntad para gobernarlos a todos y guiarlos en la oscuridad.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: "You have no power here"
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: «No tienes poder aquí».

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: These lands are beyond your rule and fell into an anarchic state.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Estas tierras están fuera de tu dominio y han caído en un estado de anarquía.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Strength is faltering and your words carry less weight.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: La fuerza está decayendo y tus palabras tienen menos peso.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Whilst there are still those who question your rule, they remain quiet for now.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Aunque todavía hay quienes cuestionan tu gobierno, por ahora permanecen en silencio.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: In stabilizing the region, your hold on it grows.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Al estabilizar la región, tu control sobre ella aumenta.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Your words carry weight and put things in motion.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Tus palabras tienen peso y ponen las cosas en marcha.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: These lands abide by your laws and order
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Estas tierras acatan sus leyes y su orden.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Our merchants are priotizing agricultural exports to the woodland halls.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Nuestros comerciantes están dando prioridad a las exportaciones agrícolas a los salones del bosque.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Our merchants are priotizing industrial exports to the woodland halls.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Nuestros comerciantes están dando prioridad a las exportaciones industriales a los salones del bosque.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Our merchants are priotizing cultural exports to the woodland halls.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Nuestros comerciantes están dando prioridad a las exportaciones culturales a los salones del bosque.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Our merchants bring many tomes and scrolls back from their journeys into Mirkwood.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Nuestros comerciantes traen consigo numerosos tomos y pergaminos de sus viajes al Bosque Negro.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Our merchants sell all sorts of fine elven craft in markets across the kingdom.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Nuestros comerciantes venden todo tipo de artesanía élfica de gran calidad en los mercados de todo el reino.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The elves trade special herbs and medicinal poultices with our merchants.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Los elfos comercian con hierbas especiales y cataplasmas medicinales con nuestros mercaderes.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The disruption of our trade route with erebor is stressing our crafstmen and metalsmiths as they try to meet the demands of our armies.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: La interrupción de nuestra ruta comercial con Erebor está causando estrés a nuestros artesanos y herreros, que intentan satisfacer las demandas de nuestros ejércitos.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The ongoing trade relationship with our ally Erebor is supplementing our military equipment production with superior dwarven craft.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: La relación comercial que mantenemos con nuestro aliado Erebor está complementando nuestra producción de equipamiento militar con artesanía enana de calidad superior.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: As a consequence of a temporary ammunition shortage, your ranged units carry less ammunition than usual, making them unsuitable for prolonged ranged combat.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Como consecuencia de una escasez temporal de munición, tus unidades a distancia llevan menos munición de lo habitual, lo que las hace inadecuadas para combates a distancia prolongados.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Your ranged units are temporarily supplied with low-quality ammunition. As a result, they will not be as effective in combat.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Tus unidades a distancia disponen temporalmente de munición de baja calidad. Como resultado, no serán tan efectivas en combate.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Your workforce is repurposed and prioritises the production of ammunition. Many workers will not partake in their usual labour.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Tu mano de obra se reasigna y da prioridad a la producción de municiones. Muchos trabajadores no participarán en sus tareas habituales.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Hay un edicto activo en la provincia local.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Diverts locally produced food towards the market with our trade partners, increasing the volume of tradeable goods.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Desvía los alimentos producidos localmente hacia el mercado con nuestros socios comerciales, aumentando el volumen de productos comercializables.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: "Build a dam, block the stream, work the furnaces night and day."
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: «Construye una presa, bloquea el arroyo, trabaja en los hornos día y noche».

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Your betrayal of your own kin has changed the way the rest of the free peoples consider you.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Tu traición a tus propios parientes ha cambiado la forma en que el resto de los pueblos libres te consideran.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Our soldiers' morale and willingness to fight has increased due to a generous distribution of excess goods.
The people rejoice after having received a generous distribution of excess goods. Their resolve benefits from this.
Troops are granted tobacco, lightening their burdens and boosting morale.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: A las tropas se les concede tabaco, lo que aligera su carga y eleva su moral.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The people receive the leaf freely, easing hardship and fostering growth.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: La gente recibe la hoja libremente, lo que alivia las dificultades y fomenta el crecimiento.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The leaf is sold in bulk, bringing wealth to the treasury.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: La hoja se vende a granel, lo que aporta riqueza al tesoro público.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The tobacco is sent abroad, earning profit and goodwill with allies.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: El tabaco se envía al extranjero, lo que genera beneficios y buena voluntad con los aliados.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Soldiers receive the wine, raising spirits in the camp though discipline wanes.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Los soldados reciben el vino, lo que levanta el ánimo en el campamento, aunque la disciplina decae.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The folk share in their lord’s bounty, feasting together and growing content.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: El pueblo comparte la generosidad de su señor, festejando juntos y creciendo en satisfacción.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The surplus of wine is sold for coin, filling the coffers.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: El excedente de vino se vende a cambio de monedas, llenando las arcas.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The wine is traded abroad, strengthening commerce and ties with neighbors.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: El vino se intercambia en el extranjero, lo que fortalece el comercio y los lazos con nuestros vecinos.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: A settlement has been lost due to our enemy's cunning plans. It has fortified the will to take up arms amongst those that remain, lest they suffer a similar fate.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Se ha perdido un asentamiento debido a los astutos planes de nuestro enemigo. Esto ha fortalecido la voluntad de tomar las armas entre los que quedan, para no sufrir un destino similar.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: A settlement has been sacked due to our enemy's cunning plans. It has fortified the will to take up arms amongst those that remain, lest they suffer a similar fate.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Un asentamiento ha sido saqueado debido a los astutos planes de nuestro enemigo. Esto ha fortalecido la voluntad de tomar las armas entre los que quedan, para no correr una suerte similar.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: This faction is not playable... yet!
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Esta facción no es jugable... ¡todavía!

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: "Men tall and proud, sons of kings and heirs of greatness."
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: «Hombres altos y orgullosos, hijos de reyes y herederos de la grandeza».

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: "By the blood of our people, are your lands kept safe!"
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: «¡Gracias a la sangre de nuestro pueblo, vuestras tierras están a salvo!».

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: "The Crownless again shall be King"
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: «El sin corona volverá a ser rey».

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: "The hardiest folk in Middle-earth, masters of craftmanship and fierce in war."
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: «El pueblo más resistente de la Tierra Media, maestros de la artesanía y feroces en la guerra».

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: PLACEHOLDER
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: PLACEHOLDER

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: "We are Sons of Dúrin, and Dúrin's folk do not flee from a fight."
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: «Somos los Hijos de Dúrin, y el pueblo de Dúrin no huye de la batalla».

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: PLACEHOLDER
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: PLACEHOLDER

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: "Wave after wave of ferocious warriors, bringing death and destruction at the Dark Lord's bidding."
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: «Ola tras ola de feroces guerreros, trayendo muerte y destrucción a las órdenes del Señor Oscuro».

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: "Vanguard of the great hordes of Rhûn, the fiercest fighters of all Easterlings."
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: «La vanguardia de las grandes hordas de Rhûn, los guerreros más feroces de todos los orientales».

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: "Eldest and noblest to walk Arda, immortal in life, and fairest of all."
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: «Los más ancianos y nobles que han pisado Arda, inmortales en vida y los más bello de todos».

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: "There shall be counsels taken stronger than Morgul-spells"
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: «Se llevarán a cabo concilios más poderosos que los hechizos de Morgul».

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: "Grey ships pass into the West..."
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: «Los barcos grises se adentran en el Oeste...».

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: "On the land of Lórien, there was no stain."
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: «En las tierras de Lórien no había mancha alguna».

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: "The fortunes of the world will rise and fall, but here, in this kingdom, we will endure."
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: «Las fortunas del mundo se alzarán y desaparecerán, pero aquí, en este reino, resistiremos».

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: "Horns from the South. The fiercest hailing from wild and distant lands, have come in full terror quashing petty lines of quaking opponents!"
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: «Cuernos del Sur. ¡Los más feroces, procedentes de tierras salvajes y lejanas, han llegado llenos de terror, aplastando las insignificantes filas de sus temblorosos oponentes!».

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: "Stalwart and resilient, the strength and hope of the world of Men."
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: «Firmes y resistentes, la fuerza y la esperanza del mundo de los hombres».

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: "There was the city of Dale, its markets known far and wide."
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: «Allí estaba la ciudad de Valle, cuyos mercados eran conocidos en todas partes».

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: This force has reduced upkeep for 10 turns as a consequence of colonizing a settlement
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Esta fuerza ha reducido sus gastos de mantenimiento durante 10 turnos como consecuencia de la colonización de un asentamiento.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: "Fell deeds awake!"
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: «¡Un momento cruel se avecina!»

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: "They are valiant men and keep open the High Pass and the Ford of Carrock."
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: «Son hombres valientes y mantienen abiertos el Paso Alto y el Vado de la Carroca».

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: "Mockery of the gift of life, the tide of doom and despair."
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: «Burla del don de la vida, la marea de la fatalidad y la desesperación».

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: "A sickness lies over the Greenwood..."
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: «Una enfermedad se cierne sobre el Bosque Verde...».

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: "Grib, grab. Pinch, nab. And down, down, down to Goblin-town."
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: «Agarra, coge. Pellizca, atrapa. Y abajo, abajo, abajo, a la Ciudad de los Trasgos».

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Placeholder description
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Placeholder description

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Scrappers: +5 melee attack, +5 morale and +15% armour for all units in this army
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Desguazadores: +5 al ataque cuerpo a cuerpo, +5 a la moral y +15 % de armadura para todas las unidades de este ejército.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: "Remnants of a bygone age, persisting through all hardship and stirring again."
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: «Vestigios de una época pasada, que persisten a pesar de todas las adversidades y vuelven a cobrar vida».

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: It is a fool's errand to challenge a brute horde of frenzied Gundabad orcs.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Es una tarea inútil desafiar a una horda brutal de orcos frenéticos de Gundabad.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: "A new power is rising. Its victory is at hand!"
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: «Un nuevo poder está surgiendo. ¡Su victoria está al alcance de la mano!»

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: "Against the power of Mordor, there can be no victory."
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: «Contra el poder de Mordor, no puede haber victoria».

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: "Harsh as the desert itself, swift as the wind, compelled to march against the Dark Lord's enemies."
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: «Duro como el propio desierto, veloz como el viento, obligado a marchar contra los enemigos del Señor Oscuro».

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: "Warriors of the South, hardened by their hatred of the West and stirred to war by the forces of darkness."
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: «Guerreros del Sur, endurecidos por su odio hacia el Oeste y empujados a la guerra por las fuerzas de la oscuridad».

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The thrill of conquest drives the hosts onward, swift and relentless.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: La emoción de la conquista impulsa a las huestes a seguir adelante, rápidas e implacables.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: "They have long ceased to fear the might of Gondor, and they have allied them with the Enemy, and now make a heavy stroke in his cause."
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: «Hace tiempo que dejaron de temer el poderío de Gondor, se han aliado con el Enemigo y ahora le prestan un gran servicio a su causa».

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: "Unwavering and unforgiving men of the wild, vengeful and persistent."
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: «Hombres inquebrantables e implacables de las tierras salvajes, vengativos y persistentes».

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: "The Horsemen took our lands, they drove our people into the hills, to scratch a living off rocks!"
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: «Los jinetes nos quitaron nuestras tierras, empujaron a nuestra gente a las colinas, ¡para ganarse la vida arañando las rocas!».

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Your agents learn from experience and are more capable of successfully executing their missions.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Tus agentes aprenden de la experiencia y son más capaces de ejecutar con éxito sus misiones.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: New slave workers are assigned to every field of work, increasing productivity of all buildings.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Se asignan nuevos trabajadores esclavos a cada campo de trabajo, lo que aumenta la productividad de todos los edificios.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Even though there might have been no issue at all, the new warehouse will certainly prevent any ammunition shortage.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Aunque puede que no hubiera ningún problema, el nuevo almacén evitará sin duda alguna cualquier escasez de munición.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: You are prepared to go into battle with the Rohirrim. They shall find your spear wall unwavering, and their riders will not return alive after charging your lines.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Estás preparado para entrar en combate con los Rohirrim. Encontrarán tu muro de lanzas inquebrantable, y sus jinetes no volverán con vida tras cargar contra tus filas.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Experience with the production and use of artillery will pay off when your enemies try hiding behind walls again.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: La experiencia en la producción y el uso de artillería dará sus frutos cuando tus enemigos vuelvan a intentar esconderse detrás de las murallas.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Optimized building processes will decrease time and cost of new construction projects.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Los procesos de construcción optimizados disminuirán el tiempo y el coste de los nuevos proyectos de construcción.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Improved armour production both in quality and quantity strengthens your troops and lowers the cost of new heavy armour equipment.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: La mejora en la producción de armaduras, tanto en calidad como en cantidad, refuerza tus tropas y reduce el coste de los nuevos equipos de armadura pesada.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: This province experiences a great temporary increase in industrial productivity.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Esta provincia experimenta un gran aumento temporal de la productividad industrial.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Having witnessed an invading force being expelled from their lands, conscripts willingly line up in front of the barracks, eager to participate in such heroic battles.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Tras haber presenciado la expulsión de una fuerza invasora de sus tierras, los reclutas se alinean voluntariamente frente a los cuarteles, ansiosos por participar en tan heroicas batallas.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Your people are more alert and thus more militant. Enemy agents will find it harder to cause harm in your settlements.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Tu gente está más alerta y, por lo tanto, más combativa. A los agentes enemigos les resultará más difícil causar daños en tus asentamientos.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: A great increase of local orc population means higher availability of fighters for your armies.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Un gran aumento de la población local de orcos significa una mayor disponibilidad de combatientes para tus ejércitos.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The tale of another region coming under control of the Power of Shadow quickly spreads and inspires resolve and faith in your population.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: La noticia de que otra región ha caído bajo el control del Poder de las Sombras se difunde rápidamente e inspira determinación y fe en tu población.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The plunder that was sacked during a recent raid is distributed among common warriors. It won't be long until they spend it for their own enjoyment, benefitting your economy.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: El botín saqueado durante una reciente incursión se distribuye entre la soldadesca. No tardarán en gastarlo en su propio disfrute, lo que beneficiará a tu economía.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Ranged units recruited in the next few turns will gain more experience.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Las unidades a distancia reclutadas en los próximos turnos obtendrán más experiencia.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: A new breed of beasts enters the battlefield on your side. Emboldened by this, they charge forward with unprecedented ferocity.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Una nueva raza de bestias entra en el campo de batalla, de tu lado. Envalentonadas por ello, cargan hacia delante con una ferocidad sin precedentes.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: You have bolstered your forces with proficient and capable horsemen, whose training provides new expertise that can benefit other units as well.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Has reforzado tus fuerzas con jinetes competentes y capaces, cuyo entrenamiento aporta nuevos conocimientos que también pueden beneficiar a otras unidades.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: You have bolstered your forces with supreme close-combat fighters, whose training provides new expertise that can benefit other units as well.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Has reforzado tus fuerzas con combatientes expertos en combate cuerpo a cuerpo, cuyo entrenamiento aporta nuevos conocimientos que también pueden beneficiar a otras unidades.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: You have bolstered your forces with skilful marksmen, whose training provides new expertise that can benefit other units as well.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Has reforzado tus fuerzas con hábiles tiradores, cuyo entrenamiento aporta nuevos conocimientos que también pueden beneficiar a otras unidades.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Dedicating a special building to recruit only the most experienced units increases the training standard and overall control, as word of the prestigious project quickly spreads.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Dedicar un edificio especial al reclutamiento de únicamente las unidades más experimentadas aumenta el estándar de entrenamiento y el control general, ya que la noticia de este prestigioso proyecto no tarda en difundirse.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The Dark Lord is the master of all living beings. His worship becomes more popular in your lands.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: El Señor Oscuro es el amo de todos los seres vivos. Su culto se está volviendo más popular en vuestras tierras.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The dark teachings of Sauron have no place in your lands. Your people are more faithful and true to the Will of the West.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Las oscuras enseñanzas de Sauron no tienen cabida en tus tierras. Tu pueblo es más fiel y leal a la Voluntad del Oeste.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Trade is thriving in your lands and more merchants arrive every day, bringing more wealth to the state.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: El comercio prospera en tus tierras y cada día llegan más comerciantes, lo que aporta más riqueza al estado.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The fierce Variags charge into battle, cleaving through their enemies' armour. Your forces attack with increased ferocity and instill fear into enemy soldiers.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Los feroces Variags se lanzan a la batalla, atravesando las armaduras de sus enemigos. Tus fuerzas atacan con mayor ferocidad e infunden miedo en los soldados enemigos.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The tale of faithful people being freed from evil occupation quickly spreads and inspires hope in your population.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: La historia de personas fieles que se liberan de la ocupación maligna se difunde rápidamente e inspira esperanza en tu población.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The Hunt for the One Ring has begun. Its reclamation would all but guarantee our rule of Middle-Earth. It must be recovered quickly, however, lest it fall into the hands of those who would defy us.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: La búsqueda del Anillo Único ha comenzado. Su recuperación garantizaría nuestro dominio sobre la Tierra Media. Sin embargo, debe recuperarse rápidamente, para que no caiga en manos de aquellos que se nos oponen.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The Hunt for the One Ring has begun. Its reclamation would all but guarantee our rule of Middle-Earth. It must be recovered quickly, however, lest it fall into the hands of those who would defy us.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: La búsqueda del Anillo Único ha comenzado. Su recuperación garantizaría nuestro dominio sobre la Tierra Media. Sin embargo, debe recuperarse rápidamente, para que no caiga en manos de aquellos que se nos oponen.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Take your war to the seas by constructing new ships and recruiting new mariners.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Lleva tu guerra a los mares construyendo nuevos barcos y reclutando nuevos marineros.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Our hopes of establishing a worthy successor state to the ancient Kingdom of Rhovanion are little else but folly.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Nuestras esperanzas de establecer un digno estado sucesor del antiguo Reino de Rhovanion no son más que una locura.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Any hope of establishing a worthy successor state to the ancient Kingdom of Rhovanion would be a mere dream at this point, albeit a sweet one.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Cualquier esperanza de establecer un digno estado sucesor del antiguo Reino de Rhovanion sería, a estas alturas, un mero sueño, aunque muy dulce.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Although we are on the right path, our future as a great kingdom of Northmen still remains insecure.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Aunque vamos por buen camino, nuestro futuro como gran reino de los hombres del norte sigue siendo incierto.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Little by little, we are securing our trade routes and borders. Although still uncertain, our Kingdom has potential.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Poco a poco, estamos asegurando nuestras rutas comerciales y fronteras. Aunque todavía es incierto, nuestro reino tiene potencial.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: What the future holds is always uncertain, but we are starting to secure our place in it.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: El futuro siempre es incierto, pero estamos empezando a asegurarnos un lugar en él.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: We have shown promise by good decision-making. Although far from a certainty, we may one day be powerful enough to secure a reformed Kingdom, worthy to call itself a true successor to the Kingdom of Rhovanion.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Hemos demostrado nuestro potencial tomando buenas decisiones. Aunque aún no es seguro, es posible que algún día seamos lo suficientemente poderosos como para asegurar un reino reformado, digno de llamarse verdadero sucesor del Reino de Rhovanion.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: We have proven our ability to defend our borders and trade routes, holding warlike intruders at bay. The prospects of a reforged Kingdom of Rhovanion are becoming more likely by the day.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Hemos demostrado nuestra capacidad para defender nuestras fronteras y rutas comerciales, manteniendo a raya a los invasores belicosos. Las perspectivas de reforjar el antiguo Reino de Rhovanion son cada día más favorables.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Arduous effort has led us to a state of prosperity and security, able to project power to every corner of our Kingdom. We have all but secured our role as the successors of the ancient Kingdom of Rhovanion.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Nuestros arduos esfuerzos nos han llevado a una situación de prosperidad y seguridad, capaces de proyectar nuestro poder a todos los rincones de nuestro reino. Hemos consolidado nuestro papel como sucesores del antiguo reino de Rhovanion.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Wealth is an inevitable byproduct of Dwarven diligence, but it matters little in the grand scheme of things.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: La riqueza es un subproducto inevitable de la diligencia de los enanos, pero tiene poca importancia tal y como están las cosas ahora.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Our society has developed an increased interest in all things shiny. Indeed, it is a tool with which any ruler can elevate their status - and the key to new opportunities.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Nuestra sociedad ha desarrollado un creciente interés por todo lo que brilla. De hecho, es una herramienta con la que cualquier gobernante puede elevar su estatus, y la clave para nuevas oportunidades.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Many of our kinsmen have evolved an apetite for gold. The mines are operating efficiently - and attracting the attention of dark powers around us.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Muchos de nuestros parientes han desarrollado un apetito por el oro. Las minas están operando con eficacia - y atrayendo la atención de los poderes oscuros que nos rodean.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Our society operates with utmost efficiency, extracting wealth from every rock and pebble. The hoards of treasure we have amassed has not gone unnoticed by jealous neighbours.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Nuestra sociedad funciona con la máxima eficiencia, extrayendo riqueza de cada roca y cada guijarro. Los grandes tesoros que hemos acumulado no han pasado desapercibidos para nuestros envidiosos vecinos.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: All the world is in awe of our extreme wealth and proficiency. Jealous neighbours covet our mountains of treasure and need often be reminded to keep their greedy hands to themselves.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Todo el mundo está asombrado por nuestra extrema riqueza y competencia. Nuestros envidiosos vecinos codician nuestras montañas de tesoros y a menudo hay que recordarles que mantengan sus codiciosas manos alejadas.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: An unquenchable thirst for gold permeates every facet of our Dwarven society. Truly, why should our kin not feast upon all the good this world has to offer?
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Una sed insaciable de oro impregna todas las facetas de nuestra sociedad enana. En verdad, ¿por qué no deberían nuestros parientes deleitarse con todo lo bueno que este mundo tiene para ofrecer?

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: La riqueza es un subproducto inevitable de la diligencia de los enanos, pero tiene poca importancia tal y como están las cosas ahora.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: If power is merely existing, then you are still weak.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Si existe el poder realmente, tú eres aún muy débil.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Some power is better than no power. Barely.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Algo de poder es mejor que ninguno. O a lo mejor no.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Your words, shouted loudly, carry some weight, but not often to those that matter.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Tus palabras, pronunciadas en alto, tienen algo de peso, pero a menudo no para aquellos que importan.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Power, undeniably, but not in abundance.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Poder, indiscutiblemente; pero no en abundancia.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: A place for everyone, and everyone in their place.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Un lugar para todos y todo el mundo en su lugar.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: To be feared is too much, to be respected is strength.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Ser temido es demasiado; ser respetado es signo de fuerza.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Strength of will forges manifest destiny.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: La fuerza de voluntad forja el destino manifiesto.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Like the mountains; immeasurable, immovable power.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Como las montañas: un poder inmensurable e inamovible.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: "Power tends to corrupt, and absolute power corrupts absolutely."
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: El poder corrompe y el poder absoluto corrompe absolutamente.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: A place for everyone, and everyone in their place.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Un lugar para todos y todo el mundo en su lugar.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: To be feared is too much, to be respected is strength.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Ser temido es demasiado; ser respetado es signo de fuerza.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Strength of will forges manifest destiny.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: La fuerza de voluntad forja el destino manifiesto.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Like the mountains; immeasurable, immovable power.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Como las montañas: un poder inmensurable e inamovible.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: "Power tends to corrupt, and absolute power corrupts absolutely."
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: El poder corrompe y el poder absoluto corrompe absolutamente.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: "Our true production potential remains untapped. We have work to do."
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: «Nuestro verdadero potencial de producción sigue sin explotarse. Tenemos trabajo por delante».

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: "Isengard has been cleared of its gardens. Every day new pits are dug, ores are smelted and our formidable Uruk-hai are armed."
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: «Isengard ha sido despojada de sus jardines. Cada día se cavan nuevos pozos, se funden minerales y se arma a nuestros formidables uruk-hai».

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: "The reach of the White Hand of Saruman will soon be felt by the realms of Men."
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: «El alcance de la Mano Blanca de Saruman pronto se dejará sentir en los reinos de los Hombres».

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: "Beneath the towering might of Orthanc, thousands of slaves and orcs labour day and night, forging weapons and armour for our growing army of Uruk-hai."
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: «Bajo el imponente sombra de Orthanc, miles de esclavos y orcos trabajan día y noche forjando armas y armaduras para nuestro creciente ejército de Uruk-hai».

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: "We are at the cusp of realising the full potential of our war machine. Soon, there will be nothing left to stop us."
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: «Estamos a punto de alcanzar todo el potencial de nuestra maquinaria bélica. Pronto, nada podrá detenernos».

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: "Our industrial might stands supreme, unrivaled even by Mordor itself. A power hitherto unconceived of in Middle Earth."
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: «Nuestro poderío industrial es supremo, sin rival ni siquiera en Mordor. Un poder hasta ahora inconcebible en la Tierra Media».

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: "A new power is rising; its victory is at hand. We have the power to end the age of Men or, should we choose, to challenge the Dark Lord in a battle for this Middle Earth."
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: «Un nuevo poder está surgiendo; su victoria está cerca. Tenemos el poder de poner fin a la era de los Hombres o, si así lo decidimos, de desafiar al Señor Oscuro en una batalla por esta Tierra Media.»

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: If power is merely existing, then you are still weak.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Si existe el poder realmente, tú eres aún muy débil.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Some power is better than no power. Barely.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Algo de poder es mejor que ninguno. O a lo mejor no.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Your words, shouted loudly, carry some weight, but not often to those that matter.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Tus palabras, pronunciadas en alto, tienen algo de peso, pero a menudo no para aquellos que importan.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: We have yet much to prove before the Eye sees our worth.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Aún nos queda mucho por demostrar antes de que el Ojo vea nuestro valor.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: We have gained some recognition from the Eye for our obedience, but it is far from significant.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Hemos obtenido cierto reconocimiento por parte del Ojo por nuestra obediencia, pero dista mucho de ser significativo.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: We have earned a modicum of Mordor's respect for our accomplishments in Sauron's name. Still, much remains before we can call ourselves an indispensable ally.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Nos hemos ganado un mínimo de respeto por parte de Mordor gracias a nuestros logros en nombre de Sauron. Aún así, queda mucho por hacer antes de que podamos considerarnos un aliado indispensable.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The Eye is pleased with our contributions to the war.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: El Ojo está satisfecho con nuestras contribuciones a la guerra.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The Eye recognizes our worth in the domination of Middle Earth.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: El Ojo reconoce nuestro valor en el dominio de la Tierra Media.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: We have proven the beyond all doubt the strength of orcs in the service of the Eye.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Hemos demostrado sin lugar a dudas la fuerza de los orcos al servicio del Ojo.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Strength of will forges manifest destiny.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: La fuerza de voluntad forja el destino manifiesto.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Como las montañas: un poder inmensurable e inamovible.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: "Power tends to corrupt, and absolute power corrupts absolutely."
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: El poder corrompe y el poder absoluto corrompe absolutamente.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Our Kingdom stands on the precipice of utter ruin; lest by outside intervention, our demise is almost certain. Yet the flames of hope, even though faint, still burn.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Nuestro reino se encuentra al borde de la ruina total; a menos que haya una intervención externa, nuestra desaparición es casi segura. Sin embargo, las llamas de la esperanza, aunque débiles, siguen ardiendo.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Our Kingdom is severely weakened. Without the King's resolve and guidance, our enemies are creeping ever closer to our homes, poised to strike a lethal blow. The future is looking grim, yet all hope is not lost.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Nuestro reino está gravemente debilitado. Sin la determinación y la guía del rey, nuestros enemigos se acercan cada vez más a nuestros hogares, preparados para asestar un golpe mortal. El futuro se presenta sombrío, pero no hay que perder la esperanza.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Our once proud Kingdom has been brought down to its knees through deception and corruption within. Raiders plague our borders whilst the nobility stands leaderless and disjointed, forming factions amongst themselves.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Nuestro otrora orgulloso reino ha sido reducido a la miseria por el engaño y la corrupción internos. Los saqueadores asolan nuestras fronteras, mientras que la nobleza, sin líderes y desunida, forma facciones entre sí.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: After several decades of slow decline, the Kingdom of Rohan stands reinvigorated. Its King has regained his strength and resolve, essential tools to guide the Kingdom to prosperity.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Tras varias décadas de lento declive, el Reino de Rohan se ha revitalizado. Su rey ha recuperado su fuerza y determinación, herramientas esenciales para guiar al reino hacia la prosperidad.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Like in the olden days, our Kingdom of horse lords enjoys great stability of the realm.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Como en los viejos tiempos, nuestro reino de señores de los caballos goza de una gran estabilidad en estas tierras.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Even the lowliest ground-dwellers struggle to find anything worth consuming here.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Incluso los seres más humildes que habitan en el suelo luchan por encontrar algo que valga la pena consumir aquí.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Little grows in these lands, yet still enough to provide for those not picky.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Poco crece en estas tierras, pero aún así es suficiente para alimentar a quienes no son exigentes.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Can provide enough crops and food to go around, but not much more.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Puede proporcionar suficientes cultivos y alimentos para todos, pero no mucho más.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Modest crops can be harvested here; enough to sustain larger settlements.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Se pueden cosechar cultivos modestos aquí; suficientes para mantener asentamientos más grandes.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: These lands can provide enough sustenance to feed immense cities.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Estas tierras pueden proporcionar sustento suficiente para alimentar a ciudades inmensas.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Ideal to serve as a breadbasket for a sprawling kingdom.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Ideal para servir como granero de un reino en expansión.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The Dailian merchants are ferrying barrels of soil up the Celduin in addition to their normal shipments.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Los comerciantes de Valle están transportando barriles de tierra por el Celduin, además de sus envíos habituales.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Our new loremaster is hard at work assisting our scholars
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Nuestro nuevo maestro del saber está trabajando duro para ayudar a nuestros eruditos.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Our negotiations went well, and our relationship is imporving to the benefit of all, including the forest itself.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Las negociaciones han ido bien y nuestra relación está mejorando en beneficio de todos, incluido el propio bosque.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Our meetings with the woodesmen have gone poorly. They have no interest in further talks. It has however strengthened the resolve to preserve elven culture in our lands.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Nuestras reuniones con los hombres del bosque han ido mal. No tienen interés en seguir negociando. Sin embargo, esto ha reforzado nuestra determinación de preservar la cultura élfica en nuestras tierras.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: We will aid them as much as we can, but feeding and housing so many refugees will strain our stores.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Les ayudaremos en todo lo que podamos, pero alimentar y alojar a tantos refugiados agotará nuestras reservas.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: They will find protection here, but we lack the resources to lend them any additional aid.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Aquí encontrarán protección, pero carecemos de los recursos necesarios para prestarles más ayuda.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Fresh untainted water once again flows through northern Mirkwood, improving the health of all plants and crops.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: El agua fresca y pura vuelve a fluir por el norte del Bosque Negro, mejorando la salud de todas las plantas y cultivos.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Where there is despair, there is disarray. Wavering leadership, raiding and destruction and a desparate tide in war instill fear and doubt, making men question authority and pushing them into foolish action. Free Peoples of Middle-Earth grow desparate where the dominance of evil starts to show its destructive effects.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Donde hay desesperación, hay desorden. El liderazgo vacilante, los saqueos y la destrucción y una marea desesperada en la guerra infunden miedo y duda, haciendo que los hombres cuestionen la autoridad, empujándolos a llevar a cabo acciones insensatas. Los Pueblos Libres de la Tierra Media se vuelven desesperados cuando el dominio del mal comienza a mostrar sus efectos destructivos.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Where there is hope, men follow lead. Strong leadership under a unified purpose, a prosperous realm and military success strengthens the heart and rallies the mind. Free Peoples of Middle-Earth thrive in peace and times of bliss, whereas those following evil are in their haydays where their joint success under Sauron keeps them aligned rather than scattered and oppressed.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Donde hay esperanza, los hombres siguen el liderazgo. Un liderazgo fuerte bajo un propósito unificado, un reino próspero y el éxito militar fortalecen el corazón y unen la mente. Los Pueblos Libres de la Tierra Media prosperan en tiempos de paz y felicidad, mientras que aquellos que siguen el mal están en sus días de gloria, donde su éxito conjunto bajo Sauron los mantiene alineados en lugar de dispersos y oprimidos.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Unique units will be available to recruit in the Southern Mirkwood upon reconstructing Dol Guldur
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Se podrán reclutar unidades únicas en el sur del Bosque Negro tras la reconstrucción de Dol Guldur.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Unique units will be available to recruit in the Lothlorien upon reconstructing Caras Galadhon
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Se podrán reclutar unidades únicas en Lothlorien tras la reconstrucción de Caras Galadhon.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Recent events have worsened the sickness in Mirkwood
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Los acontecimientos recientes han agravado la enfermedad del Bosque Negro.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Recent events have begun to heal the Greenwood
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Los acontecimientos recientes han comenzado a sanar el Bosque Verde.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Unique units available to recruit through the Thranduil's Halls building chain.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Unidades únicas disponibles para reclutar a través de la cadena de edificios de los Salones de Thranduil.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The forces of evil have triumphed over those who foolishly have sought to resist. Victory is ours and the rule of all of Middle-earth all but certain!
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Las fuerzas del mal han triunfado sobre aquellos que, neciamente, han intentado resistirse. ¡La victoria es nuestra y el dominio de toda la Tierra Media es casi seguro!

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The forces of good have prevailed in their struggle against the Dark Lord Sauron and his servants. Victory is ours, may peace and prosperity reign!
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Las fuerzas del bien han prevalecido en su lucha contra el Señor Oscuro Sauron y sus siervos. ¡La victoria es nuestra! ¡Que reine la paz y la prosperidad!

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Camels are used for travelling through the desert, which gives your armies a movement speed bonus in these regions
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Los camellos se utilizan para viajar por el desierto, lo que proporciona a tus ejércitos una bonificación de velocidad de movimiento en estas regiones.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Gondor's refusal to beg help from it's allies are a motivation to the people! Recruits are lining up and the military machine is running efficiently.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: ¡La negativa de Gondor a pedir ayuda a sus aliados es una motivación para el pueblo! Los reclutas hacen fila y la maquinaria militar funciona con eficiencia.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Soldiers from Rohan has answered the call and have traveled to Anorien and can be recruited to your armies.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Los soldados de Rohan han respondido a la llamada y han viajado a Anórien, donde pueden ser reclutados para tus ejércitos.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Your hunters have successfully defeated a brewing force of evil on the borders of your kingdom. The forest heaves a sigh of relief. (+10 Health Points added)
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Tus cazadores han derrotado con éxito a una fuerza maligna que se estaba gestando en las fronteras de tu reino. El bosque da un suspiro de alivio. (+10 puntos de Salud del Bosque)

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Your borders are secured and the corruption of evil is held back. Your people feel safe.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Tus fronteras están protegidas y la corrupción del mal se mantiene a raya. Tu pueblo se siente seguro.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Spiders and other creatures of shadow have entered your kingdom and are causing havoc!
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: ¡Las arañas y otras criaturas de las sombras han entrado en tu reino y están causando estragos!

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The forest is deeply corrupted by the forces of evil! You must fight back to regenerate the forest's health! (0 - 48 Health Points)
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: ¡Los bosques están profundamente corrompidos por las fuerzas del mal! ¡Debes luchar para regenerar la vitalidad del bosque! (0-48 Puntos de Vitalidad)

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The forest is corrupted by the forces of evil! Your kingdom is but a dim light in the darkness. Fight back to regenerate forest health (49-96 Health Points)
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: ¡El bosque está corrompido por las fuerzas del mal! Tu reino no es más que una tenue luz en la oscuridad. Lucha para regenerar la salud del bosque (49-96 puntos de salud).

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The forest is at a stalemate between the influence of light and shadow. Keep up the fight and restore Eryn Lasgalen (97 - 144 Health Points)
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: El bosque se encuentra en un punto muerto entre la influencia de la luz y la sombra. Sigue luchando y restaura Eryn Lasgalen (97 - 144 puntos de salud).

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The forest is healing! You are prevailing against the corrupting powers of evil. While not yet restored to its former glory, you are getting close! (145 - 192 Health Points)
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: ¡El bosque se está recuperando! Estás venciendo a los poderes corruptores del mal. Aunque aún no ha recuperado su antigua gloria, ¡estás cerca de conseguirlo! (145 - 192 puntos de salud)

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The forest is restored to its former glory and prosperity! People are no longer using the name "Mirkwood" and are now using the original name "Greenwood the Great" again!
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: ¡El bosque ha recuperado su antigua gloria y prosperidad! La gente ya no utiliza el nombre «Bosque Negro». ¡Ahora vuelven a usar su nombre original: «Gran Bosque Verde»!

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Each triumph over shadow breathes new life into the once-great Eryn Lasgalen, each defeat brings us closer to ruin. The Enemy must be driven out, and our forest restored.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Cada triunfo sobre la sombra da nueva vida a la otrora grandiosa Eryn Lasgalen, cada derrota nos acerca más a la ruina. Debemos expulsar al enemigo y restaurar nuestro bosque.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Each triumph over shadow breathes new life into the once-great Eryn Lasgalen, each defeat brings us closer to ruin. The Enemy must be driven out, and our forest restored.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The Dominion of Sauron recognizes your delegation of territory to its servants.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: El Dominio de Sauron reconoce tu delegación de territorio a sus siervos.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The Free Peoples recognize your honorable bestowal of land.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Los Pueblos Libres reconocen tu honorable concesión de tierras.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: This force enjoys increased replenishment and movement range.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Esta fuerza disfruta de una mayor tasa de reabastecimiento y mejor rango de movimiento.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Our kinsmen are thankful for our help, and have in turn sent gifts to show their appreciation.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Nuestros parientes están agradecidos por nuestra ayuda y nos han enviado de vuelta regalos para mostrar su apreciación.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Our allies are thankful for our help, and have in turn sent gifts to show their appreciation.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Nuestros aliados están agradecidos por nuestra ayuda y, a cambio, nos han enviado regalos para mostrar su agradecimiento.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The Southron Nomads are assimilated into our society.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Los nómadas sudrones se han integrado en nuestra sociedad.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Indulgencia

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Un triste estado de sobriedad

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: A serious workplace accident has occurred, causing the loss of life and property. It will take time to recover.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Se ha producido un grave accidente laboral que ha causado pérdidas humanas y materiales. La recuperación llevará tiempo.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Local business are booming after one of our recent investments!
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: ¡Los negocios locales están en auge tras una de nuestras recientes inversiones!

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Unfortunately, our investment proved unwise; local shops are closing due to difficult times.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Por desgracia, nuestra inversión resultó ser poco acertada; las tiendas locales están cerrando debido a nuestra decisión.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The unification of Harad grants us access to the military units of the Corsairs of Umbar and the Mahûds.\\n\\nWe gain access to the following units:[[col:yellow]]\\n\\n• Mahûd Hunters\\n• Mahûd Clubmen\\n• Mahûd Beasttamers\\n• Corsair Archers\\n• Corsair Marines\\n• Mutants of Far Harad\\n• Umbar Usurpers\\n• Baby Mûmakil\\n• Adûnakhôrî[[/col]]\\n\\nIn addition, we gain the following permanent modifiers:
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: La unificación de Harad nos da acceso a las unidades militares de los Corsarios de Umbar y los Mahûds.\\n\\nObtenemos acceso a las siguientes unidades:[[col:yellow]]\\n\\n• Cazadores Mahûd\\n• Garroteros Mahûd\\n• Domadores de bestias Mahûd\\n• Arqueros Corsarios\\n• Marines Corsarios\\n• Mutantes de Harad Lejano\\n• Usurpadores de Umbar\\n• Bebé Mûmakil\\n• Adûnakhôrî[[/col]]\\n\\nAdemás, obtenemos los siguientes modificadores permanentes:

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Precious gems, spices, cloth, trinkets and taters - these are but some of the many goods flowing through our markets. Our bustling trade empire is growing by the day, ready to burst at the seams.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Gemas preciosas, especias, telas, baratijas y patatas - estos son algunas de las mercancías que fluyen a través de nuestros mercados. Nuestro bullicioso imperio mercantil está creciendo día a día, listo para crecer más allá de sus límites.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Control has improved as a result of recent events.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: El control ha mejorado como resultado de eventos recientes.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The Crafting Guild appreciates that we've taken interest in the development of their businesses in this settlement. As a result, their position has strengthened.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: El Gremio de Artesanos agradece que nos hayamos interesado por el desarrollo de sus negocios en este asentamiento. Como resultado, su posición se ha fortalecido.
