effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Mount Doom has erupted, no doubt an ominous sign of Sauron's wrath. Local orcs are unlikely to forget their place anytime soon.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: El Monte del Destino ha entrado en erupción, sin duda una señal ominosa de la ira de Sauron. Los orcos locales difícilmente olvidarán su lugar a partir de ahora.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Isengard will receive our aid; we cannot leave them to their own fate.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Isengard recibirá nuestra ayuda. No podemos dejarlos a su suerte.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The Fangorn Forest will fuel our furnaces.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: El bosque de Fangorn alimentará nuestras hornos.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The Fangorn Forest will fuel our furnaces.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: El bosque de Fangorn alimentará nuestras hornos.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The mythologic beasts, the Kine of Araw show an incredible positive impact on our food production.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Las bestias mitológicas, las Bueyes de Araw, tienen un impacto increíblemente positivo en nuestra producción alimentaria.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: We have reclaimed an ancient stronghold of the Kingdom of Gondor.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Hemos recuperado una antigua fortaleza del Reino de Gondor.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: We keep our wealth - and strain our alliances.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Conservamos nuestra riqueza y tensamos nuestras alianzas.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Our coin strengthens bonds beyond our halls.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Nuestro oro fortalece los lazos más allá de nuestras fronteras.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The forges blaze without pause. Gold flows, but morale cracks.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Las forjas arden sin descanso. El oro fluye, pero la moral se resquebraja.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Measured work tempers tempers and honors the craft.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: El trabajo meditado modera los ánimos y honra el oficio.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The workshops run without pause. Gold flows, but morale cracks.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Los talleres funcionan sin descanso. El oro fluye, pero la moral se resquebraja.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Measured work tempers tempers and honors the craft.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: El trabajo meditado modera los ánimos y honra el oficio.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Market stalls overflow — demand did not rise as expected. Unsold goods pile up, and merchants grumble at wasted work.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Los puestos del mercado están repletos, pero la demanda no ha aumentado como se esperaba. Los productos sin vender se acumulan y los comerciantes se quejan del trabajo perdido.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Mining is intensified, increasing wealth at the risk of strained tunnels and crews.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Se intensifica la minería, lo que aumenta la riqueza a costa de poner en riesgo los túneles y las cuadrillas.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: New shafts are opened, increasing the flow of gold.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Se abren nuevas excavaciones, lo que aumenta el flujo de oro.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Deeper delving reaches richer seams of rare mithril.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Una excavación más profunda permite alcanzar vetas más ricas de mithril, un metal muy escaso.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Every gem is torn from the stone, regardless of danger or exhaustion.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Cada gema es extraída de la piedra, sin importar el peligro o el agotamiento.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The mines are pushed to their limits, leaving little behind.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Las minas se explotan hasta el límite, dejando poco tras de sí.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The mountain is forced to yield every last trace of mithril.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: La montaña se ve obligada a entregar hasta el último vestigio de mithril.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Gríma has given a rousing speech.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Gríma ha dado un discurso emocionante.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The inquisitor from Mordor has been executed.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: El inquisidor de Mordor ha sido ejecutado.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The Serpent Tribe does not make amends.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: La tribu de la Serpiente no repara el daño causado.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The council of nobles is very displeased.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: El consejo de nobles está muy descontento.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The council of nobles is displeased.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: El consejo de nobles está descontento.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The council of nobles is very pleased.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: El consejo de nobles está muy satisfecho.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The council of nobles is pleased.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: El consejo de nobles está satisfecho.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Your actions have disobeyed the wishes of Sauron
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Tus acciones han desobedecido los deseos de Sauron.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Your actions have obeyed the wishes of Sauron
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Tus acciones han obedecido los deseos de Sauron.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Levying taxes across the empire to fund the tribute is causing unrest.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: La recaudación de impuestos en todo el imperio para financiar el tributo está causando malestar.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The influences of Mordor must be expelled from our faction.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Las influencias de Mordor deben ser expulsadas de nuestra facción.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: This settlement is paying tribute to Mordor.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Este asentamiento está pagando un tributo a Mordor.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Conquest of the core regions of the Corsairs of Umbar will grant us access to the following units:[[col:yellow]]\\n\\n• Corsair Archers\\n• Corsair Marines\\n• Umbar Usurpers\\n• Adûnakhôrî[[/col]]\\n\\nConquest of the core regions of the Corsairs of Umbar will grant us access to the following units:[[col:yellow]]\\n\\n• Mahûd Hunters\\n• Mahûd Clubmen\\n• Mahûd Beasttamers\\n• Baby Mûmakil\\n[[/col]]\\n\\nIn addition, completing both objectives grants us the following permanent modifiers:
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: La conquista de las regiones centrales de los Corsarios de Umbar nos dará acceso a las siguientes unidades:[[col:yellow]]\\n\\n• Arqueros Corsarios\\n• Marines Corsarios\\n• Usurpadores de Umbar\\n• Adûnakhôrî[[/col]]\\n\\nLa conquista de las regiones centrales de los Mahûd nos dará acceso a las siguientes unidades:[[col:yellow]]\\n\\n• Cazadores Mahûd\\n• Garroteros Mahûd\\n• Domadores de bestias Mahûd\\n• Bebé mumakil[[/col]]\\n\\nAdemás, completar ambos objetivos nos otorgará los siguientes modificadores permanentes:

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Many ill fates can befall those who seek fortune in the perilous deserts of Haradwaith.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Muchas desgracias pueden acontecer a aquellos que buscan fortuna en los peligrosos desiertos de Haradwaith.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The One Ring wants to return to its Master. It wants to be found.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: El Anillo Único quiere volver con su amo. Quiere que lo encuentren.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Our mighty coffers have strengthened our realm enough to ensure its legacy through the ages.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Nuestras poderosas arcas han fortalecido nuestro reino lo suficiente como para asegurar su legado a través de las edades.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Our mighty coffers have strengthened our realm enough to ensure its legacy through the ages.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Nuestras poderosas arcas han fortalecido nuestro reino lo suficiente como para asegurar su legado a través de las edades.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Our mighty coffers have strengthened our realm enough to ensure its legacy through the ages.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Nuestras poderosas arcas han fortalecido nuestro reino lo suficiente como para asegurar su legado a través de las edades.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Mining operations in this settlement have expanded.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Las operaciones mineras en este asentamiento se han expandido.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The furnaces are roaring with ample firewood harvested from the slopes outside of Isengard.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Los hornos rugen con la abundante leña recogida en las laderas de las afueras de Isengard.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Our woodcutters are having to travel further and further from Isengard to gather fuel for the furnaces.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Nuestros leñadores tienen que alejarse cada vez más de Isengard para recolectar combustible para los hornos.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Sauron is pleased with our efforts.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Sauron está satisfecho con nuestros esfuerzos.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Sauron will be pleased with our efforts.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Sauron estará satisfecho con nuestros esfuerzos.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: We will gain access to the following general to command our armies: Lúrtz
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Obtendremos acceso al siguiente general para comandar nuestros ejércitos: Lúrtz.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Gold flows to the Lókë-Rim, ensuring their loyalty—for now.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: El oro fluye hacia los Lókë-Rim, asegurando su lealtad, por ahora.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The Lókë-Rim's desertion shakes the ranks—cohesion falters, and recruitment stalls.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: La deserción de los Lókë-Rim sacude las filas: la cohesión se tambalea y el reclutamiento se estanca.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Denied their gold, the Lókë-Rim seethe—pride wounded, loyalty frayed.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Privados de su oro, los Lókë-Rim hierven de ira, con el orgullo herido y la lealtad desgastada.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The fire left more than ash—doubt spreads like smoke through the streets.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: El incendio dejó más que cenizas: la duda se extiende como el humo por las calles.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Despair is a foe as mighty as any. This settlement is now facing enemies both from without and within.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: La desesperación es un enemigo tan poderoso como cualquier otro. Esta colonia ahora se enfrenta a enemigos tanto externos como internos.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The impudent Mahuds are threatening our trade networks, raiding our invaluable caravan stops dispersed across the desert. They must be stopped!
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Los insolentes Mahûd están amenazando nuestras redes comerciales, asaltando nuestras valiosas paradas de caravanas dispersas por el desierto. ¡Hay que detenerlos!

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Ever since the conquest of these lands, we have struggled to contain fierce separatism of the native Mahud tribes. It has recently surged and is threatening stability.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Desde la conquista de estas tierras, hemos luchado por contener el feroz separatismo de las tribus nativas Mahûd. Recientemente ha resurgido y amenaza la estabilidad.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: We have uncovered a vast chasm connected to the mine, its walls adorned with glimmering ore ready to be mined!
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: ¡Hemos descubierto un enorme abismo conectado a la mina, cuyas paredes están adornadas con minerales brillantes listos para ser extraídos!

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: A serious accident has brought about the collapse of a local mine. Many workers were lost, and it will take time to continue our operations.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Un grave accidente ha provocado el colapso de una mina local. Muchos trabajadores se perdieron y tomará tiempo continuar con nuestras operaciones.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: A serious accident has brought about the collapse of a local mine. Many workers were lost, and it will take time to continue our operations.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Un grave accidente ha provocado el colapso de una mina local. Muchos trabajadores se perdieron y tomará tiempo continuar con nuestras operaciones.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Local prosperity attracts our Dwarven kin to the region.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: La prosperidad local atrae a nuestros hermanos enanos a la región.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The Mining Guild appreciates that we've taken interest in the development of their businesses in this settlement. As a result, their position has strengthened.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: El Gremio de Mineros aprecia que hayamos tenido en cuenta el desarrollo de sus actividades en este asentamiento. Como resultado, su posición se ha fortalecido.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Local prosperity attracts our Dwarven kin to the region.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: La prosperidad local atrae a nuestros hermanos enanos a la región.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The Dark Lord is disappointed with our lack of effort.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: El Señor Oscuro está decepcionado con nuestra falta de esfuerzo.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The Dark Lord is disappointed with our lack of effort.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Dread spreads from Minas Morgul, weakening enemy resolve.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: El terror se extiende desde Minas Morgul, debilitando la determinación del enemigo.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Forbidden stratagems and cruel foresight hasten the war, as the Nine bend hidden knowledge to the Dark Lord’s will.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Estratagemas prohibidas y crueles planes aceleran la guerra, mientras los Nueve someten el conocimiento oculto a la voluntad del Señor Oscuro.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Upon finding the Ring, the Dark Lord Sauron will be able to return to his physical form, one step closer to domination of Middle-Earth.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Al encontrar el Anillo, el Señor Oscuro Sauron será capaz de volver a su forma física, un paso más cerca de la dominación de la Tierra Media.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: We will call on every able-bodied man to defend Rohan.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Llamaremos a todo hombre capaz para defender Rohan.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: We have exterminated most of the nameless creatures and sent the rest to cower in even darker depths. It will allow us to extract more minerals from their previous nesting grounds, yet the ordeal has had a significant impact on our society.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Hemos exterminado a la mayoría de las criaturas sin nombre y hemos enviado al resto a esconderse a profundidades aún más oscuras. Esto nos permitirá extraer más minerales de sus antiguos cubiles, aunque las ordalías han tenido un importante impacto en nuestra sociedad.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Khazad-dûm is ours and ours alone! These pests will be exterminated.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: ¡Khazad-dûm es nuestro y solo nuestro! Estas plagas serán exterminadas.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The secret passages beneath Khazad-dûm will remain forever shut.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Los pasadizos secretos bajo Khazad-dûm permanecerán cerrados para siempre.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The secret passages beneath Khazad-dûm will remain forever shut.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Los pasadizos secretos bajo Khazad-dûm permanecerán cerrados para siempre.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: We have come to terms with the Dunlendings, at least for now.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Hemos llegado a un acuerdo con los dunlendinos, por lo menos, de momento.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: A new threat has begun to emerge in this region; pestilence. It is spreading like wildfire, consuming everything in its path.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Una nueva amenaza ha empezado a surgir en esta región; la peste. Se está extendiendo como el fuego, consumiéndolo todo a su paso.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: This coastal region has been beset by pirates.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Esta región costera ha sido asaltada por los piratas.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Officer Punished
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Oficial castigado

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The Halls of Dáin have been reclaimed by our people. Never again shall we be ousted from our ancestral homelands!
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Los Salones de Dáin han sido reclamados por nuestro pueblo. ¡Nunca más seremos expulsados de nuestros hogares ancestrales!

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The Tomb of Dúrin has been reclaimed by our people. Never again shall we be ousted from our ancestral homelands!
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: La tumba de Dúrin ha sido reclamada por nuestro pueblo. ¡Nunca más seremos expulsados de nuestras tierras ancestrales!

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Your military endeavours imbue your troops with an unquenchable thirst for further victories.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Tus campañas militares hacen que tus tropas tengan unas ansias insaciables de victoria.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The frontier grows unruly—your failure weakens control and emboldens rival powers at the edge.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: La frontera se vuelve ingobernable: tu fracaso debilita el control y envalentona a las potencias rivales en los límites.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Your failure stirs unrest in the court—loyalty wanes as doubts creep through noble ranks.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Tu fracaso provoca inquietud en la corte: la lealtad se desvanece a medida que las dudas se extienden entre las filas de nobles.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Order tightens in the capital—your success secures the heartland and calms unrest in the borderlands.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: El orden se refuerza en la capital: tu éxito asegura el corazón del país y calma los disturbios en las zonas fronterizas.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Your victory earns praise in the court—loyalty swells as nobles rally behind your leadership.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Tu victoria te granjea elogios en la corte: la lealtad crece a medida que los nobles se unen bajo tu liderazgo.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The vast lands of Rhûn have been unified under a single banner.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Las vastas tierras de Rhûn han sido unificadas bajo un único estandarte.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: "The Lord of Gondor is not to be made the tool of other men’s purposes; and the rule of Gondor is mine."
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: «El Señor de Gondor no debe convertirse en instrumento de los propósitos de otros hombres; y el gobierno de Gondor es mío».

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: "Why? Why do the fools fly? Better to burn sooner than late, for burn we must. We will burn like heathen kings before ever a ship sailed hither from the West. The West has failed. Go back and burn!"
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: «¿Por qué? ¿Por qué vuelan los necios? Mejor arder pronto que tarde, pues arder debemos. Arderemos como reyes paganos antes de que ningún barco llegase aquí desde el Oeste. El Oeste ha fracasado. ¡Volved y arded!».

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: "Gondor has no King, Gondor needs no King."
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: «Gondor no tiene rey, Gondor no necesita rey».

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: The seasonal catch has been exceptional this year.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: La captura estacional ha sido excepcional este año.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Every dwarf should be able to live in abundance
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Todos los enanos deberían poder vivir en abundancia.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Every dwarf should be able to live like a lord in his mansion
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Todos los enanos deberían poder vivir como señores en su mansión.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: To indulge our workers with a war brewing is not an affordable option.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Mimar a nuestros trabajadores con una guerra en ciernes no es algo que podamos permitirnos.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Every dwarf should be able to live with some degree of comfort
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Todos los enanos deberían poder vivir con cierto grado de comodidad.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: We should focus on internal stability for the time being.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Deberíamos enfocarnos en la estabilidad interna por el momento.

effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_original: Théoden has given his speech, the mublings of an old man.
effect_bundles_localised_description_rom.value_translated: Théoden ha dado su discurso, los murmullos de un anciano.

event_feed_strings_text_att_event_feed_s.value_original: Ever our foes seek to harm us, sending forth covert agents lurking in the shadows. Fortunately for us, this henchman is hidden no more.
event_feed_strings_text_att_event_feed_s.value_translated: Como siempre nuestros enemigos buscan hacernos daño, enviando agentes encubiertos que acechan en las sombras. Afortunadamente para nosotros, este secuaz ya no está oculto.

event_feed_strings_text_att_event_feed_s.value_original: Our herald has arrived with a report about the latest developments of war.\\n
event_feed_strings_text_att_event_feed_s.value_translated: Nuestro heraldo ha llegado con un informe sobre los últimos acontecimientos de la guerra.\\n

event_feed_strings_text_att_event_feed_s.value_original: Our herald has arrived with a report about the latest developments of war.\\n
event_feed_strings_text_att_event_feed_s.value_translated: Nuestro heraldo ha llegado con un informe sobre los últimos acontecimientos de la guerra.\\n

event_feed_strings_text_att_event_feed_s.value_original: "My lord, I bear tragic news.\\n\\nI must regretfully inform that our courageous commander, [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(character)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], was slain near #(character.region_and_province). His undoing was at the hands of [[rgba:220:20:60]]#(opponent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] under the command of [[rgba:220:20:60]]#(opponent.primary_general)[[/rgba:220:20:60]]\\n\\nThe exploits of [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(character)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] will be remembered for generations. News of his early passing will be met with sorrow in all corners of our lands.”\\n
event_feed_strings_text_att_event_feed_s.value_translated: «Mi señor, traigo trágicas noticias.\\n\\nLamento informarles que nuestro valiente comandante, [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(character)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], ha sido asesinado cerca de #(character.region_and_province). Su muerte ha sido obra de [[rgba:220:20:60]]#(opponent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] bajo el mando de [[rgba:220:20:60]]#(opponent.primary_general)[[/rgba:220:20:60]].\\n\\nLas hazañas de [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(character)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] serán recordadas durante generaciones. La noticia de su prematura muerte será recibida con tristeza en todos los rincones de nuestras tierras».\\n

event_feed_strings_text_att_event_feed_s.value_original: “Fine news, my lord!\\n\\nIn an act of folly, our enemy [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(character)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], commanding a host of [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(character.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], was slain by our forces in battle. The battle took place near #(character.region_and_province), which shall forever be remembered as the place where that fool met an early grave. May his corpse feed the dogs!\\n\\nOur own forces led by [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(opponent.primary_general)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] are in jubilant celebration over this welcomed news.”\\n
event_feed_strings_text_att_event_feed_s.value_translated: «¡Excelentes noticias, mi señor!\\n\\nEn un acto de locura, nuestro enemigo [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(character)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], al mando de un ejército de [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(character.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], ha sido asesinado por nuestras fuerzas en combate. La batalla tuvo lugar cerca de #(character.region_and_province), que será recordada para siempre como el lugar donde ese necio encontró una muerte prematura. ¡Que su cadáver sirva de alimento a los perros!\\n\\nNuestras propias fuerzas, lideradas por [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(opponent.primary_general)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], están celebrando con júbilo estas buenas noticias».\\n

event_feed_strings_text_att_event_feed_s.value_original: Rumour has it that this man's dedication is wavering. If we are to avoid them opposing our rule, we must ensure that it does not fall any further.
event_feed_strings_text_att_event_feed_s.value_translated: Se rumorea que la dedicación de este hombre está flaqueando. Si queremos evitar que se opongan a nuestro gobierno, debemos asegurarnos de que no decaiga aún más.

event_feed_strings_text_att_event_feed_s.value_original: Our herald has arrived bearing news of our latest battle.\\n\\n"Alas, my lord, victory could not be secured this time.\\n
event_feed_strings_text_att_event_feed_s.value_translated: Nuestro heraldo ha llegado con noticias de nuestra última batalla.\\n\\n«Ay, mi señor, esta vez no hemos podido asegurar la victoria».\\n

event_feed_strings_text_att_event_feed_s.value_original: Our herald has arrived bearing news of our latest battle.\\n\\n"Alas, my lord, our forces have been defeated!\\n
event_feed_strings_text_att_event_feed_s.value_translated: Nuestro heraldo ha llegado con noticias de nuestra última batalla.\\n\\n«¡Ay, mi señor, nuestras fuerzas han sido derrotadas!».\\n

event_feed_strings_text_att_event_feed_s.value_original: Our herald has arrived bearing news of our latest battle.\\n\\n"My lord, we have won a great victory!\\n
event_feed_strings_text_att_event_feed_s.value_translated: Nuestro heraldo ha llegado con noticias de nuestra última batalla.\\n\\n«¡Mi señor, hemos obtenido una gran victoria!».\\n

event_feed_strings_text_att_event_feed_s.value_original: Our noble general, [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(attacker.primary_general)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] commanded our forces valiantly against an enemy host of [[rgba:220:20:60]]#(defender)[[/rgba:220:20:60]] led by [[rgba:220:20:42]]#(defender.primary_general)[[/rgba:220:20:60]] near #(defender.region_and_province)."\\n\\nReports indicate that we have inflicted no less than #(defender_result.primary_participant_casualties) casualties, losses that will surely hurt like a thorn in their side. event_feed_strings_text_att_event_feed_s.value_original: Panic has spread to our settlement from nearby lands. The populace in this settlement have lost their will to take up arms!

event_feed_strings_text_att_event_feed_s.value_original: A Panic Outbreak has occured in our lands. The local populace have lost their resolve amidst an ongoing crisis.

event_feed_strings_text_att_event_feed_s.value_original: Due to our neglectful rule and lack of proper defenses, our enemy has seized the opportunity to plunder and pillage one of our regions. We must act quickly, before more enemies slip through our borders!
event_feed_strings_text_att_event_feed_s.value_translated: Debido a nuestro gobierno negligente y a la falta de defensas adecuadas, nuestro enemigo ha aprovechado la oportunidad para saquear y devastar una de nuestras regiones. ¡Debemos actuar con rapidez, antes de que más enemigos crucen nuestras fronteras!

event_feed_strings_text_att_event_feed_s.value_original: Control in this province has reached critically low levels; if we do not act at once, a hostile incursion force may soon be upon us!
event_feed_strings_text_att_event_feed_s.value_translated: El control en esta provincia ha alcanzado niveles críticamente bajos; si no actuamos de inmediato, ¡una fuerza de incursión hostil podría caer sobre nosotros muy pronto!

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Good news, my lord! Our [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], has been deployed and is actively sowing despair amongst the weak-minded people of your enemy. Not that it would take much effort to discourage them.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Buenas noticias, mi señor! Nuestro [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], ha sido desplegado y está sembrando activamente la desesperación entre las mentes débiles de nuestro enemigo. Aunque no es que cueste mucho esfuerzo desesperarlas.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Unfortunate news, my lord! It appears that a craven agent of our enemy is discouraging our people with his deceptive words.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Malas noticias, mi señor! Parece que un cobarde agente de nuestro enemigo está desanimando a nuestro pueblo con sus palabras engañosas.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Encouraging news, my lord! Our esteemed [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], has sown distrust between the feeble-minded soldiers of [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]]. Rather than settling their disagreement with words as civilised people, sabre-rattling paved the way for ultimate violence, leaving scores of dead enemies!
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Noticias alentadoras, mi señor! Nuestro estimado [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], ha sembrado la desconfianza entre los débiles soldados de [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]]. En lugar de resolver sus desacuerdos con palabras como personas civilizadas, el ruido de sables allanó el camino para la violencia definitiva, ¡dejando decenas de enemigos muertos!

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Unsettling news, my lord! Our force has been duped by a hostile agent, falling victims to lies that there were traitors amongst our ranks. Unfortunately, rogue soldiers acted on the information before it could be verified, leaving many dead and injured.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Noticias inquietantes, mi señor! Nuestra fuerza ha sido engañada por un agente hostil, cayendo víctima de mentiras que afirmaban que había traidores entre nuestras filas. Desafortunadamente, soldados rebeldes actuaron basándose en esa información antes de que pudiera ser verificada, dejando muchos muertos y heridos.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Good news, my lord! Our esteemed [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], has tricked a force belonging to [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] into believing that they are surrounded! Let them enjoy many sleepless nights.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Buenas noticias, mi señor! ¡Nuestro estimado [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], ha engañado a una fuerza perteneciente a [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] haciéndoles creer que están rodeados! Que disfruten de muchas noches de insomnio.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Troubling news, my lord! A hostile agent has demoralised our forces, spreading many false but disheartening tales about the strength of the enemy and the course of the war. Alas, some of our soldiers believe such lies, leaving their morale lower desired.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Noticias preocupantes, mi señor! Un agente hostil ha desmoralizado a nuestras fuerzas, difundiendo muchas historias falsas pero desalentadoras sobre la fuerza del enemigo y el curso de la guerra. Por desgracia, algunos de nuestros soldados creen esas mentiras, lo que hace que su moral esté por debajo de lo deseado.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Good news, my lord! Intercepted by our [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], the target has spilled every secret there is to know of his master! Would that every servant of [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] be as spineless.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Buenas noticias, mi señor! Interceptado por nuestro [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], el objetivo ha revelado todos los secretos que hay que saber sobre su amo. Ojalá todos los sirvientes de [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] fueran tan cobardes.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Unfortunate news, my lord! One of our agents has been intercepted and extorted for information, revealing important knowledge of our whereabouts. Let us hope this blunder is not repeated.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Noticias desafortunadas, mi señor! Uno de nuestros agentes ha sido interceptado y extorsionado por información, revelando información importante sobre nuestro paradero. Esperemos que este error no se repita.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Excellent news, my lord! Our [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], has successfully eliminated the target belonging to [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] without drawing any suspicion to the fact that it was us who ordered the deed!\\n[[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] ought to deploy a more capable servant the next time!\\n
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Excelentes noticias, mi señor! Nuestro [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], ha eliminado con éxito el objetivo perteneciente a [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] sin levantar ninguna sospecha sobre el hecho de que fuimos nosotros quienes ordenamos el acto.\\n[[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] debería desplegar un sirviente más capaz la próxima vez.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Terrible news, my lord! Our subject has been slain, a heinous act by foes that lack any semblance of valour. We will remember [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] as a capable servant.\\n
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Terribles noticias, mi señor! Nuestro súbdito ha sido asesinado, un acto atroz por enemigos que carecen de cualquier atisbo de valor. Recordaremos a [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] como un servidor capaz.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Great news, my lord! Our shrewd [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], has successfully assailed the target belonging to [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]]. Alas, it seems the inflicted wounds were not fatal.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Grandes noticias, mi señor! Nuestro astuto [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], ha asaltado con éxito al objetivo perteneciente a [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]]. Lamentablemente, parece que las heridas infligidas no han sido letales.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Displeasing news, my lord! A malicious murderer sent by our enemy has cowardly assailed our agent while he was unable to defend himself. Luckily, the inflicted wounds were not fatal, and he will soon return to your service eager for vengeance.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Tristes noticias, mi señor! Un malicioso asesino enviado por nuestro enemigo ha atacado cobardemente a nuestro agente mientras él no podía defenderse. Afortunadamente, las heridas infligidas no fueron fatales y pronto regresará a su servicio ansioso por venganza.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Encouraging news, my lord! Our esteemed [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], has cut down a force to size belonging to [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], wiping out a number of its dim-witted patrols. A pity their blades were almost as dull as their minds, lest it could have been the source of an epic!
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Buenas noticias, mi señor! Nuestro estimado [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], ha reducido una fuerza perteneciente a [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], acabando con varias de sus torpes patrullas. Es una pena que sus espadas fueran casi tan romas como sus mentes, ¡pues podrían haber sido el origen de una epopeya!

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Unfortunate news, my lord! Like a concealed viper lashing out against its unknowing prey, some of our forces have fallen victim to an apparently cunning foe. A stroke of luck on their end, no doubt.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Noticias desafortunadas, mi señor! Como una víbora oculta que ataca a su presa sin saberlo, algunas de nuestras fuerzas han caído víctimas de un enemigo aparentemente astuto. Un golpe de suerte en su parte, sin duda.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Good news, my lord! Our [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], has conducted a successful operation to deprive [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] of their petty food reserves. These despicable peasants will certainly struggle to feed themselves and their soldiers at all.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Buenas noticias, mi señor! Nuestro [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], ha llevado a cabo con éxito una operación para privar a [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] de sus escasas reservas de alimentos. Estos despreciables campesinos tendrán sin duda dificultades para alimentarse a sí mismos y a sus soldados.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Disconcerting news, my lord! An unscrupulous agent has snuck into the storages unnoticed and laid waste to our food supplies. Truly a contemptible action, showing the depravity of our foes.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Noticias inquietantes, mi señor! Un agente sin escrúpulos se ha colado en los almacenes sin ser visto y ha devastado nuestras reservas de alimentos. Una acción verdaderamente despreciable, que demuestra la depravación de nuestros enemigos.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Excellent news, my lord! Through spectacular show of cunning and ingenuity, our loyal servant, [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], was able to inflict gaping wounds onto this settlement's walls, decorating them with breaches. The settlement is ripe for the taking, awaiting a final and deadly blow!
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Excelentes noticias, mi señor! Gracias a una espectacular demostración de astucia e ingenio, nuestro leal servidor, [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], ha logrado infligir profundas heridas en las murallas de este asentamiento, decorándolas con brechas. ¡El asentamiento está listo para ser tomado, a la espera de un golpe final y mortal!

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Terrible news, my lord! Our settlement's walls have been breached, no doubt the result of an infiltrator of great cunning! We must repair the breach before our enemies exploit this terrible weakness.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Terribles noticias, mi señor! Las murallas de nuestro asentamiento han sido vulneradas, sin duda el resultado de un infiltrado de gran astucia. Debemos reparar la brecha antes de que nuestros enemigos aprovechen esta terrible debilidad.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Good news my lord! In the darkness of the night, our cunning [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], was able to enter the target settlement undetected... more importantly, before departing, he made sure to set ablaze one of its most prominent structures.\\n
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Buenas noticias, mi señor! En la oscuridad de la noche, nuestro astuto [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], logró entrar en el asentamiento objetivo sin ser detectado... y lo que es más importante, antes de partir, se aseguró de incendiar una de sus estructuras más destacadas.\\n

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Bad tidings, my lord! Over night, a fire has broken out in our settlement and caused great damage, laid by a treacherous agent of our enemy. Ensure the buildings are repaired quickly, so that our people can resume working and trading.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Malas noticias, mi señor! Durante la noche, se ha producido un incendio en nuestro asentamiento que ha causado grandes daños, provocado por un traidor agente de nuestro enemigo. Asegúrese de que los edificios se reparen rápidamente, para que nuestra gente pueda volver al trabajo y al comercio.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Promising news, my lord! Our esteemed [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], has rendered a servant of [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] harmless, at least for a while. We should make good use of this window of opportunity.\\n
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Buenas noticias, mi señor! Nuestro estimado [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], ha neutralizado a un sirviente de [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], al menos por un tiempo. Debemos aprovechar esta oportunidad.\\n

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Alas, my lord! Our subject has been bested by an enemy agent. Though left mostly unscathed, the incident did not occur without wounds to their pride.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Mi señor! Nuestro súbdito ha sido vencido por un agente enemigo. Aunque salió físicamente airoso, el incidente dejó herido su orgullo.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Good tidings, my lord! Our fearsome Dark Rider has struck fear in the hearts of [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]]'s feeble people, indiscriminately killing some of their peasants in the open street. Their wails of terror are music in our ears.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Buenas noticias, mi señor! Nuestro temible Jinete Oscuro ha sembrado el pánico entre la débil población de [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], matando indiscriminadamente a algunos de sus campesinos en plena calle. Sus gritos de terror son música para nuestros oídos.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Nazgûl! A terrifying Dark Rider has appeared in our midst and wantonly attacked peaceful people, leaving many dead and the bystanders horrified. This scourge executes the Dark Lord's every command, and is a blight upon our folk!
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Nazgûl! Un aterrador Jinete Oscuro ha aparecido entre nosotros y ha atacado sin piedad a gente pacífica, dejando muchos muertos y horrorizando a los transeúntes. ¡Este azote ejecuta todas las órdenes del Señor Oscuro y es una lacra para nuestro pueblo!

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Good news, my lord! Our terrifying Dark Rider has demonstrated his power in sorcery by performing an arcane ritual, rousing ghouls and unleashing them upon [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]]! They wreaked havoc in the city, caused great destruction and killed many of the hapless defenders who made a hopeless effort to stop them.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Buenas noticias, mi señor! ¡Nuestro aterrador Jinete Oscuro ha demostrado su poder en la brujería realizando un ritual arcano, despertando a los ghouls y lanzándolos contra [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]]! Causaron estragos en la ciudad, provocaron una gran destrucción y mataron a muchos de los desventurados defensores que hicieron un esfuerzo inútil por detenerlos.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Nazgûl! A horrifying agent of Sauron has employed some sort of foul sorcery, raising a great many of ghouls. Though our garrison has made a valiant effort to stop these creatures of darkness, damage has been caused in the city and alas, some defenders have met their noble end in the attack.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Nazgûl! Un aterrador agente de Sauron ha empleado algún tipo de magia maligna para resucitar a una gran cantidad de ghouls. Aunque nuestra guarnición ha hecho un valiente esfuerzo por detener a estas criaturas de la oscuridad, la ciudad ha sufrido daños y, por desgracia, algunos defensores han encontrado un noble final en el ataque.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Fortunate news, my lord! As expected, our Dark Rider awakens incommensurable fear in [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]]'s cowardly soldiers, who at the mere sight of a Nazgûl wail in despair and throw themselves at the ground. These terrified cowards will surely not be able to hold their ground, should they meet our armies in battle.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Buenas noticias, mi señor! Como era de esperar, nuestro Jinete Oscuro despierta un miedo inconmensurable en los cobardes soldados de [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], que ante la mera visión de un Nazgûl gritan desesperados y se arrojan al suelo. Estos cobardes aterrorizados seguramente no podrán mantener su posición si se enfrentan a nuestros ejércitos en batalla.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Nazgûl! One of these fearsome agents of the Dark Lord has appeared in the midst of our soldiers. Despite their courage and valour, your warriors could not stand such a terrible sight, and have been left trembling with fear. It would be prudent not to send them into battle anytime soon.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Nazgûl! Uno de estos temibles agentes del Señor Oscuro ha aparecido en medio de nuestros soldados. A pesar de su valentía y coraje, tus guerreros no pudieron soportar una visión tan terrible y se han quedado temblando de miedo. Sería prudente no enviarlos a la batalla en un futuro próximo.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Good news, my lord! Our bold [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], has issued a challenge to one of [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]]'s generals. Unsurprisingly, the coward dared not to respond and has thus revealed his inaptitute as a leader in front of this own men, who no longer trust him.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Buenas noticias, mi señor! Nuestro valiente [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], ha lanzado un desafío a uno de los generales de [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]]. Como era de esperar, el cobarde no se atrevió a responder y, por lo tanto, ha revelado su incompetencia como líder ante sus propios hombres, que ya no confían en él.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Troubling news, my lord! An enemy agent has spread a rumour, claiming that our general is a coward for refusing his challenge. This is obviously a bold lie, yet our army now openly questions the aptitude of their leader, whose position is certainly weakened.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Noticias preocupantes, mi señor! Un agente enemigo ha difundido un rumor, afirmando que nuestro general es un cobarde por rechazar su desafío. Obviamente, se trata de una mentira descarada, pero ahora nuestro ejército cuestiona abiertamente la aptitud de su líder, cuya posición se ha visto claramente debilitada.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Excellent news, my lord! Our [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], has successfully eliminated the target belonging to [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] without drawing any suspicion to the fact that it was us who ordered the deed!\\n[[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] ought to deploy a more capable servant the next time!\\n

The inept coward won't be able to carry out any crucial missions, as he obviously lacks the mettle. Should you wish to further harm him, now is the time.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Buenas noticias, mi señor! Nuestro heroico [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], ha humillado a un patético sirviente de [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] en un duelo personal. El cobarde e inepto no podrá llevar a cabo ninguna misión crucial, ya que es obvio que carece del temple necesario. Si desea causarle más daño, ahora es el momento.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Unfortunate news, my lord! Inexplicably, a brutish ruffian in the service of our enemies has beaten one of your agents in a duel, leaving him ashamed and unfit for service. Surely the craven enemy has employed heinous chicanery, else the result would have been different.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Malas noticias, mi señor! Inexplicablemente, un rudo rufián al servicio de nuestros enemigos ha vencido a uno de sus agentes en un duelo, dejándolo avergonzado e incapacitado para el servicio. Sin duda, el cobarde enemigo ha empleado una artimaña atroz, de lo contrario el resultado habría sido diferente.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Great news, my lord! In a cunningly designed stratagem, our [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], fell upon an army of [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] under the cover of darkness. The hapless fools didn't see that coming and paid gravely for it: with casualities and bereft of a good night's sleep, they won't fare well in a pitched battle.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Excelentes noticias, mi señor! En una astuta estratagema, nuestro [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], atacó a un ejército de [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] al amparo de la oscuridad. Los desventurados no lo vieron venir y lo pagaron caro: con bajas y privados de un buen descanso nocturno, no les irá bien en una batalla campal.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Bad tidings, my lord! While they were resting at night, a craven agent of our enemies befell them with strength of arms. Though they quickly mounted a successful defense, some of your fighters were slain in battle, and all of them are deprived of sleep.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Malas noticias, mi señor! Mientras descansaban por la noche, un cobarde agente de nuestros enemigos los atacó con la fuerza de las armas. Aunque rápidamente montaron una defensa exitosa, algunos de sus combatientes murieron en la batalla y todos ellos se vieron privados de sueño.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Good tidings, my lord! Exhibiting utmost swiftness and prowess, our cunning [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], lead a surprise raid against [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]]. Their peasants, unwitting and inept, could do nothing to prevent the plundering and burning of their houses.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Buenas noticias, mi señor! Haciendo gala de una rapidez y destreza sin igual, nuestro astuto [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], lideró una incursión sorpresa contra [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]]. Sus campesinos, desprevenidos e ineficaces, no pudieron hacer nada para impedir el saqueo y el incendio de sus casas.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Unfortunate news, my lord! Word has reached us that a hostile agent fell upon our villages with his barbaric warriors, pillaging and plundering like the savages they are. It would be best to dispose of this henchman swiftly.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Malas noticias, mi señor! Nos ha llegado la noticia de que un agente hostil ha atacado nuestras aldeas con sus bárbaros guerreros, saqueando y devastando como los salvajes que son. Sería mejor deshacerse rápidamente de este secuaz.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Auspicious news, my lord! Our [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], has successfully completed their objectives. Supplies belonging to [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] were destroyed, no doubt a crushing blow to the already fickle morale of those witless worms.\\n
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Buenas noticias, mi señor! Nuestro [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], ha completado con éxito sus objetivos. Los suministros pertenecientes a [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] han sido destruidos, lo que sin duda supone un duro golpe para la ya de por sí inestable moral de esos gusanos estúpidos.\\n

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Worrisome tidings, my lord! We have found some of our army's supply wagons ravaged, depriving our soldiers of much-needed rations and ammunition. There's no doubt that this was an act of a hostile saboteur.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Noticias preocupantes, mi señor! Hemos encontrado algunos de los carros de suministros de nuestro ejército devastados, privando a nuestros soldados de las raciones y municiones que tanto necesitan. No hay duda de que se trata de un acto de sabotaje hostil.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Good news, my lord! A capable arsonist, our [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], was able to enter a city in [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] under a cunning disguise, only to set their crucial edifice ablaze, as commanded by you. Taken aback, the dim-witted bystanders only watched while the fire ravaged the building.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Buenas noticias, mi señor! Un hábil pirómano, nuestro [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], logró entrar en una ciudad de [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] bajo un astuto disfraz, solo para incendiar su edificio más importante, tal y como usted ordenó. Sorprendidos, los atontados transeúntes se limitaron a observar cómo el fuego devastaba el edificio.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Unsettling news, my lord! As it appears, a destructive fiend in your enemy's service has laid fire to our majestic building unnoticed. Our brave and courageous citizens rushed by immediately, but could only extinguish the fire after some damage was done.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Noticias inquietantes, mi señor! Al parecer, un demonio destructivo al servicio de vuestro enemigo ha incendiado nuestro majestuoso edificio sin que nadie se diera cuenta. Nuestros valientes y valerosos ciudadanos acudieron inmediatamente, pero solo pudieron extinguir el fuego después de que se produjeran algunos daños.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Good news, my lord! Our esteemed [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], has rendered a servant of [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] harmless, at least for a while. We should make good use of this window of opportunity.\\n
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Buenas noticias, mi señor! Nuestro estimado [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], ha neutralizado a un sirviente de [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], al menos por un tiempo. Debemos aprovechar esta oportunidad.\\n

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Alas, my lord! Our subject has been bested by an enemy agent. Though left mostly unscathed, the incident did not occur without wounds to their pride.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Mi señor! Nuestro súbdito ha sido vencido por un agente enemigo. Aunque salió físicamente airoso, el incidente dejó herido su orgullo.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Excellent news, my lord! Our [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], has successfully eliminated the target belonging to [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] without drawing any suspicion to the fact that it was us who ordered the deed!\\n[[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] ought to deploy a more capable servant the next time!\\n
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Excelentes noticias, mi señor! Nuestro [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], ha eliminado con éxito el objetivo perteneciente a [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] sin levantar ninguna sospecha sobre el hecho de que fuimos nosotros quienes ordenamos el acto.\\n[[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] debería desplegar un sirviente más capaz la próxima vez.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Terrible news, my lord! Our subject has been slain, a heinous act by foes that lack any semblance of valour. We will remember [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] as a capable servant.\\n
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Terribles noticias, mi señor! Nuestro súbdito ha sido asesinado, un acto atroz por enemigos que carecen de cualquier atisbo de valor. Recordaremos a [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] como un servidor capaz.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Great news, my lord! Our shrewd [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], has successfully assailed the target belonging to [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]]. Alas, it seems the inflicted wounds were not fatal.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Grandes noticias, mi señor! Nuestro astuto [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], ha asaltado con éxito al objetivo perteneciente a [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]]. Lamentablemente, parece que las heridas infligidas no han sido letales.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Displeasing news, my lord! A malicious murderer sent by our enemy has cowardly assailed our agent while he was unable to defend himself. Luckily, the inflicted wounds were not fatal, and he will soon return to your service eager for vengeance.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Tristes noticias, mi señor! Un malicioso asesino enviado por nuestro enemigo ha atacado cobardemente a nuestro agente mientras él no podía defenderse. Afortunadamente, las heridas infligidas no fueron fatales y pronto regresará a su servicio ansioso por venganza.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Great news, my lord! A crooked officer of [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] has easily taken the bribes of our sublime [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], who arranged a most cunning deal: In exchange for some worthless gems, the officer commanded his troops to greatly delay their march.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Grandes noticias, mi señor! Un oficial corrupto de [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] ha aceptado fácilmente los sobornos de nuestro sublime [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], quien ha organizado un trato muy astuto: a cambio de unas gemas sin valor, el oficial ordenó a sus tropas retrasar enormemente su marcha.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Unfortunate news, my lord! Even though our people are known for their integrity, there has been a sad exception: an officer, after having advocated to slow your army's march, was found to have been bribed by an enemy agent.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Malas noticias, mi señor! Aunque nuestro pueblo es conocido por su integridad, ha habido una triste excepción: un oficial, que tras haber abogado por ralentizar la marcha de su ejército, se descubrió que haía sido sobornado por un agente enemigo.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Encouraging tidings, my lord! Our apt [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], has approached soldiers of [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] under false pretenses and promised them in secret great rewards, should they leave their lord's service. They were over-eager to do so - again proving how fickle your enemy's people are.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Buenas noticias, mi señor! Nuestro agente [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], se ha acercado a los soldados de [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] con falsas promesas y les ha ofrecido en secreto grandes recompensas si abandonan el servicio de su señor. Estaban más que dispuestos a hacerlo, lo que demuestra una vez más lo volubles que son los súbditos de vuestro enemigo.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Disconcerting tidings, my lord! Due to a nefarious scheme of an enemy agent, some of our less confidable soldiers have decided to desert and leave their posts, being promised a great many riches in turn. Truly a shame that such despicable people were amongst your ranks, so good riddance to them.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Noticias inquietantes, mi señor! Debido al malvado plan de un agente enemigo, algunos de nuestros soldados menos confiables han decidido desertar y abandonar sus puestos, a cambio de lo cual se les ha prometido grandes riquezas. Es una verdadera lástima que hubiera personas tan despreciables entre sus filas, así que mejor que se hayan ido.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Good news, my lord! Being a well-versed and prudent instigator, our [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] held a captivating sermon amongst the irresolute peasants of [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], cunningly corrupting them to believe in our superior cause.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Buenas noticias, mi señor! Siendo un instigador versado y prudente, nuestro [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] pronunció un cautivador sermón entre los indecisos campesinos de [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], corrompiéndolos astutamente para que creyeran en nuestra causa superior.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Bad news, my lord! A deplorable rabble-rouser and hatemonger, no doubt in the service of your enemy, has corrupted the hearts of some of our people by foul means, resulting in their change of alignment.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Malas noticias, mi señor! Un deplorable agitador y sembrador de odio, sin duda al servicio de vuestro enemigo, ha corrompido los corazones de algunos de nuestros súbditos mediante medios deshonestos, lo que ha provocado un cambio en su lealtad.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Good news, my lord! Intercepted by our [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], the target has spilled every secret there is to know of his master! Would that every servant of [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] be as spineless.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Buenas noticias, mi señor! Interceptado por nuestro [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], el objetivo ha revelado todos los secretos que hay que saber sobre su amo. Ojalá todos los sirvientes de [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] fueran tan cobardes.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Unfortunate news, my lord! One of our agents has been intercepted and extorted for information, revealing important knowledge of our whereabouts. Let us hope this blunder is not repeated.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Noticias desafortunadas, mi señor! Uno de nuestros agentes ha sido interceptado y extorsionado por información, revelando información importante sobre nuestro paradero. Esperemos que este error no se repita.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Splendid news, my lord! With but a few subtle assertions and well-placed threats, our [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] was able to effortlessly secure the allegiance of #(target), who defected from [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] and pledged himself to your cause. If only all your enemy's servants were so easily swayed, there would be no necessity for fighting.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Excelentes noticias, mi señor! Con solo unas sutiles afirmaciones y amenazas bien colocadas, nuestro [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] ha conseguido sin esfuerzo la lealtad de #(target), quien ha desertado de [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] y se ha comprometido con vuestra causa. Si todos los sirvientes de vuestros enemigos fueran tan fáciles de convencer, no habría necesidad de luchar.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Ill news, my lord! It seems there was a contemtibly weak-minded agent in your service, who now pledges allegiance to your enemy after conversing with one of their crooked agents. Who knows what terrible threats it took to coerce him.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Malas noticias, mi señor! Parece que había un agente despreciable y de mente débil a su servicio, que ahora ha jurado lealtad a su enemigo tras conversar con uno de sus agentes corruptos. Quién sabe qué terribles amenazas se necesitaron para coaccionarlo.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Good tidings, my lord! Our wise [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], has manipulated #(target), a servant of [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], with subtle lies and harsh threats, discouraging him from serving his overlord. Thus, the target is left unable to act.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Buenas noticias, mi señor! Nuestro sabio [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], ha manipulado a #(target), un sirviente de [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], con sutiles mentiras y duras amenazas, disuadiéndole de servir a su señor. Así, el objetivo se ha quedado incapacitado por un tiempo.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Unfortunate tidings, my lord! Our loyal subject was confronted by a crooked enemy servant, seeking to coerce him into deserting. Of course, the attempt was futile, as our wise agent is not easily influenced by such subversive methods. Nevertheless, he is left unable to act for a while.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Malas noticias, mi señor! Nuestro leal súbdito se enfrentó a un siervo enemigo corrupto, que intentó coaccionarlo para que desertara. Por supuesto, el intento fue en vano, ya que nuestro sabio agente no se deja influir fácilmente por métodos tan subversivos. No obstante, se ha quedado incapacitado para actuar durante un tiempo.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Good news, my lord! Proving once more that the civil servants of [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] are utter imbeciles, they accepted a subtly-written proposal connived by our most prudent [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]]. Our agents should have no difficulty doing what you wish in their city - use this to our advantage.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Buenas noticias, mi señor! Demostrando una vez más que los funcionarios públicos de [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] son unos completos imbéciles, han aceptado una propuesta sutilmente redactada y urdida por nuestro más prudente [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]]. Nuestros agentes no deberían tener ninguna dificultad para hacer lo que usted desea en su ciudad; aprovechemos esto en nuestro beneficio.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Troubling news, my lord! Being a deceitful and perfidious man, an enemy agent has swayed our authorities to accept a dishonest proposal, undermining the security of your settlement.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Noticias preocupantes, mi señor! Siendo un hombre engañoso y pérfido, un agente enemigo ha convencido a nuestras autoridades para que acepten una propuesta deshonesta, lo que socava la seguridad de su asentamiento.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Auspicious news, my lord! Often the people of [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] boast their boldness, yet at the guileful words of our [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], they trembled in terror: having been prophesied their utter defeat in battle, a great fear has taken hold of their hearts.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Buenas noticias, mi señor! A menudo, el pueblo de [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]] se jacta de su audacia, pero ante las astutas palabras de nuestro [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], temblaron de terror: tras haberse profetizado su derrota total en la batalla, un gran temor se ha apoderado de sus corazones.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Bad news, my lord! Obviously lacking mettle and aptitude in open battle, your enemy now resorts to psychological warfare, having sent an agent to demoralize your soldiers. Alas, some warriors have taken heed of the craven agent's words, lowering their morale, albeit only temporarily.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Malas noticias, mi señor! Al carecer evidentemente de valor y aptitud en la batalla abierta, vuestro enemigo recurre ahora a la guerra psicológica, enviando a un agente para desmoralizar a vuestros soldados. Por desgracia, algunos guerreros han prestado atención a las palabras del cobarde agente, lo que ha minado su moral, aunque solo sea temporalmente.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Good tidings, my lord! With his cunning and crafty methods, our sly [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent.type)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(agent)[[/rgba:218:165:32]], has exerted pressure on the dignitaries of [[rgba:218:165:32]]#(target.faction)[[/rgba:218:165:32]]'s settlement to embezzle tax income and withhold funding the ongoing building projects. event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Bad tidings, my lord! An anonymous confession has reached us: local dignitaries were gravely threatened by a guileful enemy agent to disturb administrative processes in the region. Our ongoing construction will take longer to finish after this malevolent intervention. Who knows what dark and twisted things it took to coerce our most honorable men.
event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_translated: ¡Malas noticias, mi señor! Nos ha llegado una confesión anónima: unos dignatarios locales han sido gravemente amenazados por un astuto agente enemigo para perturbar los procesos administrativos de la región. Nuestra construcción en curso tardará más en completarse tras esta intervención maliciosa. Quién sabe qué cosas oscuras y retorcidas se necesitaron para coaccionar a nuestros hombres más honorables.

event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Good news, my lord! event_feed_strings_text_rom_event_feed_s.value_original: Disquieting news, my lord! One of our agents has been intercepted and extorted for information, revealing important knowledge of our whereabouts. Let us hope this blunder is not repeated.
