Able-bodied woodsmen such as these foresters often venture deeper into the dense forest for hunting scouting. The axe and light leather armour befits such a lifestyle and makes these swift and useful missile warriors.
unit_description_short_texts_text_av_gre.value_translated: Reclutados entre la pequeña población de hombres del bosque que viven en los límites occidentales del Bosque Negro. Los hombres del bosque de buen cuerpo como estos forestales a menudo se adentran en el denso bosque para cazar como exploradores. El hacha y la armadura ligera de cuero se adaptan a este estilo de vida y los convierten en rápidos y útiles guerreros de proyectiles.

unit_description_short_texts_text_av_gre.value_original: Recruited from the small population of Woodsmen living on the western edges of Mirkwood. Bravest and hardiest of the woodsmen are often deployed to explore beyond the vicinity of their homesteads, keeping an eye on the deepest areas of the woodland. As such, these trackers are excellent survivallers, marksmen and stealth soldiers.
unit_description_short_texts_text_av_gre.value_translated: Reclutados entre la pequeña población de hombres del bosque que viven en los límites occidentales del Bosque Negro. Los más valientes y duros de los hombres del bosque suelen ser desplegados para explorar más allá de las inmediaciones de sus hogares, vigilando las zonas más profundas del bosque. Como tales, estos rastreadores son excelentes supervivientes, tiradores y soldados sigilosos.

unit_description_short_texts_text_av_pas.value_original: Military forces recruited from the large Northmen populations living in Rhovanion west of Mirkwood. Charged with keeping open the dangerous and orc-infested passes of the Misty Mountains, these men are hardied warriors equipped with proper armour and a weapon capable of cutting down any creature.
unit_description_short_texts_text_av_pas.value_translated: Fuerzas militares reclutadas entre las grandes poblaciones norteñas que viven en Rhovanion, al oeste del Bosque Negro. Encargados de mantener abiertos los peligrosos pasos infestados de orcos de las Montañas Nubladas, estos hombres son guerreros aguerridos equipados con armaduras adecuadas y un arma capaz de abatir a cualquier criatura.

unit_description_short_texts_text_av_sto.value_original: Stoor hobbits from the foothills of the Misty Mountians. Equipped with typical hobbit clothing and with a javelin and small dagger.
unit_description_short_texts_text_av_sto.value_translated: Hobbits fuertes de las estribaciones de las Montañas Nubladas. Equipados con ropas típicas hobbit y con una jabalina y una daga pequeña.

unit_description_short_texts_text_av_val.value_original: Military forces recruited from the large Northmen populations living in Rhovanion west of Mirkwood. All-round unit with offensive capabilities and armed with a relatively large square shield to off-set their light armour.
unit_description_short_texts_text_av_val.value_translated: Fuerzas militares reclutadas entre las grandes poblaciones de hombres del norte que viven en Rhovanion, al oeste del Bosque Negro. Unidad polivalente con capacidad ofensiva y armada con un escudo cuadrado relativamente grande para compensar su armadura ligera.

unit_description_short_texts_text_av_val.value_original: Military forces recruited from the large Northmen populations living in Rhovanion west of Mirkwood. Capable defensive unit with a rectangle shield, spear and light armour.
unit_description_short_texts_text_av_val.value_translated: Fuerzas militares reclutadas entre las grandes poblaciones de hombres del norte que viven en Rhovanion, al oeste del Bosque Negro. Unidad defensiva capaz con escudo rectangular, lanza y armadura ligera.

unit_description_short_texts_text_av_val.value_original: Military forces recruited from the large Northmen populations living in Rhovanion west of Mirkwood. As traditional among the Northmen, the longbow is a commonly-featuring weapon throughout the vale and befits a lifestyle pivotting around nature. Also equipped with a very small shield on the lower left arm.
unit_description_short_texts_text_av_val.value_translated: Fuerzas militares reclutadas entre las grandes poblaciones de hombres del norte que viven en Rhovanion, al oeste del Bosque Negro. Como es tradicional entre los hombres del norte, el arco largo es un arma de uso común en todo el valle y corresponde a un estilo de vida que gira en torno a la naturaleza. También va equipado con un escudo muy pequeño en la parte inferior del brazo izquierdo.

unit_description_short_texts_text_av_val.value_original: Militias recruited from the large Northmen populations living in Rhovanion west of Mirkwood. Equipped with a simple hunting bow and a sword, providing for a cheap ranged option.
unit_description_short_texts_text_av_val.value_translated: Milicias reclutadas entre las grandes poblaciones norteñas que viven en Rhovanion, al oeste del Bosque Negro. Equipados con un sencillo arco de caza y una espada, lo que les proporciona una opción a distancia barata.

unit_description_short_texts_text_av_val.value_original: Militias recruited from the large Northmen populations living in Rhovanion west of Mirkwood. Poorly-trained, unarmoured but cheap defensive unit.
unit_description_short_texts_text_av_val.value_translated: Milicias reclutadas entre las grandes poblaciones norteñas que viven en Rhovanion, al oeste del Bosque Negro. Unidad defensiva poco entrenada y sin armadura, pero barata.

unit_description_short_texts_text_av_woo.value_original: Recruited from the small population of Woodsmen living on the western edges of Mirkwood. Used to a lifestyle of hunting and woodland living, these are hardened axemen but with little military training and armour.
unit_description_short_texts_text_av_woo.value_translated: Reclutados entre la pequeña población de hombres del bosque que viven en los límites occidentales del Bosque Negro. Acostumbrados a un estilo de vida de supervivencia y caza en el bosque, son hacheros curtidos pero con escaso entrenamiento militar y armadura.

unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_ba.value_original: High-born Variags ride to war under the banner of their chieftain. Men of admirable skill with the axe, Bane of the Steppes are peerless horsemen.
unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_ba.value_translated: Los Variags de alta cuna cabalgan a la guerra bajo el estandarte de su jefe. Hombres de admirable habilidad con el hacha, los azotes de las estepas son jinetes sin igual.

unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_cl.value_original: Speed, agility, versitality and a ferocious nature, make these men more than simple peasants
unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_cl.value_translated: Velocidad, agilidad, versatilidad y un carácter feroz, hacen de estos hombres algo más que simples campesinos.

unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_cl.value_original: Tough and ferocious warriors, these men form a solid wall from which their spears can rove, seeking weakness in the enemy lines.
unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_cl.value_translated: Duros y feroces guerreros, estos hombres forman una sólida muralla desde la que sus lanzas pueden recorrer en busca de puntos débiles en las líneas enemigas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_cl.value_original: Harsh conditions make for harsh residents. A hunter's life in the lands of Rhûn gives these troops basic archery skill and a more than average endurance
unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_cl.value_translated: Las duras condiciones hacen que sus residentes sean duros. La vida de cazador en las tierras de Rhûn proporciona a estas tropas una habilidad básica para el tiro con arco y una resistencia superior a la media.

unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_cl.value_original: The vast plains of Rhûn are home to many a raider, ready to take up the call to defend their homes, and pillage the homes of their enemies.
unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_cl.value_translated: Las vastas llanuras de Rhûn son el hogar de muchos incursores, dispuestos a acudir a la llamada para defender sus hogares y saquear los de sus enemigos.

unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_cl.value_original: Given a spear and a decent shield, these men make sure they will hold their line for as long as they can
unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_cl.value_translated: Con una lanza y un escudo decente, estos hombres se aseguran de mantener la línea todo el tiempo que puedan.

unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_fe.value_original: A folk of hunters, the marksmanship of the Feredrim surpasses all other clans, and their Rangers choose light armour to maintain mobility.
A folk of hunters, the Feredrim can levy excellent spear-throwers to rain death upon enemies, then disappear in the bushes.

unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_ha.value_original: Well-trained infantrymen wielding one-handed maces make up the frontline of the Haerrim forces.
Being mounted allows these shielded Haerrim warriors to quickly fall upon the flanks of their enemies.

unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_kh.value_original: Lord Khahàr is known all throughout Rhûn for his ambition and his prowess with spear and sword. His Rhûrim have vowed to follow him until the entire East is conquered, for Sauron.
unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_kh.value_translated: El señor Khahár es conocido en todo Rhûn por su ambición y su destreza con la lanza y la espada. Sus rhûrim han jurado seguirle hasta conquistar todo el este, para Sauron.

unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_kh.value_original: Renowned mounted archers, the men of Khand carry powerful composite bows, the design of which has been perfected by centuries of steppe warfare.
unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_kh.value_translated: Renombrados arqueros a caballo, los hombres de Khand portan poderosos arcos compuestos, cuyo diseño ha sido perfeccionado por siglos de guerra esteparia.

unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_kh.value_original: These men are the grunts of Khand, who are either unable to afford a horse or simply too old to serve on the frontline. While they are normally relegated to second-line duties, their decent skill with javelins and scimitars make them an enemy to be reckoned with, especially under a capable commander.
unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_kh.value_translated: Estos hombres son los soldados rasos de Khand, que o bien no pueden permitirse un caballo o simplemente son demasiado viejos para servir en primera línea. Aunque normalmente están relegados a tareas de segunda línea, su decente destreza con las jabalinas y las cimitarras los convierte en un enemigo a tener en cuenta, especialmente bajo un comandante capaz.

unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_kh.value_original: Heir to the Rhûrim throne, Khavàr is one of the best riders of the steppes. His guards are as loyal to him as they are deadly to his enemies.

unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_lo.value_original: And behold the Fire of the Dragon in its wrath, a terrifying storm, enveloping all that would stand in its way!
unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_lo.value_translated: ¡Y he aquí el fuego del dragón en su ira, una tormenta aterradora, envolviendo todo lo que se interponga en su camino!

unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_lo.value_original: And behold the Wings of the Dragon in their wrath, a terrifying storm, a rumbling malice bringing death!
unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_lo.value_translated: Y he aquí las alas del dragón en su ira, una tormenta aterradora, una malicia retumbante que trae la muerte.

unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_lo.value_original: And behold the Fang of the Dragon in its wrath, a terrifying storm, crushing all that would stand in its way!
unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_lo.value_translated: ¡Y he aquí el colmillo del dragón en su ira, una tormenta aterradora, aplastando todo lo que se interponga en su camino!

unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_lo.value_original: And behold the Skin of the Dragon in its wrath, a terrifying storm, enveloping all that would stand in its way!
unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_lo.value_translated: ¡Y he aquí la Piel del Dragón en su ira, una tormenta aterradora, envolviendo todo lo que se interponga en su camino!

unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_lo.value_original: And behold the Fire of the Dragon in its wrath, a terrifying storm, striking all that would stand in its way!
unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_lo.value_translated: ¡Y he aquí el fuego del dragón en su ira, una tormenta aterradora, envolviendo todo lo que se interponga en su camino!

unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_lo.value_original: And behold the Wings of the Dragon in their wrath, a terrifying storm, a rumbling malice bringing death!
unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_lo.value_translated: Y he aquí las alas del dragón en su ira, una tormenta aterradora, una malicia retumbante que trae la muerte.

unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_lo.value_original: And behold the Fang of the Dragon in its wrath, a terrifying storm, crushing all that would stand in its way!
unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_lo.value_translated: ¡Y he aquí el colmillo del dragón en su ira, una tormenta aterradora, aplastando todo lo que se interponga en su camino!

unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_lo.value_original: And behold the Skin of the Dragon in its wrath, a terrifying storm, enveloping all that would stand in its way!
unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_lo.value_translated: ¡Y he aquí la piel del dragón en su ira, una tormenta aterradora, envolviendo todo lo que se interponga en su camino!

unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_no.value_original: The nobles of the Balchoth prefer swords over less civilized weapons, and don golden armour and fine shields when they march to war.

unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_ra.value_original: Forsaking a cumbersome shield, the strength of raiders lies in their shocking impact, swiftly cleaving through enemies with their scimitars.

unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_rh.value_original: The Composite bow wielded by an Easterling warrior is sure to serve his master well in battle
unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_rh.value_translated: El arco compuesto que empuña un guerrero oriental servirá a su amo en la batalla.

unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_rh.value_original: Raiders of Rhûn: once they have visited you, you will indeed pay attention to them next time!
unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_rh.value_translated: Incursores de Rhûn: una vez que te hayan visitado, ¡la próxima vez sí que les prestarás atención!

unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_rh.value_original: The lords of Rhûn march to war with companies of disciplined infantry wearing red-stained heavy armour, fierce in attack and stalwart in defence.
unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_rh.value_translated: Los señores de Rhûn marchan a la guerra con compañías de infantería disciplinada que llevan armaduras pesadas teñidas de rojo, feroces en el ataque e incondicionales en la defensa.

unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_rh.value_original: Easterling Warriors with more wit and cunning than one might suspect. Beware them on the field of battle!
unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_rh.value_translated: Guerreros orientales con más ingenio y astucia de lo que uno podría sospechar. ¡Ten cuidado con ellos en el campo de batalla!

unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_sp.value_original: Their heavy armour, tight discipline and keen spears make these Balchoth an excellent defensive force.
Like a dragon's breath, these light weapons spit forth piercing projectiles, deadly to both man and beast.

unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_va.value_original: Skilled Variag bowmen armed with shield and composite bows. Very dangerous in the missile exchange, yet also capable in close combat.
unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_va.value_translated: Hábiles arqueros Variag armados con escudo y arcos compuestos. Muy peligrosos en el intercambio de proyectiles.

unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_va.value_original: For centuries have the elite cavalrymen of Khand brought great victories to the war-chiefs the steppes, trampling the land of the West under their hooves.
unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_va.value_translated: Durante siglos, la caballería de élite de Khand ha brindado grandes victorias a los jefes guerreros de las estepas, pisoteando la tierra de occidente bajo sus pezuñas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_va.value_original: Elite armoured axemen in the service of Khandish chiefs, often found in the vanguard of a host. Even should the battle go ill the Variag Warriors can be expected to fight on until the last strength leaves their arms and the last breath is bellowed from their chests.
unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_va.value_translated: Hacheros acorazados de élite al servicio de los jefes khandinos, a menudo en la vanguardia de una hueste. Incluso si la batalla se tuerce, cabe esperar que los guerreros Variag sigan luchando hasta que las últimas fuerzas abandonen sus brazos y el último aliento salga de sus pechos.

unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_wa.value_original: The chariots of the ancient wainrider people, steered by the most affluent chieftains.
unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_wa.value_translated: Los carros de los antiguos aurigas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_bal_wa.value_original: While the heavy chariots are reserved for the wealthiest, the sons of lesser nobles are trained in skirmishing from light chariots.

unit_description_short_texts_text_c_anfa.value_original: Gathered from the villages of Anfalas, these men possess little equipment or training but a fierce will to protect their homeland.
Gathered from the villages of Anfalas, these men possess little equipment or training but a fierce will to protect their homeland.

unit_description_short_texts_text_c_blac.value_original: Putting their skill as hunters to good use, these men from the Blackroot Vale were levied as archers, albeit without much military training.
Without much military training, these men were raised in the Blackroot Vale to act as a defensive force in dire circumstances.

unit_description_short_texts_text_c_dol_.value_original: These disciplined guardsmen of Dol Amroth are trained to protect the Prince's land against any foes.
To spot corsairs raiding along the coast and swiftly deliver messages, these men are mounted on swift horses without heavy armour.
When the coasts of Dol Amroth are threatened and its forces spread thin, common villagers don the Prince's livery and defend their home with spears.

unit_description_short_texts_text_c_dwar.value_original: Dwarves who have lost their halls to swarms of goblins and wander the lands in search of a new home.

unit_description_short_texts_text_c_east.value_original: Whatever lies or threats have led them on the long march from their home, they would really rather have stayed there in peace.
Spear-fishers from the Sea of Rhun, knowing little of war but willing to throw their spears at the enemy.

unit_description_short_texts_text_c_ithi.value_original: Driven from the once bountiful lands of Ithilien by the raiders of Minas Morgul, these people fight not to defend their home, but for their very lives.

unit_description_short_texts_text_c_lame.value_original: Light infantry armed with spears that hold the southern and sloping regions of Gondor against the Southron assaults, levied in times of need.
Light infantry armed with swords that hold the southern and sloping regions of Gondor against the Southron assaults, levied in times of need.

unit_description_short_texts_text_c_lebe.value_original: Hardy fishermen and hunters from fair Lebennin of the Five Streams, serving as barely trained but light-footed skirmishers.
To protect the walls of Pelargir and maintain order in its busy harbour, brave men of Lebennin are trained as guards.

unit_description_short_texts_text_c_loss.value_original: Farmers from the orchards of Lossarnach, levied under dire circumstances. Familiar with axes as tools of their craft, they turn them into deadly weapons on the battlefield.
Farmers from the orchards of Lossarnach, levied under dire circumstances. They may not be trained well, but are brave enough to face the enemy nonetheless.

unit_description_short_texts_text_c_nom_.value_original: Not much is known about the nomadic people hailing from the far South. Likely former hunters turned into an archer unit, these men are unprotected in close combat.
Not much is known about the nomadic people hailing from the far South. Their raiders are barely armoured, yet armed with cruel scimitars.
Not much is known about the nomadic people hailing from the far South. These men are equipped with light shields and spears to ward off enemy cavalry.
Not much is known about the nomadic people hailing from the far South. These men are equipped with light shields and swords, making up the main infantry line.
Not much is known about the nomadic people hailing from the far South. They move through the desert to strike swift as a snake, not hindered by any armour.

unit_description_short_texts_text_c_nort.value_original: Men and women tending to the fields of Rhovanion, raising their farming tools in a desparate attempt to hold off their murderous enemies.
Spear-fishers from the Celduin and its tributaries, knowing little of war but willing to throw their spears at the enemy.
Knowing their way around horses thanks to their profession, these people ride out in the hour of utmost need to defend their herds. Sending them against experienced foes will end in a bloodbath.
Lumberjacks who work in the forests of Rhovanion, having no military experience or equipment save their trusty axes.

unit_description_short_texts_text_c_orc_.value_original: Orcs who either disappointed their chieftain or were simply too weak end up as Snagas (slaves) at the very bottom of Mordor's food chain.

Orcs who either disappointed their chieftain or were simply too weak end up as Snagas (slaves) at the very bottom of Mordor's food chain. These ones were commanded to chop down trees with crude axes, which can serve as weapons, too.

unit_description_short_texts_text_c_pinn.value_original: Hailing from the Green Hills and dressed in that colour, these spearmen are levied in times of dire need.
Hailing from the Green Hills and dressed in that colour, these swordsmen are levied in times of dire need.

unit_description_short_texts_text_c_ring.value_original: Villagers and hillmen from the Vale of Ringló tasked to protect Gondor in its darkest hour. They will do their best to deliver deadly volleys, but lack training and experience.
Villagers and hillmen from the Vale of Ringló tasked to protect Gondor in its darkest hour. They will do their best to hold the line, but lack training and experience.

unit_description_short_texts_text_c_slav.value_original: These Overseers relish in whipping Snagas while driving them to their deplorable jobs. Any who fall behind are eaten by the Wargs.

unit_description_short_texts_text_c_sout.value_original: Spear-fishers from nameless rivers of Harad, knowing little of war but willing to throw their spears at the enemy.

unit_description_short_texts_text_c_trib.value_original: Poor farmers tending fields amidst forsaken lands of the wilderness, knowing little of war and using their tools to defend themselves.
Spear-fishers from nameless streams in the wilderness, knowing little of war but willing to throw their spears at the enemy.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dale_a.value_original: The aim of the hidden Avari is still as true as that of the Eldar, but not as exposed to or expected by evil!
unit_description_short_texts_text_dale_a.value_translated: El objetivo de los Avari ocultos sigue siendo tan verdadero como el de los Eldar, ¡pero no tan expuesto al mal ni tan esperado por él!

unit_description_short_texts_text_dale_b.value_original: May the followers of Morgoth Bauglir be driven back to their wicked holes from whence they came by the arrows of the Bardings!
unit_description_short_texts_text_dale_b.value_translated: ¡Que los seguidores de Morgoth Bauglir sean devueltos a sus malvados agujeros de donde vinieron por las flechas de los Bárdidos!

unit_description_short_texts_text_dale_b.value_original: Heralding the strength of Girion of Old, King Brand hopes to lead his people to prosperity and peace. The threat from the East stands between him and a bright future for Dale.
unit_description_short_texts_text_dale_b.value_translated: Portando la fuerza de su ancestro Girion, el rey Brand espera llevar a su gente a la prosperidad y la paz. La amenaza del este se encuentra entre él y un futuro brillante para Valle.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dale_c.value_original: The heritage of the Northmen cavalry lives on in the new city-regiments. They are well-armoured horsemen in tradition of the ancient Éothéod.
unit_description_short_texts_text_dale_c.value_translated: Durante mucho tiempo se han perdido los reinos de los jinetes, ¡pero no así los propios jinetes!

unit_description_short_texts_text_dale_l.value_original: The Guards of the Lake protect the people of Laketown against the many perils that come with the rising Eastern sun.
unit_description_short_texts_text_dale_l.value_translated: Los guardias del lago protegen a los habitantes de Ciudad del Lago de los numerosos peligros que acompañan a la salida del sol del Este.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dale_m.value_original: Despite ruin and death, the tradition of the Marksmen of Dale has never been abandoned and once more their bows shall harm all of Darkness.
unit_description_short_texts_text_dale_m.value_translated: A pesar de la ruina y la muerte, la tradición de los tiradores de Valle nunca se ha abandonado y una vez más sus arcos dañarán toda la Oscuridad.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dale_m.value_original: These guardians of trade are the very guardians of the wealth of Dale itself.
unit_description_short_texts_text_dale_m.value_translated: Estos guardianes del comercio son los mismísimos guardianes de la riqueza del propio Valle.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dale_n.value_original: Scouts are as vital to the Northmen as bread is for the commoners. For who else could know what troubles lie beyond wood and wasteland?
unit_description_short_texts_text_dale_n.value_translated: Los exploradores son tan vitales para los norteños como el pan lo es para los plebeyos, quién si no podría saber qué problemas se esconden más allá del bosque y el páramo.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dale_r.value_original: The Rhovanion Rangers patrol beyond the frontier with utmost stealth and skill. You will be dead before you notice them.
unit_description_short_texts_text_dale_r.value_translated: Los montaraces de Rhovanion patrullan más allá de la frontera con sumo sigilo y habilidad. Estarás muerto antes de que te des cuenta de su presencia.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dale_r.value_original: May the Knights of Rhovanion embody once more the unified strength that opposes the forces of evil!
unit_description_short_texts_text_dale_r.value_translated: ¡Que los caballeros de Rhovanion encarnen una vez más la fuerza unificada que se opone a las fuerzas del mal!

unit_description_short_texts_text_dale_r.value_original: Those with hope for a rebuilt kingdom will guard their homes as a dragon guards his plunder.
unit_description_short_texts_text_dale_r.value_translated: Aquellos con esperanzas de un reino reconstruido guardarán sus hogares como un dragón guarda su botín.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dale_s.value_original: Despite many dangers, these men will go out on trading missions for the good of the Kingdom and protect their goods with their lives.
unit_description_short_texts_text_dale_s.value_translated: A pesar de los muchos peligros, estos hombres saldrán en misiones comerciales por el bien del reino y protegerán sus bienes con sus vidas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dale_s.value_original: Should all hope be abandoned, the fishermen, the merchants and the farmers will remember the valour of their ancestors, and they will stand firm to equal the great deeds of yore.
unit_description_short_texts_text_dale_s.value_translated: A menudo, cuando ya no quedan guardias ni soldados, las milicias dan su vida por la causa y por ello hay que alabarlas y valorarlas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dale_s.value_original: None will either tempt or conquer the might of Dale when these spear-men guard it!
unit_description_short_texts_text_dale_s.value_translated: ¡Nadie tentará ni conquistará el poder de Valle mientras estos lanceros lo protejan!

unit_description_short_texts_text_dale_s.value_original: Dalian Swordsmen deliver heavy blows to their ill-disciplined mannish and orcish enemies. They will not see Dale turned once more into ashes.
unit_description_short_texts_text_dale_s.value_translated: Las espadas de los hombres de Valle asestan duros golpes a todos los enemigos. No verán a Valle convertido una vez más en cenizas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dale_v.value_original: The fine lands of Dorwinion make for fine men to defend it.
unit_description_short_texts_text_dale_v.value_translated: Las buenas tierras de Dorwinion requieren buenos hombres para defenderlas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dale_v.value_original: The fine lands of Dorwinion make for fine men to defend it.
unit_description_short_texts_text_dale_v.value_translated: Las buenas tierras de Dorwinion requieren buenos hombres para defenderlas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dale_v.value_original: Men who defend the vineyards so keenly it could be thought that they were born in them.
unit_description_short_texts_text_dale_v.value_translated: Hombres que defienden los viñedos con tanto ahínco que podría pensarse que han nacido en ellos.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dale_v.value_original: From the bushes spring the Yardpatrollers, as if they were Silvan Elves!
unit_description_short_texts_text_dale_v.value_translated: De los arbustos surgen los patrulleros, ¡como si fueran elfos silvanos!

unit_description_short_texts_text_dale_w.value_original: Never dismiss a watchful eye: such is the key to preventing the Dragon of the East from surprising the unknowing Dalians.
unit_description_short_texts_text_dale_w.value_translated: Nunca hay que descuidar la vigilancia: ésa es la clave para evitar que el Dragón de Oriente sorprenda a los ignorantes de Valle.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dale_y.value_original: The honor and memory of a bowman's ancestors ever guides the shot of his longbow.
unit_description_short_texts_text_dale_y.value_translated: El honor y la memoria de los antepasados de un arquero guían siempre el disparo de su arco largo.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dg_chi.value_original: While lesser Orcs may flee, the champions of Dol Guldur revel in the savagery of combat, for they are the most feared amongst their repulsive kin.
unit_description_short_texts_text_dg_chi.value_translated: Mientras que los orcos a veces huyen, los campeones de Dol Guldur se deleitan en el salvajismo del combate, pues son los más temidos entre su repulsiva parentela.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dg_gul.value_original: Guldur Blades are eager for war and cruelly effective in many roles as their numbers and excellent equipment make them dangerous to even a well-trained elf.
unit_description_short_texts_text_dg_gul.value_translated: Los espadachines de Guldur están ansiosos por la guerra y son cruelmente eficaces en muchas funciones, ya que su número y su excelente equipo los hacen peligrosos incluso para un elfo bien entrenado.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dg_gul.value_original: The lack of a shield is rarely a hindrance to these uruks since their glaives provide sufficient protection against any foe, whether mounted or on foot.
unit_description_short_texts_text_dg_gul.value_translated: La falta de escudo rara vez es un obstáculo para estos uruks, ya que sus glaives proporcionan protección suficiente contra cualquier enemigo, ya sea montado o a pie.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dg_gul.value_original: Elite troops wielding a menacing pike, these uruks present an impenetrable wall of death to their foes.
unit_description_short_texts_text_dg_gul.value_translated: Tropas de élite que blanden una amenazadora pica, estos uruks presentan un impenetrable muro de muerte a sus enemigos.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dg_kha.value_original: Even his own folk quail at the sight of the Shadow of the East, personally leading Sauron's legions forth from Dol Guldur.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dg_mir.value_original: Small and sneaky, the Raiders are expected to to close with the enemy and deliver volleys into their ranks, an extremely dangerous task that more often than not is intended to only distract the enemy while the main Dol Guldur army manoeuver into position.
unit_description_short_texts_text_dg_mir.value_translated: Pequeños y sigilosos, se espera que los incursores se acerquen al enemigo y lancen andanadas contra sus filas, una tarea extremadamente peligrosa que la mayoría de las veces sólo pretende distraer al enemigo mientras el ejército principal de Dol Guldur maniobra hasta su posición.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dg_mir.value_original: These are the very weakest of Orcs and their skill with the bow is doubtful at best, but with a large enough volley of arrows some are bound to find their marks.
unit_description_short_texts_text_dg_mir.value_translated: Estos son los orcos más débiles y su habilidad con el arco es dudosa en el mejor de los casos, pero pueden lanzar una andanada de flechas lo suficientemente grande para que alguna, con suerte, de al objetivo.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dg_pha.value_original: Phantoms are cursed creatures kept from their eternal rest by dark sorcery, but unlike higher forms of undead they are only instilled with a very limited form of intelligence and kept under weaker spells.
unit_description_short_texts_text_dg_pha.value_translated: Los fantasmas son criaturas malditas a las que la brujería oscura mantiene alejadas de su descanso eterno, pero a diferencia de las formas superiores de no-muertos, sólo se les infunde una forma muy limitada de inteligencia y se les mantiene bajo hechizos más débiles.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dg_ser.value_original: High men of Numenor brought low by black sorcery. Cruel and twisted servants of evil, yet with great strength.
unit_description_short_texts_text_dg_ser.value_translated: Altos hombres de Númenor abatidos por la brujería negra. Crueles y retorcidos sirvientes del mal, pero con gran fuerza.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dg_spi.value_original: The numerous offspring of Shelob, having infested the regions of Mirkwood, possess a cruel intelligence making them far more dangerous than any ordinary beast.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dg_wra.value_original: Wraiths are cursed souls deprived of their final rest either through the shackles of dark magic or their own utterly dishonourable life.
unit_description_short_texts_text_dg_wra.value_translated: Los espectros son almas malditas privadas de su descanso final, ya sea por los grilletes de la magia oscura o por su propia vida totalmente deshonrosa.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dun_ar.value_original: No wise man ignores the chance to kill an enemy who is beyond sword-reach.
unit_description_short_texts_text_dun_ar.value_translated: Ningún hombre sabio ignora la oportunidad de matar a un enemigo que está más allá del alcance de su espada.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dun_ax.value_original: Summoned under a ban of their warlord, these axemen are not savages but professional warriors with their discipline and equipment rivalling that of the Northmen.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dun_bl.value_original: Driven by oaths and glory, these men and their crude clubs are terrible enemies to face.
unit_description_short_texts_text_dun_bl.value_translated: Impulsados por los juramentos y la gloria, estos hombres y sus toscos garrotes son terribles enemigos a los que enfrentarse.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dun_ch.value_original: Revered by the Dunlendings, Chosens are law unto themselves, uncontrollable and overwhelming.
unit_description_short_texts_text_dun_ch.value_translated: Venerados por los dunledinos, los elegidos son la ley personificada, incontrolables y abrumadores.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dun_el.value_original: Broken enemies know it is better to flee than face riders who will not spare their lives.
unit_description_short_texts_text_dun_el.value_translated: Los enemigos rotos saben que es mejor huir que enfrentarse a jinetes que no les perdonarán la vida.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dun_el.value_original: Age does not chill a warrior's heart, or still his lust for battle.
unit_description_short_texts_text_dun_el.value_translated: La edad no enfría el corazón de un guerrero ni apaga su ansia de batalla.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dun_hi.value_original: Drawn from the most loyal vassals of a tribal warlord, these men guard their hilltop hall with an impenetrable shield-wall.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dun_ho.value_original: If these vicious wolves do not tear a man limb from limb, which rarely happens, the handlers are ready to pick up the slack.
unit_description_short_texts_text_dun_ho.value_translated: Si estos lobos despiadados no desgarran a un hombre miembro por miembro, lo que rara vez ocurre, los adiestradores están preparados para recoger el testigo.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dun_hu.value_original: Wearing coats of mail and helms of steel, men of the Dunhird appreciate better than many Dunlendings the value of good order and discipline.
unit_description_short_texts_text_dun_hu.value_translated: Ataviados con cotas de malla y yelmos de acero, los hombres de Dunhird aprecian mejor que muchos dunledinos el valor del buen orden y la disciplina.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dun_or.value_original: Hired by Saruman to guard the secrets of Orthanc against Rohan, these once simple tribal warriors were provided with deadly pikes, heavy armour and the discipline to stand against a cavalry charge.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dun_pi.value_original: Instructed by a wise ally of the Dunlendings, these men have learned to stand in formation and let the Rohirrim spear themselves on Dunland's pikes.
These experienced, high-status warriors will not flinch from a fight, making them fearsome battlefield opponents.
unit_description_short_texts_text_dun_pi.value_translated: Estos experimentados guerreros de alto estatus no se acobardan en la lucha, lo que los convierte en temibles oponentes en el campo de batalla.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dun_ra.value_original: The arrows of these men should not be underestimated; nor should the swords they wear at their sides.
unit_description_short_texts_text_dun_ra.value_translated: No hay que subestimar las flechas de estos hombres, ni las espadas que llevan a los lados.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dun_sl.value_original: Stones are found everywhere, with no need for a fletcher and supply trains. With a simple sling and some practice, they are no less deadly than arrows!

unit_description_short_texts_text_dun_tr.value_original: There is little difference in hunting animals or men to these raiders. Enough axes and arrows will do the trick.
unit_description_short_texts_text_dun_tr.value_translated: Animales u hombres, con suficientes flechas todo se puede matar.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dun_tr.value_original: A Dunlending is at his fiercest when he stands to defend what belongs to his people.
unit_description_short_texts_text_dun_tr.value_translated: Un dunledino es más feroz cuando defiende lo que pertenece a su pueblo.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dun_tr.value_original: With an axe in the right place at the right time, even the lowliest tribesmen can bring down even the greatest of warriors.
unit_description_short_texts_text_dun_tr.value_translated: Con un hacha en el lugar adecuado y en el momento oportuno, hasta el miembro más humilde de una tribu puede derribar al más grande de los guerreros.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dun_tr.value_original: Even the youngest of the tribe can fight in its name, harassing slower, heavier enemy units.
unit_description_short_texts_text_dun_tr.value_translated: Incluso los más jóvenes de la tribu pueden luchar en su nombre, hostigando a las unidades enemigas más lentas y pesadas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dun_wa.value_original: Seen as an unhonourable weapon, crossbows are not commonly used in tribal warfare, but a certain ally has encouraged tribesmen to use them against their mounted and armoured enemies.
The combination of advanced weapons and intrinsic savagery is devastating, allowing these warriors to sever bodily extremities with frightening ease.
unit_description_short_texts_text_dun_wa.value_translated: La combinación de armas avanzadas y salvajismo intrínseco es devastadora, lo que permite a estos guerreros seccionar extremidades corporales con una facilidad aterradora.

unit_description_short_texts_text_dun_wa.value_original: Champions are not born, but aspirants must purchase the title with enemy lives.
unit_description_short_texts_text_dun_wa.value_translated: Los campeones no nacen, sino que los aspirantes deben comprar el título con vidas enemigas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_ax.value_original: The inner halls of Dwarven mansions are guarded by these veterans of the Goblin-wars. Their heavy armour does not make them any less capable of quickly hewing off limbs and heads!
Hardy Dwarves carry large throwing axes which they hurl with devastating effect against their foes.
unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_ax.value_translated: Los duros enanos llevan grandes hachas arrojadizas que lanzan con efecto devastador contra sus enemigos.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_ax.value_original: Grim-faced, iron-shod, plate-clad warriors from Erebor, the Axe Warriors go into battle carrying a heavy ornated axe with their right hand and a round shield slung on their left.
unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_ax.value_translated: Los guerreros con hachas, guerreros de Erebor con rostro sombrío, herrados y vestidos de placas, entran en batalla portando una pesada hacha ornamentada con la mano derecha y un escudo redondo colgado de la izquierda.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_ax.value_original: There is no other weapon so often associated with the Dwarves as the axe. These mighty weapons require the skill few in Middle-Earth possess to be wielded effectively.
unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_ax.value_translated: No hay otra arma que se asocie tan a menudo con los enanos como el hacha. Estas poderosas armas requieren la habilidad que pocos poseen en la Tierra Media para ser blandidas con eficacia.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_ba.value_original: The oldest and wisest of the Dwarves that took on the Quest of Erebor, Balin seeks now to reclaim the lost mansions of Khazad-dûm for his King.
unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_ba.value_translated: «A través de profundas mazmorras y viejas cavernas, la gente de Durin caza a sus enemigos y aplasta el mal de las profundidades.»

unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_ba.value_original: Built by noble and experienced craftsmen, the great siege weapons of the dwarves can crumble all defences.
unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_ba.value_translated: Construidas por nobles y experimentados artesanos, las grandes armas de asedio de los enanos pueden derrumbar todas las defensas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_ba.value_original: With plated armour, a shield and an axe, these warriors are one of the finest offensive and yet versatile infantry available in Middle-Earth.
unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_ba.value_translated: Con armadura chapada, escudo y hacha, estos guerreros son una de las mejores infanterías ofensivas y versátiles disponibles en la Tierra Media.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_cr.value_original: Strong and far reaching crossbows crafted with great skill are wielded by trained and armoured dwarven soldiers.
unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_cr.value_translated: Los soldados enanos entrenados y acorazados blanden ballestas fuertes y de gran alcance fabricadas con gran habilidad.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_dw.value_original: These are the Dwarves that venture far and wide together with the travellers.
unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_dw.value_translated: Estos son los enanos que se aventuran a lo largo y ancho del mundo junto con los viajeros.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_dw.value_original: When an enemy comes near them, they will try to shoot it with their bows, and if that fails, they will jump out of the scrub and rid themselves of their foe.
unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_dw.value_translated: Cuando se les acerque un enemigo, intentarán dispararle con sus arcos y, si eso falla, saltarán fuera de los matorrales y se librarán de su enemigo.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_dw.value_original: Though the axe or hammer are more common weapons of Dwarven infantry, spears are exceptionally useful against larger enemies and their mounts or beasts.

All Dwarves are natural warriors. They are tough, battle-hardened and stubborn. Many have experienced the harsh nature of warfare, but have never grown tired of it when war served a cause they would follow.
unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_dw.value_translated: Todos los enanos son guerreros por naturaleza. Son duros, aguerridos y testarudos. Muchos han experimentado la dura naturaleza de la guerra, pero nunca se han cansado de ella cuando la guerra servía a una causa que querían seguir.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_er.value_original: Their chainmail, plated armour and Dwarven axes can withstand the greatest of dragons, and their distinctive masks, the greatest of fires.
unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_er.value_translated: Sus cotas de malla, armaduras chapadas y hachas artesanales enanas pueden resistir al mayor de los dragones, y sus distintivas máscaras, al mayor de los fuegos.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_gi.value_original: Certainty of death? Little chance of success? What are we waiting for?

unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_gl.value_original: Member of the Quest of Erebor and old enough to remember the Battle of Azanulbizar, Glóin has since become a renowned and wealthy Dwarven lord.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_ha.value_original: For their lord, they will march to war. For the preservation of their mansions, they will hold their line unless a drake should come again from the north.
unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_ha.value_translated: Por su señor, aguantarán y empujarán. Por la preservación de sus mansiones, mantendrán su línea a menos que un dragón venga de nuevo desde el norte.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_ir.value_original: A true defensive line, the Iron Guard march to the fray wielding iron battle shields and terrible spears.
unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_ir.value_translated: Verdadera línea defensiva, la Guardia de Hierro marcha hacia la trifulca blandiendo escudos de batalla de hierro y terribles lanzas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_ir.value_original: The Bows of the Elves sing, but to the Dwarves there is no music like the percussion of their mattocks!
unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_ir.value_translated: Los arcos de los elfos cantan, ¡pero para los enanos no hay música como la percusión de sus azadas!

unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_ma.value_original: Through dungeons deep and caverns old, the Folk of Dúrin hunt down their enemies and vanquish foul evil from the Deep'
unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_ma.value_translated: «A través de profundas mazmorras y viejas cavernas, la gente de Durin caza a sus enemigos y aplasta el mal de las profundidades.»

unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_ma.value_original: The fearsome warriors from the Iron Hills fight in the service of King Dáin and provide his arms with a formidable battalion of swift shock infantry.
unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_ma.value_translated: Los temibles guerreros de las Colinas de Hierro luchan al servicio del rey Dáin y proporcionan a sus ejércitos un formidable batallón de veloz infantería de choque.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_me.value_original: These guards of Dalian merchants are recruited for a pretty price to accompany Dwarven armies and alleviate their distinct lack of cavalry forces.
unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_me.value_translated: Estos guardianes del comercio son los mismísimos guardianes de la riqueza del propio Valle.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_mi.value_original: Fighting with pickaxes, these Dwarves are sturdier and better armoured than most infantry levies. Still, they are no professional soldiers, and their stubbornness will only take them so far.
unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_mi.value_translated: Estos hombres luchan con azadas y son bastante numerosos, robustos y mejor blindados que la mayoría de las levas de infantería.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_or.value_original: Strong ranged unit, armed with a powerful composite bow from the Red Mountains
unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_or.value_translated: Fuerte unidad a distancia, armada con un poderoso arco compuesto de las Montañas Rojas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_or.value_original: Hammer-wielding Dwarves in service of Erebor, recruited from their eastern kin.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_so.value_original: As iron hewn from the walls of the hills so are foes hewn from their ranks by the mighty Sons of the Mountain
unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_so.value_translated: «Como el hierro tallado en las paredes de las colinas, así son despachados los enemigos por los poderosos Hijos de la Montaña»

unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_sp.value_original: Elite and veteran warriors from the line of Durin wielding fine dwarven plate armor and ferocious spears.
unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_sp.value_translated: Guerreros de élite y veteranos de la línea de Durin que empuñan finas armaduras de placas enanas y feroces lanzas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_th.value_original: Prince of Erebor and heir to Dáin Ironfoot, Thorin III Stonehelm has not only the name, but also the military prowess of Thorin Oakenshield.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_to.value_original: To all that seek to defy the Tomb of Dúrin the Deathless, there will be the wrath of its fierce wardens'
unit_description_short_texts_text_ere_to.value_translated: «A todos los que intenten desafiar la tumba de Durin el Inmortal, les llegará la ira de sus feroces guardianes.»

unit_description_short_texts_text_gob_ch.value_original: Taller, stronger and better armoured, these orcs are specifically hand-picked to follow the Goblin-King and protect him in battle.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gob_ch.value_translated: Más altos, más fuertes y mejor blindados, estos orcos son elegidos específicamente para seguir al rey trasgo y protegerle en la batalla.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gob_go.value_original: It's a wonder that these goblins managed to craft some blades and piece together some armour. Still, their shields and helmets protect them surprisingly well.
It's easier to make way for a Chief with a big and rusty cleave, rather than with words and grunts.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gob_go.value_translated: Es más fácil abrir paso a un jefe con una gran y oxidada hendidura, que con palabras y gruñidos.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gob_go.value_original: What's better than a goblin archer? A hundred goblin archers with heavy armour.
A crown forged in betrayal and ruthlessness, the Goblin-King rules the Orcish strongholds of the Misty Mountains with an iron fist.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gob_go.value_translated: Con una corona forjada en la traición y la crueldad, el rey trasgo gobierna con puño de hierro los bastiones orcos de las Montañas Nubladas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gob_go.value_original: Masses of goblins clad in leather and armed with a rusty sharp piece of metal, hoping to prey on light enemy units and catch them unprepared.
Their strength lies in their numbers. And in how long their Dwarven rusty scraps will last.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gob_go.value_translated: Su fuerza reside en su número. Y en cuánto durarán sus chatarras enanas oxidadas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gob_go.value_original: A spear is easy to craft and great for warding off larger enemies, which is why these armoured goblins can hold the line while others sneak around the flanks.
This band of gnarly goblins has crafted shields by reinforcing planks with sharp metal corners, protecting them somewhat in battle.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gob_mo.value_original: Whips and lashes! Grunts and screams! All fine instruments to stir the goblins to war and do the Dark Lord's bidding.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gob_mo.value_translated: ¡Látigos y azotes! ¡Gruñidos y gritos! Todos buenos instrumentos para incitar a los trasgos a la guerra y cumplir las órdenes del Señor Oscuro.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gob_mo.value_original: These goblins need nothing more than a salvaged helmet and a crude glaive to charge their enemies head-on.
These light-footed goblins make sure none make it through the Misty Mountains unnoticed.
Gigantic, strong and cruel, wielding large clubs capable of sending their enemies flying. Though Trolls are not particularly smart, their thick skin makes them hard to kill.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gob_mo.value_translated: «¡Rígida como la piedra es la carne y el hueso de un troll que se sienta en las colinas, solo!»

unit_description_short_texts_text_gob_ni.value_original: These goblins skulk to battle whilst adorned in scavenged gear. The Moon bears witness to their cunning ruthlessness.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gob_ni.value_translated: Estos trasgos se escabullen a la batalla ataviados con equipo carroñero. La luna es testigo de su astucia y crueldad.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gob_sc.value_original: Resourceful goblins make use of anything they can find, including these Dwarven crossbows left behind in underground storerooms.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gob_sn.value_original: Lowly goblins too weak or afraid to charge Dwarven shieldwalls head-on, they throw their crude spears in the vague direction of the enemy and retreat back to the shadows.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gob_un.value_original: Patrolling the deep pits under the Misty Mountains, these goblins are tasked with protecting their hoards from men or beasts alike.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gob_un.value_translated: Patrullando las profundas fosas bajo las Montañas Nubladas, estos trasgos tienen la misión de proteger a sus hordas de hombres y bestias.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gob_wa.value_original: Goblins are happy to send out packs of Wargs to feast on their enemies. That means they don't have to risk losing an arm when feeding them.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_an.value_original: Local watch and patrol keep safe the long beaches of Anfalas against intruders from oversea.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_an.value_translated: La vigilancia y las patrullas locales mantienen seguras las largas playas de Anfalas frente a intrusos de ultramar.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_an.value_original: Common men of Anórien who bring their own horses to battle, having been briefly trained in light cavalry and scouting tactics.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_ar.value_original: Keen may the arrows of Númenor's sons fly against the forces of shadow.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_ar.value_translated: Que las flechas de los hijos de Númenor vuelen afiladas contra las fuerzas de la sombra.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_bl.value_original: The marksmanship of the men of the Morthond Vale is an unmistakeable asset in defence of Gondor.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_bl.value_translated: La puntería de los hombres del valle de Morthond es una baza inconfundible en la defensa de Gondor.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_bo.value_original: Heir of the House of Stewards and High Warden of the Kingdom of Gondor even in its darkest hours.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_bo.value_translated: Heredero de la casa de los Senescales y alto custodio del reino de Gondor incluso en sus horas más oscuras.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_bo.value_original: Whether trained by a professional or learned from a father, skill with a bow is an equitable prowess.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_bo.value_translated: Ya sea entrenado por un profesional o aprendido de un padre, la habilidad con el arco es una proeza equitativa.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_bo.value_original: Their well-made bows and honed marksmanship make these armoured bowmen a deadly force, recalling the splendour of Númenor.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_ca.value_original: Though known for their heavy infantry, Gondor also fields mounted spearmen, an invaluable asset against the horsemen from East and South.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_ca.value_translated: Hacia el filo sombrío del horizonte y la noche estrellada.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_ca.value_original: The cavalry of Gondor charge eagerly into the ranks of any enemy when the horn of Gondor calls.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_ci.value_original: "Fealty with love, valour with honour." Sworn to this oath, the Citadel Guard proudly defend the heart of Minas Tirith against whatever darkness may come.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_ci.value_translated: Lealtad con amor, valor con honor.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_de.value_original: Tall, valiant and more kingly than any man that had appeared in Gondor for many generations, Denethor is a masterful lord, holding the best interests of his people in his heart.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_de.value_translated: Alto, valiente y más rey que cualquier otro hombre que hubiera aparecido en Gondor durante muchas generaciones, Denethor es un señor magistral, que lleva en su corazón los mejores intereses de su pueblo.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_fa.value_original: Son of the Steward, standing in defiance of the Dark Lord and harbouring unwavering loyalty to the White City.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_fa.value_translated: Hijo del Senescal, desafíando al Señor Oscuro y guardando una lealtad inquebrantable a la Ciudad Blanca.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_fo.value_original: The winged helmets of the Fountain Guards defend the White Tree, whether it is blooming or not.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_fo.value_translated: Los cascos alados de los guardias de la fuente defienden el Árbol Blanco hasta el retorno del rey..

unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_hi.value_original: With particular audacity do the Men of Lamedon guard Gondor's bountiful heartlands.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_hi.value_translated: Con especial audacia, los hombres de Lamedon vigilan las abundantes tierras de Gondor.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_ho.value_original: The cavalry of Gondor charge eagerly into the ranks of any enemy when the horn of Gondor calls.
The cavalry of Gondor charge eagerly into the ranks of any enemy when the horn of Gondor calls.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_im.value_original: Prince of Dol Amroth, with blood of the Firstborn running through his veins and instilling the glory of the elder days in others.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_im.value_translated: Príncipe de Dol Amroth, con sangre de los Primogénitos corriendo por sus venas e inculcando la gloria de los días más antiguos a los demás.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_it.value_original: These men do not love the arrow for its swiftness. They love that which it defends.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_it.value_translated: Estos hombres no aman la flecha por su rapidez. Aman lo que defiende.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_lo.value_original: Axemen of the Vale of Flowers, facing the brutality of war in Gondor's name.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_lo.value_translated: Hacheros del valle de las flores, enfrentándose a la brutalidad de la guerra en nombre de Gondor.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_na.value_original: Picked men of Pelargir and Gondor, the guards of the admiral will undoubtedly be the last and most determined line of defence if a naval battle sours.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_na.value_translated: Hombres escogidos de Pelargir y Gondor, los guardias del almirante serán sin duda la última y más decidida línea de defensa si una batalla naval se tuerce.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_na.value_original: While the Prince's marines are trained for ramming tactics, their discipline and hardiness also allows them to withstand any foe in melee combat.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_na.value_translated: Aunque los marines del Príncipe están entrenados para tácticas de embestida, su disciplina y dureza también les permiten resistir a cualquier enemigo en combate cuerpo a cuerpo.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_na.value_original: The Prince's knights do not only glitter on the field of battle, but also among the waves as an intimidating honourguard.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_na.value_translated: Los caballeros del Príncipe no sólo brillan en el campo de batalla, sino también entre las olas como una intimidante guardia de honor.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_on.value_original: Simple yet effective catapults, used in sieges all across Middle-earth.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_on.value_translated: Cargad. Apuntad. Disparad. A ver si hay suerte.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_pe.value_original: Soldiers of the ancient Faithful city of Pelargir, experts in warfare on land and sea alike.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_pe.value_translated: Soldados de la antigua ciudad fiel de Pelargir, expertos en la guerra tanto en tierra como en mar.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_pi.value_original: Sentinels of the lush, green fields of the Pinnath Gelin, these spearmen are a reliable watch of territory.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_pi.value_translated: Centinelas de los exuberantes y verdes campos de Pinnath Gelin, estos lanceros son una vigilancia fiable del territorio.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_pr.value_original: Foot soldiers proudly defending the coasts of Belfalas against any threat.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_pr.value_translated: Soldados de infantería que defienden las orgullosas costas de Belfalas contra cualquier amenaza.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_pr.value_original: Disciples of valour and chivalry, proudly bearing the sigil of their knightly brethren.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_pr.value_translated: Discípulos del valor y la caballerosidad, portan con orgullo el emblema de sus hermanos caballeros.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_ri.value_original: The Men of the Ringló Vale take up arms at their lord's behest in the name of the White Tree.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_ri.value_translated: Los hombres del valle del Ringló toman las armas a instancias de su señor en nombre del Árbol Blanco.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_si.value_original: The glittering charge of the Knights of Dol Amroth shall rid the lands of Gondor from all darkness!
unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_si.value_translated: ¡La brillante carga de los Caballeros de Dol Amroth liberará las tierras de Gondor de toda oscuridad!

unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_sp.value_original: You are soldiers of Gondor, no matter what comes through that gate, you will stand your ground!
unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_sp.value_translated: ¡Sois soldados de Gondor! ¡No importa lo que atraviese esa puerta, permaneced en el puesto!

unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_sp.value_original: Common men but noble of heart, for they have the valour to defy the Dark Lord's legions in arms for people and country.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_sp.value_translated: La nobleza es el valor para desafiar a las legiones del Señor Oscuro en armas por el pueblo y la patria.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_sp.value_original: Well-trained and disciplined spearmen, their armour and weapons as well as their undying courage will hold the line against the beasts of Mordor.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_st.value_original: The Dome of Stars is guarded by these sturdy pikemen who carry the Star of Osgiliath with them to all ends of Middle-Earth.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_st.value_translated: El domo de las estrellas está custodiada por estos robustos piqueros que llevan consigo la Estrella de Osgiliath a todos los confines de la Tierra Media.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_su.value_original: This barrel replenishes the ammunition of all nearby units.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_su.value_translated: Este barril repone la munición de todas las unidades cercanas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_su.value_original: This wagon replenishes the ammunition of all nearby units.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_su.value_translated: Este vagón repone la munición de todas las unidades cercanas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_sw.value_original: Bulwark of the defences of the Free Peoples, among the finest soldiers of Men.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_sw.value_translated: Baluarte de las defensas de los Pueblos Libres, entre los mejores soldados de los hombres.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_sw.value_original: Not trained nor heavily armoured, and though all the lands be engulfed in darkness, courage to resist sprouts from the heart of these men.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_sw.value_translated: Aunque todas las tierras estén sumidas en la oscuridad, el valor para resistir brota del corazón.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_sw.value_original: The swordsmen of Gondor will break many an Orc's neck ere their own lines can be broken.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_tr.value_original: Common men of Anórien who bring their own horses to battle, having been briefly trained in light cavalry and scouting tactics.
Brave men who gained archery skills in peace-time that reinforce the armies of Gondor, after receiving some military training.
Though not professional soldiers, these men have been given spears and decent armour, and were trained to fight in formation.
Though not professional soldiers, these men have been given swords and decent armour, and were trained to fight in formation.
The pinnacle of engineering, mightily mounting the bastions of the West.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_tr.value_translated: El pináculo de la ingeniería, montando poderosamente los bastiones de occidente.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_tr.value_original: The knowledge to build advanced siege weapons has survived in the archives of Minas Tirith. They hurl heavy rocks further and more precise than any ordinary catapult.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_wa.value_original: A new dawn for Men, a new hope for Gondor, a new era for the Steward.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gon_wa.value_translated: Un nuevo amanecer para los hombres, una nueva esperanza para Gondor, una nueva era para el Senescal.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gondor.value_original: The 'Swan Wing' is the Prince's own vessel on the high waters of Belegaer, and has never been in a lost battle.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gondor.value_translated: El «Ala de Cisne» es el propio navío del Príncipe en las aguas profundas del Belegaer, y nunca ha estado en una batalla perdida.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gondor.value_original: Powerful ramming ship that is nigh unstoppable as it cleaves through its target with the pride and fury of Dol Amroth.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gondor.value_translated: Poderosa nave de embestida casi imparable que atraviesa su objetivo con el orgullo y la furia de Dol Amroth.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gondor.value_original: A light ship carrying a repeating ballista meant to function as the ultimate definition of 'hit-and-run' tactics.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gondor.value_translated: Una nave ligera que transporta una ballesta de repetición destinada a funcionar como la forma definitiva de las tácticas de «golpear y huir».

unit_description_short_texts_text_gondor.value_original: Learning the secrets of fire from years of fighting the corsairs, Gondor has equipped light strike vessels with firepots.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gondor.value_translated: Aprendiendo los secretos del fuego tras años de lucha contra los corsarios, Gondor ha equipado naves de ataque ligeras con ollas de fuego.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gondor.value_original: A versatile ship armed with a repeating ballista that can discharge volleys and disengage in a moment's notice.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gondor.value_translated: Una nave versátil armada con una ballesta de repetición que puede descargar salvas y retirarse en un momento.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gondor.value_original: A medium melee ship capable of intercepting and engaging enemies before they reach more vulnerable targets.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gondor.value_translated: Una nave media de combate de cercanía capaz de interceptar y atacar a los enemigos antes de que alcancen objetivos más vulnerables.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gondor.value_original: A medium missile ship that can harrass enemies or stoke the fire, literally.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gondor.value_translated: Una nave de proyectiles mediana que puede hostigar a los enemigos o avivar el fuego, literalmente.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gondor.value_original: A medium ramming ship that is designed for quick, maneuverable incisions into enemy ranks.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gondor.value_translated: Una nave de embestida media diseñada para penetrar con rapidez y maniobrabilidad en las filas enemigas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gondor.value_original: The 'Respect' is a formidable flagship, defended by Gondor's elite. It is a fool's errand to engage it without adequate preparations.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gondor.value_translated: El «Respeto» es un formidable buque insignia, defendido por la élite de Gondor. Es una tontería enfrentarse a él sin los preparativos adecuados.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gondor.value_original: A towered heavy warship with a crew complement able to tie down any foe on the sea.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gondor.value_translated: Un buque de guerra pesado con una tripulación capaz de mantener a raya a cualquier enemigo en el mar.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gondor.value_original: A towered heavy warship that is meant to engage enemies at a distance, pinning them down under a shower of arrows.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gondor.value_translated: Una nave de guerra pesada con torreón, destinada a enfrentarse a enemigos a distancia, inmovilizándolos bajo una lluvia de flechas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gondor.value_original: The pride of Gondor's engineers on display in the high seas, the massive rocks it hurls is a danger to all wooden ships.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gondor.value_translated: El orgullo de los ingenieros de Gondor exhibido en alta mar, las enormes rocas que lanza son un peligro para todos los barcos de madera.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gun_ar.value_original: Both Warg and rider armoured in black plate, to withstand the arrows of the Valesmen.
With sharp spears and tough armour, these Warg-riders are a dangerous match for heavy cavalry.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gun_ba.value_original: Souls of dark men fallen in wars of the Second Age, corrupted and twisted, now unleashed to haunt the living of Middle-Earth.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gun_be.value_original: These berserkers possess no sense of organisation or coherence, but each individual will fight madly to their death.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gun_be.value_translated: Una unidad de asaltantes completamente desorganizada, pero individualmente, ¡difícilmente igualada en terror!

unit_description_short_texts_text_gun_ci.value_original: Recalling the terrifying splendour of Carn Dûm, the capital of fallen Angmar, their keen spears and red shields will hold the line at any cost.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gun_go.value_original: Masses of goblins clad in leather and armed with a rusty sharp piece of metal, hoping to prey on light enemy units. Their chiefs have struck some kind of deal to have them fight for Gundabad.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gun_he.value_original: Heavy armour and a sharp-edged shield protect these Orcs well when they cleave their way through enemy ranks.
Properly armed and armoured by the forges of Gundabad, marching in formation and pointing a thicket of halberds at their enemies.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gun_ni.value_original: The dark makes these Night Hunters come alive, moving unseen to scout enemy positions and harass them from afar.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gun_or.value_original: These Marauders are driven by ancient hatred that they above all want to bloody their axes, heedless of their lack of protection.
A numerous, ragged band of orcs somewhat capable of defending their position with shields and spears.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gun_re.value_original: Through ice and thunder roaring, from desolate peaks and sharpened cliffs, the Reavers come down from Gundabad. Crude axes they swing, but none can hear a sound. The mountain passes are being watched.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gun_re.value_translated: A través del hielo y el rugido del trueno, desde picos desolados y acantilados afilados, los segadores descienden de Gundabad. Blanden toscas hachas, pero nadie puede oír un sonido. Los pasos de montaña están siendo vigilados.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gun_rh.value_original: Few foul men now populate the region of Rhudaur. Hillmen mercenaries, who prefer to fight for the Orcs of Gundabad rather than defend their own people from evil.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gun_rh.value_translated: Pocos hombres viles pueblan ahora la región de Rhudaur. Hombres de las colinas mercenarios que prefieren luchar para los orcos de Gundabad antes que defender a su propio pueblo del Mal.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gun_st.value_original: Cruel and relentless orcs, clad only in light armour, to chase down any lost souls who dared to venture forth to their mountains.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gun_to.value_original: No Dwarven tomb is safe from these hulking yet brutal Tomb Raiders, smashing even the heaviest armour with their powerful swings.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gun_tr.value_original: Specialised ranging Mountain Orcs that traverse the wild tundras to the north of Middle-Earth and its cold climes, wild territories and harsh mountain.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gun_tr.value_translated: Orcos de montaña de rango especializado que recorren las salvajes tundras del norte de la Tierra Media y sus fríos climas, territorios salvajes y duras montañas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gun_tu.value_original: No one cared to train or properly arm this rabble summoned forth from the tunnels of the mountains, likely breathing fresh air for the first time.

unit_description_short_texts_text_gun_wa.value_original: Orcs are happy to send out packs of Wargs to feast on their enemies. That means they don't have to risk losing an arm when feeding them.
The uncommon beasts and their cruel riders frighten horses, giving the hosts of Gundabad a way to dispatch of enemy cavalry.
Fast and ferocious, the Warg-scouts of Gundabad scent the enemies before they can be seen.
Sturdy and hardened Mountain Orcs hailing from the peaks of Gundabad. They have come to instill discipline and fear in the lesser goblins who dwell in the Misty Mountains.
unit_description_short_texts_text_gun_wa.value_translated: Robustos y endurecidos orcos de montaña procedentes de las cumbres de Gundabad. Han venido para infundir disciplina y miedo a los trasgos menores que habitan en las Montañas Nubladas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_har_ad.value_original: A line of true Kings in rivalry with those long robbed of purity that now reside in Gondor: that end will these men persue perpetually.
unit_description_short_texts_text_har_ad.value_translated: Una línea de verdaderos reyes en rivalidad con los que hace tiempo fueron despojados de la pureza que ahora residen en Gondor. Hasta el fin perseguirán perpetuamente a estos hombres.

unit_description_short_texts_text_har_ar.value_original: A Captain of Númenórean descent, who pledged his cunning and ruthlessness in allegiance to Harad.
unit_description_short_texts_text_har_ar.value_translated: Un capitán de ascendencia númenórea que juró lealtad a Harad por su astucia y crueldad.

unit_description_short_texts_text_har_bl.value_original: Relatively lightly-armoured, these archer units operate in a fashion of stealth and persevere in the harshest of conditions.
unit_description_short_texts_text_har_bl.value_translated: Con un blindaje relativamente ligero, estas unidades de arqueros operan con sigilo y perseveran en las condiciones más duras.

unit_description_short_texts_text_har_co.value_original: The ships of Umbar are manned by countless archers, letting loose a swift torrent of fiery arrows.
Prepared to fight the guards of merchant vessels, the Marines throw javelins to weaken their foe before they board.
With fierce shouts the Raiders announce themselves as they spring from their decks, taking loot and slaves from hapless villages.

unit_description_short_texts_text_har_de.value_original: Hidden behind dunes, under foreign forests or in the thick of battle, these Haradrim will make their bows sing.
unit_description_short_texts_text_har_de.value_translated: Escondidos tras las dunas, bajo bosques extranjeros o en plena batalla, estos haradrim harán cantar a sus arcos.

unit_description_short_texts_text_har_de.value_original: These men shall free the lands of Harad once and for all, by the strength of their arms, the aim of their eyes and the speed of their horses.
unit_description_short_texts_text_har_de.value_translated: Estos hombres liberarán las tierras de Harad de una vez por todas, con la fuerza de sus armas, la puntería de sus ojos y la velocidad de sus caballos.

unit_description_short_texts_text_har_de.value_original: From the war-torn lands of Harondor to the warmest deserts of Harad, legions of men muster in the hope of serving the Serpent Lord.
unit_description_short_texts_text_har_de.value_translated: Desde las tierras devastadas por la guerra de Harondor hasta los desiertos más cálidos de Harad, legiones de hombres se reúnen con la esperanza de servir al Señor de la Serpiente.

unit_description_short_texts_text_har_de.value_original: None who foolishly venture into the deserts of Harad survive for long once the Trackers have spotted them.
