unit_description_short_texts_text_har_fa.value_original: From the forgotten lands to the south of Far Harad come the cruel Half-trolls. They fire their reflex bows while their thick skin protects them from returned fire.
unit_description_short_texts_text_har_fa.value_translated: Las normas de crueldad se quedan totalmente cortas ante el poder tembloroso de mutantes aterradores nunca antes vistos, inauditos.

unit_description_short_texts_text_har_fa.value_original: From the forgotten lands to the south of Far Harad come the cruel Half-trolls. They wield their bone-crushing clubs while their thick skin turns many a blade.

unit_description_short_texts_text_har_ha.value_original: Harad's weather forecast is twofold: hot with a chance of arrow showers.
unit_description_short_texts_text_har_ha.value_translated: La previsión meteorológica de Harad es doble: calor con probabilidad de chubascos de flechas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_har_ha.value_original: The fierce sun of the Haradwaith demands a sturdier beast to cross its endless dunes.
unit_description_short_texts_text_har_ha.value_translated: El feroz sol del Haradwaith exige una bestia más robusta para cruzar sus interminables dunas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_har_ha.value_original: Be their foe from Gondor or Haradwaith, mounted or on foot, these warriors will hew all before them.
unit_description_short_texts_text_har_ha.value_translated: Sea su enemigo de Gondor o de Haradwaith, montado o a pie, estos guerreros cortarán todo ante ellos.

unit_description_short_texts_text_har_ha.value_original: A southron raid is oft started by a hail of arrows and the stamp of a thousand hoofbeats. Akin to a terrible sandstorm, the desert claims its prey.
unit_description_short_texts_text_har_ha.value_translated: Las incursiones de los sudrones suelen comenzar con una lluvia de flechas y el estampido de mil cascos. Semejante a una terrible tormenta de arena, el desierto reclama su presa.

unit_description_short_texts_text_har_ha.value_original: Swift as the wind, deadly as the desert, cruel as the vulture!
unit_description_short_texts_text_har_ha.value_translated: ¡Rápido como el viento, mortal como el desierto, cruel como el buitre!

unit_description_short_texts_text_har_ha.value_original: The organised legions of Haradrim march and overwhelm their enemies like a storm of sand.
unit_description_short_texts_text_har_ha.value_translated: Las organizadas legiones de haradrim marchan y arrollan a sus enemigos como una tormenta de arena.

unit_description_short_texts_text_har_ha.value_original: The trained warriors of the south wear light wood and leather mesh armour to give them protection from the sword as well as from the desert sun.
unit_description_short_texts_text_har_ha.value_translated: Los guerreros entrenados del sur llevan armaduras ligeras de madera y malla de cuero que les protegen tanto de la espada como del sol del desierto.

unit_description_short_texts_text_har_ma.value_original: Horns from the South, hailing from wild and distant lands, have come in full terror quashing their quaking opponents! Beware the Beast-Tamers of the Mahud and their barbed spears.
unit_description_short_texts_text_har_ma.value_translated: Cuernos del sur. Los más feroces, procedentes de tierras salvajes y lejanas, han llegado aterrorizados para aplastar a las pequeñas filas de temblorosos oponentes. Cuidado con los domadores de bestias de Mahûd y sus lanzas de púas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_har_ma.value_original: The Mahûd tribesmen wield carven clubs, suited to kill both animals and men, as long as they don't wear decent armour.
Mahûd tribesmen rush into battle with terrifying speed and aggression.
unit_description_short_texts_text_har_ma.value_translated: Los miembros de la tribu Mahûd se lanzan a la batalla con una velocidad y una agresividad aterradoras.

unit_description_short_texts_text_har_ma.value_original: These Mahûd tribesmen carry painted shields and simple spears, suited to kill horses and keep enemies at a distance.

unit_description_short_texts_text_har_mu.value_original: Untamed Mûmak suffering no rider and giving little heed to commands.
The legends are true! Behold: wild beasts of war towering above all else have come to trample the lines of the West into the dust!
unit_description_short_texts_text_har_mu.value_translated: Las leyendas son ciertas. Contemplad: ¡bestias salvajes de guerra que se elevan sobre todo lo demás han venido a pisotear las líneas del Oeste hasta convertirlas en polvo!

unit_description_short_texts_text_har_mu.value_original: The legends are true! Behold: wild beasts of war towering above all else have come to trample the lines of the West into the dust!
unit_description_short_texts_text_har_mu.value_translated: Las leyendas son ciertas. Contemplad: ¡bestias salvajes de guerra que se elevan sobre todo lo demás han venido a pisotear las líneas del Oeste hasta convertirlas en polvo!

unit_description_short_texts_text_har_mu.value_original: The legends are true! Behold: wild beasts of war towering above all else have come to trample the lines of the West into the dust!
unit_description_short_texts_text_har_mu.value_translated: Las leyendas son ciertas. Contemplad: ¡bestias salvajes de guerra que se elevan sobre todo lo demás han venido a pisotear las líneas del Oeste hasta convertirlas en polvo!

unit_description_short_texts_text_har_mu.value_original: The legends are true! Behold: wild beasts of war towering above all else have come to trample the lines of the West into the dust!
unit_description_short_texts_text_har_mu.value_translated: Las leyendas son ciertas. Contemplad: ¡bestias salvajes de guerra que se elevan sobre todo lo demás han venido a pisotear las líneas del Oeste hasta convertirlas en polvo!

unit_description_short_texts_text_har_mu.value_original: The legends are true! Behold: wild beasts of war towering above all else have come to trample the lines of the West into the dust!
unit_description_short_texts_text_har_mu.value_translated: Las leyendas son ciertas. Contemplad: ¡bestias salvajes de guerra que se elevan sobre todo lo demás han venido a pisotear las líneas del Oeste hasta convertirlas en polvo!

unit_description_short_texts_text_har_se.value_original: Among the countless arrows of Harad's volley, these men's arrows are surest to hit their marks.
unit_description_short_texts_text_har_se.value_translated: Entre las innumerables flechas de la andanada de Harad, las de estos hombres son las más seguras de dar en el blanco.

unit_description_short_texts_text_har_se.value_original: The heart of the Army of Harad beats in their fell, cunning and wicked chieftains. Their war-cry and thundering hooves lay low any who oppose them.
unit_description_short_texts_text_har_se.value_translated: El corazón de las temibles bestias del ejército de Harad late a través del chillido de guerra de sus terribles, astutos y malvados jefes.

unit_description_short_texts_text_har_se.value_original: Penetrating lines of the Haradrim's fiercest spearmen is as impossible as traversing Harad's desert.
unit_description_short_texts_text_har_se.value_translated: Penetrar las filas de los lanceros haradrim más feroces es tan imposible como atravesar el desierto de Harad...

unit_description_short_texts_text_har_se.value_original: The venom of the Serpent, swinging their glaives with deadly speed.
unit_description_short_texts_text_har_se.value_translated: Rápidos con hachas a dos manos, y silenciosos con capas oscuras pueden despachar a muchos enemigos sin ser vistos.

unit_description_short_texts_text_har_so.value_original: Swift as the wind, deadly as the desert, cruel as the vulture!
unit_description_short_texts_text_har_so.value_translated: ¡Rápido como el viento, mortal como el desierto, cruel como el buitre!

unit_description_short_texts_text_har_um.value_original: Guarding the haven of Umbar, their hatred of Gondor as well as their preference of heavy armour trace back to the descendants of Castamir fleeing from the kin-strife.
Leading the Corsair invasions, their hatred of Gondor as well as their preference of heavy armour trace back to the descendants of Castamir fleeing from the kin-strife.
unit_description_short_texts_text_har_um.value_translated: Por venganza y sed de sangre por sus opresores enemigos del norte, estos hombres se agitan y prosperan; los corsarios han llegado...

unit_description_short_texts_text_iml_ar.value_original: Ten thousand years of skill with a bow enables these elves to slay even the mightiest of foes at great range, and when they do close in, these heavily armored archers may prove to be just as deadly with their swords.
unit_description_short_texts_text_iml_ar.value_translated: Diez mil años de habilidad con el arco permiten a estos elfos matar incluso a los enemigos más poderosos a gran distancia, y cuando se acercan, estos arqueros fuertemente acorazados pueden resultar igual de letales con sus espadas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_iml_ca.value_original: Swift upon their horses, the Noldor charge into battle bringing their honed spears to bear against their foes!
unit_description_short_texts_text_iml_ca.value_translated: Rápidos sobre sus caballos, los Noldor se lanzan a la batalla blandiendo sus afiladas lanzas contra sus enemigos.

unit_description_short_texts_text_iml_gu.value_original: The elite Guard of Imladris is charged with keeping the defense of the Hidden Valley, guarding the gates and bridges leading into Rivendell.
unit_description_short_texts_text_iml_gu.value_translated: Los piqueros de élite de Imladris son los encargados de mantener la defensa del Valle Oculto, custodiando las puertas y puentes que conducen a Rivendel.

unit_description_short_texts_text_iml_ho.value_original: Elladan and Elrohir lead the strongest rangers in a talented guerrilla defence of their lands.
unit_description_short_texts_text_iml_ho.value_translated: Elledan y Elrohir lideran a los exploradores más fuertes en la talentosa defensa guerrillera de sus tierras.

unit_description_short_texts_text_iml_pi.value_original: The Pikemen of Imladris are charged with keeping the defence of the Hidden Valley, guarding the gates and bridges leading into Rivendell.
unit_description_short_texts_text_iml_pi.value_translated: Los piqueros de Imladris son los encargados de mantener la defensa del Valle Oculto, custodiando las puertas y puentes que conducen a Rivendel.

unit_description_short_texts_text_iml_sw.value_original: Strong veterans of countless wars, age old warriors who have no fear nor rivals.
unit_description_short_texts_text_iml_sw.value_translated: Fuertes veteranos de incontables guerras, viejos guerreros que no tienen miedo ni rivales.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_ba.value_original: Crafted according to Saruman's designs, a new siege weapon combining precision and power.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_be.value_original: Ferocious creations of Saruman, these fearless killers take no heed of anything on the battlefield but of satisfying their craving for flesh.
unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_be.value_translated: Feroces creaciones de Saruman, estos intrépidos asesinos no prestan atención a nada en el campo de batalla salvo a satisfacer su ansia de carne.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_bo.value_original: Elite Uruk-hai throwing explosive pots devised by Saruman, blasting apart any resistance.
unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_bo.value_translated: Pequeña unidad que lanza proyectiles explosivos de pólvora negra similares a granadas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_du.value_original: These speedy cavalrymen can do good service in harrying the enemy; a well-placed javelin can bring down even the heaviest armoured Forgoil riders.
unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_du.value_translated: Estos veloces jinetes pueden prestar un gran servicio hostigando al enemigo, pues una jabalina bien lanzada puede derribar incluso a los fuertemente acorazados jinetes Forgoil.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_du.value_original: These speedy cavalrymen can do good service in harrying the enemy; a well-placed javelin can bring down even the heaviest armoured Forgoil riders.
unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_du.value_translated: Estos veloces jinetes pueden prestar un gran servicio hostigando al enemigo, pues una jabalina bien lanzada puede derribar incluso a los fuertemente acorazados jinetes Forgoil.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_du.value_original: Tribesmen from Dunland only need a little encouragement to join to Saruman for a chance to strike back at their Rohirrim enemies.
unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_du.value_translated: Los hombres de las tribus de Dunland solo necesitan un pequeño empujón para unirse a Saruman y tener la oportunidad de vengarse de sus enemigos rohirrim.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_du.value_original: Tribesmen from Dunland only need a little encouragement to join to Saruman for a chance to strike back at their Rohirrim enemies.
unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_du.value_translated: Los hombres de las tribus de Dunland solo necesitan un pequeño empujón para unirse a Saruman y tener la oportunidad de vengarse de sus enemigos rohirrim.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_go.value_original: Captured by Saruman, these goblins will have to undergo everything they're forced to, including battle. Such is the fate of the mountain folk.
unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_go.value_translated: Capturados por Saruman, estos trasgos tendrán que someterse a todo lo que se les obligue, incluida la batalla. Tal es el destino de los montañeses.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_go.value_original: Grim folk wandering the wild paths of Eriador, these brigands have the cunning of men and the cruelty of goblins.
unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_go.value_translated: Cuando se hace referencia a la gente sombría que vaga por los senderos salvajes de Eriador, es probable que se hable de estos bandidos.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_go.value_original: Saruman's first creatures of interbreeding experiments will indeed turn the streets of Eriador grim.
unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_go.value_translated: Las primeras criaturas de los experimentos de mestizaje de Saruman harán que las calles de Eriador se vuelvan sombrías.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_ha.value_original: With their large axes, Saruman's first warriors will break the enemy line, and a man's skull as well!
unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_ha.value_translated: Con sus grandes hachas, los primeros guerreros de Saruman romperán la línea enemiga, ¡y también el cráneo de un hombre!

unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_ha.value_original: Created in unspeakable experiments by Saruman, these Half-orcs are tough enough to stand in the face of a Rohirrim charge.
unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_ha.value_translated: Unidad de lanceros medio orcos. Equivalente defensivo de los hacheros medio orcos. Utiliza la misma armadura con un escudo uruk-hai.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_lu.value_original: With a keen eye, a sharp blade and a strong bow, Lurtz poses a deadly threat to any who oppose him and his master Saruman.
unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_lu.value_translated: Con un ojo agudo, una espada afilada y un arco fuerte, Lurtz representa una amenaza mortal para cualquiera que se oponga a él y a su amo Saruman.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_mo.value_original: One of the strongest Uruk-hai personally selected by Saruman to stain the land with the blood of Rohan.
Numerous and cunning orc archers, with a short bow and light armor.
unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_mo.value_translated: Numerosos y astutos arqueros orcos, con arco corto y armadura ligera.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_mo.value_original: Orc raiders hoping to slay and loot the unprepared, armed in light armor for speed and wielding any weapons they have. Ferocity is their most dangerous tool.
unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_mo.value_translated: Incursores orcos que esperan matar y saquear a los desprevenidos, armados con armaduras ligeras para ser rápidos, y cualquier arma que tengan, la ferocidad es su herramienta más peligrosa.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_sa.value_original: A team of Berserkers carrying the Fire of Orthanc to bring down enemy wall in a siege. This fearsome weapon is crafted using the most advanced alchemical techniques, and once activated it initiates an enormous explosion, turning everything around it into dust.
Saruman of Many Colours, head of the Istari, leading the world into a new age himself.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_ug.value_original: Trusty captain of the Uruk-hai, always intent on bringing meat back on the menu.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_ur.value_original: Well-armoured Uruk archers, who are swift and effective in both skirmishing and melee combat.
unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_ur.value_translated: Arqueros uruk bien armados, rápidos y eficaces tanto en escaramuzas como en combate cuerpo a cuerpo.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_ur.value_original: Heavy armour-penetrating crossbows wielded by strong and wild Uruk-hai, to rain death upon the Free Peoples.
unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_ur.value_translated: Pesadas ballestas penetrantes blandidas por fuertes y salvajes uruk-hai, para hacer llover muerte sobre los Pueblos Libres.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_ur.value_original: This is no rabble of mindless orcs: these are Uruk-hai. Their armour is thick, their shields broad. And they have an insatiable hunger for man-flesh.
unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_ur.value_translated: Esta no es una chusma de orcos descerebrados, estos son uruk-hai. Su armadura es gruesa, sus escudos anchos. Y tienen un hambre insaciable de carne humana.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_ur.value_original: Well trained and wielding pikes, these armoured Uruk-hai provide a wall of resistance against the fearsome Riders of Rohan.
unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_ur.value_translated: Bien entrenados y empuñando picas, estos uruk-hai acorazados proporcionan un muro de resistencia contra los temibles jinetes de Rohan.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_ur.value_original: Incredibly effective raiders, the Uruk-hai are devastatingly effective as hit-and-run troops, as exhibited so well by these sword wielding hunters.
unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_ur.value_translated: Incursores increíblemente eficaces. Los uruk-hai son devastadoramente efectivos como tropas de asalto y huida, como bien demuestran estos cazadores que blanden espadas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_wa.value_original: Orc soldiers mounted on wargs, who charge quickly from their hidden places, and overtake the unsuspecting with cruelty and predatory speed.
unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_wa.value_translated: Soldados orcos montados en huargos, que cargan rápidamente desde sus lugares ocultos y alcanzan a los desprevenidos con crueldad y velocidad depredadora.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_wh.value_original: To storm even the fortresses of Mordor, their heavy shields thwart any attempt of stopping them before they breach the gate.
unit_description_short_texts_text_ise_wh.value_translated: Para siquiera asaltar las fortalezas de Sauron se necesita la fuerza para gobernar toda la Tierra Media.

unit_description_short_texts_text_lin_ar.value_original: The realms of Lindons held on to the ancient tradition of well-armoured infantry that goes back to the Elven kingdoms of the First Age; their archers are no exception. Clad in golden elven plates and with armed with deadly arrows that can pierce even MÃ»makil's hide, few indeed are the orcs who can claim to have faced such volleys and live.
unit_description_short_texts_text_lin_ar.value_translated: El reino de Lindon se aferraron a la antigua tradición de infantería bien blindada que se remonta a los reinos élficos de la Primera Edad, y sus arqueros no son una excepción. Ataviados con placas élficas doradas y armados con mortiferas flechas capaces de atravesar incluso la piel de un Mûmakil, pocos son los orcos que pueden afirmar haberse enfrentado a tales andanadas y haber sobrevivido.

unit_description_short_texts_text_lin_ca.value_original: The Elves are natural riders, and these Noldor have had many lifetimes of Men to hone their formidable skill. Their skill with spear and shield is scarcely to be matched, and there are few enemies who can withstand the charge of their graceful steeds.
unit_description_short_texts_text_lin_ca.value_translated: Los elfos son jinetes por naturaleza, y estos Noldor han tenido muchas vidas de hombres para perfeccionar su formidable habilidad. Su destreza con la lanza y el escudo es difícilmente igualable, y hay pocos enemigos que puedan resistir la carga de sus gráciles corceles.

unit_description_short_texts_text_lin_fa.value_original: Ancient Falathrim stand up in times of need and will defend their ships and beloved coasts.
unit_description_short_texts_text_lin_fa.value_translated: Los antiguos falathrim se alzan en tiempos de necesidad y defenderán sus barcos y sus amadas costas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_lin_gu.value_original: Guarding the Straight Road so that their kinsmen may pass into the West, these Noldorin spearmen fight with unbreakable spirit.

unit_description_short_texts_text_lin_ha.value_original: Descendands of the Falathrim, skilled with the bow on land and on sea.
Swift yet capable Sindar guarding the Gulf of Lune and manning patrol-ships to keep open the Straight Road.
Teleri are also known as the Arrow-elves for their love of archery. Even though they are no veterans of war, their skill with the bow makes them deadly foes.

unit_description_short_texts_text_lin_li.value_original: For the survival of the realm of Lindon, the messages and undertakings of these scouts will prove crucial.
unit_description_short_texts_text_lin_li.value_translated: Para la supervivencia del reino de Lindon, los mensajes y las tareas de estos exploradores resultarán cruciales.

unit_description_short_texts_text_lin_no.value_original: A retinue of Teleri nobles entrusted with their lord's life, these are among the best trained soldiers in the whole of Middle Earth, equally able to stand and hold a critical point in a battle line or to charge the enemy in a rush of glittering blades.
unit_description_short_texts_text_lin_no.value_translated: Un séquito de nobles teleri a los que se les ha confiado la vida de su señor, los cuales se encuentran entre los soldados mejor entrenados de toda la Tierra Media, capaces tanto de mantenerse en un punto crítico de una línea de batalla como de cargar contra el enemigo en una avalancha de relucientes espadas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_lin_no.value_original: Though the High King may be lost, his realm will not fall into shadow while the fiery hearts of the Noldor still defend it.
The Arannaith-i-Mithlond, heroes of Noldorin lineage, have long protected the Grey Haven from danger, choosing to fight with longspears as their liege lord Gil-Galad once did.

unit_description_short_texts_text_lin_sp.value_original: Warriors wielding glittering spears with deadly precision, Noldor Spears are the unyielding bastion of Elven battle line, ready to defend to the last the final fragments of the Firstborn in Endor.
unit_description_short_texts_text_lin_sp.value_translated: Guerreros que blanden lanzas relucientes con precisión mortal. Las lanzas de los Noldor son el bastión inquebrantable de la línea de batalla élfica, listos para defender hasta el final los últimos fragmentos de los Primogénitos en Endor.

unit_description_short_texts_text_lin_sw.value_original: Noldorin Swords are the most renowned champions among the Elven Realm, each Elf claiming a lifespan that outlasts many kingdoms of Middle-earth. Their skill with the greatsword is unmatched, and the mere sight of these mighty warriors is enough to unnerve even the stoutest heart amongst the servants of Sauron.
unit_description_short_texts_text_lin_sw.value_translated: Los espadachines noldorin son los campeones más renombrados de los reinos élficos, y cada uno de ellos tiene una vida que sobrepasa la de muchos reinos de la Tierra Media. Su destreza con la gran espada es inigualable, y la mera visión de estos poderosos guerreros basta para inquietar incluso al corazón más robusto de los siervos de Sauron.

unit_description_short_texts_text_loth_a.value_original: Whosoever breaketh through Lórien's outer parameters is folly to believe the paths along the Amroth river are devoid of sentinels.
unit_description_short_texts_text_loth_a.value_translated: Quienquiera que atraviese las fronteras exteriores de Lórien comete la locura de creer que los caminos a lo largo del río Amroth están desprovistos de centinelas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_loth_c.value_original: Also known by his Telerin name Teleporno, Celeborn the Wise has witnessed the fall of the great Elven realms of the First Age. Under his guidance, that fate shall not befall Lóthlórien.

unit_description_short_texts_text_loth_g.value_original: Unrivalled acumen, senses and shot present a formidable threat from afar, rendering unprepared intruders utterly without chance.
unit_description_short_texts_text_loth_g.value_translated: Su perspicacia, sus sentidos y su puntería sin parangón suponen una amenaza formidable desde lejos, que deja a los intrusos desprevenidos sin ninguna oportunidad.

unit_description_short_texts_text_loth_g.value_original: The Warriors of the Galadhrim suffer no abandonment in defence, even in the hour of the greatest need.
unit_description_short_texts_text_loth_g.value_translated: Los guerreros de los galadhrim no sufren ningún abandono en defensa, ni siquiera en la hora de mayor necesidad.

unit_description_short_texts_text_loth_g.value_original: Fighters of the Golden Wood, the coming of the Galadhrim Warriors is the tide of light and hope, in spite of darkness or danger.
unit_description_short_texts_text_loth_g.value_translated: Luchadores del Bosque Dorado, la llegada de los guerreros galadhrim es la marea de la luz y la esperanza, a pesar de la oscuridad o el peligro.

unit_description_short_texts_text_loth_g.value_original: Should Lórien's fences fall, there remain the last wardens of the Fortress of Trees, the Golden Wood's sacred city.
unit_description_short_texts_text_loth_g.value_translated: Si los cercos de Lórien caen, quedan los últimos guardianes de la fortaleza de los árboles, la ciudad sagrada del Bosque Dorado.

unit_description_short_texts_text_loth_h.value_original: Under the lead of Haldir, the marchwardens of Lórien venture to the outer borders of the forests to keep watch and deal swift death to any intruders.
Though the world be full of peril and dark places, and the toll of defence of sanctity ever increases,fairness grows where love and grief mingle.
unit_description_short_texts_text_loth_h.value_translated: Aunque el mundo esté lleno de peligros y lugares oscuros, y el peaje de la defensa de la santidad aumente sin cesar, la equidad crece donde se mezclan el amor y el dolor.

unit_description_short_texts_text_loth_h.value_original: Lest the reclamation of the Naked Hill is forfeited, the former vanguard of its reconquest holds the precious fortress to the last.
unit_description_short_texts_text_loth_h.value_translated: Para que no se detenga la recuperación de la Colina Desnuda, la antigua vanguardia de su reconquista mantiene la preciosa fortaleza hasta el final.

unit_description_short_texts_text_loth_l.value_original: No defence halts at the outer parameter, and the open Fields of Celebrant that belong to the Galadhrim are not left unchecked.
unit_description_short_texts_text_loth_l.value_translated: Ninguna defensa se detiene en el perímetro exterior, y los abiertos campos del Celebrant que pertenecen a los galadhrim nunca dejan de estar vigilados.

unit_description_short_texts_text_loth_l.value_original: The Galadhrim and their woods are one, so that no enemy eye can spot death coming swiftly as if from the trees themselves.
unit_description_short_texts_text_loth_l.value_translated: Los galadhrim y sus bosques son uno, de modo que ningún ojo enemigo puede detectar la muerte que se acerca velozmente como si surgiera de los propios árboles.

unit_description_short_texts_text_loth_l.value_original: There is no perseverance of Elven life without the sanctity of hallowed woods. Better to forfeit immortal life than see it spoiled.
unit_description_short_texts_text_loth_l.value_translated: No hay perseverancia de la vida élfica sin la santidad de los bosques sagrados. Mejor renunciar a la vida inmortal que verla estropeada.

unit_description_short_texts_text_loth_l.value_original: Not idly do the leaves of Lórien fall, nor its swords lose their sharpness and agility in ultimate defence of what must be saved.
unit_description_short_texts_text_loth_l.value_translated: No en vano caen las hojas de Lórien, ni sus espadas pierden su filo y agilidad en defensa última de lo que debe salvarse.

unit_description_short_texts_text_loth_m.value_original: May last of the Noldor of Lothlórien forfeit their priceless lives for the sanctity of the golden trees which they protect, when Shadow covers all else.
unit_description_short_texts_text_loth_m.value_translated: Que el último de los Noldor de Lothlórien pierda su valiosa vida por la santidad de los árboles dorados que protegen, cuando la Sombra cubra todo lo demás.

unit_description_short_texts_text_loth_n.value_original: The Silverlode and Anduin form a spear-headed angle, the heart of Lothlórien defended by dedicated warriors.
unit_description_short_texts_text_loth_n.value_translated: El Cauce de Plata y el Anduin forman un ángulo en forma de punta de lanza, el corazón de Lothlórien defendido por dedicados guerreros.

unit_description_short_texts_text_loth_n.value_original: Though Nimrodel is long lost, the springs of the river of her namesake are patrolled ceaselessly.
unit_description_short_texts_text_loth_n.value_translated: Aunque Nimrodel hace tiempo que se perdió, los manantiales del río que comparte su nombre son patrullados sin cesar.

unit_description_short_texts_text_loth_t.value_original: Unrivalled is the marksmanship of the Galadhrim, whose crafty bows sing death upon those who would veil the light of EÃ¤rendil.
unit_description_short_texts_text_loth_t.value_translated: No tiene rival la puntería de los galadhrim, cuyos astutos arcos cantan la muerte a quienes velan la luz de Eärendil.

unit_description_short_texts_text_loth_w.value_original: Though the world be full of peril and dark places, and the toll of defence of sanctity ever increases,fairness grows where love and grief mingle.
unit_description_short_texts_text_loth_w.value_translated: Aunque el mundo esté lleno de peligros y lugares oscuros, y el peaje de la defensa de la santidad aumente sin cesar, la equidad crece donde se mezclan el amor y el dolor.

unit_description_short_texts_text_merc_a.value_original: Recruited from the Éothéod people living in the Northen and Southern Anduin valleys, the Éothéod are excellent horsemen like their Rohirrim kin. The hallmark of the Éothéod military tradition, the Éothéod cavalry forces are renowned as effective horsemen with these units comprising the backbone of their forces.
unit_description_short_texts_text_merc_a.value_translated: Reclutados entre los éothéod que viven en los valles del Anduin del Norte y del Sur, los éothéod son excelentes jinetes, como sus parientes Rohirrim. El sello distintivo de la tradición militar éothéod, las fuerzas de caballería éothéod tienen fama de ser jinetes eficaces y estas unidades constituyen la columna vertebral de sus fuerzas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_merc_a.value_original: Military forces recruited from the large Northmen populations living in Rhovanion west of Mirkwood. As traditional among the Northmen, the longbow is a commonly-featuring weapon throughout the vale and befits a lifestyle pivotting around nature. Also equipped with a very small shield on the lower left arm.
unit_description_short_texts_text_merc_a.value_translated: Fuerzas militares reclutadas entre las grandes poblaciones de hombres del norte que viven en Rhovanion, al oeste del Bosque Negro. Como es tradicional entre los hombres del norte, el arco largo es un arma de uso común en todo el valle y corresponde a un estilo de vida que gira en torno a la naturaleza. También va equipado con un escudo muy pequeño en la parte inferior del brazo izquierdo.

unit_description_short_texts_text_merc_b.value_original: Renowned mounted archers, the men of Khand carry powerful composite bows, the design of which has been perfected by centuries of steppe warfare.
unit_description_short_texts_text_merc_b.value_translated: Renombrados arqueros a caballo, los hombres de Khand portan poderosos arcos compuestos, cuyo diseño ha sido perfeccionado por siglos de guerra esteparia.

unit_description_short_texts_text_merc_b.value_original: These men are the grunts of Khand, who are either unable to afford a horse or simply too old to serve on the frontline. While they are normally relegated to second-line duties, their decent skill with javelins and scimitars make them an enemy to be reckoned with, especially under a capable commander.
unit_description_short_texts_text_merc_b.value_translated: Estos hombres son los soldados rasos de Khand, que o bien no pueden permitirse un caballo o simplemente son demasiado viejos para servir en primera línea. Aunque normalmente están relegados a tareas de segunda línea, su decente destreza con las jabalinas y las cimitarras los convierte en un enemigo a tener en cuenta, especialmente bajo un comandante capaz.

unit_description_short_texts_text_merc_b.value_original: Easterling Warriors with more wit and cunning than one might suspect. Beware them on the field of battle!
unit_description_short_texts_text_merc_b.value_translated: Guerreros orientales con más ingenio y astucia de lo que uno podría sospechar. ¡Ten cuidado con ellos en el campo de batalla!

unit_description_short_texts_text_merc_b.value_original: For centuries have the elite cavalrymen of Khand brought great victories to the war-chiefs the steppes, trampling the land of the West under their hooves.
unit_description_short_texts_text_merc_b.value_translated: Durante siglos, la caballería de élite de Khand ha brindado grandes victorias a los jefes guerreros de las estepas, pisoteando la tierra de occidente bajo sus pezuñas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_merc_c.value_original: Protecting the trade caravans from whatever dangers lurk in the sands, for a pretty price.

unit_description_short_texts_text_merc_d.value_original: These guards of Dalian merchants are recruited for a pretty price to accompany foreign armies and alleviate their lack of cavalry forces.
Scouts are as vital to the Northmen as bread is for the commoners. For who else could know what troubles lie beyond wood and wasteland?
Despite many dangers, these men will go out on trading missions for the good of the Kingdom and protect their goods with their lives.
unit_description_short_texts_text_merc_d.value_translated: A pesar de los muchos peligros, estos hombres saldrán en misiones comerciales por el bien del reino y protegerán sus bienes con sus vidas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_merc_d.value_original: Never dismiss a watchful eye: such is the key to preventing the Dragon of the East from surprising the unknowing Dalians.
unit_description_short_texts_text_merc_d.value_translated: Nunca hay que descuidar la vigilancia: ésa es la clave para evitar que el Dragón de Oriente sorprenda a los ignorantes de Valle.

unit_description_short_texts_text_merc_d.value_original: It is folly to wander the desert without a guide if you were not born in it.
In the West, they've ruled with land and sea power. In the South, we need to cultivate desert power.
These are the very weakest of Orcs and their skill with the bow is doubtful at best, but with a large enough volley of arrows some are bound to find their marks.
unit_description_short_texts_text_merc_d.value_translated: Estos son los orcos más débiles y su habilidad con el arco es dudosa en el mejor de los casos, pero pueden lanzar una andanada de flechas lo suficientemente grande para que alguna, con suerte, de al objetivo.

unit_description_short_texts_text_merc_d.value_original: There is little difference in hunting animals or men to these raiders. Enough axes and arrows will do the trick.
With an axe in the right place at the right time, even the lowliest tribesmen can bring down even the greatest of warriors.
unit_description_short_texts_text_merc_d.value_translated: Con un hacha en el lugar adecuado y en el momento oportuno, hasta el miembro más humilde de una tribu puede derribar al más grande de los guerreros.

unit_description_short_texts_text_merc_e.value_original: When an enemy comes near them, they will try to shoot it with their bows, and if that fails, they will jump out of the scrub and rid themselves of their foe.
unit_description_short_texts_text_merc_e.value_translated: Cuando se les acerque un enemigo, intentarán dispararle con sus arcos y, si eso falla, saltarán fuera de los matorrales y se librarán de su enemigo.

unit_description_short_texts_text_merc_e.value_original: All Dwarves are natural warriors. They are tough, battle-hardened and stubborn. Many have experienced the harsh nature of warfare, but have never grown tired of it when war served a cause they would follow.
unit_description_short_texts_text_merc_e.value_translated: Todos los enanos son guerreros por naturaleza. Son duros, aguerridos y testarudos. Muchos han experimentado la dura naturaleza de la guerra, pero nunca se han cansado de ella cuando la guerra servía a una causa que querían seguir.

unit_description_short_texts_text_merc_g.value_original: Masses of goblins clad in leather and armed with a rusty sharp piece of metal, hoping to prey on light enemy units and catch them unprepared.
This band of gnarly goblins has crafted shields by reinforcing planks with sharp metal corners, protecting them somewhat in battle.
These light-footed goblins make sure none make it through the Misty Mountains unnoticed.
These goblins skulk to battle whilst adorned in scavenged gear. The Moon bears witness to their cunning ruthlessness.
unit_description_short_texts_text_merc_g.value_translated: Estos trasgos se escabullen a la batalla ataviados con equipo carroñero. La luna es testigo de su astucia y crueldad.

unit_description_short_texts_text_merc_g.value_original: Patrolling the deep pits under the Misty Mountains, these goblins are tasked with protecting their hoards from men or beasts alike.
unit_description_short_texts_text_merc_g.value_translated: Patrullando las profundas fosas bajo las Montañas Nubladas, estos trasgos tienen la misión de proteger a sus hordas de hombres y bestias.

unit_description_short_texts_text_merc_h.value_original: Harad's weather forecast is twofold: hot with a chance of arrow showers.
unit_description_short_texts_text_merc_h.value_translated: La previsión meteorológica de Harad es doble: calor con probabilidad de chubascos de flechas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_merc_h.value_original: The organised legions of Haradrim march and overwhelm their enemies like a storm of sand.
unit_description_short_texts_text_merc_h.value_translated: Las organizadas legiones de haradrim marchan y arrollan a sus enemigos como una tormenta de arena.

unit_description_short_texts_text_merc_m.value_original: Shock troops of Mordor, with large weapons but little discipline.
unit_description_short_texts_text_merc_m.value_translated: Tropas de choque de Mordor, con grandes armas pero poca disciplina.

unit_description_short_texts_text_merc_m.value_original: Aggressive Orcs with cruel spears and little discipline, waiting to feast on enemy horses and their riders.
A band of ferocious Orcs, supplied with some armour, shields and grim weapons. Do not expect them to defeat disciplined formations.
Where there's a whip, there's a will.

unit_description_short_texts_text_merc_r.value_original: Mail-clad, fierce horsemen from Rohan eager for glory through great deeds.

unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_go.value_original: A twisted Black Númenórean, with a mind of cunning and malice. His cruel strategies have earned him the position as Lieutenant of Minas Morgul.

unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_gu.value_original: You are standing underneath the Towers of the Teeth. Move an inch, and you'll be dead!
unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_gu.value_translated: Estás debajo de las Torres de los Dientes. ¡Muévete un centímetro y morirás!

unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_gu.value_original: Bred for the purpose of war and clad in heavy steel, these archers from Dol Guldur hail death upon enemies from afar.
While lesser Orcs may flee, the Dol Guldur Head Hunters revel in the savagery of combat, for they are the most feared amongst their repulsive kin.
unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_gu.value_translated: Mientras que los orcos menores puede que huyan, los cazadores de cabezas de Dol Guldur se deleitan en el salvajismo del combate, pues son los más temidos entre su repulsiva parentela.

unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_la.value_original: Put together by trolls, these gigantic catapults instill fear in any besieged city: for they throw multiple projectiles at once, trading accuracy for destructive power.

unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_mi.value_original: Small and sneaky, the Raiders are expected to to close with the enemy and deliver volleys into their ranks, an extremely dangerous task that more often than not is intended to only distract the enemy while the main Dol Guldur army manoeuver into position.
unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_mi.value_translated: Pequeños y sigilosos, se espera que los incursores se acerquen al enemigo y lancen andanadas contra sus filas, una tarea extremadamente peligrosa que la mayoría de las veces sólo pretende distraer al enemigo mientras el ejército principal de Dol Guldur maniobra hasta su posición.

unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_mi.value_original: Poorly armoured yet swift and cruel, these Reavers hope to overrun enemies before they can organise defenses.
These are the very weakest of Orcs and their skill with the bow is doubtful at best, but with a large enough volley of arrows some are bound to find their marks.
unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_mi.value_translated: Estos son los orcos más débiles y su habilidad con el arco es dudosa en el mejor de los casos, pero pueden lanzar una andanada de flechas lo suficientemente grande para que alguna, con suerte, de al objetivo.

unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_mo.value_original: Loyal and well trained Uruks that forego the infighting and squabbling of lesser Orcs, for they are the Witch King's personal legions.
unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_mo.value_translated: Uruks leales y bien entrenados que renuncian a las luchas internas y disputas de los orcos menores, ya que son las legiones personales del Rey Brujo.

unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_mo.value_original: Black Orcs from Morgul who wield sword and shield and bring darkness with them.
unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_mo.value_translated: Orcos negros de Morgul que empuñan espada y escudo y traen consigo el miedo a la oscuridad.

unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_mo.value_original: Black Orcs sent out from Minas Morgul to pillage and burn the unprotected countryside.
unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_mo.value_translated: Una de las cinco sedes patriarcales supremas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_mo.value_original: The wolves of Sauron brought into battle by lightly equipped Orcs.
unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_mo.value_translated: Los lobos de Sauron llevados a la batalla por orcos ligeramente equipados.

unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_mo.value_original: Gigantic, strong and cruel, wielding large clubs capable of sending their enemies flying. Though Trolls are not particularly smart, their thick skin makes them hard to kill.
unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_mo.value_translated: Rígida como la piedra es la carne y el hueso de un troll que se sienta solo en las colinas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_na.value_original: Sauron's most terrible servants, leading his armies from horseback. Do not come between the Nazgûl and his prey!

unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_ol.value_original: Trolls, armored in black steel with massive hammers - which they wield effortlessly - make up the mighty shock forces of the Black legion.
unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_ol.value_translated: Los trols, blindados con acero negro y enormes martillos, que blanden sin esfuerzo, forman las poderosas fuerzas de choque de la Legión Negra.

unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_or.value_original: What they lack in discipline and precision, the archers of Mordor make up with their numbers.
Mail-clad pikemen who keep enemy horsemen at bay.
unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_or.value_translated: Los piqueros con cota de malla mantienen a raya a los jinetes enemigos.

unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_or.value_original: Shock troops of Mordor, with large weapons but little discipline.
unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_or.value_translated: Tropas de choque de Mordor, con grandes armas pero poca disciplina.

unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_or.value_original: Numerous and cunning Orc archers, with a short bow and light armor.
unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_or.value_translated: Numerosos y astutos arqueros orcos, con arco corto y armadura ligera.

unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_or.value_original: Orc raiders hoping to slay and loot the unprepared, armed in light armor for speed, and any weapons they have, ferocity is their most dangerous tool.
unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_or.value_translated: Incursores orcos que esperan matar y saquear a los desprevenidos, armados con armaduras ligeras para ser rápidos, y cualquier arma que tengan, la ferocidad es su herramienta más peligrosa.

unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_or.value_original: Aggressive Orcs with cruel spears and little discipline, waiting to feast on enemy horses and their riders.
A band of ferocious Orcs, supplied with some armour, shields and grim weapons. Do not expect them to defeat disciplined formations.
Where there's a whip, there's a will.

unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_ot.value_original: "The Age of Men is over. The Time of the Orc has come."

unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_sa.value_original: He took up again his great Ring in Barad-dur, and wrought himself a new guise, an image of malice and hatred made visible; and the Eye of Sauron the Terrible few could endure.

unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_se.value_original: High men of Númenor brought low by black sorcery. Cruel and twisted servants of evil, yet with great strength.
unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_se.value_translated: Altos hombres de Númenor abatidos por la brujería negra. Crueles y retorcidos sirvientes del mal, pero con gran fuerza.

unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_th.value_original: The Ringwraiths, the Enemy's most terrible servants; darkness goes with them, and they cry with the voices of death.

unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_ur.value_original: Stronger and more cunning than regular Orcs, these Uruks can shoot further and aim better.
unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_ur.value_translated: Muévete un milímetro y perderás, la elección del mal es tuya.

unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_ur.value_original: Only the toughest Uruks, having killed their way up the food chain, may earn the large shield and cloak of the bodyguards.
There is little more terrifying than a full-sized Uruk in heavy armour, screaming with rage and bloodlust.
Disciplined spearmen armoured in mail, the Uruk Spears form a solid defense against cavalry for the armies of Mordor.
unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_ur.value_translated: Disciplinados lanceros blindados con cota de malla, los lanceros uruk forman una sólida defensa contra la caballería para los ejércitos de Mordor.

unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_ur.value_original: Trained and organised legions of uruks, with shields and swords, and a mind to the will of its master.
unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_ur.value_translated: Legiones entrenadas y organizadas de uruks, con escudos y espadas, y una mente a la voluntad de su amo.

unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_wa.value_original: Orcs riding upon fell wargs, making for a swift flanking force and pursuing any who try to flee.
On swift wargs, these Orcs ride ahead to scout the battlefield and catch light troops at unawares.

unit_description_short_texts_text_mor_wi.value_original: It was no brigand or orc-chieftain that ordered the assault upon the Lord of Mordor’s greatest foe. A power and mind of malice guided it.

unit_description_short_texts_text_ondor_.value_original: A towered heavy warship with a crew complement able to tie down any foe on the sea.
unit_description_short_texts_text_ondor_.value_translated: Un buque de guerra pesado con una tripulación capaz de mantener a raya a cualquier enemigo en el mar.

unit_description_short_texts_text_roh_ax.value_original: Well-armed and trained axemen of Rohan, they are ready and eager to form the great shield wall against the enemies of the King.
unit_description_short_texts_text_roh_ax.value_translated: Bien armados y entrenados hacheros de Rohan, listos y ansiosos por formar el gran muro de escudos contra los enemigos del rey.

unit_description_short_texts_text_roh_eo.value_original: Third Marshal of the Riddermark, a valiant and skilled rider dealing swift death to those who threaten the Mark.+
Horsemen hailing from the Eastfold, armed with long spears to deliver a deadly charge.
unit_description_short_texts_text_roh_eo.value_translated: Jinetes fieros, vestidos con cota de malla, de Rohan, ansiosos de gloria a través de grandes hazañas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_roh_eo.value_original: Bow-armed, mail-clad horsemen from the kingdom of Rohan, their strong bows and sturdy arms are a force to be reckoned with.
unit_description_short_texts_text_roh_eo.value_translated: Jinetes armados con arcos y vestidos con cota de malla del reino de Rohan, sus fuertes arcos y robustas armas son una fuerza a tener en cuenta.

unit_description_short_texts_text_roh_eo.value_original: Personally selected for protecting the King's Mark, these horsemen let loose their arrows and then close in for the kill.
Fierce riders of the Westfold, throwing and then swinging their axes at their enemies.
unit_description_short_texts_text_roh_eo.value_translated: Jinetes fieros, vestidos con cota de malla, de Rohan, ansiosos de gloria a través de grandes hazañas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_roh_eo.value_original: Well-trained and capable mail-clad horsemen, the point of their lance is driven forth by a desire for glory.
unit_description_short_texts_text_roh_eo.value_translated: Jinetes bien entrenados y capaces vestidos con cota de malla. La punta de su lanza está impulsada por el deseo de gloria.

unit_description_short_texts_text_roh_eo.value_original: Experienced forces of permanent guards of Rohan townships.
unit_description_short_texts_text_roh_eo.value_translated: Fuerzas experimentadas de guardias permanentes de los municipios de Rohan.

unit_description_short_texts_text_roh_eo.value_original: Well-equipped and experienced swordsmen sword to serve their lord.
Swift riders equipped with shield and spear, trampling and piercing the enemies of Rohan.

unit_description_short_texts_text_roh_er.value_original: Amid them strode a man tall and strong. His shield was red, and he set to his lips a great black horn and blew a ringing blast.

unit_description_short_texts_text_roh_es.value_original: Esquires of the King, they accompany the Knights of the Mark in the field.
unit_description_short_texts_text_roh_es.value_translated: Escuderos del rey, acompañan a los caballeros de la Marca en el campo de batalla.

unit_description_short_texts_text_roh_he.value_original: They are arrayed in the finest armor of the Mark, and wield deadly longbows and brutal iron axes.
unit_description_short_texts_text_roh_he.value_translated: Van ataviados con las mejores armaduras de la Marca y blanden mortíferos arcos largos y brutales hachas de hierro.

unit_description_short_texts_text_roh_ho.value_original: These mounted archers are a deadly mobile unit when kept out of close combat.
Forth! And fear no darkness! Arise! Arise, Riders of Théoden!
unit_description_short_texts_text_roh_ho.value_translated: «¡Avanzad, sin temor a la oscurirdad! ¡Luchad! ¡Luchad, jinetes de Théoden!»

unit_description_short_texts_text_roh_ki.value_original: Selected amongst the most renowned horse-lords, these are the men the King trusts with his life.

unit_description_short_texts_text_roh_me.value_original: Bow-armed, mail-clad horsemen from the kingdom of Rohan, their strong bows and sturdy arms are a force to be reckoned with.
unit_description_short_texts_text_roh_me.value_translated: Jinetes armados con arcos y vestidos con cota de malla del reino de Rohan, sus fuertes arcos y robustas armas son una fuerza a tener en cuenta.

unit_description_short_texts_text_roh_mu.value_original: Proud sons of common fathers, who have taken axe and shield to stand behind the banner of the King.
unit_description_short_texts_text_roh_mu.value_translated: Orgullosos hijos de padres comunes, que han tomado el hacha y el escudo para ponerse detrás del estandarte del rey.

unit_description_short_texts_text_roh_mu.value_original: Young volunteers from the Folde, who fight on foot with spear and shield.
unit_description_short_texts_text_roh_mu.value_translated: Jóvenes voluntarios de los Foldes, que luchan a pie con lanza y escudo.

unit_description_short_texts_text_roh_re.value_original: Sworn to serve the House of Eorl as their forefathers have, the Retinue is known for impeccable horsemanship and undying loyalty to their lord.

unit_description_short_texts_text_roh_ri.value_original: Mail-clad, fierce horsemen from Rohan eager for glory through great deeds.
unit_description_short_texts_text_roh_ri.value_translated: Fieros jinetes de Rohan, vestidos con cota de malla, ansiosos de gloria a través de grandes hazañas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_roh_ro.value_original: Mounted hunters hastily drafted to defend the Mark, employing hit-and-run tactics to harass enemy formations.

unit_description_short_texts_text_roh_sc.value_original: Lightly armored horse skirmishers, with javelins and swords, eager to ride into battle in the service of their King.
unit_description_short_texts_text_roh_sc.value_translated: Escaramuzadores a caballo ligeramente acorazados, con jabalinas y espadas, deseosos de entrar en batalla al servicio de su rey.

unit_description_short_texts_text_roh_sw.value_original: Steady, well equipped, brave, and heavy swordsmen from the plains of Rohan.
unit_description_short_texts_text_roh_sw.value_translated: Firmes, bien equipados, valientes y pesados espadachines de las llanuras de Rohan.

unit_description_short_texts_text_roh_th.value_original: "Arise, arise, Riders of Théoden! Spear shall be shaken, shield shall be splintered, a sword-day, a red day, ere the sun rises!"
Loyal heir to the throne of Rohan, leading the best of his household knights.

unit_description_short_texts_text_roh_wi.value_original: His valour as a wise man, a learned scholar and a just governor is recognised from the Westfold to the halls of Anórien. In memoriam DeAustriae.

unit_description_short_texts_text_roh_ye.value_original: Strong archers from the lands of Rohan, with good armor and strong hunting bows, not to mention sharp and ready swords.
unit_description_short_texts_text_roh_ye.value_translated: Fuertes arqueros de las tierras de Rohan, con buenas armaduras y fuertes arcos de caza, sin olvidar las afiladas y preparadas espadas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_umbar_.value_original: A light ship carrying a scorpion meant to function as the ultimate definition of 'hit-and-run' tactics.
unit_description_short_texts_text_umbar_.value_translated: Una nave ligera que transporta un escorpión destinado a funcionar como la definición definitiva de las tácticas de «golpear y huir».

unit_description_short_texts_text_umbar_.value_original: A light ship carrying deadly naft-throwing marines and firepots to protect against enemy boarding attempts.
unit_description_short_texts_text_umbar_.value_translated: Una nave ligera que transporta mortíferos marines lanzadores de naftas y ollas de fuego para protegerse de los intentos de abordaje enemigos.

unit_description_short_texts_text_umbar_.value_original: A nimble medium ship carrying multiple scorpions meant to pepper and pin down the enemy.
unit_description_short_texts_text_umbar_.value_translated: Una ágil nave mediana que transporta varios escorpiones destinados a acribillar e inmovilizar al enemigo.

unit_description_short_texts_text_umbar_.value_original: Umbar complements its lack of ramming capabilities by equipping light ships with explosive firepots.
unit_description_short_texts_text_umbar_.value_translated: Umbar complementa su falta de capacidad de embestida equipando naves ligeras con ollas explosivas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_umbar_.value_original: The dread-terror of Gondorian marines, this ship is equipped with dragon fire that can do damage to ships large or small.
unit_description_short_texts_text_umbar_.value_translated: El terror encarnado de los marines gondorianos, esta nave está equipada con fuego de dragón que puede hacer daño a naves grandes o pequeñas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_umbar_.value_original: A nimble medium ship armed with grappling hooks to assist its savage corsairs in boarding the enemy.
unit_description_short_texts_text_umbar_.value_translated: Una ágil nave mediana armada con garfios para ayudar a sus salvajes corsarios a abordar al enemigo.

unit_description_short_texts_text_umbar_.value_original: A nimble medium ship that can loose arrows while kiting around valuable enemy targets.
unit_description_short_texts_text_umbar_.value_translated: Una ágil nave mediana que puede soltar flechas mientras merodea alrededor de valiosos objetivos enemigos.

unit_description_short_texts_text_umbar_.value_original: A large, durable warship with a rock-hurling ballista that is more dangerous than it looks.
unit_description_short_texts_text_umbar_.value_translated: Un buque de guerra grande y resistente con una ballesta que lanza rocas y es más peligroso de lo que parece.

unit_description_short_texts_text_umbar_.value_original: 'The serpent is terrible not only in its visage, but because of the fire it spews'. This ship can set alight small and do considerable damage to large ships.
unit_description_short_texts_text_umbar_.value_translated: «La serpiente es terrible no sólo por su aspecto, sino por el fuego que escupe». Puede incendiar barcos pequeños y causar daños considerables a los grandes.

unit_description_short_texts_text_umbar_.value_original: The 'Night Jewel' is the pride of Umbar's navy, decked with royal ribbons and some of the most formidable Men of Middle Earth.
unit_description_short_texts_text_umbar_.value_translated: La «Joya de la Noche» es el orgullo de la armada de Umbar, engalanada con cintas reales y algunos de los hombres más formidables de la Tierra Media.

unit_description_short_texts_text_umbar_.value_original: A large, durable warship filled with a professional complement of Umbar's Númenórean marines.
unit_description_short_texts_text_umbar_.value_translated: Un buque de guerra grande y duradero repleto de una dotación profesional de marines númenóreos de Umbar.

unit_description_short_texts_text_umbar_.value_original: A large, durable warship carrying marines armed with wicked crossbows, raining steel onto enemy decks.
unit_description_short_texts_text_umbar_.value_translated: Un buque de guerra grande y duradero que transporta marines armados con ballestas malvadas, haciendo llover acero sobre las cubiertas enemigas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_wr_elv.value_original: Personal companions of the Elvenking, these warriors are much more than just mere bodyguards.
unit_description_short_texts_text_wr_elv.value_translated: Compañeros personales del Rey de los Elfos, estos guerreros son mucho más que simples guardaespaldas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_wr_for.value_original: Functioning as agile skirmishers, they steal through the forest, leaving no trace for the gaze of the Eye to detect.
unit_description_short_texts_text_wr_for.value_translated: Funcionando como ágiles escaramuzadores, se escabullen por el bosque, sin dejar rastro que la mirada del Ojo pueda detectar.

unit_description_short_texts_text_wr_for.value_original: Skilled in the arts of stealth and ambush, elven rangers move with uncanny speed to strike hard at their enemy with arrows and blades.
unit_description_short_texts_text_wr_for.value_translated: Hábiles en las artes del sigilo y la emboscada, los montaraces elfos se mueven con una velocidad endiablada para golpear con fuerza a su enemigo con flechas y espadas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_wr_for.value_original: While light on their feet, Elves cannot beat the speed of an horse when patrolling the distant outskirts of Mirkwood.
unit_description_short_texts_text_wr_for.value_translated: Aunque ligeros de pies, los elfos no pueden superar la velocidad de un caballo cuando patrullan las lejanas fronteras del Bosque Negro.

unit_description_short_texts_text_wr_for.value_original: Devensive unit of the Woodland Realm used for guarding strategic passages and outposts.
unit_description_short_texts_text_wr_for.value_translated: Unidad defensiva del reino de los bosques utilizada para vigilar pasos estratégicos y puestos avanzados.

unit_description_short_texts_text_wr_for.value_original: As unyielding as the great trees of Mirkwood, these Elves guard the secret path inside the Forest.
unit_description_short_texts_text_wr_for.value_translated: Tan inflexibles como los grandes árboles del Bosque Negro, estos elfos guardan el camino secreto dentro del Bosque.

unit_description_short_texts_text_wr_gat.value_original: Protectors of the Elvenking's Halls and Thranduil himself, the Wardens boast millennia of experience fighting creatures of darkness.
unit_description_short_texts_text_wr_gat.value_translated: Protectores de los Salones del Rey de los Elfos y del propio Thranduil, los guardianes cuentan con milenios de experiencia en la lucha contra las criaturas de la oscuridad.

unit_description_short_texts_text_wr_gur.value_original: The king commands and his rangers ride forth, cleansing the shadow under the pounding of the hooves of their steeds.
unit_description_short_texts_text_wr_gur.value_translated: El rey ordena y sus montaraces cabalgan, limpiando la sombra bajo el golpeteo de los cascos de sus corceles.

unit_description_short_texts_text_wr_hal.value_original: Protectors of the Elvenking's Halls and Thranduil himself, the Guardians boast millennia of experience fighting creatures of darkness.
unit_description_short_texts_text_wr_hal.value_translated: Protectores de los Salones del Rey de los Elfos y del propio Thranduil, los guardianes cuentan con milenios de experiencia en la lucha contra las criaturas de la oscuridad.

unit_description_short_texts_text_wr_las.value_original: Thousand years of skill with a bow enables these elves to slay even the mightiest of foes at great range, and when they do close in, these heavily armored archers may prove to be just as deadly with their swords.
unit_description_short_texts_text_wr_las.value_translated: Miles de años de habilidad con el arco permiten a estos elfos matar incluso a los enemigos más poderosos a gran distancia, y cuando se acercan, estos arqueros fuertemente acorazados pueden resultar igual de letales con sus espadas.

unit_description_short_texts_text_wr_las.value_original: These long-lived nobles of the Silvan Elves go into battle armed with the ancient blades and bows of their households, both of which they wield with deadly precision.
unit_description_short_texts_text_wr_las.value_translated: Estos longevos nobles de los elfos silvanos acuden a la batalla armados con las antiguas espadas y arcos de sus casas, que blanden con mortal precisión.

unit_description_short_texts_text_wr_las.value_original: The elite spears of Mirkwood are charged with keeping the defense of Elvenking's Halls, guarding the gates and bridges leading into the hidden city,
unit_description_short_texts_text_wr_las.value_translated: Las lanzas de élite del Bosque Negro se encargan de mantener la defensa de los Salones del Rey Elfo, vigilando las puertas y puentes que conducen a la ciudad oculta.

unit_description_short_texts_text_wr_las.value_original: Veterans of countless wars against orcs and monsters, these warriors have neither fear nor rivals.
unit_description_short_texts_text_wr_las.value_translated: Veteranos de incontables guerras contra orcos y monstruos, estos guerreros no tienen ni miedo ni rivales.

unit_description_short_texts_text_wr_sil.value_original: Quick and quiet, the Silvan Archers of the Woodland Realm set up ambushes along the Old Forest Road to take their enemies by surprise.
unit_description_short_texts_text_wr_sil.value_translated: Rápidos y silenciosos, los arqueros silvanos del reino de los bosques preparan emboscadas a lo largo del Camino del Bosque Viejo para coger a sus enemigos por sorpresa.

unit_description_short_texts_text_wr_sil.value_original: Hailing from the distant outposts of Greenwood the Great, these Elves have heeded the battle cry of their King.
unit_description_short_texts_text_wr_sil.value_translated: Procedentes de los lejanos puestos avanzados del Gran Bosque Verde, estos elfos han escuchado el grito de guerra de su rey.

unit_description_short_texts_text_wr_sil.value_original: Innate elegance and prowess will have to do for the Elven militia that is rising to defend the Kingdom.
unit_description_short_texts_text_wr_sil.value_translated: La elegancia y la destreza innatas tendrán que bastar para la milicia élfica que se está alzando a defender el Reino.

unit_traits_bullet_text_all_ranks_fire.value_original: all ranks can fire if using a weapon that only allows 1 rank
unit_traits_bullet_text_all_ranks_fire.value_translated: Todas las líneas pueden disparar si se usa un arma que solo permite disparar a la primera linea.

unit_traits_bullet_text_campaign_stealth.value_original: able to move around the campaign map without being seen
unit_traits_bullet_text_campaign_stealth.value_translated: Capaz de moverse por el mapa de la campaña sin ser visto.

unit_traits_bullet_text_disciplined.value_original: doesn't suffer morale penalty from general's death
unit_traits_bullet_text_disciplined.value_translated: No sufre penalización de moral por la muerte del general.

unit_traits_bullet_text_encourages.value_original: provides a morale bonus to nearby allies
unit_traits_bullet_text_encourages.value_translated: Proporciona una bonificación de moral a los aliados cercanos.

unit_traits_bullet_text_fatigue_res.value_original: fatigue doesn't have as much of an effect
unit_traits_bullet_text_fatigue_res.value_translated: La fatiga no tiene tanto efecto como en otras unidades.

unit_traits_bullet_text_formed_attack.value_original: This unit tries to stay in formation when in melee
unit_traits_bullet_text_formed_attack.value_translated: Esta unidad intenta mantenerse en formación cuando está en combate cuerpo a cuerpo.

unit_traits_bullet_text_guerrilla_deploy.value_translated: Puede desplegarse fuera de la zona de despliegue.

unit_traits_bullet_text_ignore_ground_mo.value_original: doesn't get slowed down by terrain

unit_traits_bullet_text_immune_cav_penal.value_original: spears don't get a bonus against this cavalry unit
unit_traits_bullet_text_immune_cav_penal.value_translated: Las lanzas no obtienen bonificación contra esta unidad de caballería.

unit_traits_bullet_text_impetuous.value_translated: Bonificación de moral extra cuando estés ansioso.

unit_traits_bullet_text_mounted_fire.value_original: can fire while on a mount
unit_traits_bullet_text_mounted_fire.value_translated: Puede disparar mientras está en una montura.

unit_traits_bullet_text_resist_cold.value_original: doesn't take extra casualties from these cold climes
unit_traits_bullet_text_resist_cold.value_translated: No sufre bajas adicionales por estos climas fríos.

unit_traits_bullet_text_resist_heat.value_original: doesn't take extra casualties from these hot climes
unit_traits_bullet_text_resist_heat.value_translated: No sufre bajas adicionales por estos climas cálidos.

unit_traits_bullet_text_scare_immune.value_translated: Inmune a los efectos de miedo.

unit_traits_bullet_text_snipe.value_translated: La unidad permanece oculta mientras dispara.

unit_traits_bullet_text_stalk.value_translated: Puede permanecer oculto mientras se mueve.
